```kotlin
enum class ReaderPagePointerOwnership { Pending, Curl, Content, Terminal }

class ReaderPagePointerSequence(
    val gestureId: Long,
    val downX: Float,
    val downY: Float
) {
    var ownership: ReaderPagePointerOwnership = ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Pending
        private set
    var pendingTapGestureId: Long? = null
        private set
    var resolvedContentOutcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome? = null
        private set
    private var terminalOutcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome? = null

    fun moveTo(x: Float, y: Float, touchSlop: Float): ReaderPagePointerOwnership {
        if (ownership != ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Pending) return ownership
        val dx = x - downX
        val dy = y - downY
        if (kotlin.math.abs(dx) <= touchSlop && kotlin.math.abs(dy) <= touchSlop) return ownership
        ownership = if (kotlin.math.abs(dx) > kotlin.math.abs(dy)) {
            ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Curl
        } else {
            ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Content
        }
        return ownership
    }

    fun claimContentAction(): Boolean {
        if (
            ownership != ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Pending &&
            ownership != ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Content
        ) return false
        ownership = ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Content
        resolvedContentOutcome = ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction
        return true
    }

    fun pointerUp() {
        if (
            ownership == ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Pending &&
            resolvedContentOutcome == null
        ) {
            pendingTapGestureId = gestureId
        } else if (ownership != ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Terminal) {
            ownership = ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Terminal
        }
    }

    fun complete(outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome): Boolean {
        if (terminalOutcome != null) return false
        terminalOutcome = outcome
        pendingTapGestureId = null
        resolvedContentOutcome = null
        ownership = ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Terminal
        return true
    }
}
```

Add a host-independent router so Android dispatch is behavior-tested rather than validated only through source strings:

```kotlin
data class ReaderPagePointerBeginResult(
    val gestureId: Long,
    val route: ReaderPagePointerRoute
)

sealed interface ReaderPagePointerRoute {
    data object Content : ReaderPagePointerRoute
    data class ContentTerminal(
        val gestureId: Long,
        val outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ) : ReaderPagePointerRoute
    data object Consume : ReaderPagePointerRoute
    data class ClaimCurl(val gestureId: Long) : ReaderPagePointerRoute
    data class Curl(val gestureId: Long) : ReaderPagePointerRoute
    data class Terminal(
        val gestureId: Long,
        val outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ) : ReaderPagePointerRoute
    data object Ignore : ReaderPagePointerRoute
}

class ReaderPagePointerRouter(
    private val lifecycle: ReaderPageGestureLifecycle,
    private val publishTerminal: (
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
) {
    private val sequences = linkedMapOf<Long, ReaderPagePointerSequence>()
    private var activeGestureId: Long? = null
    private var consumedPointerStreamId: Long? = null
    private var curlClaimed = false

    fun begin(
        downX: Float,
        downY: Float,
        admission: ReaderPageNewPointerDecision
    ): ReaderPagePointerBeginResult {
        check(activeGestureId == null && consumedPointerStreamId == null) {
            "A pointer sequence is already active"
        }
        val gestureId = lifecycle.beginGesture()
        sequences[gestureId] = ReaderPagePointerSequence(gestureId, downX, downY)
        activeGestureId = gestureId
        curlClaimed = false
        return when (admission) {
            ReaderPageNewPointerDecision.Accept ->
                ReaderPagePointerBeginResult(gestureId, ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content)
            is ReaderPageNewPointerDecision.Reject -> {
                check(complete(gestureId, admission.outcome))
                consumedPointerStreamId = gestureId
                ReaderPagePointerBeginResult(
                    gestureId,
                    ReaderPagePointerRoute.Terminal(gestureId, admission.outcome)
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun move(
        x: Float,
        y: Float,
        touchSlop: Float
    ): ReaderPagePointerRoute {
        if (consumedPointerStreamId != null) return ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume
        val sequence = activeGestureId?.let(sequences::get)
            ?: return ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        return when (sequence.moveTo(x, y, touchSlop)) {
            ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Pending,
            ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Content -> ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content
            ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Curl -> if (curlClaimed) {
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.Curl(sequence.gestureId)
            } else {
                curlClaimed = true
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.ClaimCurl(sequence.gestureId)
            }
            ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Terminal -> ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        }
    }

    fun claimContentAction(gestureId: Long): ReaderPagePointerRoute {
        val sequence = sequences[gestureId]
            ?.takeIf { activeGestureId == gestureId }
            ?: return ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        return if (sequence.claimContentAction()) {
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content
        } else {
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        }
    }

    fun pointerUp(gestureId: Long): ReaderPagePointerRoute {
        if (consumedPointerStreamId == gestureId) {
            consumedPointerStreamId = null
            return ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume
        }
        val sequence = sequences[gestureId]
            ?.takeIf { activeGestureId == gestureId }
            ?: return ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        val resolvedContentOutcome = sequence.resolvedContentOutcome
        val route = when {
            sequence.ownership == ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Curl ->
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.Curl(gestureId)
            resolvedContentOutcome != null ->
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.ContentTerminal(
                    gestureId,
                    resolvedContentOutcome
                )
            sequence.ownership == ReaderPagePointerOwnership.Pending ->
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content
            else -> ReaderPagePointerRoute.ContentTerminal(
                gestureId,
                ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledByUser
            )
        }
        sequence.pointerUp()
        activeGestureId = null
        curlClaimed = false
        return route
    }

    fun isDelayedTapPending(gestureId: Long): Boolean =
        sequences[gestureId]?.pendingTapGestureId == gestureId

    fun completeDelayedTap(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ): Boolean {
        require(
            outcome == ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CommittedForward ||
                outcome == ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CommittedBackward ||
                outcome == ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction
        ) { "Unsupported delayed tap outcome: $outcome" }
        val sequence = sequences[gestureId]
            ?.takeIf { it.pendingTapGestureId == gestureId }
            ?: return false
        return complete(gestureId, outcome)
    }

    fun cancel(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ): Boolean = complete(gestureId, outcome)

    fun interruptPhysicalStream(
        gestureId: Long,
        finalStreamEvent: Boolean
    ): ReaderPagePointerRoute {
        if (consumedPointerStreamId == gestureId) {
            if (finalStreamEvent) consumedPointerStreamId = null
            return ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume
        }
        val outcome = sequences[gestureId]
            ?.resolvedContentOutcome
            ?: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledByUser
        val completed = complete(gestureId, outcome)
        if (!finalStreamEvent) consumedPointerStreamId = gestureId
        return if (completed) {
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Terminal(gestureId, outcome)
        } else {
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume
        }
    }

    fun secondaryPointerUp(gestureId: Long): ReaderPagePointerRoute =
        if (consumedPointerStreamId == gestureId) {
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume
        } else {
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        }

    fun cancelAll(
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ): List<Long> {
        val physicalGestureId = activeGestureId
        val cancelled = sequences.keys.toList().filter { gestureId ->
            complete(gestureId, outcome)
        }
        if (physicalGestureId != null && physicalGestureId in cancelled) {
            consumedPointerStreamId = physicalGestureId
        }
        return cancelled
    }

    fun abandonPhysicalPointerStream() {
        check(activeGestureId == null) {
            "An active pointer sequence must be terminal before abandonment"
        }
        consumedPointerStreamId = null
    }

    fun trackedSequenceCount(): Int = sequences.size

    fun complete(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ): Boolean {
        val sequence = sequences[gestureId] ?: return false
        if (!lifecycle.completeGesture(gestureId, outcome)) return false
        check(sequence.complete(outcome)) {
            "Pointer sequence completed before lifecycle gate"
        }
        sequences.remove(gestureId)
        if (activeGestureId == gestureId) {
            activeGestureId = null
            curlClaimed = false
        }
        publishTerminal(gestureId, outcome)
        return true
    }
}
```

`ReaderPagePointerRouter.complete` is the only terminal entry point. It first wins `ReaderPageGestureLifecycle.completeGesture`, then marks/removes the local sequence, then invokes `publishTerminal`. No host or controller code calls the lifecycle directly, and the publication sink never calls it again. Therefore a successful lifecycle compare-and-set always removes router state and emits exactly one external terminal; a stale callback does neither. `consumedPointerStreamId` is a physical-stream tombstone, not gesture lifecycle state. Admission rejection, non-final lifecycle cancellation, and `ACTION_POINTER_DOWN` establish it; `cancelAll` preserves an existing tombstone and establishes one for the active physical sequence it terminalizes. Moves and secondary-pointer-up events remain consumed until the matching final `ACTION_UP`/`ACTION_CANCEL` clears the tombstone through `pointerUp` or `interruptPhysicalStream`. Only a permanently detached/destroyed/closed host may call `abandonPhysicalPointerStream` after it can no longer receive events. That call atomically sets `pointerDeliveryClosed` before clearing router/tokens and is idempotent for detach-plus-release; every later facade event, including a fresh `Down`, returns `ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore` with no gesture ID and cannot allocate lifecycle state.

Add one production Android-facing facade so the host's QA-01 behavior is tested through the same object it uses at runtime rather than through a test-only replica:

```kotlin
internal enum class ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent {
    Detached,
    CanvasDisabled,
    WindowHidden,
    ShellCoverShown,
    Destroyed,
    ReaderClosed,
    RendererReplaced,
    ViewportChanged,
    ReaderSettingsChanged,
    ExternalRelocation,
    RasterProfileInvalidated,
    UnsafeContextLost,
    GlFailed
}

internal val readerPageFinalHostLifecycleEvents = setOf(
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Detached,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Destroyed,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ReaderClosed
)

internal fun ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.cancellationReason():
    ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason = when (this) {
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Detached ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.HostDetached
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.CanvasDisabled,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.WindowHidden,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ShellCoverShown ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.CanvasDisabled
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Destroyed ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.HostDestroyed
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ReaderClosed ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.ReaderExit
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.RendererReplaced ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.RendererReplaced
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ViewportChanged,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ReaderSettingsChanged,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ExternalRelocation,
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.RasterProfileInvalidated ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.RasterProfileInvalidated
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.UnsafeContextLost ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.UnsafeContextLoss
    ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.GlFailed ->
        ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.GlFailure
}

internal data class ReaderPageContentGestureToken(
    val downTimeMillis: Long,
    val gestureId: Long,
    val x: Float,
    val y: Float
)

internal sealed interface ReaderPageHostPointerEvent {
    data class Down(
        val x: Float,
        val y: Float,
        val downTimeMillis: Long
    ) : ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
    data class Move(
        val x: Float,
        val y: Float,
        val touchSlop: Float
    ) : ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
    data object Up : ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
    data object Cancel : ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
    data object SecondaryPointerDown : ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
    data object SecondaryPointerUp : ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
}

internal data class ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
    val gestureId: Long?,
    val route: ReaderPagePointerRoute
)

internal interface ReaderPageHostCancellationPort {
    fun cancelForPointerInterruption(gestureId: Long)

    fun cancelActiveRendererGesture(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    )
    fun cancelReadableViewerDragPreview(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    )
    fun clearNativeTapState(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    )
    fun clearSwipeTouchState(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    )
}

internal class ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController(
    initialPolicy: ReaderPageOperationPolicy,
    private val pointerRouter: ReaderPagePointerRouter,
    private val cancellationPort: ReaderPageHostCancellationPort,
    private val publishLifecycleCancellation: (
        gestureId: Long,
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
) {
    private var operationPolicy = initialPolicy
    private var physicalStreamGestureId: Long? = null
    private var pointerDeliveryClosed = false
    private val contentTokenByGestureId =
        linkedMapOf<Long, ReaderPageContentGestureToken>()

    fun updateOperationPolicy(policy: ReaderPageOperationPolicy) {
        operationPolicy = policy
    }

    fun dispatchPointer(
        event: ReaderPageHostPointerEvent
    ): ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult {
        if (pointerDeliveryClosed) {
            return ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                null,
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
            )
        }
        return when (event) {
            is ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Down -> {
                check(physicalStreamGestureId == null) {
                    "A physical pointer stream is already active"
                }
                val begin = beginPointer(event.x, event.y)
                physicalStreamGestureId = begin.gestureId
                if (begin.route == ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content) {
                    bindContentToken(
                        downTimeMillis = event.downTimeMillis,
                        gestureId = begin.gestureId,
                        x = event.x,
                        y = event.y
                    )
                }
                ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                    begin.gestureId,
                    begin.route
                )
            }
            is ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Move -> {
                val route = movePointer(
                    event.x,
                    event.y,
                    event.touchSlop
                )
                if (route is ReaderPagePointerRoute.ClaimCurl) {
                    releaseContentToken(route.gestureId)
                }
                ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                    physicalStreamGestureId,
                    route
                )
            }
            ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up -> {
                val gestureId = physicalStreamGestureId
                if (gestureId == null) {
                    ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                        null,
                        ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
                    )
                } else {
                    val route = endPointer(gestureId)
                    physicalStreamGestureId = null
                    ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                        gestureId,
                        route
                    )
                }
            }
            ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Cancel ->
                interruptPointer(finalStreamEvent = true)
            ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.SecondaryPointerDown ->
                interruptPointer(finalStreamEvent = false)
            ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.SecondaryPointerUp -> {
                val gestureId = physicalStreamGestureId
                ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                    gestureId,
                    gestureId?.let(pointerRouter::secondaryPointerUp)
                        ?: ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun beginPointer(
        x: Float,
        y: Float
    ): ReaderPagePointerBeginResult =
        pointerRouter.begin(x, y, operationPolicy.newPointer)

    private fun movePointer(
        x: Float,
        y: Float,
        touchSlop: Float
    ): ReaderPagePointerRoute =
        pointerRouter.move(x, y, touchSlop)

    fun claimContentAction(
        downTimeMillis: Long
    ): ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult {
        contentTokenByGestureId.values
            .asSequence()
            .filter { token ->
                token.downTimeMillis == downTimeMillis
            }
            .forEach { token ->
                val route = pointerRouter.claimContentAction(
                    token.gestureId
                )
                if (route != ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore) {
                    return ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                        token.gestureId,
                        route
                    )
                }
            }
        return ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
            null,
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
        )
    }

    fun takeDelayedTap(
        downTimeMillis: Long
    ): ReaderPageContentGestureToken? =
        takeDelayedTapMatching { token ->
            token.downTimeMillis == downTimeMillis
        }

    fun takeOldestDelayedTap(): ReaderPageContentGestureToken? =
        takeDelayedTapMatching { true }

    private fun takeDelayedTapMatching(
        matches: (ReaderPageContentGestureToken) -> Boolean
    ): ReaderPageContentGestureToken? {
        val entry = contentTokenByGestureId
            .entries
            .firstOrNull { (gestureId, token) ->
                matches(token) &&
                    pointerRouter.isDelayedTapPending(gestureId)
            }
            ?: return null
        contentTokenByGestureId.remove(entry.key)
        return entry.value
    }

    fun contentGestureTokenCount(): Int =
        contentTokenByGestureId.size

    private fun bindContentToken(
        downTimeMillis: Long,
        gestureId: Long,
        x: Float,
        y: Float
    ) {
        check(gestureId !in contentTokenByGestureId) {
            "Gesture already has a content token: $gestureId"
        }
        contentTokenByGestureId[gestureId] =
            ReaderPageContentGestureToken(
                downTimeMillis = downTimeMillis,
                gestureId = gestureId,
                x = x,
                y = y
            )
    }

    private fun releaseContentToken(gestureId: Long) {
        contentTokenByGestureId.remove(gestureId)
    }

    private fun endPointer(
        gestureId: Long
    ): ReaderPagePointerRoute =
        pointerRouter.pointerUp(gestureId)

    private fun interruptPointer(
        finalStreamEvent: Boolean
    ): ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult {
        val gestureId = physicalStreamGestureId
            ?: return ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(
                null,
                ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore
            )
        val route = pointerRouter.interruptPhysicalStream(
            gestureId,
            finalStreamEvent
        )
        if (route is ReaderPagePointerRoute.Terminal) {
            releaseContentToken(gestureId)
            cancellationPort.cancelForPointerInterruption(gestureId)
        }
        if (finalStreamEvent) physicalStreamGestureId = null
        return ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult(gestureId, route)
    }

    fun complete(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ): Boolean {
        val completed = pointerRouter.complete(gestureId, outcome)
        if (completed) releaseContentToken(gestureId)
        return completed
    }

    fun completeDelayedTap(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ): Boolean {
        val completed = pointerRouter.completeDelayedTap(
            gestureId,
            outcome
        )
        if (completed) releaseContentToken(gestureId)
        return completed
    }

    fun onLifecycleEvent(
        event: ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent
    ): List<Long> = cancelForLifecycle(event.cancellationReason())

    private fun cancelForLifecycle(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ): List<Long> {
        val cancelled = pointerRouter.cancelAll(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledLifecycle
        )
        cancelled.forEach { gestureId ->
            releaseContentToken(gestureId)
            publishLifecycleCancellation(gestureId, reason)
        }
        cancellationPort.cancelActiveRendererGesture(reason)
        cancellationPort.cancelReadableViewerDragPreview(reason)
        cancellationPort.clearNativeTapState(reason)
        cancellationPort.clearSwipeTouchState(reason)
        return cancelled
    }

    fun abandonPhysicalPointerStream(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ) {
        require(
            reason == ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.HostDetached ||
                reason == ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.HostDestroyed ||
                reason == ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.ReaderExit
        ) { "Pointer abandonment is unsafe for $reason" }
        if (pointerDeliveryClosed) return
        pointerDeliveryClosed = true
        pointerRouter.abandonPhysicalPointerStream()
        physicalStreamGestureId = null
        contentTokenByGestureId.clear()
    }
}
```

`updateOperationPolicy` deliberately has no cancellation or presentation side effect. The actual `KomikkuReaderNativeFrameHost` constructs this facade with adapters for pointer interruption plus the four reason-carrying lifecycle-cleanup operations and a privacy-safe sink that logs `gestureId` plus `ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason`. It routes policy updates, every Android pointer action through `dispatchPointer`, delayed taps, renderer settlements, and every unsafe teardown/invalidation callback through `onLifecycleEvent`. `ReaderPageContentGestureToken(downTimeMillis, gestureId, x, y)` correlates the original content `ACTION_DOWN` with the stable router ID and preserves its coordinates after Android recycles the event; it is not a second lifecycle authority. The facade creates this token only after the router allocates the unique ID and keeps tokens in gesture order while content may still produce a long-press or confirmed-tap callback. Long press selects the matching still-active content sequence. Ordinary confirmed tap selects the oldest matching sequence for which `isDelayedTapPending` is true. `onDoubleTap` selects the oldest prior delayed tap without consulting the second stream's callback event; the current second stream cannot match because it has not reached router `UP` and is not delayed-tap pending. Therefore two streams with the same millisecond `downTime` remain distinct, and the first double-tap action uses the first stream's saved coordinates. Curl claim, terminal completion, lifecycle cancellation, pointer interruption, or final host abandonment releases the association. Both delayed-tap retrieval methods remove the selected association before dispatch, so a second physical stream can begin without overwriting the first tap's identity. The Android host must not call `beginPointer`, `movePointer`, `endPointer`, `interruptPointer`, or `cancelForLifecycle` directly; those are private facade implementation details exercised only through the typed production entry points. The host selects a `ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent`; the production mapper is the only code that chooses the cancellation reason. Only `cancelForLifecycle(reason)` inside the facade may call the reason-carrying lifecycle port methods; readiness transitions, including `Settling`, cannot. Non-final invalidation and interruption retain the consumed-stream tombstone until the physical stream ends. Only actual detachment or `AndroidView.onRelease` may call `abandonPhysicalPointerStream(reason)`, after event delivery is impossible. `ON_DESTROY` alone cancels with `HostDestroyed` but retains the tombstone; if detach or release follows, delivery closure reuses that winning reason.

Use this exhaustive production wiring table; no raw string reason in the host or controller may decide cancellation:

| Actual production path | Typed handling | Physical-stream rule |
|---|---|---|
| `setPageTurnCanvasEnabled(false)` | `onLifecycleEvent(CanvasDisabled)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| `setShellCoverVisible(true)` | `onLifecycleEvent(ShellCoverShown)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| `onWindowVisibilityChanged` to non-visible | `onLifecycleEvent(WindowHidden)` | non-final; retain tombstone until Android delivers cancel/up |
| `replaceViewerContent` | `onLifecycleEvent(RendererReplaced)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| `onSizeChanged` | `onLifecycleEvent(ViewportChanged)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| bitmap quality, snapshot key, reading direction, or pagination settings change | `onLifecycleEvent(ReaderSettingsChanged)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| authoritative non-token Foliate relocation | `onLifecycleEvent(ExternalRelocation)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| explicit profile invalidation from controller/repair logic | `onLifecycleEvent(RasterProfileInvalidated)` | non-final; retain tombstone |
| unrecoverable EGL/context loss | `onLifecycleEvent(UnsafeContextLost)` | non-final unless followed by final destruction |
| terminal renderer/GL failure | `onLifecycleEvent(GlFailed)` | non-final unless followed by final destruction |
| `onDetachedFromWindow` | `onLifecycleEvent(Detached)`, then close physical delivery and abandon after detachment proves no more events can arrive | final cancellation + delivery close |
| `ViewTreeLifecycleOwner` reaches `ON_DESTROY` while still attached | `onLifecycleEvent(Destroyed)` only; retain the frozen dispatch mode and consumed-stream tombstone for any trailing Android events | final cancellation; delivery still open |
| `AndroidView.onRelease` removes this reader host | `onLifecycleEvent(ReaderClosed)`, then close physical delivery and abandon before child composition disposal | final cancellation + delivery close |
| readiness/progress changes including `Settling`, background prefetch, content-ready refresh, exact token acknowledgement, window-visible, shell-cover hidden, targeted current-snapshot refresh, low-memory trim, or retry availability | update the owning state machine only; do **not** call lifecycle cancellation | preserve accepted pointer/settlement |

Wire all three final events to reachable production callbacks rather than exposing unused helper methods. Add `AndroidView(onRelease = { root -> root.closeReader() })` for explicit reader exit. Observe `ViewTreeLifecycleOwner.get(this)?.lifecycle` while the viewer container is attached for final destruction, and use `onDetachedFromWindow` for final detachment.

Final terminal cancellation and physical-delivery closure are separate idempotent gates. `ON_DESTROY` can occur while the view is still attached, so it cancels typed and legacy ownership but does **not** abandon the router stream or clear `physicalDispatchMode`. A trailing move, secondary-pointer action, up, or cancel therefore stays on the frozen imported path and is consumed by the lifecycle tombstone. Only actual detachment or `AndroidView.onRelease` proves that no more Android events can arrive and closes physical delivery:

```kotlin
private var finalHostLifecycleEvent: ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent? = null
private var physicalPointerDeliveryClosed = false
private var task4ResourceTeardownStarted = false
private var observedHostLifecycle: Lifecycle? = null

private val hostLifecycleObserver = object : DefaultLifecycleObserver {
    override fun onDestroy(owner: LifecycleOwner) {
        beginFinalHostLifecycle(ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Destroyed)
    }
}

override fun onAttachedToWindow() {
    super.onAttachedToWindow()
    observedHostLifecycle = ViewTreeLifecycleOwner.get(this)?.lifecycle
        ?.also { lifecycle ->
            lifecycle.addObserver(hostLifecycleObserver)
        }
    playLikeCurlController.onHostAttached()
    requestPageTurnPrewarmWhenReady()
}

override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
    beginFinalHostLifecycle(ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Detached)
    closePhysicalPointerDelivery()
    teardownTask4Resources()
    observedHostLifecycle?.removeObserver(hostLifecycleObserver)
    observedHostLifecycle = null
    super.onDetachedFromWindow()
}

fun closeReader() {
    beginFinalHostLifecycle(ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.ReaderClosed)
    closePhysicalPointerDelivery()
    teardownTask4Resources()
}

private fun beginFinalHostLifecycle(
    event: ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent
) {
    require(event in readerPageFinalHostLifecycleEvents) {
        "Non-final host event passed to final lifecycle gate: $event"
    }
    if (finalHostLifecycleEvent != null) return
    finalHostLifecycleEvent = event
    val reason = event.cancellationReason()
    pageInputSettlementHostController.onLifecycleEvent(event)
    clearLegacyNativeTapState(reason)
}

private fun closePhysicalPointerDelivery() {
    if (physicalPointerDeliveryClosed) return
    physicalPointerDeliveryClosed = true
    val event = checkNotNull(finalHostLifecycleEvent)
    val reason = event.cancellationReason()
    pageInputSettlementHostController.abandonPhysicalPointerStream(reason)
    physicalDispatchMode = null
}

private fun teardownTask4Resources() {
    if (task4ResourceTeardownStarted) return
    task4ResourceTeardownStarted = true
    removePageTurnPrewarmLayoutListener()
    playLikeCurlController.destroy()
    pageRasterPreparationController.destroy()
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement provisional Android dispatch**

Freeze one physical dispatch mode on each `ACTION_DOWN`. The typed router owns only the imported PlayLikeCurl readable-surface path. Native shell-cover gestures and the non-curl rollback path retain the existing Komikku-style child-first dispatcher and a separate gesture detector; they must never consume or complete a delayed callback that belongs to the typed PlayLikeCurl detector.

```kotlin
private enum class ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode {
    Legacy,
    PlayLikeCurl
}

private var physicalDispatchMode: ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode? = null

private fun shouldUsePlayLikeCurlPointerRouter(): Boolean =
    pageTurnCanvasEnabled &&
        !verticalPageDragPreview &&
        !shellCoverVisible

override fun dispatchTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
    if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
        check(physicalDispatchMode == null) {
            "A physical pointer dispatch mode is already active"
        }
        physicalDispatchMode =
            if (shouldUsePlayLikeCurlPointerRouter()) {
                ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.PlayLikeCurl
            } else {
                ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.Legacy
            }
    }

    val handled = when (physicalDispatchMode) {
        ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.PlayLikeCurl ->
            dispatchPlayLikeCurlPointerEvent(event)
        ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.Legacy ->
            dispatchLegacyReaderPointerEvent(event)
        null -> super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
    }

    if (
        event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP ||
        event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL
    ) {
        physicalDispatchMode = null
    }
    return handled
}
```

The mode is physical-stream state, not gesture-terminal state. A non-final lifecycle cancellation keeps `PlayLikeCurl` mode frozen so trailing move, secondary-pointer-up, and final primary events still reach the router tombstone. Only the separate detach/release delivery-close gate, primary `ACTION_UP`, or primary `ACTION_CANCEL` clears it; `ON_DESTROY` while attached does not. A setting, shell-cover, renderer, or readiness change during a stream cannot reroute the tail into the legacy dispatcher.

Extract the current child-first behavior, including shell-cover drag handling and ordinary non-curl navigation, without changing its semantics:

```kotlin
private fun dispatchLegacyReaderPointerEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
    val handled = super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
    handleSwipeTouchEvent(event)
    if (
        !horizontalSwipeDispatched &&
        !nativeSwipeIntercepted &&
        !nativeTapCancelledByDrag
    ) {
        legacyGestureDetector.onTouchEvent(event)
    }
    val consumed =
        handled || nativeSwipeIntercepted || horizontalSwipeDispatched
    if (
        event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP ||
        event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL
    ) {
        clearLegacyNativeTapState()
    }
    return consumed
}
```

Map every Android pointer action in the imported path to the typed facade in one exhaustive helper. No imported-path action may bypass `dispatchPointer` or mutate gesture-terminal state directly:

```kotlin
private fun dispatchPlayLikeCurlPointerEvent(
    event: MotionEvent
): Boolean {
    val pointerEvent: ReaderPageHostPointerEvent? =
        when (event.actionMasked) {
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN ->
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Down(
                    x = event.x,
                    y = event.y,
                    downTimeMillis = event.downTime
                )
            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE ->
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Move(
                    x = event.x,
                    y = event.y,
                    touchSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(context)
                        .scaledTouchSlop
                        .toFloat()
                )
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP ->
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up
            MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL ->
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Cancel
            MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN ->
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.SecondaryPointerDown
            MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP ->
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.SecondaryPointerUp
            else -> null
        }
    val pointerDispatch = pointerEvent?.let(
        pageInputSettlementHostController::dispatchPointer
    )
    return if (pointerDispatch != null) {
        applyPointerRoute(event, pointerDispatch)
    } else {
        super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
    }
}
```

In `onInterceptTouchEvent`, return `false` whenever `physicalDispatchMode == ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.PlayLikeCurl`, so readable WebView content receives the provisional down. Move the existing shell-cover/non-curl interception body into `interceptLegacyReaderPointerEvent(event)` and use it only for `Legacy` mode. The parent still sees every imported-path event first in `dispatchTouchEvent`; a later horizontal `ClaimCurl` cancels the child before PlayLikeCurl receives the retained down and current move. This preserves shell-cover gestures and the tested non-curl rollback while removing the stale contract that PlayLikeCurl owns readable `ACTION_DOWN` before arbitration.

On an imported-path `ACTION_DOWN`, the facade stores the physical stream's gesture ID, binds `ReaderPageContentGestureToken(event.downTime, begin.gestureId)` only when the route is `Content`, freezes the latest `ReaderPageOperationPolicy.newPointer` exactly once, and delegates to `ReaderPagePointerRouter.begin`. The router always allocates the stable gesture ID first. For `Content`, retain `MotionEvent.obtain(event)` as the original down and call `super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)` so WebView selection, vertical motion, long press, and tap candidacy remain functional. For `Terminal`, consume the down immediately, do not forward it to content or PlayLikeCurl, and retain the returned gesture ID only to consume the remainder of that Android pointer stream. This publishes `RejectedPreparing`, `RejectedSettling`, `RejectedRendererUnavailable`, or another admission outcome on the down itself, including down-only taps and tiny moves.

On `ACTION_MOVE`, evaluate only the returned ownership route; admission was frozen at down so readiness changes caused by the accepted gesture cannot reject its own settlement.

When the route first becomes `ClaimCurl`:

1. Dispatch an `ACTION_CANCEL` copy to `super.dispatchTouchEvent`.
2. Send the retained original `ACTION_DOWN` to `playLikeCurlController.onPageTouchEvent` with the sequence's ID.
3. Send the current move to PlayLikeCurl.
4. Set `playLikeCurlGestureOwned = true`.

When the host's timer confirms a long press before `ACTION_UP`, pass `event.downTime` to `pageInputSettlementHostController.claimContentAction(downTimeMillis)`. The result carries the original gesture ID; it succeeds only for the matching active `Pending` or already-`Content` sequence, records `CompletedTapAction` as the resolved content outcome, and prevents every later horizontal move from claiming curl. Continue forwarding content-owned movement so WebView selection/long-press behavior remains usable. For `Content`, never send events to PlayLikeCurl. For `Consume`, consume the event without forwarding it. Route final `ACTION_UP` through `dispatchPointer(ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up)` and final `ACTION_CANCEL` through `dispatchPointer(ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Cancel)`. Route `ACTION_POINTER_DOWN` through `SecondaryPointerDown`: it terminalizes an accepted sequence once as `CancelledByUser`, except that an already completed long-press/content action preserves its resolved `CompletedTapAction`; it invokes `cancelForPointerInterruption(gestureId)` and leaves a consumed-stream tombstone. Route `ACTION_POINTER_UP` through `SecondaryPointerUp`; it consumes without clearing that tombstone. The later primary up/cancel clears the marker, and an admission rejection or earlier lifecycle terminal cannot be published again.

Apply the returned route in one production helper. This is the only code allowed to forward a pointer to content or PlayLikeCurl:

```kotlin
private var retainedContentDown: MotionEvent? = null

private fun applyPointerRoute(
    event: MotionEvent,
    dispatch: ReaderPageHostPointerDispatchResult
): Boolean = when (val route = dispatch.route) {
    ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content -> {
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
            retainedContentDown?.recycle()
            retainedContentDown = MotionEvent.obtain(event)
        }
        val handled = super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
        playLikeCurlGestureDetector.onTouchEvent(event)
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) {
            recycleRetainedContentDown()
            clearPlayLikeCurlPointerTapFlagsAfterUp()
        }
        handled
    }
    is ReaderPagePointerRoute.ContentTerminal -> {
        val handled = super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
        playLikeCurlGestureDetector.onTouchEvent(event)
        pageInputSettlementHostController.complete(
            route.gestureId,
            route.outcome
        )
        recycleRetainedContentDown()
        clearPlayLikeCurlPointerTapFlagsAfterUp()
        handled
    }
    is ReaderPagePointerRoute.ClaimCurl -> {
        dispatchContentCancel(event)
        val originalDown = checkNotNull(retainedContentDown) {
            "Curl claim has no retained content DOWN"
        }
        val downResult = playLikeCurlController.onPageTouchEvent(
            originalDown,
            route.gestureId
        )
        recycleRetainedContentDown()
        when (downResult) {
            ReaderPageCurlDispatchResult.Accepted -> {
                playLikeCurlController.onPageTouchEvent(
                    event,
                    route.gestureId
                )
                playLikeCurlGestureOwned = true
            }
            ReaderPageCurlDispatchResult.TerminalPublished -> {
                playLikeCurlGestureOwned = false
                clearPlayLikeCurlPointerTapFlagsAfterUp()
            }
        }
        true
    }
    is ReaderPagePointerRoute.Curl -> {
        playLikeCurlController.onPageTouchEvent(
            event,
            route.gestureId
        )
        if (
            event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP ||
            event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL
        ) {
            playLikeCurlGestureOwned = false
            clearPlayLikeCurlPointerTapFlagsAfterUp()
        }
        true
    }
    is ReaderPagePointerRoute.Terminal -> {
        dispatchContentCancel(event)
        recycleRetainedContentDown()
        playLikeCurlGestureOwned = false
        true
    }
    ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume -> true
    ReaderPagePointerRoute.Ignore -> true
}

private fun dispatchContentCancel(source: MotionEvent? = null) {
    val retainedDown = retainedContentDown ?: return
    val cancel = MotionEvent.obtain(source ?: retainedDown).apply {
        action = MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL
    }
    try {
        super.dispatchTouchEvent(cancel)
        playLikeCurlGestureDetector.cancelForDrag(cancel)
    } finally {
        cancel.recycle()
    }
}

private fun recycleRetainedContentDown() {
    retainedContentDown?.recycle()
    retainedContentDown = null
}

private fun clearPlayLikeCurlPointerTapFlagsAfterUp() {
    nativeTapCandidate = false
    nativeTapLongConfirmed = false
}
```

Every forwarded primary `ACTION_UP`, including a delayed-tap candidate, recycles `retainedContentDown`; only the collision-safe token survives for asynchronous confirmation by `playLikeCurlGestureDetector`. `dispatchContentCancel` checks `retainedContentDown` only as evidence that imported readable content received the original down; it never forwards a rejected down or a tombstoned trailing event. The host implementations of both `cancelForPointerInterruption` and reason-carrying `clearPlayLikeCurlNativeTapState` call `dispatchContentCancel()`, cancel `playLikeCurlGestureDetector`, and call `recycleRetainedContentDown()`. The legacy path has its own `legacyGestureDetector` and `clearLegacyNativeTapState`; neither detector may complete or cancel the other path's delayed callback. On first `ClaimCurl`, source order must be content `ACTION_CANCEL`, retained original `ACTION_DOWN` to PlayLikeCurl, current move to PlayLikeCurl, then ownership flag. `cancelForPointerInterruption` and lifecycle cancellation cancel the renderer/preview/typed-tap owners, while `applyPointerRoute(Terminal)` delivers the matching child cancellation for the current imported-path Android event. Unknown non-pointer actions for which `pointerEvent == null` may use the existing superclass path; every one of the six mapped imported-path pointer actions must use `applyPointerRoute`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Preserve the ID through delayed tap and route every terminal through one host gate**

Remove `currentPageGestureId` and direct host ownership of `ReaderPageGestureLifecycle`; `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController` is the host's only route to `ReaderPagePointerRouter`. Instantiate two `KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap` objects with distinct listeners: `legacyGestureDetector` retains the existing shell-cover/non-curl tap and long-press behavior, while `playLikeCurlGestureDetector` is the only detector allowed to resolve or complete a typed gesture ID. Never fall back from a missing typed token into the legacy listener.

For the imported path, route every `ACTION_UP` through `dispatchPointer(ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up)` and every `ACTION_CANCEL` through `dispatchPointer(ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Cancel)`. The router derives tap candidacy from its own ownership state: only a sequence still `Pending` at `UP` becomes a delayed tap, while vertical/content movement returns `ContentTerminal(CancelledByUser)` and curl ownership remains in flight. Host-global tap flags are not part of typed terminal accounting. A delayed tap remains in the router while a later pointer may begin. The typed single-tap listener calls `takeDelayedTap(downTimeMillis = event.downTime)`; the facade selects and removes the oldest matching pending-tap token and returns its original ID and original coordinates. Android calls `onDoubleTap` during the second stream, before that stream's `UP`; this callback must instead call `takeOldestDelayedTap()` and dispatch the first pending tap from its stored coordinates. The second stream is resolved only from `onDoubleTapEvent(ACTION_UP)` through its own `downTime`. A later suppressed or unexpected `onSingleTapConfirmed` sees no first token and is inert. A PlayLikeCurl edge tap passes the returned ID to `turn`: an accepted renderer turn returns `Settling` and keeps the ID pending until renderer settlement, while a synchronous controller rejection or failure returns controller-owned `TerminalPublished` after publishing the exact terminal through `onGestureTerminal`. The host never completes either result again. A successfully handled center/menu or chrome-gated action returns host-owned `CompleteInHost(CompletedTapAction)`. A missing token means curl claim or another terminal already won, so the typed callback returns without allocating a replacement ID, publishing another terminal, or invoking legacy navigation. Preserve the existing chrome gate after resolving the tap zone: when chrome is visible and the action is not `MENU`, do not navigate and complete the original ID once as `CompletedTapAction`; center `MENU` remains allowed to hide chrome. A confirmed typed long press calls `claimContentAction` before `UP`; its final `dispatchPointer(ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up)` returns a dispatch result whose route is `ContentTerminal(gestureId, CompletedTapAction)`. The host forwards that `UP` to content first and then calls the facade's `complete` with the route's outcome. If lifecycle cancellation won first, completion returns false and the final `UP` cannot publish again. A typed content-owned non-tap `UP` forwards to content and then completes as `CancelledByUser`; a curl-owned `UP` forwards to PlayLikeCurl and remains in-flight until settlement. Explicit user cancellation uses `CancelledByUser`; detach/disable/destroy and other unsafe lifecycle paths call `onLifecycleEvent` with the exact typed host event and let the production mapper choose the reason; unrecoverable repair uses `FailedRecovery`.

The legacy listener never calls `takeDelayedTap`, `takeOldestDelayedTap`, `claimContentAction`, or `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController.complete`; it invokes the existing non-curl/shell-cover action path directly. Neither delayed single-tap callback may read `nativeTapCandidate`, `nativeTapLongConfirmed`, or `nativeTapCancelledByDrag`: a newer physical stream may already have changed those mutable flags before delayed confirmation arrives. Both detectors must receive explicit `ACTION_CANCEL` through their owner-specific `cancelForDrag` path when drag or lifecycle cancellation wins. The typed ordinary callback has the additional admission of callback `downTime` resolved to a collision-safe token whose router sequence is still in `pendingTapGestureId` state. The first double-tap callback has no event-identity admission: it resolves only the oldest already-pending delayed tap and always uses that token's saved coordinates.

Define the tap-turn start contract beside `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController`. `TerminalPublished` means the controller has already invoked its `onGestureTerminal` callback with this exact ID, outcome, and detail before returning. The Android host must not complete that ID again:

```kotlin
internal sealed interface ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail {
    data class RendererRejected(
        val generationId: Long,
        val reason: GestureRejectionReason
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class RendererCancelled(
        val generationId: Long
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class SettlementCompleted(
        val pageChange: PageChange,
        val ordinal: Int
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class SettlementCancelled(
        val generationId: Long
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class TouchRejected(
        val actionMasked: Int
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class TapTurnUnavailable(
        val pageChange: PageChange
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class RelocationCapacityUnavailable(
        val occupied: Int,
        val capacity: Int
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class RelocationReservationProtocolFailure(
        val gestureId: Long
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class TouchProtocolFailure(
        val actionMasked: Int
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class TapTurnProtocolFailure(
        val pageChange: PageChange
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class RelocationGenerationOrSessionDrift(
        val gestureId: Long
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data object ControllerCancelled : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data class RenderFailed(
        val generationId: Long,
        val reason: RenderFailureReason
    ) : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail

    data object RecoveryFailed : ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
}

internal sealed interface ReaderPageTurnStartResult {
    data object Settling : ReaderPageTurnStartResult

    data class TerminalPublished(
        val outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        val detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ) : ReaderPageTurnStartResult
}

internal sealed interface ReaderPageCurlDispatchResult {
    data object Accepted : ReaderPageCurlDispatchResult
    data object TerminalPublished : ReaderPageCurlDispatchResult
}

internal sealed interface ReaderPageTapDispatchResult {
    data object Settling : ReaderPageTapDispatchResult
    data object TerminalPublished : ReaderPageTapDispatchResult

    data class CompleteInHost(
        val outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ) : ReaderPageTapDispatchResult
}
```

`ReaderPageTurnStartResult` has one publication owner: the controller callback adapter. Unavailable, boundary, settlement-running, or other synchronous renderer rejection calls the adapter before `turn` returns `TerminalPublished`; accepted settlement returns `Settling` and publishes only from the later renderer callback. `ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail` is deliberately closed over numeric generations/ordinals, Android action constants, and library enums. It cannot carry logical page IDs, hrefs, CFIs, book IDs, EPUB text, selected text, annotations, transcript content, URLs, or arbitrary exception messages. `ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.CompleteInHost` is reserved for a successfully handled non-renderer tap such as the center menu action. The typed production callbacks therefore resolve original identity and disposition from the facade instead of a mutable current-ID or current-stream field:

```kotlin
private val legacyGestureDetector = KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap(
    context,
    object : KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap.Listener() {
        override fun onSingleTapConfirmed(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
            onLegacySingleTapConfirmed(event)

        override fun onDoubleTap(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
            onLegacySingleTapConfirmed(event)

        override fun onDoubleTapEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
            if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) {
                onLegacySingleTapConfirmed(event)
            } else {
                true
            }

        override fun onLongTapConfirmed(event: MotionEvent) {
            nativeTapLongConfirmed = true
            performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.LONG_PRESS)
            onContentLongPress(event.x, event.y, width, height)
        }
    }
)

private val playLikeCurlGestureDetector =
    KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap(
        context,
        object : KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap.Listener() {
            override fun onSingleTapConfirmed(
                event: MotionEvent
            ): Boolean = onPlayLikeCurlSingleTapConfirmed(
                downTimeMillis = event.downTime
            )

            override fun onDoubleTap(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
                onPlayLikeCurlFirstDoubleTapConfirmed()

            override fun onDoubleTapEvent(
                event: MotionEvent
            ): Boolean =
                if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) {
                    onPlayLikeCurlSingleTapConfirmed(
                        downTimeMillis = event.downTime
                    )
                } else {
                    true
                }

            override fun onLongTapConfirmed(event: MotionEvent) {
                val dispatch =
                    pageInputSettlementHostController.claimContentAction(
                        downTimeMillis = event.downTime
                    )
                if (dispatch.route != ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content) return
                nativeTapLongConfirmed = true
                performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.LONG_PRESS)
                onContentLongPress(event.x, event.y, width, height)
            }
        }
    )

private fun onLegacySingleTapConfirmed(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return false
    val point = KomikkuPoint(
        x = (event.x / width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
        y = (event.y / height.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    )
    val action = if (shellCoverVisible) {
        shellCoverNavigator.getAction(point)
    } else {
        navigator.getAction(point)
    }
    if (
        chromeOverlayVisible &&
        action != KomikkuNavigationRegion.MENU
    ) return true
    dispatchLegacySingleTapAction(action)
    return true
}

private fun onPlayLikeCurlSingleTapConfirmed(
    downTimeMillis: Long
): Boolean {
    val tap = pageInputSettlementHostController.takeDelayedTap(
        downTimeMillis = downTimeMillis
    ) ?: return false
    return dispatchPlayLikeCurlDelayedTap(tap)
}

private fun onPlayLikeCurlFirstDoubleTapConfirmed(): Boolean {
    val tap = pageInputSettlementHostController
        .takeOldestDelayedTap()
        ?: return false
    return dispatchPlayLikeCurlDelayedTap(tap)
}

private fun dispatchPlayLikeCurlDelayedTap(
    tap: ReaderPageContentGestureToken
): Boolean {
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
        pageInputSettlementHostController.completeDelayedTap(
            tap.gestureId,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledByUser
        )
        return false
    }
    val point = KomikkuPoint(
        x = (tap.x / width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
        y = (tap.y / height.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    )
    val action = navigator.getAction(point)
    if (
        chromeOverlayVisible &&
        action != KomikkuNavigationRegion.MENU
    ) {
        pageInputSettlementHostController.completeDelayedTap(
            tap.gestureId,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction
        )
        return true
    }
    when (
        val result = dispatchPlayLikeCurlSingleTapAction(
            action = action,
            gestureId = tap.gestureId
        )
    ) {
        ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.Settling,
        ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.TerminalPublished -> Unit

        is ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.CompleteInHost -> {
            pageInputSettlementHostController.completeDelayedTap(
                tap.gestureId,
                result.outcome
            )
        }
    }
    return true
}
```

Because `KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap.Listener` is also an Android double-tap listener, leaving the default `onDoubleTap` behavior would suppress `onSingleTapConfirmed` and strand one or two pending router IDs. Android invokes `onDoubleTap` from the second stream before its `ACTION_UP`, and the callback event identifies that second stream rather than the first tap. Therefore `onDoubleTap` removes the oldest already-pending delayed token and dispatches from that token's saved first-tap coordinates. `onDoubleTapEvent(secondUp)` resolves the second token by its own `downTime` only after router `UP` has made it delayed-tap pending. Intermediate double-tap events return `true` without publishing. A later suppressed or replayed `onSingleTapConfirmed` finds no first token. A curl claim or lifecycle cancellation removes its token first, so either callback safely returns `false` rather than falling through.

`dispatchLegacySingleTapAction(action)` retains the current shell-cover and non-curl action behavior and never calls the typed facade. Implement the typed dispatcher with an explicit result conversion; it must never call `beginGesture`, read a current-ID field, synthesize an ID when the token is absent, or fall through to `dispatchLegacySingleTapAction`:

```kotlin
private fun dispatchPlayLikeCurlSingleTapAction(
    action: KomikkuNavigationRegion,
    gestureId: Long
): ReaderPageTapDispatchResult {
    val pageChange = playLikeCurlPageChangeFor(action)
    if (pageChange != null) {
        return when (
            tapTurnController.turn(gestureId, pageChange)
        ) {
            ReaderPageTurnStartResult.Settling ->
                ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.Settling

            is ReaderPageTurnStartResult.TerminalPublished ->
                ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.TerminalPublished
        }
    }

    onAction(action)
    return ReaderPageTapDispatchResult.CompleteInHost(
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction
    )
}
```

`ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController` implements `ReaderPageTapTurnPort`; add `: ReaderPageTapTurnPort` to its existing class declaration. The host constructs the facade and no production call site invokes the controller's internal tap method directly. The controller installs the facade-provided terminal sink before renderer admission, retains it across asynchronous settlement, and removes it exactly once in `finishGesture`. Drag gestures continue to use the constructor's `onGestureTerminal` sink. Add these members inside the controller:

```kotlin
private var tapTurnGestureId: Long? = null
    private var tapTurnTerminalSink: ((
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ) -> Boolean)? = null
    private var synchronousTurnGestureId: Long? = null
    private var synchronousTurnTerminal:
        ReaderPageTurnStartResult.TerminalPublished? = null

    override fun start(
        gestureId: Long,
        pageChange: PageChange,
        onTerminal: (
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
        ) -> Boolean
    ): ReaderPageTurnStartResult {
        check(tapTurnGestureId == null && tapTurnTerminalSink == null) {
            "A tap turn terminal sink is already installed"
        }
        tapTurnGestureId = gestureId
        tapTurnTerminalSink = onTerminal
        return try {
            startTapTurn(pageChange, gestureId)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            if (tapTurnGestureId == gestureId) {
                tapTurnGestureId = null
                tapTurnTerminalSink = null
            }
            throw failure
        }
    }

    private fun startTapTurn(
        pageChange: PageChange,
        gestureId: Long
    ): ReaderPageTurnStartResult {
        check(synchronousTurnGestureId == null) {
            "A tap turn is already starting"
        }
        activeGestureId = gestureId
        synchronousTurnGestureId = gestureId
        synchronousTurnTerminal = null

        return try {
            if (!isAvailable) {
                finishGesture(
                    gestureId,
                    ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
                        .RejectedRendererUnavailable,
                    ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.TapTurnUnavailable(
                        pageChange
                    )
                )
                checkNotNull(synchronousTurnTerminal)
            } else {
                surfaceView.alpha = 1f
                val accepted = surfaceView.turn(pageChange, gestureId)
                if (accepted) {
                    ReaderPageTurnStartResult.Settling
                } else {
                    hideSurface()
                    synchronousTurnTerminal ?: run {
                        finishGesture(
                            gestureId,
                            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.FailedRenderer,
                            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
                                .TapTurnProtocolFailure(pageChange)
                        )
                        checkNotNull(synchronousTurnTerminal)
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            synchronousTurnGestureId = null
            synchronousTurnTerminal = null
        }
    }

    private fun finishGesture(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ): Boolean {
        if (activeGestureId == gestureId) activeGestureId = null
        val tapSink = if (tapTurnGestureId == gestureId) {
            tapTurnGestureId = null
            tapTurnTerminalSink.also { tapTurnTerminalSink = null }
        } else {
            null
        }
        val published = if (tapSink == null) {
            onGestureTerminal(gestureId, outcome, detail)
        } else {
            tapSink(outcome, detail)
        }
        if (synchronousTurnGestureId == gestureId) {
            check(published) { "Synchronous renderer terminal lost the host CAS" }
            check(synchronousTurnTerminal == null) {
                "Tap turn published more than one synchronous terminal"
            }
            synchronousTurnTerminal =
                ReaderPageTurnStartResult.TerminalPublished(
                    outcome = outcome,
                    detail = detail
                )
        }
        return published
    }
```

If renderer admission throws, `start` clears the still-owned sink before propagating. If it returns `Settling`, the sink remains until the settlement callback. Every synchronous rejection invokes `finishGesture` before returning `TerminalPublished`, so the facade observes the callback and never publishes a fallback duplicate. Never invoke the sink directly anywhere else.

The controller constructor's terminal callback uses the same CAS result throughout Tasks 4 and 10:

```kotlin
onGestureTerminal: (
    gestureId: Long,
    outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
    detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
) -> Boolean
```

Task 3 must make every synchronous PlayLikeCurl rejection call `onGestureRejected` before `PageSurfaceView.turn` returns `false`: `BOUNDARY` maps to `RejectedBoundary`, `SETTLEMENT_RUNNING` maps to `RejectedSettling`, and every other unavailable state maps to `RejectedRendererUnavailable`. The `FailedRenderer` fallback above is an invariant alarm for a library `false` result without a terminal callback; it is not the normal boundary path.

Migrate every controller terminal call site to the closed detail type in the same change. Use these exact mappings:

```kotlin
// PageSurfaceListener callbacks
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RendererRejected(
    generationId,
    reason
)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RendererCancelled(generationId)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.SettlementCompleted(
    pageChange,
    currentPageOrdinal
)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.SettlementCancelled(generationId)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RenderFailed(
    failure.generationId,
    failure.reason
)

// Host/controller paths
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.TouchRejected(event.actionMasked)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.TapTurnUnavailable(pageChange)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.TapTurnProtocolFailure(pageChange)
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.ControllerCancelled
ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RecoveryFailed
```

Do not pass `sourceLogicalPageId`, `targetLogicalPageId`, `currentLogicalPageId`, `webView.url`, `sourceIdentity`, `href`, CFI, book identity, `failure.message`, or `failure.cause` into terminal details or logs. Replace the three existing settlement log messages with these privacy-safe forms; callback parameters may remain because the imported interface requires them, but production logging must not interpolate them:

```kotlin
Logger.i(
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateControllerTag,
    "PlayLikeCurl settlement started gestureId=$gestureId " +
        "generation=$generationId change=$pageChange"
)
Logger.i(
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateControllerTag,
    "PlayLikeCurl settlement completed generation=$generationId " +
        "ordinal=$currentPageOrdinal change=$pageChange " +
        "exactDispatch=${pageChange != PageChange.NONE}"
)
Logger.i(
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateControllerTag,
    "PlayLikeCurl settlement cancelled generation=$generationId"

```

Install one complete controller-terminal adapter in the Android host and pass only that adapter to `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController`:

```kotlin
private val playLikeCurlController =
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController(
        host = this,
        webViewProvider = {
            viewerContentContainer.findDescendantWebView()
        },
        bundleSource = pageTurnBundleSource,
        onRequestPrewarm = ::requestPageTurnPrewarmWhenReady,
        onRequestRasterRepair = ::requestPageRasterRepair,
        onGestureTerminal = { gestureId, outcome, detail ->
            completePageGesture(gestureId, outcome, detail)
        },
        onReadinessStateChange = ::onRendererReadinessChanged
    )

private val tapTurnController = ReaderPageTapTurnControllerFacade(
    port = playLikeCurlController,
    publishTerminal = ::completePageGesture
)

private fun completePageGesture(
    gestureId: Long,
    outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
    detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
): Boolean {
    val won = pageInputSettlementHostController.complete(
        gestureId,
        outcome
    )
    logGestureTerminal(
        gestureId = gestureId,
        outcome = outcome,
        detail = detail,
        won = won
    )
    return won
}

private fun logGestureTerminal(
    gestureId: Long,
    outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
    detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail,
    won: Boolean
) {
    val message = "Reader gesture terminal gestureId=$gestureId " +
        "outcome=$outcome won=$won detail=$detail"
    if (won) {
        Logger.i(KomikkuReaderNativeFrameHostTag, message)
    } else {
        Logger.w(
            KomikkuReaderNativeFrameHostTag,
            "Reader gesture terminal replay $message"
        )
    }
}
```

Every controller terminal helper—gesture rejection, explicit cancellation, settlement completion, snap-back completion, render failure, unavailable touch, synchronous tap-turn rejection, and failed recovery—calls only `onGestureTerminal(gestureId, outcome, detail)`. No controller helper calls `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController`, `ReaderPagePointerRouter`, or `ReaderPageGestureLifecycle` directly. `completePageGesture` preserves the closed `ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail` for privacy-safe diagnostics, but only the facade/router decides whether publication won. A replayed late callback logs `won=false` and cannot recreate sequence state or emit a second external terminal. The router's `publishTerminal` sink emits only after successful completion and must not call `pageGestureLifecycle.completeGesture` again. Admission rejection, delayed tap completion, controller settlement, boundary rejection, renderer failure, lifecycle cancellation, and failed recovery all use this same router terminal gate.

```kotlin
private class FakeReaderPageHostCancellationPort :
    ReaderPageHostCancellationPort {
    val calls =
        mutableListOf<Pair<String, ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason>>()
    val pointerInterruptions = mutableListOf<Long>()
    var rendererAnimatorInFlight = false

    override fun cancelForPointerInterruption(gestureId: Long) {
        pointerInterruptions += gestureId
        rendererAnimatorInFlight = false
    }

    override fun cancelActiveRendererGesture(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ) {
        calls += "renderer" to reason
        rendererAnimatorInFlight = false
    }

    override fun cancelReadableViewerDragPreview(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ) {
        calls += "drag-preview" to reason
    }

    override fun clearNativeTapState(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ) {
        calls += "tap" to reason
    }

    override fun clearSwipeTouchState(
        reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
    ) {
        calls += "swipe" to reason
    }
}

    assertNull(host.takeDelayedTap(firstDownTime))

    val secondTap = requireNotNull(host.takeDelayedTap(secondDownTime))

    assertEquals(90f, secondTap.x)
    assertEquals(91f, secondTap.y)

    )
    assertFalse(

        )

    assertFalse(
        host.completeDelayedTap(
            secondId,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction

Change only `KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap` from `private` to `internal` so the host test instantiates the production detector. Update the existing source-governance slices in `ReaderKomikkuBackboneResetTest`, `ReaderRuntimeShellProgressTest`, and `ReaderRuntimeImageLinkTest` to use the exact `internal class KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap` marker; do not broaden those slices. Create `KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTapBehaviorTest.kt`:

```kotlin
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(manifest = Config.NONE)
@LooperMode(LooperMode.Mode.PAUSED)
class KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTapBehaviorTest {
    @Test
    fun androidDoubleTapOrderResolvesFirstBeforeSecondUpExactlyOnce() {
        val published =
            mutableListOf<Pair<Long, ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome>>()
        val lifecycle = ReaderPageGestureLifecycle()
        val router = ReaderPagePointerRouter(lifecycle) { id, outcome ->
            published += id to outcome
        }
        val host = ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController(
            initialPolicy = readerPageOperationPolicy(
                ReaderPageReadinessState(
                    textureDeck = ReaderTextureDeckState.Ready,
                    interaction = ReaderPageInteractionState.Ready
                )
            ),
            pointerRouter = router,
            cancellationPort = NoOpCancellationPort()
        )
        val resolved = mutableListOf<ReaderPageContentGestureToken>()
        val detector = KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap(
            ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>(),
            object : KomikkuGestureDetectorWithLongTap.Listener() {
                override fun onDown(event: MotionEvent): Boolean = true

                override fun onSingleTapConfirmed(
                    event: MotionEvent
                ): Boolean = host.takeDelayedTap(event.downTime)
                    ?.let(::complete)
                    ?: false

                override fun onDoubleTap(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
                    host.takeOldestDelayedTap()
                        ?.let(::complete)
                        ?: false

                override fun onDoubleTapEvent(
                    event: MotionEvent
                ): Boolean = if (
                    event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                ) {
                    host.takeDelayedTap(event.downTime)
                        ?.let(::complete)
                        ?: false
                } else {
                    true
                }

                private fun complete(
                    tap: ReaderPageContentGestureToken
                ): Boolean {
                    resolved += tap
                    return host.completeDelayedTap(
                        tap.gestureId,
                        ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction
                    )
                }
            }
        )

        fun send(
            downTime: Long,
            eventTime: Long,
            action: Int,
            x: Float,
            y: Float
        ): Long? {
            val event = MotionEvent.obtain(
                downTime,
                eventTime,
                action,
                x,
                y,
                0
            )
            return try {
                val id = when (action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> host.dispatchPointer(
                        ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Down(
                            x = x,
                            y = y,
                            downTimeMillis = downTime
                        )
                    ).gestureId
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        host.dispatchPointer(
                            ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up
                        )
                        null
                    }
                    else -> error("Unsupported action: $action")
                }
                detector.onTouchEvent(event)
                id
            } finally {
                event.recycle()
            }
        }

        val firstId = requireNotNull(
            send(100L, 100L, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 10f, 11f)
        )
        send(100L, 130L, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 10f, 11f)
        val secondId = requireNotNull(
            send(180L, 180L, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 20f, 21f)
        )

        assertEquals(listOf(firstId), resolved.map { it.gestureId })
        assertEquals(10f, resolved.single().x)
        assertEquals(11f, resolved.single().y)

        send(180L, 210L, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 20f, 21f)

        assertEquals(
            listOf(firstId, secondId),
            resolved.map { it.gestureId }
        )
        assertEquals(20f, resolved.last().x)
        assertEquals(21f, resolved.last().y)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                firstId to
                    ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction,
                secondId to
                    ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CompletedTapAction
            ),
            published
        )
        assertEquals(0, host.contentGestureTokenCount())
        assertEquals(0, router.trackedSequenceCount())
    }

    private class NoOpCancellationPort : ReaderPageHostCancellationPort {
        override fun cancelForPointerInterruption(gestureId: Long) = Unit

        override fun cancelActiveRendererGesture(
            reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
        ) = Unit

        override fun cancelReadableViewerDragPreview(
            reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
        ) = Unit

        override fun clearNativeTapState(
            reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
        ) = Unit

        override fun clearSwipeTouchState(
            reason: ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason
        ) = Unit
    }
}

fun productionHostLetsCommitAndSnapBackFinishWhileConcurrentDownIsRejectedOnce() {

    ).forEach { settlementOutcome ->

        assertEquals(
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Curl(primaryId),
            host.dispatchPointer(
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up
            ).route

        )
        assertEquals(
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume,
            host.dispatchPointer(
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Move(121f, 200f, 8f)
            ).route
        )
        assertEquals(
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Consume,
            host.dispatchPointer(
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up
            ).route
        )

        assertTrue(host.complete(primaryId, settlementOutcome))
        assertFalse(
            host.complete(
                primaryId,
                ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledLifecycle
            )
        )
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                concurrentId to
                    ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.RejectedSettling,
                primaryId to settlementOutcome
            ),
            published
        )
        assertEquals(0, router.trackedSequenceCount())
        assertTrue(cancellationPort.calls.isEmpty())
    }
}
