Extract the production tap-turn callback adapter into `ReaderPageTapTurnControllerFacade.android.kt`; `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController` supplies the real renderer port, and the host supplies `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController.complete`. The facade—not a test replica—owns synchronous return-versus-callback arbitration and the original gesture ID:

```kotlin
internal fun interface ReaderPageTapTurnPort {
    fun start(
        gestureId: Long,
        pageChange: PageChange,
        onTerminal: (
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
        ) -> Boolean
    ): ReaderPageTurnStartResult
}

internal class ReaderPageTapTurnControllerFacade(
    private val port: ReaderPageTapTurnPort,
    private val publishTerminal: (
        Long,
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ) -> Boolean
) {
    fun turn(
        gestureId: Long,
        pageChange: PageChange
    ): ReaderPageTurnStartResult {
        var callbackObserved = false
        val result = port.start(gestureId, pageChange) { outcome, detail ->
            callbackObserved = true
            publishTerminal(gestureId, outcome, detail)
        }
        when (result) {
            ReaderPageTurnStartResult.Settling -> check(!callbackObserved) {
                "Settling tap turn published a synchronous terminal"
            }
            is ReaderPageTurnStartResult.TerminalPublished ->
                check(callbackObserved) {
                    "TerminalPublished returned before callback publication"
                }
        }
        return result
    }
}
```

The real Foliate controller implements the port by invoking its private renderer tap-turn method and routing that gesture's renderer callbacks into the installed typed outcome/detail sink; it must not allocate, substitute, or recover a gesture ID. Add these controller-callback behavior cases to `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostControllerTest.kt`. They instantiate the production facade/router and fake only `ReaderPageTapTurnPort` callback timing. `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateControllerSourceTest` separately proves that the controller implements `ReaderPageTapTurnPort`, installs/removes the per-gesture sink in `start`/`finishGesture`, and has no public `turn` bypass. `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostSourceTest` proves the Android host constructs one facade with `port = playLikeCurlController`, dispatches navigation taps only through `tapTurnController.turn(gestureId, pageChange)`, and contains no direct `playLikeCurlController.turn` call:

```kotlin
private data class TapTurnTerminalCase(
    val outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
    val detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail,
    val synchronous: Boolean
)

private data class TapTurnTerminalAttempt(
    val gestureId: Long,
    val outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
    val detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail,
    val won: Boolean
)

private class TapTurnHarness {
    val lifecycle = ReaderPageGestureLifecycle()
    val published =
        mutableListOf<Pair<Long, ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome>>()
    val router = ReaderPagePointerRouter(lifecycle) { gestureId, outcome ->
        published += gestureId to outcome
    }
    val host = ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController(
        initialPolicy = readerPageOperationPolicy(
            ReaderPageReadinessState(
                textureDeck = ReaderTextureDeckState.Ready,
                interaction = ReaderPageInteractionState.Ready
            )
        ),
        pointerRouter = router,
        cancellationPort = FakeReaderPageHostCancellationPort()
    )
    val attempts = mutableListOf<TapTurnTerminalAttempt>()

    fun beginDelayedTap(downTimeMillis: Long): Long {
        val gestureId = requireNotNull(
            host.dispatchPointer(
                ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Down(
                    x = 20f,
                    y = 20f,
                    downTimeMillis = downTimeMillis
                )
            ).gestureId
        )
        assertEquals(
            ReaderPagePointerRoute.Content,
            host.dispatchPointer(ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up).route
        )
        assertEquals(
            gestureId,
            requireNotNull(host.takeDelayedTap(downTimeMillis)).gestureId
        )
        return gestureId
    }

    fun publishFromController(
        gestureId: Long,
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        detail: ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ): Boolean {
        val won = host.complete(gestureId, outcome)
        attempts += TapTurnTerminalAttempt(
            gestureId = gestureId,
            outcome = outcome,
            detail = detail,
            won = won
        )
        return won
    }
}

private class FakeTapTurnPort(
    private val terminalCase: TapTurnTerminalCase
) : ReaderPageTapTurnPort {
    private var deferred: ((
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ) -> Boolean)? = null
    private var retained: ((
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
        ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
    ) -> Boolean)? = null

    override fun start(
        gestureId: Long,
        pageChange: PageChange,
        onTerminal: (
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail
        ) -> Boolean
    ): ReaderPageTurnStartResult {
        retained = onTerminal
        if (!terminalCase.synchronous) {
            check(deferred == null)
            deferred = onTerminal
            return ReaderPageTurnStartResult.Settling
        }
        check(
            onTerminal(terminalCase.outcome, terminalCase.detail)
        ) { "Synchronous fake terminal lost original host ownership" }
        return ReaderPageTurnStartResult.TerminalPublished(
            outcome = terminalCase.outcome,
            detail = terminalCase.detail
        )
    }

    fun completeDeferred() {
        val callback = checkNotNull(deferred)
        deferred = null
        callback(terminalCase.outcome, terminalCase.detail)
    }

    fun replay(
        outcome: ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
    ) {
        checkNotNull(retained)(
            outcome,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.ControllerCancelled
        )
    }
}

@Test
fun synchronousTapTurnRejectionsPublishOriginalIdExactlyOnce() {
    listOf(
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome
                .RejectedRendererUnavailable,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.TapTurnUnavailable(
                PageChange.NEXT
            ),
            synchronous = true
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.RejectedBoundary,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RendererRejected(
                generationId = 11L,
                reason = GestureRejectionReason.BOUNDARY
            ),
            synchronous = true
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.RejectedSettling,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RendererRejected(
                generationId = 12L,
                reason = GestureRejectionReason.SETTLEMENT_RUNNING
            ),
            synchronous = true
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.FailedRenderer,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.TapTurnProtocolFailure(
                PageChange.NEXT
            ),
            synchronous = true
        )
    ).forEachIndexed { index, terminalCase ->
        val harness = TapTurnHarness()
        val port = FakeTapTurnPort(terminalCase)
        val controller = ReaderPageTapTurnControllerFacade(
            port = port,
            publishTerminal = harness::publishFromController
        )
        val originalId = harness.beginDelayedTap(
            downTimeMillis = 100L + index
        )

        val result = controller.turn(originalId, PageChange.NEXT)
            as ReaderPageTurnStartResult.TerminalPublished
        assertEquals(terminalCase.outcome, result.outcome)
        assertEquals(terminalCase.detail, result.detail)
        assertEquals(0, harness.host.contentGestureTokenCount())
        assertEquals(0, harness.router.trackedSequenceCount())
        assertEquals(
            listOf(originalId to terminalCase.outcome),
            harness.published
        )
        port.replay(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledLifecycle
        )
        assertEquals(1, harness.attempts.count { it.won })
        assertEquals(2, harness.attempts.size)
        assertEquals(
            terminalCase.outcome,
            harness.lifecycle.terminalOutcome(originalId)
        )
    }
}

@Test
fun deferredTapTurnTerminalsPublishOriginalIdExactlyOnce() {
    listOf(
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CommittedForward,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.SettlementCompleted(
                pageChange = PageChange.NEXT,
                ordinal = 7
            ),
            synchronous = false
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CommittedBackward,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.SettlementCompleted(
                pageChange = PageChange.PREVIOUS,
                ordinal = 6
            ),
            synchronous = false
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledByUser,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.SettlementCompleted(
                pageChange = PageChange.NONE,
                ordinal = 7
            ),
            synchronous = false
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.CancelledByUser,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RendererCancelled(
                generationId = 13L
            ),
            synchronous = false
        ),
        TapTurnTerminalCase(
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.FailedRenderer,
            ReaderPageGestureTerminalDetail.RenderFailed(
                generationId = 14L,
                reason = RenderFailureReason.CONTEXT
            ),
            synchronous = false
        )
    ).forEachIndexed { index, terminalCase ->
        val harness = TapTurnHarness()
        val port = FakeTapTurnPort(terminalCase)
        val controller = ReaderPageTapTurnControllerFacade(
            port = port,
            publishTerminal = harness::publishFromController
        )
        val originalId = harness.beginDelayedTap(
            downTimeMillis = 200L + index
        )

        assertEquals(
            ReaderPageTurnStartResult.Settling,
            controller.turn(originalId, PageChange.NEXT)
        )
        assertEquals(1, harness.router.trackedSequenceCount())
        port.completeDeferred()
        assertEquals(0, harness.host.contentGestureTokenCount())
        assertEquals(0, harness.router.trackedSequenceCount())
        assertEquals(
            listOf(originalId to terminalCase.outcome),
            harness.published
        )
        port.replay(ReaderPageGestureTerminalOutcome.FailedRecovery)
        assertEquals(1, harness.attempts.count { it.won })
        assertEquals(2, harness.attempts.size)
        assertEquals(
            terminalCase.outcome,
            harness.lifecycle.terminalOutcome(originalId)
        )
    }
}
```

The immediate cases cover unavailable edge tap, boundary edge tap, renderer rejection, and the false-without-callback invariant failure. The deferred cases cover both committed directions, snap-back completion, explicit cancellation, settlement completion, and renderer failure. Every case replays a late callback and asserts the original delayed-tap ID, one successful terminal publication, zero content tokens, and zero tracked router sequences. Keep `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateControllerSourceTest` only as a governance check that the Android host constructs `ReaderPageTapTurnControllerFacade`, the real Foliate controller implements/injects `ReaderPageTapTurnPort`, the host delegates terminal callbacks through `ReaderPageInputSettlementHostController.complete`, the facade delegates to `ReaderPagePointerRouter.complete`, and neither controller calls `ReaderPageGestureLifecycle.completeGesture` directly.

Enumerate all six Android action constants inside the imported-path helper so adding one typed branch while leaving another on legacy state cannot pass. Also prove the outer dispatcher freezes its mode only on `ACTION_DOWN`, preserves the legacy shell-cover/non-curl path, and does not re-evaluate capability during the tail of a stream:

```kotlin
@Test
fun productionHostFreezesDispatchModeAndRoutesEveryImportedAction() {
    val hostSource = hostFile.readText()
    val outerDispatch = hostSource
        .substringAfter(
            "override fun dispatchTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean"
        )
        .substringBefore(
            "private fun dispatchLegacyReaderPointerEvent("
        )
    val importedDispatch = hostSource
        .substringAfter(
            "private fun dispatchPlayLikeCurlPointerEvent("
        )
        .substringBefore("private fun applyPointerRoute(")
    val pointerMapping = importedDispatch
        .substringAfter(
            "val pointerEvent: ReaderPageHostPointerEvent? ="
        )
        .substringBefore("val pointerDispatch =")
    val expectedMappings = linkedMapOf(
        "MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN" to
            "ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Down(",
        "MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE" to
            "ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Move(",
        "MotionEvent.ACTION_UP" to
            "ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Up",
        "MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL" to
            "ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.Cancel",
        "MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN" to
            "ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.SecondaryPointerDown",
        "MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP" to
            "ReaderPageHostPointerEvent.SecondaryPointerUp"
    )

    assertContains(outerDispatch, "if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)")
    assertContains(outerDispatch, "shouldUsePlayLikeCurlPointerRouter()")
    assertContains(
        outerDispatch,
        "ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.PlayLikeCurl ->"
    )
    assertContains(
        outerDispatch,
        "dispatchPlayLikeCurlPointerEvent(event)"
    )
    assertContains(
        outerDispatch,
        "ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.Legacy ->"
    )
    assertContains(
        outerDispatch,
        "dispatchLegacyReaderPointerEvent(event)"
    )
    assertEquals(
        1,
        Regex("shouldUsePlayLikeCurlPointerRouter\\(\\)")
            .findAll(outerDispatch)
            .count()
    )
    expectedMappings.forEach { (androidAction, typedEvent) ->
        val branch = Regex(
            Regex.escape(androidAction) +
                "\\s*->\\s*" +
                Regex.escape(typedEvent)
        )
        assertTrue(
            branch.containsMatchIn(pointerMapping),
            "$androidAction must map directly to $typedEvent"
        )
    }
    assertContains(pointerMapping, "downTimeMillis = event.downTime")
    assertContains(
        importedDispatch,
        "pageInputSettlementHostController::dispatchPointer"
    )
    assertFalse(hostSource.contains("currentPageGestureId"))
    assertFalse(hostSource.contains("pageGestureLifecycle"))
    assertContains(hostSource, "takeDelayedTap(")
    assertContains(hostSource, "takeOldestDelayedTap(")
    assertContains(hostSource, "claimContentAction(")
    listOf(
        "beginPointer(",
        "movePointer(",
        "endPointer(",
        "interruptPointer(",
        "cancelForLifecycle("
    ).forEach { forbidden ->
        assertFalse(
            hostSource.contains(
                "pageInputSettlementHostController.$forbidden"
            ),
            "The Android host must not bypass dispatchPointer via $forbidden"
        )
    }
}

            "private class KomikkuReaderNativeViewerContainer"
        )
        .substringBefore("private fun View.findDescendantWebView")
    val observer = viewer
        .substringAfter("private val hostLifecycleObserver")
        .substringBefore("override fun onAttachedToWindow")
    val begin = viewer
        .substringAfter("private fun beginFinalHostLifecycle(")
        .substringBefore("private fun closePhysicalPointerDelivery()")
    val dispatch = viewer
        .substringAfter(
            "override fun dispatchTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean"
        )
        .substringBefore("private fun dispatchLegacyReaderPointerEvent(")

    assertContains(
        observer,
        "beginFinalHostLifecycle(" +
            "ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent.Destroyed)"
    )
    assertFalse(observer.contains("closePhysicalPointerDelivery()"))
    assertFalse(begin.contains("physicalDispatchMode = null"))
    assertContains(
        dispatch,
        "ReaderPagePhysicalDispatchMode.PlayLikeCurl"
    )
    assertContains(dispatch, "dispatchPlayLikeCurlPointerEvent(event)")
    assertContains(
        dispatch,
        "event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP ||"
    )
    assertContains(
        dispatch,
        "event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL"
    )
}
```

The same source suite asserts every production teardown/invalidation path in the exhaustive wiring table calls `onLifecycleEvent`, every `ReaderPageHostLifecycleEvent` maps to the exact Task 2 reason, and no non-final path abandons physical delivery. Only `closePhysicalPointerDelivery` calls `abandonPhysicalPointerStream`; it is reachable from detach and release but not from the lifecycle observer's `onDestroy`. Pair these source contracts with `destroyedWhileAttachedConsumesPhysicalTailThroughPrimaryUp` so production mode retention and facade tombstone behavior are both covered.

```kotlin
@Test
```

```kotlin
        val released = mutableListOf<String>()

        val ledger = ReaderPageRasterPublicationLedger<String>(released::add)
        val started = assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started>(
            ledger.begin("digest", "active", callbacks::add)
        )
        assertEquals("active", ledger.acquireForPersistence(started.request))

        ledger.invalidate()

        assertEquals(listOf(false), callbacks)
        assertTrue(released.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(ledger.complete(started.request, persisted = true))

    @Test
    fun pausedOldCompletionCannotSatisfySameDigestInNewEpoch() {
        val released = mutableListOf<String>()
        val results = mutableListOf<Pair<String, Boolean>>()
        val ledger = ReaderPageRasterPublicationLedger<String>(released::add)
        val old = assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started>(
            ledger.begin("digest", "old") { results += "old" to it }
        )
        assertEquals("old", ledger.acquireForPersistence(old.request))

        ledger.invalidate()
        val current = assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started>(
            ledger.begin("digest", "new") { results += "new" to it }
        )
        assertEquals("new", ledger.acquireForPersistence(current.request))

        assertFalse(ledger.complete(old.request, persisted = true))
        assertTrue(ledger.complete(current.request, persisted = true))
        assertEquals(listOf("old" to false, "new" to true), results)
        assertEquals(listOf("old", "new"), released)
    }

    @Test
    fun duplicateRegistrationCoalescesWithoutSchedulingReleasedValue() {
        val released = mutableListOf<String>()
        val callbacks = mutableListOf<Pair<String, Boolean>>()
        val scheduled = mutableListOf<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest>()
        val ledger = ReaderPageRasterPublicationLedger<String>(released::add)

        val first = ledger.begin("digest", "producer") {
            callbacks += "producer" to it
        }
        if (first is ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started) {
            scheduled += first.request
        }
        val duplicate = ledger.begin("digest", "duplicate") {
            callbacks += "duplicate" to it
        }
        if (duplicate is ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started) {
            scheduled += duplicate.request
        }

        val request = assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started>(first).request
        assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Coalesced>(duplicate)
        assertEquals(listOf(request), scheduled)
        assertEquals("producer", ledger.acquireForPersistence(request))
        assertTrue(ledger.complete(request, persisted = true))
        assertEquals(

        assertEquals(listOf("duplicate", "producer"), released)

        val callbacks = mutableListOf<String>()

        val ledger = ReaderPageRasterPublicationLedger<String> { value ->
            releases += value
            if (value == "producer") error("release-failed")
        }
        val started = assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started>(
            ledger.begin("digest", "producer") {
                callbacks += "first"
                error("callback-failed")
            }
        )
        assertIs<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Coalesced>(
            ledger.begin("digest", "duplicate") {
                callbacks += "second"
            }
        )
        assertEquals("producer", ledger.acquireForPersistence(started.request))

        assertTrue(ledger.complete(started.request, persisted = true))

        assertEquals(listOf("first", "second"), callbacks)
        assertEquals(listOf("duplicate", "producer"), releases)
        assertEquals(0, ledger.entryCount())

    @Test
    fun invalidationAttemptsEveryCallbackAndQueuedReleaseAfterFailure() {
        val events = mutableListOf<String>()
        val ledger = ReaderPageRasterPublicationLedger<String> { value ->
            events += "release-$value"
            if (value == "a") error("release-a")
        }
        ledger.begin("a", "a") {
            events += "callback-a"
            error("callback-a")
        }
        ledger.begin("b", "b") {
            events += "callback-b"
        }

        ledger.invalidate()

        assertTrue("callback-a" in events)
        assertTrue("callback-b" in events)
        assertTrue("release-a" in events)
        assertTrue("release-b" in events)
        assertEquals(0, ledger.entryCount())
        assertNotNull(ledger.dispatchFailure())

```

The ledger tests deliberately use hostile callbacks and releasers. `complete`, `invalidate`, coalescing, and capacity rejection must detach logical ownership under the monitor, invoke every callback and release outside the monitor, retain the first failure plus suppressed failures in `dispatchFailure`, and never throw before all detached work is attempted. Teardown reads that retained failure only after publication workers join and the entry count reaches zero.

```kotlin
@Test
fun cancelBeforeEpochNeverStartsQueuedWorkAndActiveWorkRunsFinally() = runTest {
    val scheduler = ReaderPageRasterPublicationScheduler(
        scope = this,
        maxConcurrentWorkers = 1
    )
    val activeStarted = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    val releaseActive = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    val activeFinally = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    var queuedStarted = false
    scheduler.schedule(
        ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest("active", 0L)
    ) {
        activeStarted.complete(Unit)
        try {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                releaseActive.await()
            }
        } finally {
            activeFinally.complete(Unit)
        }
    }
    activeStarted.await()
    scheduler.schedule(
        ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest("queued", 0L)
    ) {
        queuedStarted = true
    }

    scheduler.cancelBeforeEpoch(currentEpoch = 1L)
    releaseActive.complete(Unit)
    activeFinally.await()
    scheduler.closeAndJoin()

    assertFalse(queuedStarted)
    assertEquals(0, scheduler.activeWorkerCount())
}
```

These tests fail against the current Boolean `write`: persistence success and decoded-value ownership are independent facts. Publication must remain disk-only so its ledger keeps recycle authority; normal generation may transfer authority to the decoded cache, but the scheduler must release the value when the result says `Caller`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement epoch-qualified publication identity and ownership**

```kotlin
internal data class ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest(
    val digest: String,
    val epoch: Long
)

internal enum class ReaderPageRasterPublicationRejection {
    EntryCapacity,
    CallbackCapacity
}

internal sealed interface ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration {
    data class Started(
        val request: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest
    ) : ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration

    data class Coalesced(
        val request: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest
    ) : ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration

    data class Rejected(
        val reason: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRejection
    ) : ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration
}

internal class ReaderPageRasterPublicationLedger<T : Any>(
    private val release: (T) -> Unit
) {
    private enum class ProducerState { Queued, Active }

    private data class Entry<T : Any>(
        val value: T,
        val callbacks: MutableList<(Boolean) -> Unit>,
        var producerState: ProducerState = ProducerState.Queued,
        var stale: Boolean = false
    )

    private data class Completion<T : Any>(
        val value: T,
        val callbacks: List<(Boolean) -> Unit>,
        val accepted: Boolean,
        val persisted: Boolean
    )

    private var epoch = 0L
    private val entries =
        linkedMapOf<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest, Entry<T>>()
    private var retainedDispatchFailure: Throwable? = null

    fun begin(
        digest: String,
        value: T,
        callback: (Boolean) -> Unit
    ): ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration {
        var redundantValue: T? = null
        val registration = synchronized(this) {
            val request = ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest(digest, epoch)
            val existing = entries[request]
            if (existing != null) {
                existing.callbacks += callback
                redundantValue = value
                ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Coalesced(request)
            } else {
                entries[request] = Entry(value, mutableListOf(callback))
                ReaderPageRasterPublicationRegistration.Started(request)
            }
        }
        dispatchBestEffort(
            callbacks = emptyList(),
            callbackResult = false,
            values = listOfNotNull(redundantValue)
        )
        return registration
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun acquireForPersistence(
        request: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest
    ): T? {
        val entry = entries[request] ?: return null
        if (entry.stale || entry.producerState != ProducerState.Queued) {
            return null
        }
        entry.producerState = ProducerState.Active
        return entry.value
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun entryCount(): Int = entries.size

    @Synchronized
    fun currentEpoch(): Long = epoch

    @Synchronized
    fun dispatchFailure(): Throwable? = retainedDispatchFailure

    fun commitFence(
        request: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest
    ): ReaderPageRasterCommitFence = ReaderPageRasterCommitFence { commit ->
        synchronized(this) {
            val entry = entries[request]
            if (
                entry == null ||
                entry.stale ||
                request.epoch != epoch ||
                entry.producerState != ProducerState.Active
            ) {
                ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(
                    persisted = false,
                    ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
                )
            } else {
                commit()
            }
        }
    }

    fun recordFailure(failure: Throwable) {
        synchronized(this) {
            val first = retainedDispatchFailure
            if (first == null) retainedDispatchFailure = failure
            else if (failure !== first) first.addSuppressed(failure)
        }
    }

    fun complete(
        request: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest,
        persisted: Boolean
    ): Boolean {
        val completion = synchronized(this) {
            val entry = entries.remove(request) ?: return false
            check(entry.producerState == ProducerState.Active) {
                "Publication completed without active worker ownership"
            }
            val accepted = !entry.stale && request.epoch == epoch
            Completion(
                value = entry.value,
                callbacks = entry.callbacks.toList(),
                accepted = accepted,
                persisted = persisted
            )
        }
        dispatchBestEffort(
            callbacks = completion.callbacks,
            callbackResult = completion.persisted && completion.accepted,
            values = listOf(completion.value)
        )
        return completion.accepted
    }

    fun invalidate() {
        val callbacks = mutableListOf<(Boolean) -> Unit>()
        val queuedValues = mutableListOf<T>()
        synchronized(this) {
            epoch += 1L
            val iterator = entries.iterator()
            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                val (_, entry) = iterator.next()
                entry.stale = true
                callbacks += entry.callbacks
                entry.callbacks.clear()
                if (entry.producerState == ProducerState.Queued) {
                    queuedValues += entry.value
                    iterator.remove()
                }
            }
        }
        dispatchBestEffort(callbacks, false, queuedValues)
    }

    private fun dispatchBestEffort(
        callbacks: List<(Boolean) -> Unit>,
        callbackResult: Boolean,
        values: List<T>
    ) {
        var failure: Throwable? = null
        fun capture(action: () -> Unit) {
            try {
                action()
            } catch (next: Throwable) {
                val first = failure
                if (first == null) failure = next
                else if (next !== first) first.addSuppressed(next)
            }
        }
        callbacks.forEach { callback ->
            capture { callback(callbackResult) }
        }
        values.forEach { value ->
            capture { release(value) }
        }
        failure?.let { next ->
            synchronized(this) {
                val first = retainedDispatchFailure
                if (first == null) retainedDispatchFailure = next
                else if (next !== first) first.addSuppressed(next)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Add a dedicated publication scheduler instead of assuming an API on the existing raster-generation scheduler:

```kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.joinAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Semaphore
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withPermit
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

internal class ReaderPageRasterPublicationScheduler(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    val maxConcurrentWorkers: Int = 1
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private val permits = Semaphore(maxConcurrentWorkers)
    private val jobs =
        linkedMapOf<ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest, Job>()
    private val closedSignal = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    private var activeWorkers = 0
    private var closed = false

    init {
        require(maxConcurrentWorkers > 0)
    }

    fun schedule(
        request: ReaderPageRasterPublicationRequest,
        worker: suspend () -> Unit
    ) {
        val job = synchronized(lock) {
            check(!closed) { "Publication scheduler is closed" }
            check(request !in jobs) {
                "Publication request already scheduled: $request"
            }
            scope.launch(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
                permits.withPermit {
                    synchronized(lock) { activeWorkers += 1 }
                    try {
                        worker()
                    } finally {
                        synchronized(lock) { activeWorkers -= 1 }
                    }
                }
            }.also { created ->
                jobs[request] = created
            }
        }
        job.invokeOnCompletion {
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (jobs[request] === job) jobs.remove(request)
            }
        }
        job.start()
    }

    fun cancelBeforeEpoch(currentEpoch: Long) {
        val staleJobs = synchronized(lock) {
            jobs.filterKeys { request ->
                request.epoch < currentEpoch
            }.values.toList()
        }
        staleJobs.forEach { job -> job.cancel() }
    }

    fun activeWorkerCount(): Int =
        synchronized(lock) { activeWorkers }

    suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
        val closingJobs = synchronized(lock) {
            if (closed) {
                null
            } else {
                closed = true
                jobs.values.toList()
            }
        }
        if (closingJobs != null) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                try {
                    closingJobs.forEach { job -> job.cancel() }
                    closingJobs.joinAll()
                } finally {
                    closedSignal.complete(Unit)
                }
            }
        }
        closedSignal.await()
    }
}
```

The scheduler owns jobs, not staged bitmap values. Its fixed semaphore enforces `maxConcurrentWorkers`; the publication ledger remains the value owner. Cancellation of a queued job prevents `acquireForPersistence`; cancellation of an active job runs the worker's `finally`, which calls ledger completion and releases the active value exactly once. Add scheduler tests for FIFO-independent concurrency enforcement, queued cancellation before acquisition, active cancellation reaching `finally`, and idempotent `closeAndJoin`.

Add the batch durability gate:

```kotlin
internal sealed interface ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision {
    data class Continue(
        val completed: Int,
        val required: Int
    ) : ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision

    data class Failed(val pageIndex: Int) : ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision
    data object Ready : ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision
}

internal class ReaderPageRasterDurabilityGate(
    requiredPageIndices: Set<Int>
) {
    private val required = requiredPageIndices.toSet()
    private val durable = linkedSetOf<Int>()

    fun record(pageIndex: Int, persisted: Boolean): ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision {
        require(pageIndex in required) { "Unexpected page index $pageIndex" }
        if (!persisted) return ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision.Failed(pageIndex)
        durable += pageIndex
        return if (durable == required) {
            ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision.Ready
        } else {
            ReaderPageRasterDurabilityDecision.Continue(durable.size, required.size)
        }
    }

    fun retryPageIndices(): Set<Int> = required - durable
}
```

Duplicate `(digest, epoch)` requests now retain the original staged value, atomically append the callback, release the redundant bitmap copy outside the ledger monitor, and return `Coalesced`. Only `Started` transfers producer authority to the bundle source; a coalesced caller must not enqueue persistence or access its released bitmap. The producer receives only the request until its scheduler job atomically calls `acquireForPersistence`. Queued entries can be released during invalidation because no worker has acquired them; active entries remain owned until their worker exits and calls `complete`. Callback or release failure never prevents later detached work; it is retained by `dispatchFailure()` for typed teardown after entry ownership drains.

Encoding and temporary-file fsync happen before the fence. Invoke `commitFence.commit` exactly once around the synchronized promotion, retention decision, manifest write, owner-map update, and decoded adoption. A publication fence therefore orders an epoch change against the durable manifest commit rather than merely checking an atomic before or after the transaction.

In this task's temporary key-based decoded owner, failed writes return `ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(false, Caller)`. Task 12 replaces that temporary rule with identity-scoped encode admission: a failed `AdoptDecoded` write returns `Store` whenever the cache owns or is already consuming the exact identity, and an identity already in `Releasing` fails before encode with `failureReason = EncodeIdentityReleasing`. If the enforcing disk-retention decision excludes the proposed key, first durably write the retained manifest, delete the now-unreferenced promoted file, do not call `putDecoded`, and return the ownership selected by the current task's owner model. A failed manifest write restores the prior in-memory entry set and deletes the promoted file only when that file was not referenced by the prior manifest. This explicitly closes the current orphan-file/adopted-value path when a write is valid but cannot fit.

For each manifest commit, increment a cache-owned monotonic in-process revision and retain it beside the digest. A successful result carries a `ReaderPageRasterWriteReceipt` containing that revision and exact raster filename. `rollbackPublication(receipt)` removes an entry only when both its current revision and filename still match the receipt; a newer normal-generation or publication write therefore returns `false` and is never removed. If the exact receipt still owns the entry, rollback writes the manifest without that entry before deleting its decoded identity and raster file; manifest failure throws and leaves the prior entry intact. Revisions need not persist across process restart because no active old-epoch worker survives a process boundary.

After the manifest is durable, attempt decoded adoption only for `AdoptDecoded`. Return `Caller` when decoded residency is disabled or when the positive identity limit is full and every eviction candidate is protected; in either case the cache must not insert, release, or otherwise consume the supplied value, and the scheduler performs the one caller release. Return `Store` only after the cache has attached the value to an active identity owner or established that the exact identity is already under store-owned release. An accepted adoption may evict and release an unprotected LRU owner before attaching the new identity. `PersistOnly` always returns `Caller` and must never insert, evict, or release the supplied value. Task 12 replaces the temporary key-based decoded owner with an identity-safe owner while preserving this explicit capacity-sensitive result and receipt contract.

The scheduled producer must acquire and release worker ownership in one `try/finally`:

```kotlin
publicationScheduler.schedule(request) {
    val value = publicationLedger.acquireForPersistence(request)
        ?: return@schedule
    var write = ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(
        persisted = false,
        ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
    )
    val store = persistentStore
    try {
        write = store?.writePublication(
            key = value.key,
            metadata = value.generation.metadata,
            value = value.generation.value,
            commitFence = publicationLedger.commitFence(request)
        ) ?: write
        check(
            write.ownership == ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
        ) { "Publication store adopted a ledger-owned value" }
        // Task 15 inserts qaFaultRegistry.pausePublicationWithinWorker(request.epoch)
        // here, after the persistence outcome and before ledger completion.
    } finally {
        val accepted = publicationLedger.complete(
            request = request,
            persisted = write.persisted
        )
        if (!accepted) {
            write.receipt?.let { receipt ->
                runCatching {
                    store?.rollbackPublication(receipt)
                }.onFailure(publicationLedger::recordFailure)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`commitFence(request)` is the publication epoch's commit linearization point. Its monitor is acquired before the cache monitor and remains held only for promotion/manifest/owner-map commit; encoding and fsync stay outside it, and no cache code may call back into the ledger. Invalidation acquires the same ledger monitor, so it either precedes the commit (the fence returns a non-persisted caller-owned result and deletes the temporary) or follows it. If invalidation follows a commit but wins before `complete`, the worker rolls back only the exact receipt. A concurrent newer write changes the in-process revision, causing rollback to return `false` without deleting the newer file or manifest entry. Rollback manifest failure is retained by `recordFailure()` and fails typed teardown.

A completion may mutate readiness or invoke `true` only if its epoch is current. Invalidation first calls `publicationLedger.invalidate()` so no queued old-epoch worker can acquire a released value, then calls `publicationScheduler.cancelBeforeEpoch(publicationLedger.currentEpoch())`. Queued entries are released by invalidation; active jobs retain their value through cancellation and release it exactly once from the worker's `finally`. The scheduler contract must guarantee that cancellation of an already-started job runs `finally`; cancellation must never directly recycle the staged bitmap. Old active entries remain included in staged-publication ownership metrics until their worker exits, even though their callbacks have already failed and a new epoch may begin. Add races for invalidation before the commit fence, invalidation after manifest commit but before ledger completion, a newer same-key normal write before stale rollback, and rollback manifest failure.

Extract the turn-completion refill ordering from `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController` into a production coordinator; the controller calls this exact type after a committed turn instead of duplicating the sequence:

```kotlin
internal data class ReaderPagePersistentRefillFence(
    val committedTurnVersion: Long,
    val destinationOrdinal: Int,
    val protectedWindowVersion: Long,
    val protectedWindow: List<Int>
)

internal class ReaderPagePersistentRefillCoordinator(
    private val protectedWindowForCenter: (Int) -> List<Int>,
    private val publishProtectedWindow: (List<Int>) -> Long,
    private val isDecoded: (Int) -> Boolean,
    private val hydratePersistent: suspend (
        Int,
        ReaderPagePersistentRefillFence,
        (ReaderPagePersistentRefillFence) -> Boolean
    ) -> Boolean,
    private val requestRepair: (Int) -> Unit
) {
    suspend fun onTurnCommitted(
        direction: ReaderPageTurnDirection,
        destinationOrdinal: Int,
        committedTurnVersion: Long,
        isTurnStillCurrent: () -> Boolean,
        isStillCurrent: (ReaderPagePersistentRefillFence) -> Boolean
    ) {
        if (!isTurnStillCurrent()) return
        val protectedWindow =
            protectedWindowForCenter(destinationOrdinal).toList()
        val fence = ReaderPagePersistentRefillFence(
            committedTurnVersion = committedTurnVersion,
            destinationOrdinal = destinationOrdinal,
            protectedWindowVersion =
                publishProtectedWindow(protectedWindow),
            protectedWindow = protectedWindow
        )
        if (!isStillCurrent(fence)) return
        val farEdge = when (direction) {
            ReaderPageTurnDirection.Next -> protectedWindow.last()
            ReaderPageTurnDirection.Previous -> protectedWindow.first()
        }
        if (isDecoded(farEdge)) return
        val hydrated = hydratePersistent(
            farEdge,
            fence,
            isStillCurrent
        )
        if (!isStillCurrent(fence)) return
        if (!hydrated) requestRepair(farEdge)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
private class PersistentRefillHarness(
    initialCenter: Int,
    initiallyDecoded: Set<Int>,
    private val durablePages: Set<Int>
) {
    private val decoded = initiallyDecoded.toMutableSet()
    val events = mutableListOf<String>()
    val capturePageIndices = mutableListOf<Int>()
    val repairPageIndices = mutableListOf<Int>()
    var protectedPageIndices: Set<Int> =
        (initialCenter - 2..initialCenter + 2).toSet()
        private set
    var committedTurnVersion = 0L
        private set
    private var protectedWindowVersion = 0L
    private val coordinator = ReaderPagePersistentRefillCoordinator(
        protectedWindowForCenter = { center ->
            (center - 2..center + 2).toList()
        },
        publishProtectedWindow = { window ->
            protectedWindowVersion += 1L
            protectedPageIndices = window.toSet()
            events += "window:$window"
            protectedWindowVersion
        },
        isDecoded = decoded::contains,
        hydratePersistent = { pageIndex, fence, isStillCurrent ->
            events += "persistent:$pageIndex"
            val hit = pageIndex in durablePages
            if (hit && isStillCurrent(fence)) decoded += pageIndex
            hit
        },
        requestRepair = { pageIndex -> repairPageIndices += pageIndex }
    )

    fun evictDecoded(pageIndex: Int) {
        decoded -= pageIndex
    }

    suspend fun commitTurn(
        direction: ReaderPageTurnDirection,
        destinationOrdinal: Int
    ) {
        committedTurnVersion += 1L
        val expectedTurnVersion = committedTurnVersion
        coordinator.onTurnCommitted(
            direction = direction,
            destinationOrdinal = destinationOrdinal,
            committedTurnVersion = expectedTurnVersion,
            isTurnStillCurrent = {
                committedTurnVersion == expectedTurnVersion
            },
            isStillCurrent = { fence ->
                committedTurnVersion == fence.committedTurnVersion &&
                    protectedWindowVersion ==
                        fence.protectedWindowVersion &&
                    protectedPageIndices ==
                        fence.protectedWindow.toSet()
            }
        )
    }
}

private fun persistentRefillHarness(
    initialCenter: Int,
    initiallyDecoded: Set<Int>,
    durablePages: Set<Int>
): PersistentRefillHarness = PersistentRefillHarness(
    initialCenter,
    initiallyDecoded,
    durablePages
)

@Test
fun nextTurnAdvancesWindowThenHydratesOnlyMissingFarEdgeWithoutCapture() = runTest {
    val harness = persistentRefillHarness(
        initialCenter = 4,
        initiallyDecoded = setOf(2, 3, 4, 5, 6),
        durablePages = (0..12).toSet()
    )
    harness.evictDecoded(pageIndex = 7)

    harness.commitTurn(
        direction = ReaderPageTurnDirection.Next,
        destinationOrdinal = 5
    )

    assertEquals(
        listOf("window:[3,4,5,6,7]", "persistent:7"),
        harness.events
    )
    assertEquals(emptyList(), harness.capturePageIndices)
    assertEquals(emptyList(), harness.repairPageIndices)
    assertEquals(setOf(3, 4, 5, 6, 7), harness.protectedPageIndices)
}

@Test
fun previousTurnAdvancesWindowThenHydratesOnlyMissingFarEdgeWithoutCapture() = runTest {
    val harness = persistentRefillHarness(

    )

@Test
fun abaReturnToSameDestinationCannotPublishStaleHydrationOrRepair() = runTest {
    var committedTurnVersion = 1L
    var protectedWindowVersion = 0L
    var protectedWindow = emptyList<Int>()
    val hydrationStarted = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    val releaseHydration = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    val decoded = mutableSetOf<Int>()
    val repairs = mutableListOf<Int>()
    val coordinator = ReaderPagePersistentRefillCoordinator(
        protectedWindowForCenter = { center ->
            (center - 2..center + 2).toList()
        },
        publishProtectedWindow = { window ->
            protectedWindowVersion += 1L
            protectedWindow = window
            protectedWindowVersion
        },
        isDecoded = decoded::contains,
        hydratePersistent = { pageIndex, fence, isStillCurrent ->
            hydrationStarted.complete(Unit)
            releaseHydration.await()
            if (isStillCurrent(fence)) decoded += pageIndex
            false
        },
        requestRepair = repairs::add
    )
    val expectedTurnVersion = committedTurnVersion
    val refill = async {
        coordinator.onTurnCommitted(
            direction = ReaderPageTurnDirection.Next,
            destinationOrdinal = 5,
            committedTurnVersion = expectedTurnVersion,
            isTurnStillCurrent = {
                committedTurnVersion == expectedTurnVersion
            },
            isStillCurrent = { fence ->
                committedTurnVersion == fence.committedTurnVersion &&
                    protectedWindowVersion ==
                        fence.protectedWindowVersion &&
                    protectedWindow == fence.protectedWindow
            }
        )
    }
    hydrationStarted.await()

    // NEXT -> 6 publishes another version, then PREVIOUS -> 5
    // restores the original destination/window value with a third version.
    committedTurnVersion = 2L
    protectedWindowVersion = 2L
    protectedWindow = (4..8).toList()
    committedTurnVersion = 3L
    protectedWindowVersion = 3L
    protectedWindow = (3..7).toList()
    releaseHydration.complete(Unit)
    refill.await()

    assertTrue(decoded.isEmpty())
    assertTrue(repairs.isEmpty())
    assertEquals(3L, committedTurnVersion)
    assertEquals(3L, protectedWindowVersion)
    assertEquals((3..7).toList(), protectedWindow)
}
```

The harness contains no refill algorithm: it exposes fake decoded/persistent/repair ports around `ReaderPagePersistentRefillCoordinator`, the same production type invoked by `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController`. The far-edge page starts absent from decoded memory but valid in persistent storage. The production coordinator publishes the protected-window update before invoking any resolver, so neither a source-order unit nor a stand-in controller can satisfy this gate.

The PlayLikeCurl settlement callback is non-suspending. Bridge it through the existing controller-owned `rasterScope`, overriding only the dispatcher to main-immediate so controller profile/generation fields are read on their owning thread and the existing scope teardown still joins the work:

```kotlin
private var committedTurnVersion = 0L
private var protectedWindowVersion = 0L
private var currentProtectedWindow = emptyList<Int>()

private fun publishProtectedWindow(window: List<Int>): Long {
    protectedWindowVersion = Math.incrementExact(
        protectedWindowVersion
    )
    currentProtectedWindow = window.toList()
    publishProtectedRasterOrdinals(currentProtectedWindow)
    return protectedWindowVersion
}

private fun schedulePersistentRefill(
    direction: ReaderPageTurnDirection,
    destinationOrdinal: Int,
    expectedTurnVersion: Long
) {
    val expectedProfile = requestedProfile ?: return
    val expectedGeneration = requestGeneration
    rasterScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) {
        persistentRefillCoordinator.onTurnCommitted(
            direction = direction,
            destinationOrdinal = destinationOrdinal,
            committedTurnVersion = expectedTurnVersion,
            isTurnStillCurrent = {
                !destroyed &&
                    requestedProfile == expectedProfile &&
                    requestGeneration == expectedGeneration &&
                    currentOrdinal == destinationOrdinal &&
                    committedTurnVersion == expectedTurnVersion
            },
            isStillCurrent = { fence ->
                !destroyed &&
                    requestedProfile == expectedProfile &&
                    requestGeneration == expectedGeneration &&
                    currentOrdinal == fence.destinationOrdinal &&
                    committedTurnVersion ==
                        fence.committedTurnVersion &&
                    protectedWindowVersion ==
                        fence.protectedWindowVersion &&
                    currentProtectedWindow == fence.protectedWindow
            }
        )
    }
}
```

Call this from the committed non-`NONE` settlement path after `currentOrdinal` is promoted:

```kotlin
committedTurnVersion = Math.incrementExact(committedTurnVersion)
schedulePersistentRefill(
    direction = direction,
    destinationOrdinal = destinationOrdinal,
    expectedTurnVersion = committedTurnVersion
)
```

Every code path that replaces the adapter/bundle protected window—including profile activation, external relocation, recovery, and turn refill—must call the single `publishProtectedWindow` method so `protectedWindowVersion` cannot miss a replacement. Never mutate `currentProtectedWindow` or invoke `publishProtectedRasterOrdinals` elsewhere. Never call the suspend refill function directly from `PageSurfaceListener`. Import `kotlinx.coroutines.launch`. Task 12's controller-worker teardown cancels and joins the existing `rasterScope`, so this child cannot outlive the controller. `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateControllerSourceTest` requires one coordinator field/construction, this exact `rasterScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate)` bridge, profile/generation/current-ordinal/committed-turn/protected-window-version fences, the central publisher, and the direct committed-path call to `schedulePersistentRefill`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add one suspendable, ownership-safe snapshot resolver**

```kotlin
internal fun interface ReaderPageRasterDescriptorPort {
    fun request(
        webView: WebView,
        pageIndex: Int,
        onDescriptor: (ReaderPageRasterDescriptor?) -> Unit
    )
}

internal interface ReaderPageRasterHydrationStorePort {
    suspend fun readCopy(
        key: ReaderPageRasterKey
    ): ReaderPageRaster<Bitmap>?

    suspend fun remove(key: ReaderPageRasterKey): Boolean
}

internal fun interface ReaderPageRasterHydrationRequest {
    fun cancel()
}

suspend fun resolveSnapshot(
    webView: WebView,
    pageIndex: Int,
    kind: ReaderPageTurnTransitionKind,
    reference: ReaderPageSlideSnapshot,
    publicationFence: () -> Boolean
): ReaderPageSlideSnapshot? = withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) {
    if (!publicationFence()) return@withContext null
    val retained = retainedSnapshot(pageIndex, kind)
    if (retained != null) {
        return@withContext suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
            continuation.resume(retained) { _, undelivered, _ ->
                undelivered.release()
            }
        }
    }
    suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
        val request = hydrateSnapshot(
            webView,
            pageIndex,
            kind,
            reference,
            publicationFence
        ) { hydrated ->
            continuation.resume(hydrated) { _, undelivered, _ ->
                undelivered?.release()
            }
        }
        continuation.invokeOnCancellation {
            request.cancel()
        }
    }
}
```

`retainedSnapshot` and every non-null `hydrateSnapshot` callback transfer exactly one retained `ReaderPageSlideSnapshot` reference to that recipient. Both the retained fast path and asynchronous hydration path cross a `suspendCancellableCoroutine` handoff with an undelivered-value release callback; never return a newly retained snapshot directly from `withContext`. `hydrateSnapshot` takes and stores the recipient-local `publicationFence`, returns a recipient-local `ReaderPageRasterHydrationRequest`, and `cancel()` removes only that recipient idempotently. Change the immediate cached branch in `hydrateSnapshot` to use `retainedSnapshot`. After persistent decode, detach only recipients whose fences still pass; if none pass, release the decoded bitmap without inserting it. Immediately before `putSnapshot`, re-check closed state, generation, quality/profile, destination, committed-turn version, protected-window version, and exact protected-window identity through each surviving fence. Insert once only when at least one recipient remains, then call `retain()` separately for each detached callback. The recipient releases once after leaf copying. The asynchronous path's `invokeOnCancellation` unregisters a recipient when cancellation wins before descriptor or disk completion. Null needs no cleanup. Retain the active prepared reference before calling the resolver and release it in `finally`. Do not capture in this method.

The default `ReaderPageRasterDescriptorPort` is the only implementation allowed to call `evaluateJavascript`; it parses the production descriptor and returns through the source-owned token. The default `ReaderPageRasterHydrationStorePort` delegates to the one Task 5 `ReaderPageRasterCacheStore`, using `readCopy` to create the independent decoded bitmap and identity-qualified `remove` for corrupt geometry. Constructor injection exists only at these two narrow ports so Robolectric tests execute the production bundle resolver, recipient registry, cache insertion, and Foliate loader without duplicating their algorithm.

Route every persistent read through the Task 5 `ReaderPageRasterCacheStore.readCopy`; production hydration must never call `rasterCache.read`, `rasterCache.readCopy`, or `rasterCache.remove` directly. Add a bounded read owner:

```kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.joinAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Semaphore
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withPermit
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

internal class ReaderPageRasterHydrationScheduler(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    val maxConcurrentWorkers: Int = 2
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private val permits = Semaphore(maxConcurrentWorkers)
    private val jobs = linkedSetOf<Job>()
    private val closedSignal = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    private var closed = false

    init {
        require(maxConcurrentWorkers > 0)
    }

    fun schedule(worker: suspend () -> Unit): Job? {
        val job = synchronized(lock) {
            if (closed) {
                null
            } else {
                scope.launch(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
                    permits.withPermit { worker() }
                }.also { created -> jobs.add(created) }
            }
        } ?: return null
        job.invokeOnCompletion {
            synchronized(lock) { jobs.remove(job) }
        }
        job.start()
        return job
    }

    suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
        val closing = synchronized(lock) {
            if (closed) null
            else {
                closed = true
                jobs.toList()
            }
        }
        if (closing != null) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                try {
                    closing.forEach { job -> job.cancel() }
                    closing.joinAll()
                } finally {
                    closedSignal.complete(Unit)
                }
            }
        }
        closedSignal.await()
    }
}
```

Before `evaluateJavascript`, allocate a monotonic descriptor-request token plus a recipient token and register an entry containing the recipient and immutable copied surface geometry. The JavaScript callback captures only the descriptor token and bundle source; it must not capture the external recipient or `ReaderPageSlideSnapshot` reference. `ReaderPageRasterHydrationRequest.cancel()` removes the exact recipient under the same serialized owner. If it was the final descriptor recipient, remove/tombstone the descriptor request; close/invalidation performs the same detachment and delivers null once to still-active recipients. A later WebView callback finds no owner and cannot retain caller state or schedule cache work.

After a valid descriptor returns, move each still-active recipient token into the digest-qualified in-flight hydration entry before scheduling. Store the `Job` returned by `ReaderPageRasterHydrationScheduler.schedule` on that exact entry. Cancelling one coalesced recipient leaves the others; cancelling the final recipient removes the entry and cancels that exact job. The worker owns the store `readCopy`, bitmap copy, validation, cache insertion, and callback detachment. A null schedule result removes that exact entry and delivers null. Worker cancellation also removes the exact entry in `finally`; it releases any uninserted bitmap and delivers null to every detached callback once. JavaScript descriptor callbacks that arrive after close see only the absent token/closed fence and never schedule a read or retain an external callback. Task 12 cancels and joins this scheduler before closing the persistent store or decoded cache.

Add tests for coroutine cancellation before descriptor acknowledgement, cancellation of one versus the final coalesced recipient, close before descriptor acknowledgement, one retained reference per coalesced callback, cancellation after `resume`, null scheduling, close during decode, and `closeAndJoin` returning only after all descriptor entries, read workers, and callback lists are empty.

Only invoke `onMissingRaster` after both decoded and persistent sources miss or fail validation while the same fence remains current.     data class WaitingForPreparation(
```kotlin
        val generationId: Long,
        val role: ReaderDeckSubmissionRole
    ) : ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState
    data class Ready(val generationId: Long) : ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState
    data class Failed(val reason: String) : ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState
}

internal class ReaderPageDeckRecoveryCoordinator(
    private val host: ReaderPageDeckRecoveryHost
) {
    private var nextRequestId = 0L

    var state: ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Idle
        private set

    val canAcceptPointer: Boolean
        get() = state is ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Ready ||
            host.hasUsablePreparedActiveDeck()

    fun accept(result: ReaderPageRasterRepairResult): Boolean {
        if (result !is ReaderPageRasterRepairResult.Repaired) return false
        if (!host.isCurrentRepairWindow(
                result.repairedPageIndices,
                result.centerOrdinal,
                result.rasterEpoch
            )
        ) {
            return false
        }
        val previous = state
        val requestId = ++nextRequestId
        state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForBuild(
            requestId = requestId,
            repairedPageIndices = result.repairedPageIndices,
            centerOrdinal = result.centerOrdinal,
            rasterEpoch = result.rasterEpoch
        )
        cancelOwnedState(previous)
        try {
            host.requestRecoveredDeckBuild(
                requestId = requestId,
                repairedPageIndices = result.repairedPageIndices,
                centerOrdinal = result.centerOrdinal,
                rasterEpoch = result.rasterEpoch
            ) { build -> onDeckBuilt(requestId, build) }
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            host.cancelRecoveredDeckBuild(requestId)
            val waiting = state as? ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForBuild
            if (waiting?.requestId == requestId) {
                state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Failed(
                    failure.message ?: "protected-window-build-failed"
                )
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    fun onDeckBuilt(
        requestId: Long,
        result: ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult
    ): Boolean {
        val waiting = state as? ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForBuild
        if (waiting == null || waiting.requestId != requestId) {
            releaseIfUnsubmitted(result)
            return false
        }
        if (!host.isCurrentRepairWindow(
                waiting.repairedPageIndices,
                waiting.centerOrdinal,
                waiting.rasterEpoch
            )
        ) {
            host.cancelRecoveredDeckBuild(requestId)
            releaseIfUnsubmitted(result)
            state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Idle
            return false
        }
        if (result is ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult.Failed) {
            state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Failed(result.reason)
            return false
        }
        val generationId =
            (result as ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult.Built).generationId
        val role = host.currentRecoveredDeckRole()
        state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForPreparation(
            generationId,
            role
        )
        return try {
            host.submitRecoveredDeck(generationId, role)
            true
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            val owned = state as?
                ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForPreparation
            if (owned?.generationId == generationId && owned.role == role) {
                host.releaseRecoveredDeck(generationId)
                state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Failed(
                    "recovered-deck-submission-failed"
                )
            }
            false
        }
    }

    private fun releaseIfUnsubmitted(
        result: ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult
    ) {
        if (result is ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult.Built) {
            host.releaseRecoveredDeck(result.generationId)
        }
    }

    private fun cancelOwnedState(previous: ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState) {
        when (previous) {
            is ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForBuild ->
                host.cancelRecoveredDeckBuild(previous.requestId)
            is ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForPreparation ->
                host.cancelSubmittedRecoveredDeck(
                    previous.generationId,
                    previous.role
                )
            else -> Unit
        }
    }

    fun cancelAll() {
        val previous = state
        state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Idle
        nextRequestId += 1L
        cancelOwnedState(previous)
    }

    fun onDeckRejected(
        generationId: Long,
        reason: DeckRejectionReason
    ): Boolean {
        val waiting = state as?
            ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForPreparation
            ?: return false
        if (waiting.generationId != generationId) return false
        state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Failed(
            "recovered-deck-rejected:${reason.name}"
        )
        return true
    }

    fun onDeckPrepared(generationId: Long): Boolean {
        val waiting = state as? ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.WaitingForPreparation
            ?: return false
        if (waiting.generationId != generationId || !host.isPrepared(generationId)) {
            return false
        }
        state = ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Ready(generationId)
        return true
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Rebuild and submit a matching deck after repair**

In the Foliate controller:

1. Reject stale profile/epoch repair results as no-ops; they must not replace `Idle`, `Ready`, or a newer recovery state with `Failed`.
2. Start an epoch-qualified asynchronous build of the full protected decoded window centered on the current logical ordinal. The request ID tombstones superseded build callbacks.
3. Revalidate the repaired page set, center, and raster epoch when the build callback returns. A callback for a superseded request is a no-op; a same-request callback whose authoritative window has moved clears only that obsolete recovery to `Idle`.
4. Immediately before submitting the built generation, query authoritative current controller state and choose `Active` when no valid prepared active deck remains; otherwise choose `Pending`. Do not snapshot a Boolean or role when repair or build starts, and do not store a role in `ReaderPageRasterRepairResult` or `WaitingForBuild`.
5. For an `Active` submission, set authoritative `textureDeck = Preparing`; for a `Pending` submission, leave the prepared active `textureDeck = Ready` and set only `pendingTextureDeck = Preparing`. A rejected submission clears only the role-specific slot and is a typed recovery failure.
6. On the exact accepted `onDeckPrepared(generationId)`, publish `textureDeck = Ready`; a pending promotion also clears `pendingTextureDeck = Empty`. Pointer admission during pending build/preparation remains derived from the current prepared active owner, never a stale role or the pending slot.

Only the controller implements `hasUsablePreparedActiveDeck()` and `currentRecoveredDeckRole()`, on its serialized main-thread owner:

```kotlin
override fun hasUsablePreparedActiveDeck(): Boolean {
    val generationId = activeDeckGenerationId ?: return false
    val pages = generationOwners[generationId] ?: return false
    return generationId in preparedDeckGenerations &&
        !pages.obsolete &&
        pages.profile == requestedProfile &&
        readinessState.textureDeck == ReaderTextureDeckState.Ready
}

override fun currentRecoveredDeckRole(): ReaderDeckSubmissionRole =
    if (hasUsablePreparedActiveDeck()) {
        ReaderDeckSubmissionRole.Pending
    } else {
        ReaderDeckSubmissionRole.Active
    }
```

`PageSurfaceView.submitDeck` remains the imported void API in Task 7. `onDeckBuilt` transitions to `WaitingForPreparation` before calling it, so even a synchronous `PageSurfaceListener.onDeckRejected` callback is correlated by generation and role through `onDeckRejected(generationId, reason)` and cannot be overwritten after `submitDeck` returns. The listener releases the rejected generation through the controller's existing owner path, then notifies the recovery coordinator; a thrown submission call is the only path where the coordinator calls `releaseRecoveredDeck` itself. Do not infer synchronous acceptance from listener timing and do not return a fabricated Boolean from the host adapter.

Every deck admission, preparation, promotion, rejection, release, profile invalidation, and destruction path updates those same owner collections before a repair callback can run. A `Built` callback transfers one unsubmitted generation lease to the coordinator: successful submission transfers it to renderer/deck ownership; stale or superseded build calls `releaseRecoveredDeck` exactly once, renderer rejection is released by the listener owner, and a throwing submission is released by the coordinator catch. Superseding repair, profile invalidation, and teardown call `cancelAll()` so the host cancels the exact build request, while the request ID still tombstones a hostile late callback. Add a coordinator test that starts a repair while the host reports `Pending`, changes the host to `Active` before build completion, and proves the submitted role follows the new state; add the inverse transition as well. Add `synchronousRendererRejectionCannotBeOverwrittenByWaitingState`: the fake host invokes `coordinator.onDeckRejected(generationId, DeckRejectionReason.INVALID_CONTENT)` from inside `submitRecoveredDeck`, then proves state remains `Failed`, the host listener released exactly once, and no preparation callback can revive it. This catches stale repair-start snapshots, synchronous callback races, and unsubmitted-generation leaks.

If refill or deck preparation fails after durable repair, complete the owning gesture with `FailedRecovery` and publish retryable failure state.

```kotlin
    assertIs<ReaderPageDeckRecoveryState.Failed>(coordinator.state)

private fun repairedWindow(
    pageIndices: IntRange,
    center: Int,
    rasterEpoch: Long = 9L
): ReaderPageRasterRepairResult.Repaired =
    ReaderPageRasterRepairResult.Repaired(
        repairedPageIndices = pageIndices.toSet(),
        centerOrdinal = center,
        rasterEpoch = rasterEpoch
    )

private class FakeDeckRecoveryHost(
    private val expectedPageIndices: Set<Int>,
    private val expectedCenterOrdinal: Int,
    var currentRole: ReaderDeckSubmissionRole,
    var usableActiveDeck: Boolean,
    private val expectedRasterEpoch: Long = 9L
) : ReaderPageDeckRecoveryHost {
    private val builds = linkedMapOf<
        Long,
        (ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult) -> Unit
    >()
    private val cancelledBuilds = linkedMapOf<
        Long,
        (ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult) -> Unit
    >()
    val cancelledRequests = mutableListOf<Long>()
    val releasedGenerations = mutableListOf<Long>()
    var synchronousCancelledGeneration: Long? = null
    var synchronousRejection: ((Long, DeckRejectionReason) -> Unit)? = null
    val submissions = mutableListOf<Pair<Long, ReaderDeckSubmissionRole>>()
    val cancelledSubmissions =
        mutableListOf<Pair<Long, ReaderDeckSubmissionRole>>()
    val prepared = mutableSetOf<Long>()

    override fun isCurrentRepairWindow(
        repairedPageIndices: Set<Int>,
        centerOrdinal: Int,
        rasterEpoch: Long
    ): Boolean = repairedPageIndices == expectedPageIndices &&
        centerOrdinal == expectedCenterOrdinal &&
        rasterEpoch == expectedRasterEpoch

    override fun hasUsablePreparedActiveDeck(): Boolean = usableActiveDeck

    override fun requestRecoveredDeckBuild(
        requestId: Long,
        repairedPageIndices: Set<Int>,
        centerOrdinal: Int,
        rasterEpoch: Long,
        onBuilt: (ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult) -> Unit
    ) {
        check(isCurrentRepairWindow(repairedPageIndices, centerOrdinal, rasterEpoch))
        builds[requestId] = onBuilt
    }

    override fun cancelRecoveredDeckBuild(requestId: Long) {
        cancelledRequests += requestId
        val callback = builds.remove(requestId) ?: return
        val synchronousGeneration = synchronousCancelledGeneration
        if (synchronousGeneration == null) {
            cancelledBuilds[requestId] = callback
        } else {
            synchronousCancelledGeneration = null
            callback(
                ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult.Built(
                    synchronousGeneration
                )
            )
        }
    }

    override fun currentRecoveredDeckRole(): ReaderDeckSubmissionRole = currentRole

    override fun submitRecoveredDeck(
        generationId: Long,
        role: ReaderDeckSubmissionRole
    ) {
        submissions += generationId to role
        synchronousRejection?.let { reject ->
            releasedGenerations += generationId
            reject(generationId, DeckRejectionReason.INVALID_CONTENT)
        }
    }

    override fun releaseRecoveredDeck(generationId: Long) {
        releasedGenerations += generationId
    }

    override fun cancelSubmittedRecoveredDeck(
        generationId: Long,
        role: ReaderDeckSubmissionRole
    ) {
        cancelledSubmissions += generationId to role
    }

    override fun isPrepared(generationId: Long): Boolean = generationId in prepared

    fun buildRequestIds(): Set<Long> = builds.keys.toSet()

    fun singleBuildRequestId(): Long = builds.keys.single()

    fun completeBuild(requestId: Long, generationId: Long) {
        checkNotNull(builds.remove(requestId)).invoke(
            ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult.Built(generationId)
        )
    }

    fun deliverCancelledBuild(requestId: Long, generationId: Long) {
        checkNotNull(cancelledBuilds.remove(requestId)).invoke(
            ReaderPageRecoveredDeckBuildResult.Built(generationId)
        )
    }
}
```

Also cover asynchronous build failure, submission rejection, a same-request build that becomes stale when the authoritative window moves, the inverse `Active`→`Pending` role transition before build completion, a stale prepared callback after a newer repair supersedes the first, supersession after successful submission but before preparation, and teardown in `WaitingForPreparation`. The final two tests must assert one `cancelSubmittedRecoveredDeck(generationId, role)` call and zero retained submitted generations.

```kotlin
internal enum class ReaderPageRasterRetryEvent {
    ContentReady,
    LayoutStable,
```
