Use an access-order `LinkedHashMap<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey, CacheEntry<T>>(0, 0.75f, true)` plus an identity-backed `retiredEntries` set, but do not let each cache entry own/recycle its value independently. Introduce one identity-keyed decoded owner shared by every alias entry:

```kotlin
import java.util.Collections
import java.util.IdentityHashMap
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

private enum class DecodedOwnerState {
    Active,
    Releasing,
    Released
}

private class DecodedValueOwner<T : Any>(
    val value: T,
    var state: DecodedOwnerState = DecodedOwnerState.Active
) {
    var entryReferences: Int = 0
}

private class CacheEntry<T : Any>(
    val key: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey,
    val owner: DecodedValueOwner<T>,
    val residencySlot: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Slot,
    var retainCount: Int = 0
)

// Includes Active and Releasing owners. An identity leaves this map only
// after its arbitrary release callback returns.
private val decodedOwners = IdentityHashMap<T, DecodedValueOwner<T>>()
private val retiredEntries = Collections.newSetFromMap(
    IdentityHashMap<CacheEntry<T>, Boolean>()
)

private fun assertDecodedCapacityLocked() {
    check(materializationValueReservations >= 0)
    check(
        decodedOwners.size + materializationValueReservations <=
            uniqueDecodedBitmapLimit
    ) { "PlayLikeCurl decoded identity capacity exceeded" }
}

private fun ownerForMaterializedValueLocked(
    worker: Job,
    value: T?
): DecodedValueOwner<T>? {
    val ownership = checkNotNull(workers[worker])
    check(ownership.kind == WorkerKind.Materialization)
    check(ownership.materializationReservationHeld)
    check(materializationValueReservations > 0)
    ownership.materializationReservationHeld = false
    materializationValueReservations -= 1

    if (value == null) {
        assertDecodedCapacityLocked()
        return null
    }
    val existing = decodedOwners[value]
    if (existing != null) {
        assertDecodedCapacityLocked()
        return when (existing.state) {
            DecodedOwnerState.Active -> existing
            DecodedOwnerState.Releasing -> null
            DecodedOwnerState.Released ->
                error("Released decoded owner remained indexed")
        }
    }
    check(decodedOwners.size < uniqueDecodedBitmapLimit)
    return DecodedValueOwner(value).also { owner ->
        decodedOwners[value] = owner
        updateResidencyPeaksLocked()
        assertDecodedCapacityLocked()
    }
}

private fun attachEntryLocked(entry: CacheEntry<T>) {
    check(entry.owner.state == DecodedOwnerState.Active)
    entry.owner.entryReferences += 1
}

private fun detachEntryLocked(
    entry: CacheEntry<T>
): DecodedValueOwner<T>? {
    val owner = entry.owner
    check(owner.state == DecodedOwnerState.Active)
    check(owner.entryReferences > 0)
    owner.entryReferences -= 1
    if (owner.entryReferences != 0) return null
    owner.state = DecodedOwnerState.Releasing
    releasedEntries += 1L
    return owner
}

private fun scheduleUnadoptedReleaseLocked(
    value: T,
    scheduled: MutableList<DecodedValueOwner<T>>
) {
    val owner = checkNotNull(decodedOwners[value]) {
        "Materialized value was not converted from its reservation"
    }
    when (owner.state) {
        DecodedOwnerState.Active -> {
            if (owner.entryReferences != 0) return
            owner.state = DecodedOwnerState.Releasing
            releasedEntries += 1L
            scheduleReleaseLocked(owner, scheduled)
        }
        DecodedOwnerState.Releasing -> Unit
        DecodedOwnerState.Released ->
            error("Released decoded owner remained indexed")
    }
}
```

Every inserted key calls `attachEntryLocked`; eviction/retired-entry drain calls `detachEntryLocked` exactly once. A non-null detached owner is changed to `Releasing` and registered as pending before the lock is dropped. It remains in `decodedOwners` until its callback returns, so another materializer cannot reopen recycle authority during the callback window. `ownerForMaterializedValueLocked` is the only reservation-conversion path: it consumes the calling worker's reservation exactly once, returns null for a null loader result or an identity already in `Releasing`, reuses an active alias owner, or indexes one new owner only after checking the reserved capacity. A current result may publish only with a non-null active owner. A late or stale result calls `scheduleUnadoptedReleaseLocked`: an active identity with references remains owned, a releasing identity already has final release authority, and a reservation-created zero-reference identity changes to `Releasing` and receives exactly one callback. This rule applies before replacing an entry as well, so two keys, a stale/current race, or a release/readoption race cannot recycle a still-visible or newly republished page.

Each `prepare(profile, pageIndices)` replaces the protected key set with that request's distinct keys. Evict least-recently-used entries outside the protected set; remove cache-entry ownership immediately. An unpinned entry detaches at once; a pinned entry moves to `retiredEntries` and detaches only when `retainCount == 0`. Active, pending, and renderer-release-in-flight decks remain pinned by `retainCount`. Under the adapter lock, `residentEntries` is `entries.size + retiredEntries.size`, while `uniqueDecodedBitmaps` is `decodedOwners.size`, including identities whose final callback is in progress. Update configured limits, peaks, pinned, active-preparation-worker, active-materialization-worker, pending-release, evicted, and released counters from those authoritative owners. Admission counts releasing identities against the bound rather than widening capacity while a callback is blocked.

Derive adapter limits from the centralized portrait/landscape protected-window policy plus `PageSurfaceView.getDeckLeaseLimit()` rather than only one active/one pending deck. The surface returns `leaseRegistry.capacity()`; the adapter receives that owner-provided value at construction and reserves at most that many maximally sized deck pins. The fixed current/retiring adapter pool may aggregate two owner limits, but the renderer still enforces the shared four-lease total. Do not duplicate the numeric lease ceiling in Kotlin diagnostics or scripts and do not infer bitmap ownership from key count because one decoded value may appear under more than one page role or overlay key.

Capacity rejection must arm a production wakeup under the same lock that observes the full owner. Emit one edge-triggered callback only when at least one armed capacity becomes usable; a retry that still cannot run re-arms its exact reason. This prevents a worker, reservation, release callback, or deck unpin from returning capacity between rejection and waiter registration:

```kotlin
private enum class CapacityKind {
    PreparationWorker,
    MaterializationWorkerOrIdentity,
    ResidentSlot
}

private val blockedCapacities = linkedSetOf<CapacityKind>()

private fun rejectForCapacityLocked(kind: CapacityKind) {
    if (!closed) blockedCapacities += kind
}

private fun residentSlotAvailableLocked(): Boolean =
    ownedEntryCountLocked() < residentEntryLimit ||
        entries.values.any { entry ->
            entry.retainCount == 0 && entry.key !in protectedKeys
        }

private fun capacityAvailableLocked(kind: CapacityKind): Boolean = when (kind) {
    CapacityKind.PreparationWorker ->
        canAdmitWorkerLocked(WorkerKind.Preparation)
    CapacityKind.MaterializationWorkerOrIdentity ->
        canAdmitWorkerLocked(WorkerKind.Materialization)
    CapacityKind.ResidentSlot -> residentSlotAvailableLocked()
}

private fun collectCapacitySignalsLocked(): Set<CapacityKind> {
    if (closed) {
        blockedCapacities.clear()
        return emptySet()
    }
    val available = blockedCapacities
        .filterTo(linkedSetOf(), ::capacityAvailableLocked)
    blockedCapacities.removeAll(available)
    return available
}

private fun rearmCapacitySignalsLocked(kinds: Set<CapacityKind>) {
    if (!closed) blockedCapacities += kinds
}

private fun dispatchCapacitySignals(returned: Set<CapacityKind>) {
    if (returned.isEmpty()) return
    val accepted = try {
        onCapacityAvailable()
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        synchronized(lock) {
            recordReleaseFailureLocked(failure)
        }
        false
    }
    if (!accepted) {
        synchronized(lock) {
            rearmCapacitySignalsLocked(returned)
        }
    }
}
```

`dispatchCapacitySignals` always runs outside `lock`; the controller callback posts/coalesces one main-thread `refreshPreparedDeck()` and returns whether that edge was accepted. A throw or rejected post re-arms the exact detached `CapacityKind` set under the adapter lock, records the failure, and publishes typed failed readiness rather than silently dropping durable work. A later owner transition can deliver the re-armed edge; closing clears armed reasons and emits no retry.

Track every adapter-owned coroutine explicitly. Create each `async`/`launch` with `CoroutineStart.LAZY`, register it under the adapter lock before start, and remove it from `invokeOnCompletion`:

```kotlin
private enum class WorkerKind {
    Preparation,
    Materialization
}

private class WorkerOwnership(
    val kind: WorkerKind,
    var materializationReservationHeld: Boolean
)

private val workers = linkedMapOf<Job, WorkerOwnership>()
private val closedSignal = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
private var openDeckRetainers = 0
private var pendingValueReleases = 0
private var releaseFailure: Throwable? = null

private fun activeWorkerCountLocked(kind: WorkerKind): Int =
    workers.values.count { ownership -> ownership.kind == kind }

private fun canAdmitWorkerLocked(kind: WorkerKind): Boolean = when (kind) {
    WorkerKind.Preparation ->
        activeWorkerCountLocked(kind) < preparationWorkerLimit
    WorkerKind.Materialization ->
        activeWorkerCountLocked(kind) < materializationWorkerLimit &&
            decodedOwners.size + materializationValueReservations <
                uniqueDecodedBitmapLimit
}

private fun <J : Job> registerWorkerLocked(
    worker: J,
    kind: WorkerKind
): J {
    check(!closed) { "PlayLikeCurl raster adapter is closed" }
    check(canAdmitWorkerLocked(kind)) {
        "PlayLikeCurl raster worker capacity exceeded"
    }
    val ownsReservation = kind == WorkerKind.Materialization
    if (ownsReservation) {
        materializationValueReservations += 1
    }
    workers[worker] = WorkerOwnership(
        kind = kind,
        materializationReservationHeld = ownsReservation
    )
    assertDecodedCapacityLocked()
    worker.invokeOnCompletion { workerFailure ->
        val capacityReturned = synchronized(lock) {
            val ownership = workers.remove(worker)
            if (ownership != null &&
                ownership.materializationReservationHeld
            ) {
                check(materializationValueReservations > 0)
                ownership.materializationReservationHeld = false
                materializationValueReservations -= 1
            }
            workerFailure?.takeUnless { it is CancellationException }
                ?.let(::recordReleaseFailureLocked)
            assertDecodedCapacityLocked()
            collectCapacitySignalsLocked().also {
                completeCloseIfDrainedLocked()
            }
        }
        dispatchCapacitySignals(capacityReturned)
    }
    return worker
}

private fun ownedEntryCountLocked(): Int =
    entries.size + retiredEntries.size

private fun recordReleaseFailureLocked(next: Throwable) {
    val first = releaseFailure
    if (first == null) {
        releaseFailure = next
    } else if (next !== first) {
        first.addSuppressed(next)
    }
}

private fun completeCloseIfDrainedLocked() {
    if (
        !closed || workers.isNotEmpty() || inFlight.isNotEmpty() ||
        openDeckRetainers != 0 ||
        materializationValueReservations != 0 ||
        pendingValueReleases != 0
    ) return

    if (ownedEntryCountLocked() != 0 || decodedOwners.isNotEmpty()) {
        recordReleaseFailureLocked(
            IllegalStateException(
                "PlayLikeCurl adapter retained decoded ownership after drain"
            )
        )
    }
    val failure = releaseFailure
    if (failure == null) {
        closedSignal.complete(Unit)
    } else {
        closedSignal.completeExceptionally(failure)
    }
}
```

The preparation deferred and each materializer job must be registered atomically with the generation/in-flight state that makes it reachable, then started after leaving the lock. Import `CancellationException` and `CoroutineStart`. A close race that wins before registration returns a completed-null deck instead of a cancelled deferred. Replace the existing preparation path with this exact worker-owned form:

```kotlin
fun prepare(
    profile: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProfile,
    pageIndices: List<Int>,
    onProgress: (ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProgress) -> Unit = {}
): Deferred<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterDeck<T>?> {
    val uniquePageIndices = pageIndices.distinct()
    val requestedKeys = uniquePageIndices
        .mapTo(linkedSetOf()) { pageIndex ->
            ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey(
                profile = profile,
                pageIndex = pageIndex
            )
        }
    val staleWaiters = mutableListOf<
        CompletableDeferred<CacheEntry<T>?>
    >()
    val scheduled = mutableListOf<DecodedValueOwner<T>>()
    var workerToStart: Deferred<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterDeck<T>?>? = null

    val result = synchronized(lock) {
        if (closed) return completedNullDeck()
        if (activeProfile != profile) {
            generation += 1L
            activeProfile = profile
            inFlight.values
                .filter { work -> work.generation != generation }
                .mapTo(staleWaiters) { work -> work.result }
            retireResidentEntriesLocked(scheduled)
        }
        protectedKeys = requestedKeys
        if (!canAdmitWorkerLocked(WorkerKind.Preparation)) {
            rejectForCapacityLocked(CapacityKind.PreparationWorker)
            return@synchronized completedNullDeck()
        }

        val admittedGeneration = generation
        lateinit var worker: Deferred<
            ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterDeck<T>?
        >
        worker = scope.async(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            prepareDeck(
                profile = profile,
                uniquePageIndices = uniquePageIndices,
                requestedKeys = requestedKeys,
                preparationGeneration = admittedGeneration,
                onProgress = onProgress
            )
        }
        registerWorkerLocked(worker, WorkerKind.Preparation)
        workerToStart = worker
        worker
    }

    staleWaiters.forEach { waiter -> waiter.complete(null) }
    releaseScheduledOwners(scheduled)
    workerToStart?.start()
    return result
}

private fun retireResidentEntriesLocked(
    scheduled: MutableList<DecodedValueOwner<T>>
) {
    val previous = entries.values.toList()
    entries.clear()
    previous.forEach { entry ->
        if (entry.retainCount > 0) {
            check(retiredEntries.add(entry))
        } else {
            detachEntryLocked(entry)?.let { owner ->
                scheduleReleaseLocked(owner, scheduled)
            }
        }
    }
}

private suspend fun prepareDeck(
    profile: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProfile,
    uniquePageIndices: List<Int>,
    requestedKeys: Set<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey>,
    preparationGeneration: Long,
    onProgress: (ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProgress) -> Unit
): ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterDeck<T>? {
    onProgress(
        ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProgress(
            completed = 0,
            total = uniquePageIndices.size
        )
    )
    val loaded = LinkedHashMap<
        ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey,
        CacheEntry<T>
    >(uniquePageIndices.size)
    for ((position, pageIndex) in uniquePageIndices.withIndex()) {
        val key = ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey(
            profile = profile,
            pageIndex = pageIndex
        )
        val entry = loadEntry(key, preparationGeneration) ?: return null
        loaded[key] = entry
        onProgress(
            ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProgress(
                completed = position + 1,
                total = uniquePageIndices.size
            )
        )
    }

    val retainedEntries = synchronized(lock) {
        val current =
            !closed &&
                generation == preparationGeneration &&
                activeProfile == profile &&
                requestedKeys.all { key -> entries[key] === loaded[key] }
        if (!current) return@synchronized null
        loaded.values.distinct().also { entriesToRetain ->
            entriesToRetain.forEach { entry -> entry.retainCount += 1 }
            openDeckRetainers += 1
        }
    } ?: return null

    return ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterDeck(
        profile = profile,
        values = loaded.mapKeys { (key, _) -> key.pageIndex }
            .mapValues { (_, entry) -> entry.owner.value },
        releaseOwnership = { releaseDeckRetainer(retainedEntries) }
    )
}
```

A new profile invalidates the generation and retires its old resident entries even when all preparation-worker slots are occupied; otherwise an old worker could still publish after the caller observed a new profile. Capacity rejection returns a completed-null deck only after arming the matching `CapacityKind` under `lock`; worker removal, an unused reservation return, decoded-release completion, or deck unpin then emits the production retry edge outside the lock. For the same profile, each admitted request replaces `protectedKeys`. Before retaining a deck, `prepareDeck` proves every loaded key still maps to the exact same active cache entry; a concurrent request may have evicted an unpinned entry while this worker was suspended, and such a worker must return null rather than pin a detached or releasing identity.

Replace materializer creation and publication with this exact reservation-owning path:

```kotlin
private class InFlight<T : Any>(
    val generation: Long,
    val result: CompletableDeferred<CacheEntry<T>?>
) {
    lateinit var worker: Job
}

private suspend fun loadEntry(
    key: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey,
    preparationGeneration: Long
): CacheEntry<T>? {
    var workerToStart: Job? = null
    val work = synchronized(lock) {
        if (closed || generation != preparationGeneration ||
            activeProfile != key.profile
        ) return null
        entries[key]?.let { entry -> return entry }
        inFlight[key]
            ?.takeIf { active ->
                active.generation == preparationGeneration
            }
            ?.let { active -> return@synchronized active }
        if (!canAdmitWorkerLocked(WorkerKind.Materialization)) {
            rejectForCapacityLocked(
                CapacityKind.MaterializationWorkerOrIdentity
            )
            return null
        }

        val created = InFlight<T>(
            generation = preparationGeneration,
            result = CompletableDeferred()
        )
        lateinit var worker: Job
        worker = scope.launch(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            materialize(key, created, worker)
        }
        created.worker = worker
        inFlight[key] = created
        worker.invokeOnCompletion {
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (inFlight[key] === created) {
                    inFlight.remove(key)
                }
                completeCloseIfDrainedLocked()
            }
            created.result.complete(null)
        }
        registerWorkerLocked(worker, WorkerKind.Materialization)
        workerToStart = worker
        created
    }
    workerToStart?.start()
    return work.result.await()
}

private fun detachResidentEntryLocked(
    entry: CacheEntry<T>,
    residencySlotsToRelease: MutableList<
        ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Slot
    >
): DecodedValueOwner<T>? {
    residencySlotsToRelease += entry.residencySlot
    return detachEntryLocked(entry)
}

private fun replacementCandidateLocked(): CacheEntry<T>? =
    entries.entries.firstOrNull { (_, entry) ->
        entry.retainCount == 0 && entry.key !in protectedKeys
    }?.value

private suspend fun materialize(
    key: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterKey,
    work: InFlight<T>,
    worker: Job
) {
    var value: T? = null
    var cancellation: CancellationException? = null
    try {
        value = loader.load(key)
    } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
        cancellation = cancelled
    } catch (_: Throwable) {
        // Loader failure is a typed null materialization, matching the
        // existing adapter contract; ownership still finalizes below.
    }

    val scheduled = mutableListOf<DecodedValueOwner<T>>()
    val published = synchronized(lock) {
        if (inFlight[key] === work) {
            inFlight.remove(key)
        }
        val owner = ownerForMaterializedValueLocked(worker, value)
        val current =
            cancellation == null &&
                value != null &&
                owner != null &&
                !closed &&
                generation == work.generation &&
                activeProfile == key.profile
        if (!current) {
            value?.let { stale ->
                scheduleUnadoptedReleaseLocked(stale, scheduled)
            }
            return@synchronized null
        }

        val mustReplace = ownedEntryCountLocked() >= residentEntryLimit
        val replacement = replacementCandidateLocked()
        val admission = if (mustReplace && replacement == null) {
            ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Admission.Unavailable
        } else {
            residencyBudget.tryAcquireOrReplace(
                replacement = replacement?.residencySlot,
                allowNew = !mustReplace
            )
        }
        when (admission) {
            ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Admission.Unavailable -> {
                rejectForCapacityLocked(CapacityKind.ResidentSlot)
                value?.let { rejected ->
                    scheduleUnadoptedReleaseLocked(rejected, scheduled)
                }
                null
            }
            is ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Admission.Acquired -> {
                val entry = CacheEntry(
                    key = key,
                    owner = checkNotNull(owner),
                    residencySlot = admission.slot
                )
                attachEntryLocked(entry)
                entries[key] = entry
                updateResidencyPeaksLocked()
                entry
            }
            is ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Admission.Replaced -> {
                val candidate = checkNotNull(replacement)
                check(candidate.residencySlot === admission.slot)
                val entry = CacheEntry(
                    key = key,
                    owner = checkNotNull(owner),
                    residencySlot = admission.slot
                )
                // Attach first so an identity alias cannot enter Releasing.
                attachEntryLocked(entry)
                check(entries.remove(candidate.key) === candidate)
                evictedEntries += 1L
                detachEntryLocked(candidate)?.let { detachedOwner ->
                    scheduleReleaseLocked(detachedOwner, scheduled)
                }
                entries[key] = entry
                updateResidencyPeaksLocked()
                entry
            }
        }
    }
    work.result.complete(published)
    releaseScheduledOwners(scheduled)
    cancellation?.let { cancelled -> throw cancelled }
}
```

`protectedKeys` is the distinct key set installed by the admitted preparation. `replacementCandidateLocked` selects only an unpinned, unprotected LRU entry. When local capacity is full it is mandatory; when local capacity remains it is offered only as an atomic fallback if the aggregate budget is saturated. `Admission.Replaced` transfers that live slot without releasing it, while every fresh `Admission.Acquired` increments the aggregate count exactly once. Pinned entries remain in `entries` or `retiredEntries` and therefore consume resident capacity until their deck closes. The materializer always consumes its reservation after `loader.load`, even for null, stale, closed, loader-failure, and cancellation paths. If a lazy job is cancelled before entering its body, `registerWorkerLocked` returns its still-held reservation from the completion callback, and the materializer-specific completion callback removes the matching in-flight record and completes its waiter with null. A current value publishes only after fresh or replacement admission; otherwise its zero-reference owner enters the same one-callback release path as every other stale value.

Every value returned by `detachEntryLocked` is registered as a pending release before the lock is dropped; arbitrary `release` callbacks run outside the lock, all are attempted, and their failures are retained for `closeAndJoin`:

```kotlin
private fun scheduleReleaseLocked(
    owner: DecodedValueOwner<T>,
    scheduled: MutableList<DecodedValueOwner<T>>
) {
    check(owner.state == DecodedOwnerState.Releasing)
    pendingValueReleases += 1
    scheduled += owner
}

private fun releaseScheduledOwners(
    owners: List<DecodedValueOwner<T>>
) {
    owners.forEach { owner ->
        var callbackFailure: Throwable? = null
        try {
            release(owner.value)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            callbackFailure = failure
        } finally {
            val capacityReturned = synchronized(lock) {
                callbackFailure?.let(::recordReleaseFailureLocked)
                check(owner.state == DecodedOwnerState.Releasing)
                check(decodedOwners.remove(owner.value) === owner)
                owner.state = DecodedOwnerState.Released
                if (pendingValueReleases <= 0) {
                    recordReleaseFailureLocked(
                        IllegalStateException(
                            "Decoded release completed without pending ownership"
                        )
                    )
                    pendingValueReleases = 0
                } else {
                    pendingValueReleases -= 1
                }
                collectCapacitySignalsLocked().also {
                    completeCloseIfDrainedLocked()
                }
            }
            dispatchCapacitySignals(capacityReturned)
        }
    }
}

private fun detachEntryIfRetiredLocked(
    entry: CacheEntry<T>,
    residencySlotsToRelease: MutableList<
        ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Slot
    >
): DecodedValueOwner<T>? {
    if (entry.retainCount != 0 || entry !in retiredEntries) {
        return null
    }
    check(retiredEntries.remove(entry))
    return detachResidentEntryLocked(entry, residencySlotsToRelease)
}

private fun releaseDeckEntries(entries: List<CacheEntry<T>>) {
    val scheduled = mutableListOf<DecodedValueOwner<T>>()
    val residencySlotsToRelease = mutableListOf<
        ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudget.Slot
    >()
    synchronized(lock) {
        entries.forEach { entry ->
            if (entry.retainCount <= 0) {
                recordReleaseFailureLocked(
                    IllegalStateException(
                        "PlayLikeCurl raster deck released without ownership"
                    )
                )
            } else {
                entry.retainCount -= 1
                try {
                    detachEntryIfRetiredLocked(
                        entry,
                        residencySlotsToRelease
                    )?.let { owner ->
                            scheduleReleaseLocked(owner, scheduled)
                        }
                } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                    recordReleaseFailureLocked(failure)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    releaseScheduledOwners(scheduled)
    residencySlotsToRelease.forEach(residencyBudget::release)
}

private fun releaseDeckRetainer(entries: List<CacheEntry<T>>) {
    try {
        releaseDeckEntries(entries)
    } finally {
        val capacityReturned = synchronized(lock) {
            if (openDeckRetainers <= 0) {
                recordReleaseFailureLocked(
                    IllegalStateException(
                        "Raster deck retainer completed more than once"
                    )
                )
                openDeckRetainers = 0
            } else {
                openDeckRetainers -= 1
            }
            collectCapacitySignalsLocked().also {
                completeCloseIfDrainedLocked()
            }
        }
        dispatchCapacitySignals(capacityReturned)
    }
}
```

`detachEntryIfRetiredLocked` returns null while the entry is still cache-owned, and otherwise delegates to `detachResidentEntryLocked`, which schedules the exact shared residency slot for release beside the identity-safe decoded owner. Every profile retirement, ordinary non-replacement eviction, failed fresh-slot publication, deck unpin, and final `close()` path must use that helper and release collected budget slots only after dropping the adapter lock. Atomic replacement is the sole exception: it uses `detachEntryLocked` after attaching the new owner because the same live slot moves into the replacement entry and must not be released. When a preparation successfully increments every distinct entry's `retainCount`, increment `openDeckRetainers` in the same synchronized block and construct the deck with `releaseOwnership = { releaseDeckRetainer(retainedEntries) }`. `ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterDeck.close()` keeps its synchronized exactly-once guard; the adapter callback itself is best-effort, so a bad releaser or one corrupt entry cannot prevent later entry unpins, shared-slot return, or the final retainer decrement.

`close()` keeps its synchronous fencing behavior, completes every in-flight waiter with null, drops cache ownership through `detachResidentEntryLocked`, schedules every newly unowned identity and shared residency slot, invokes decoded release callbacks and budget release after leaving the lock, and does not itself cancel active materializers. The controller teardown cancels their shared parent after every adapter is fenced. Add:

```kotlin
suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
    close()
    withContext(NonCancellable) {
        closedSignal.await()
    }
}
```

`completeCloseIfDrainedLocked()` runs at the end of `close()`, from every worker completion, after every value-release callback, and after every deck retainer closes. It waits for workers, open decks, and pending release callbacks. Once those future ownership-changing paths are all zero, any remaining entry or decoded owner completes the shared signal exceptionally instead of hanging forever. Therefore repeated close callers share one completion, preparation waiters finish promptly, a loader's late value remains owned until its materializer publishes it as stale and attempts `release` exactly once, and `closeAndJoin()` cannot report success while a renderer-held deck still pins an entry. Extend the pin test so the close deferred remains pending until `deck.close()` releases the final retained entry, and add a releaser-throws test proving all identities are attempted, metrics drain, and every `closeAndJoin` caller receives the same failure rather than waiting forever.

The protected request is already produced by `readerPlayLikeCurlPreparedPageIndices`: portrait current ±2 pages, landscape current spread ±2 complete spreads, clipped to real boundaries.

- [ ] **Step 5: Add structured non-blocking teardown across renderer and raster owners**

Retain the existing raster-generation worker job, but make each dequeued request an isolated terminal unit. `rollbackPublication`, store reads/writes, value release, and completion callbacks may all throw; none may kill the sole drain before the current waiter is completed and pending ownership is removed. Add a retained aggregate failure and make `process` own finalization:

```kotlin
private var retainedWorkerFailure: Throwable? = null

private val workerJob = scope.launch {
    for (signal in wakeups) drain()
}

private suspend fun process(work: Work<T>) {
    var status = ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Failed
    var cancellation: CancellationException? = null
    try {
        status = processOwned(work)
    } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
        cancellation = cancelled
        status = ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Stale
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        recordWorkerFailure(failure)
    } finally {
        try {
            complete(work, status)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            recordWorkerFailure(failure)
            synchronized(lock) {
                pending[work.key.digest]
                    ?.takeIf { current -> current === work }
                    ?.let { pending.remove(work.key.digest) }
            }
            work.result.complete(
                ReaderPageRasterScheduleResult(work.key, status)
            )
        }
    }
    cancellation?.let { throw it }
}

private suspend fun processOwned(
    work: Work<T>
): ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus {
    if (withContext(ioDispatcher) { store.contains(work.key) }) {
        return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Cached
    }
    if (!isCurrent(work)) {
        return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Stale
    }
    val generated = generator.generate(work.key)
        ?: return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Failed
    var callerOwnsValue = true
    try {
        if (!isCurrent(work)) {
            return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Stale
        }
        val write = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
            store.write(work.key, generated.metadata, generated.value)
        }
        callerOwnsValue =
            write.ownership == ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
        if (!write.persisted) {
            return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Failed
        }
        if (!isCurrent(work)) {
            write.receipt?.let { receipt ->
                withContext(ioDispatcher) {
                    store.rollbackPublication(receipt)
                }
            }
            return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Stale
        }
        return ReaderPageRasterScheduleStatus.Published
    } finally {
        if (callerOwnsValue) release(generated.value)
    }
}

private fun recordWorkerFailure(failure: Throwable) {
    synchronized(lock) {
        val first = retainedWorkerFailure
        if (first == null) retainedWorkerFailure = failure
        else if (failure !== first) first.addSuppressed(failure)
    }
}

suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
    close()
    withContext(NonCancellable) {
        workerJob.join()
    }
    synchronized(lock) { retainedWorkerFailure }?.let { throw it }
}
```

Adapt `processOwned` to Task 5's exact ownership result: if a stale write transferred ownership to the store, do not release that identity; if `rollbackPublication` throws, its exception is retained, the current result still completes `Failed`, and the worker continues draining later requests. A generated value that never reaches `write` remains caller-owned and is released in `finally`. If `release` itself throws, retain it without skipping finalization. The worker's completion hook must detach and complete any requests still in `pending` as `Stale` if parent cancellation ends the drain unexpectedly; invoke detached completions outside `lock`. `close()` keeps its current synchronous behavior: mark the scheduler closed, invalidate the active profile generation, complete queued requests as `Stale`, and close `wakeups`. `closeAndJoin()` waits for an already-running request to finalize and then throws the same retained aggregate object to every caller. Do not rely on `Job.join()` to surface a child exception and do not cancel the worker before its `finally`/stale cleanup runs.

Assert both deferreds complete, the second request is processed, `pending` is zero, each caller-owned value is released once, and `closeAndJoin()` throws the retained rollback failure with any release/completion failures suppressed. Add a parent-cancellation case proving the completion hook drains the current and queued waiters even though no later wakeup can run.

Make every decoded-cache mutation identity-safe, not only final close. Replace the key-owned `ReaderPageRaster<T>` values in `decoded` with entries that share one identity owner:

```kotlin
private enum class DecodedCacheOwnerState {
    Active,
    ReleasePendingForEncode,
    Releasing,
    Released
}

private class DecodedCacheOwner<T : Any>(
    val value: T,
    var state: DecodedCacheOwnerState = DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active,
    var entryReferences: Int = 0
)

private class DecodedCacheEntry<T : Any>(
    val key: ReaderPageRasterKey,
    val metadata: ReaderPageRasterMetadata,
    val owner: DecodedCacheOwner<T>
)

private class DecodedCacheEncodePin<T : Any>(
    val value: T
) {
    var released = false
}

private sealed interface DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission<out T : Any> {
    data class Pinned<T : Any>(
        val pin: DecodedCacheEncodePin<T>
    ) : DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission<T>

    data object IdentityReleasing : DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission<Nothing>
    data object CacheClosed : DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission<Nothing>
}

private val decoded =
    LinkedHashMap<String, DecodedCacheEntry<T>>(0, 0.75f, true)
private val decodedOwners =
    IdentityHashMap<T, DecodedCacheOwner<T>>()
private val decodedEncodePins = IdentityHashMap<T, Int>()
private var activeEncodePins = 0
private var pendingDecodedReleases = 0
private var decodedReleaseFailure: Throwable? = null
private var decodedClosed = false

private enum class DecodedCacheAdoption {
    Adopted,
    ConsumedByStore,
    Caller,
    RetryAfterRelease
}
```

`decodedOwners` contains active, encode-pinned-pending, and releasing identities. `decodedEncodePins` is identity-keyed rather than equality-keyed. A write acquires a pin before `codec.encode` and retains it through file encoding, manifest commit, and its final decoded-adoption decision. Attach a logical digest by incrementing `entryReferences`; replacing the same digest with the same owner only refreshes key/metadata. Every replacement, `retainProfile`, `protectChapter`, `trimDecodedToProtectedWindow`, explicit `remove`, capacity eviction, corrupt-entry removal, and final close detaches the logical entry exactly once. The last detach either moves an encode-pinned owner to `ReleasePendingForEncode` or schedules `Releasing`; no release callback can recycle an identity while that identity is being encoded:

```kotlin
private fun scheduleDecodedOwnerReleaseLocked(
    owner: DecodedCacheOwner<T>,
    scheduled: MutableList<DecodedCacheOwner<T>>
) {
    check(owner.entryReferences == 0)
    check(owner.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active ||
        owner.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.ReleasePendingForEncode)
    if ((decodedEncodePins[owner.value] ?: 0) > 0) {
        owner.state = DecodedCacheOwnerState.ReleasePendingForEncode
        return
    }
    owner.state = DecodedCacheOwnerState.Releasing
    pendingDecodedReleases += 1
    scheduled += owner
}

private fun detachDecodedEntryLocked(
    digest: String,
    scheduled: MutableList<DecodedCacheOwner<T>>
) {
    val entry = decoded.remove(digest) ?: return
    val owner = entry.owner
    check(owner.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active)
    check(owner.entryReferences > 0)
    owner.entryReferences -= 1
    if (owner.entryReferences == 0) {
        scheduleDecodedOwnerReleaseLocked(owner, scheduled)
    }
}

private fun acquireDecodedEncodePin(
    value: T
): DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission<T> = synchronized(this) {
    if (decodedClosed) {
        return@synchronized DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission.CacheClosed
    }
    when (decodedOwners[value]?.state) {
        DecodedCacheOwnerState.Releasing ->
            return@synchronized DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission.IdentityReleasing
        DecodedCacheOwnerState.Released ->
            error("Released decoded owner remained indexed")
        DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active,
        DecodedCacheOwnerState.ReleasePendingForEncode,
        null -> Unit
    }
    decodedEncodePins[value] = (decodedEncodePins[value] ?: 0) + 1
    activeEncodePins += 1
    DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission.Pinned(DecodedCacheEncodePin(value))
}

private fun requirePersistOnlyIdentityAvailable(value: T) {
    synchronized(this) {
        check(!decodedClosed) { "Decoded raster cache is closed" }
        check(decodedOwners[value] == null) {
            "PersistOnly value is already owned by the decoded cache"
        }
        check(decodedEncodePins[value] == null) {
            "PersistOnly value is adopt-pinned by the decoded cache"
        }
    }
}

private fun ownershipForPinnedFailure(
    pin: DecodedCacheEncodePin<T>
): ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership = synchronized(this) {
    check(!pin.released)
    if (decodedOwners[pin.value] != null) {
        ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Store
    } else {
        ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
    }
}

private fun releaseDecodedEncodePin(pin: DecodedCacheEncodePin<T>) {
    val scheduled = mutableListOf<DecodedCacheOwner<T>>()
    synchronized(this) {
        check(!pin.released) { "Decoded encode pin released twice" }
        pin.released = true
        val count = checkNotNull(decodedEncodePins[pin.value])
        if (count == 1) decodedEncodePins.remove(pin.value)
        else decodedEncodePins[pin.value] = count - 1
        activeEncodePins -= 1
        check(activeEncodePins >= 0)
        val owner = decodedOwners[pin.value]
        if (owner?.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.ReleasePendingForEncode &&
            owner.entryReferences == 0 &&
            decodedEncodePins[pin.value] == null
        ) {
            scheduleDecodedOwnerReleaseLocked(owner, scheduled)
        }
    }
    releaseDecodedOwners(scheduled)
}

private inline fun withDecodedEncodeAdmission(
    mode: ReaderPageRasterWriteMode,
    value: T,
    transaction: () -> ReaderPageRasterWriteResult
): ReaderPageRasterWriteResult {
    if (mode == ReaderPageRasterWriteMode.PersistOnly) {
        requirePersistOnlyIdentityAvailable(value)
        return transaction()
    }

    val pin = when (val admission = acquireDecodedEncodePin(value)) {
        is DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission.Pinned -> admission.pin
        DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission.IdentityReleasing -> {
            onDiagnostic("write-failed reason=encode-identity-releasing")
            return ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(
                persisted = false,
                ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Store,
                failureReason =
                    ReaderPageRasterWriteFailureReason.EncodeIdentityReleasing
            )
        }
        DecodedCacheEncodeAdmission.CacheClosed -> {
            return ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(
                persisted = false,
                ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
            )
        }
    }

    return try {
        val result = transaction()
        if (!result.persisted &&
            result.ownership == ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller &&
            ownershipForPinnedFailure(pin) ==
                ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Store
        ) {
            result.copy(ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Store)
        } else {
            result
        }
    } finally {
        releaseDecodedEncodePin(pin)
    }
}
```

Make the public `write` method call `withDecodedEncodeAdmission(mode, value)` around its complete existing transaction. The lambda begins with `codec.encode` and ends only after temporary-file fsync, commit-fence execution, file promotion, durable manifest publication, and the final `adoptDecodedValue` decision. No early return may bypass the helper's `finally`. `PersistOnly` performs its identity check before `codec.encode`; an indexed or adopt-pinned identity throws `IllegalStateException`, so publication cannot silently borrow an identity whose release authority belongs to the decoded cache. `AdoptDecoded` does not call `codec.encode` when admission returns `IdentityReleasing`, and the returned result is exactly `persisted = false`, `ownership = Store`, `receipt = null`, and `failureReason = EncodeIdentityReleasing`.

```kotlin
private fun attachDecodedEntryLocked(
    key: ReaderPageRasterKey,
    metadata: ReaderPageRasterMetadata,
    owner: DecodedCacheOwner<T>
) {
    check(owner.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active)
    check(decoded[key.digest] == null)
    decoded[key.digest] = DecodedCacheEntry(key, metadata, owner)
    owner.entryReferences += 1
}

private fun adoptDecodedValue(
    key: ReaderPageRasterKey,
    metadata: ReaderPageRasterMetadata,
    value: T
): DecodedCacheAdoption {
    if (maxDecodedEntries <= 0) return DecodedCacheAdoption.Caller

    while (true) {
        val scheduled = mutableListOf<DecodedCacheOwner<T>>()
        val decision = synchronized(this) {
            val current = decoded[key.digest]
            val existingOwner = decodedOwners[value]
            if (current?.owner === existingOwner &&
                existingOwner?.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active
            ) {
                decoded[key.digest] =
                    DecodedCacheEntry(key, metadata, existingOwner)
                return@synchronized DecodedCacheAdoption.Adopted
            }

            if (current != null) {
                detachDecodedEntryLocked(key.digest, scheduled)
                return@synchronized DecodedCacheAdoption.RetryAfterRelease
            }

            when (existingOwner?.state) {
                DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active -> {
                    attachDecodedEntryLocked(
                        key,
                        metadata,
                        existingOwner
                    )
                    DecodedCacheAdoption.Adopted
                }
                DecodedCacheOwnerState.ReleasePendingForEncode -> {
                    check(existingOwner.entryReferences == 0)
                    check(decodedEncodePins[value] != null)
                    existingOwner.state = DecodedCacheOwnerState.Active
                    attachDecodedEntryLocked(
                        key,
                        metadata,
                        existingOwner
                    )
                    DecodedCacheAdoption.Adopted
                }
                DecodedCacheOwnerState.Releasing ->
                    DecodedCacheAdoption.ConsumedByStore
                DecodedCacheOwnerState.Released ->
                    error("Released decoded owner remained indexed")
                null -> {
                    if (decodedOwners.size < maxDecodedEntries) {
                        val owner = DecodedCacheOwner(value)
                        decodedOwners[value] = owner
                        attachDecodedEntryLocked(key, metadata, owner)
                        DecodedCacheAdoption.Adopted
                    } else {
                        val eviction = decoded.entries.firstOrNull {
                            (_, candidate) ->
                            candidate.key.visualPageOrdinal !in
                                protectedDecodedPageIndices
                        }
                        if (eviction == null) {
                            DecodedCacheAdoption.Caller
                        } else {
                            detachDecodedEntryLocked(
                                eviction.key,
                                scheduled
                            )
                            DecodedCacheAdoption.RetryAfterRelease
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        releaseDecodedOwners(scheduled)
        if (decision != DecodedCacheAdoption.RetryAfterRelease) {
            return decision
        }
    }
}

private fun recordDecodedReleaseFailureLocked(failure: Throwable) {
    val first = decodedReleaseFailure
    if (first == null) {
        decodedReleaseFailure = failure
    } else if (failure !== first) {
        first.addSuppressed(failure)
    }
}

private fun releaseDecodedOwners(
    owners: List<DecodedCacheOwner<T>>
) {
    owners.forEach { owner ->
        var callbackFailure: Throwable? = null
        try {
            codec.release(owner.value)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            callbackFailure = failure
        } finally {
            synchronized(this) {
                callbackFailure?.let(::recordDecodedReleaseFailureLocked)
                check(owner.state == DecodedCacheOwnerState.Releasing)
                check(decodedOwners.remove(owner.value) === owner)
                owner.state = DecodedCacheOwnerState.Released
                pendingDecodedReleases -= 1
            }
        }
    }
}

fun close() {
    val scheduled = synchronized(this) {
        if (decodedClosed) return
        check(activeEncodePins == 0) {
            "Decoded raster cache closed with active encode pins"
        }
        check(decodedEncodePins.isEmpty()) {
            "Decoded raster cache closed with pinned identities"
        }
        decodedClosed = true
        mutableListOf<DecodedCacheOwner<T>>().also { owners ->
            decoded.keys.toList().forEach { digest ->
                detachDecodedEntryLocked(digest, owners)
            }
        }
    }
    releaseDecodedOwners(scheduled)
    val failure = synchronized(this) {
        check(decoded.isEmpty())
        check(decodedOwners.isEmpty())
        check(decodedEncodePins.isEmpty())
        check(activeEncodePins == 0)
        check(pendingDecodedReleases == 0)
        decodedReleaseFailure.also { decodedReleaseFailure = null }
    }
    when (failure) {
        null -> Unit
        is RuntimeException -> throw failure
        is Error -> throw failure
        else -> throw IllegalStateException(
            "Unexpected checked decoded raster release failure",
            failure
        )
    }
}
```

No method invokes `codec.release` while holding the cache monitor. Each mutation gathers all detached owners, exits the monitor, and attempts every callback. Release failures are accumulated in `decodedReleaseFailure` without changing the write result's ownership contract or suppressing later releases; idempotent `close()` drains all remaining owners and then completes exceptionally with that retained failure and its suppressed failures. An identity in `Releasing` is non-admissible: `write(AdoptDecoded)` reports `Store` ownership without attaching a new entry because the existing store-owned release authority already consumes that exact identity, and a decode/read path returns no raster rather than attaching or scheduling a second release behind the callback already in flight. A genuinely new decoded value that cannot fit while releasing owners consume the fixed bound is released once outside the monitor and the read reports a miss. The caller retries from the durable file after the release completion event; no path widens `maxDecodedEntries`. `PersistOnly` never transfers ownership to this cache; encountering a value identity already owned by the cache in that mode is a protocol violation rather than permission to create a second release authority.

Every mutation checks both logical and identity limits. fun failedEncodeOfAlreadyOwnedIdentityStillReturnsStoreOwnership() {
    val shared = Any()
    var encodeCount = 0
    val releases = mutableListOf<Any>()
    val cache = rasterCache(
        encode = { _, target ->
            encodeCount += 1
            if (encodeCount == 1) target.writeText("raster")
            encodeCount == 1
        },
        release = releases::add
    )
    assertTrue(cache.write(key(1), metadata(), shared).persisted)

    val failed = cache.write(key(2), metadata(), shared)

    assertFalse(failed.persisted)
    assertEquals(ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Store, failed.ownership)
    assertTrue(releases.isEmpty())
    assertTrue(cache.remove(key(1)))
    assertEquals(listOf(shared), releases)
}

@Test
fun persistOnlyRejectsDecodedIdentityBeforeEncode() {
    val shared = Any()
    var encodeCount = 0
    val cache = rasterCache(
        encode = { _, target ->
            encodeCount += 1
            target.writeText("raster")
            true
        }
    )
    assertTrue(cache.write(key(1), metadata(), shared).persisted)

    assertFailsWith<IllegalStateException> {
        cache.write(
            key = key(2),
            metadata = metadata(),
            value = shared,
            mode = ReaderPageRasterWriteMode.PersistOnly
        )
    }
    assertEquals(1, encodeCount)
}

Make `DeckLeaseRegistry` the enforcing owner of a fixed total lease capacity. Four leases permit one active deck, one pending deck, and a short renderer-release backlog without allowing repeated replacements to retain unbounded bitmap decks:

```java
static final int MAX_DECK_LEASES = 4;

private final int capacity;
private final Map<Long, PageSurfaceListener> owners =
        new LinkedHashMap<>();
private final Map<Long, DeckReleaseReason> requestedReleaseReasons =
        new LinkedHashMap<>();

DeckLeaseRegistry() {
    this(MAX_DECK_LEASES);
}

DeckLeaseRegistry(int capacity) {
    if (capacity <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity must be positive");
    }
    this.capacity = capacity;
}

synchronized boolean acquire(
        long generationId,
        PageSurfaceListener listener) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(listener, "listener");
    if (owners.containsKey(generationId)
            || owners.size() >= capacity) {
        return false;
    }
    owners.put(generationId, listener);
    return true;
}

synchronized boolean hasCapacity() {
    return owners.size() < capacity;
}

synchronized int capacity() {
    return capacity;
}

synchronized int size() {
    return owners.size();
}

synchronized boolean contains(long generationId) {
    return owners.containsKey(generationId);
}

synchronized int releaseInFlightCount(
        long activeGenerationId,
        long pendingGenerationId) {
    int count = 0;
    for (long generationId : requestedReleaseReasons.keySet()) {
        if (generationId != activeGenerationId
                && generationId != pendingGenerationId) {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}
```

public final class PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult {
    public enum Status {
        ACCEPTED,
        UNCHANGED,
        REJECTED
    }

    private final Status status;
    private final DeckRejectionReason rejectionReason;

    private PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult(
            Status status,

        if ((status == Status.REJECTED) != (rejectionReason != null)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(

        this.rejectionReason = rejectionReason;
    }

    public static PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult accepted() {

    }

    public static PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult unchanged() {
        return new PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult(Status.UNCHANGED, null);
    }

    public static PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult rejected(
            DeckRejectionReason reason) {

                Objects.requireNonNull(reason, "reason"));

The package-private gate owns the real coordinator and registry references and exposes:

```java
final class PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionGate<T> {
    static final class Result<T> {
        private final PageDeckCoordinator.Offer<T> offer;
        private final PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult publicResult;

        Result(
                PageDeckCoordinator.Offer<T> offer,
                PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult publicResult) {
            this.offer = offer;
            this.publicResult = Objects.requireNonNull(
                    publicResult,
                    "publicResult");
            if (offer == null && publicResult.getStatus()
                    != PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.Status.REJECTED) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Only a pre-offer rejection may omit the offer");
            }
        }

        PageDeckCoordinator.Offer<T> offer() { return offer; }
        PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult publicResult() { return publicResult; }
    }

    private static final long NO_GENERATION_ID = -1L;
    private final PageDeckCoordinator<T> coordinator;
    private final DeckLeaseRegistry leaseRegistry;
    private boolean capacitySignalArmed;
    private boolean closed;

    synchronized Result<T> submit(
            PageDeck<T> deck,
            PageSurfaceListener listener) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(deck, "deck");
        Objects.requireNonNull(listener, "listener");
        if (closed) {
            return preOfferRejected(DeckRejectionReason.DISPOSED);
        }
        long generationId = deck.getGenerationId();
        PageDeck<T> active = coordinator.getActiveDeck();
        PageDeck<T> pending = coordinator.getPendingDeck();
        boolean alreadyPlaced =
                generationIdOf(active) == generationId ||
                generationIdOf(pending) == generationId;
        boolean existingLease = leaseRegistry.contains(generationId);
        if (!alreadyPlaced &&
                (existingLease || !leaseRegistry.hasCapacity())) {
            capacitySignalArmed = true;
            return preOfferRejected(
                    DeckRejectionReason.RESOURCE_CAPACITY);
        }

        PageDeckCoordinator.Offer<T> offer = coordinator.offer(deck);
        switch (offer.getPlacement()) {
            case REJECTED:
                return result(offer);
            case UNCHANGED:
                if (!alreadyPlaced) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Only an active or pending generation may be unchanged");
                }
                return new Result<>(
                        offer,
                        PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.unchanged());
            case ACTIVE:
            case PENDING:
                if (alreadyPlaced ||
                        !leaseRegistry.acquire(generationId, listener)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Accepted placement did not acquire one fresh lease");
                }
                return new Result<>(
                        offer,
                        PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.accepted());
            default:
                throw new AssertionError("Unhandled deck placement");
        }
    }

    private Result<T> preOfferRejected(DeckRejectionReason reason) {
        return new Result<>(
                null,
                PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.rejected(reason));
    }

    private Result<T> result(PageDeckCoordinator.Offer<T> offer) {
        DeckRejectionReason reason = offer.getRejectionReason();
        if (reason == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Rejected coordinator offer omitted its reason");
        }
        return new Result<>(
                offer,
                PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.rejected(reason));
    }

    private long generationIdOf(PageDeck<T> deck) {
        return deck == null ? NO_GENERATION_ID : deck.getGenerationId();
    }

    synchronized boolean takeCapacityAvailableSignal() {
        if (!capacitySignalArmed || !leaseRegistry.hasCapacity()) {
            return false;
        }
        capacitySignalArmed = false;
        return true;
    }

    synchronized void close() {
        closed = true;
        capacitySignalArmed = false;
    }
}
```

Import `java.util.Objects` in both new Java classes and explicitly add `import java.util.Objects;` to `PageSurfaceView.java`. Add `RESOURCE_CAPACITY` to `DeckRejectionReason`. Preserve the existing JVM method descriptor exactly:

```java
public void submitDeck(PageDeck<Bitmap> deck) {
    submitDeckWithResult(deck);
}

public PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult submitDeckWithResult(
        PageDeck<Bitmap> deck) {
    requireMainThread();
    if (deck == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("deck must not be null");
    }
    if (disposed) {
        return rejectDeck(deck, DeckRejectionReason.DISPOSED);
    }
    if (!attached) {
        return rejectDeck(deck, DeckRejectionReason.SESSION_DETACHED);
    }
    if (renderCapabilities == null) {
        return rejectDeck(
                deck,
                DeckRejectionReason.CAPABILITIES_UNAVAILABLE);
    }

    PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionGate.Result<Bitmap> gated =
            submissionGate.submit(deck, pageSurfaceListener);
    PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult result = gated.publicResult();
    if (result.getStatus()
            == PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.Status.REJECTED) {
        pageSurfaceListener.onDeckRejected(
                deck.getGenerationId(),
                result.getRejectionReason());
        return result;
    }
    PageDeckCoordinator.Offer<Bitmap> offer = gated.offer();
    if (result.getStatus()
            == PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.Status.UNCHANGED) {
        return result;
    }
    for (PageDeckCoordinator.Release<Bitmap> release :
            offer.getReleases()) {
        queueDeckRelease(release);
    }
    boolean activateWhenPrepared =
            offer.getPlacement() == PageDeckCoordinator.Placement.ACTIVE;
    preparedGenerations.remove(deck.getGenerationId());
    queueEvent(() -> renderer.prepareDeck(deck, activateWhenPrepared));
    requestRender();
    return result;
}

private PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult rejectDeck(
        PageDeck<Bitmap> deck,
        DeckRejectionReason reason) {
    pageSurfaceListener.onDeckRejected(deck.getGenerationId(), reason);
    return PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.rejected(reason);
}
```

Only a generation currently placed active or pending may use the no-capacity `UNCHANGED` path. A lease-registry identity that is only release-in-flight is not `alreadyPlaced`, so saturation rejects before `coordinator.offer` and cannot place a deck that will lose ownership when the old release acknowledgement arrives. After `handleDeckReleased` removes the acknowledged lease, it snapshots `submissionGate.takeCapacityAvailableSignal()`, delivers the normal release callback, then invokes the new default `PageSurfaceListener.onDeckSubmissionCapacityAvailable()` exactly once when armed capacity returned. Disposal calls `submissionGate.close()` before draining coordinator decks.

`PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionGateTest` constructs the real `PageDeckCoordinator` and `DeckLeaseRegistry`. Its saturation scenario is exact: generation 1 is active; settlement begins; generation 2 becomes pending; generation 3 replaces 2; generation 4 replaces 3; the registry now owns 1, 2, 3, and 4 while 2 and 3 are release-in-flight; generation 5 is rejected for `RESOURCE_CAPACITY` before coordinator mutation; acknowledging generation 2 produces one capacity edge; and resubmitting the same generation 5 succeeds. It additionally proves an identical saturated active/pending generation returns `UNCHANGED` without rejection, acquisition, or release; a release-in-flight generation is rejected before offer and never uses `UNCHANGED`; a duplicate release acknowledgement emits no capacity edge; a second saturation re-arms exactly one later edge; `closeSuppressesArmedCapacityAfterLateReleaseAcknowledgement` closes the gate while a capacity edge is armed, acknowledges the late release, and proves `takeCapacityAvailableSignal()` remains false; and `submit`, `takeCapacityAvailableSignal`, and `close` serialize hostile concurrent calls. `ProductionBitmapApiSourceTest` requires `submissionGate.close()` after `disposed = true` and before both the missing-executor fallback and `deckCoordinator.dispose()`. `DeckLeaseRegistryTest` independently proves duplicate acquisition cannot grow ownership.
