Add the production synchronous-callback fence instead of teaching the recovery listener to guess which rejection belongs to the returned result. `ReaderPageDeckSubmissionCallbackFence.android.kt` imports the canonical return and rejection types explicitly:

```kotlin
import karacken.curl.DeckRejectionReason
import karacken.curl.PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult
```

```kotlin
internal class ReaderPageDeckSubmissionCallbackFence {
    private data class Captured(
        val generationId: Long,
        val reason: DeckRejectionReason
    )

    private class Active(val generationId: Long) {
        var captured: Captured? = null
    }

    private val lock = Any()
    private var active: Active? = null

    fun onDeckRejected(
        generationId: Long,
        reason: DeckRejectionReason
    ): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
        val current = active
        if (current == null || current.generationId != generationId) {
            return@synchronized false
        }
        check(current.captured == null) {
            "Matching deck rejection was delivered more than once"
        }
        current.captured = Captured(generationId, reason)
        true
    }

    fun submit(
        generationId: Long,
        action: () -> PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult
    ): PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult {
        val owner = synchronized(lock) {
            check(active == null) { "Deck submission fence is already active" }
            Active(generationId).also { active = it }
        }
        val result = try {
            action()
        } finally {
            synchronized(lock) {
                check(active === owner)
                active = null
            }
        }
        val captured = owner.captured
        if (result.status == PageSurfaceDeckSubmissionResult.Status.REJECTED) {
            checkNotNull(captured) {
                "Returned rejection omitted the synchronous listener callback"
            }
            check(captured.reason == result.rejectionReason) {
                "Returned rejection and synchronous callback diverged"
            }
        } else {
            check(captured == null) {
                "Accepted submission emitted a synchronous rejection"
            }
        }
        return result
    }
}
```

The surface listener first calls `submissionCallbackFence.onDeckRejected`. A `true` result means the generation remains owned by the in-flight submission decision and suppresses the legacy release path; `false` routes the unrelated rejection through existing handling. Recovery calls `submissionCallbackFence.submit(generationId) { surfaceView.submitDeckWithResult(deck) }`. The fence clears in `finally` even when submission throws. `ReaderPageDeckSubmissionCallbackFenceTest` proves `returnedCapacityRejectionIsCapturedWithoutLegacyReleaseHandling`, `submissionResultAndSynchronousCallbackMustAgree`, unrelated rejection passthrough, duplicate matching callback rejection, and post-exception reuse.

The disposal callback is lifecycle evidence, not a diagnostic guess. Separate the single required reader-controller waiter from bounded auxiliary observers. Add a package-private `PageSurfaceRequiredTerminalCallback<T>` production seam with exactly one registration slot, immediate terminal replay, hostile-callback isolation, and no capacity-rejection outcome; duplicate owner registration is a programmer error. `PageSurfaceView.disposeForLifecycleOwner` uses that dedicated slot, while the source-compatible no-argument `dispose()` starts teardown without allocating a callback and `dispose(Callback)` remains the capacity-reporting auxiliary API. Auxiliary saturation must never affect the controller's ability to wait for renderer acknowledgement. Track logical pause (`attached`), physical window attachment (`windowAttached`), holder-surface availability (`holderSurfaceAvailable`), and atomic terminal execution ownership in `PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate` separately:

```java
private static final long NO_GENERATION_ID = -1L;
private static final int REQUIRED_DISPOSAL_CALLBACK_LIMIT = 1;
private static final int AUXILIARY_DISPOSAL_CALLBACK_LIMIT = 2;
private static final int OWNERSHIP_CALLBACK_LIMIT = 4;
private static final int MAIN_TERMINAL_ACTION_LIMIT =
        OWNERSHIP_CALLBACK_LIMIT + REQUIRED_DISPOSAL_CALLBACK_LIMIT;

public interface MainTerminalExecutor {
    boolean execute(Runnable action);
}

public enum DisposalCallbackRegistration {
    ACCEPTED,
    DELIVERED_TERMINAL,
    CALLBACK_CAPACITY
}

private final AtomicInteger pendingMainTerminalActions = new AtomicInteger();
private final AtomicReference<Runnable> retainedMainTerminalAction =
        new AtomicReference<>();
private MainTerminalExecutor mainTerminalExecutor;
private boolean mainTerminalExecutorRegistered;
private final PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate terminalDisposalGate =
        new PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate();
private final FailureAccumulator disposalFailure =
        new FailureAccumulator();
private final PageSurfaceRequiredTerminalCallback<PageSurfaceDisposalResult>
        requiredDisposeCallback = new PageSurfaceRequiredTerminalCallback<>(
                (callback, failure) -> reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
                        IsolatedCallbackKind.DISPOSAL,
                        callback,
                        failure));
private final PageSurfaceTerminalCallbacks<PageSurfaceDisposalResult>
        disposeCallbacks = new PageSurfaceTerminalCallbacks<>(
                AUXILIARY_DISPOSAL_CALLBACK_LIMIT,
                (callback, failure) -> reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
                        IsolatedCallbackKind.DISPOSAL,
                        callback,
                        failure));
private final PageSurfaceTerminalCallbacks<PageSurfaceOwnershipSnapshot>
        pendingOwnershipCallbacks = new PageSurfaceTerminalCallbacks<>(
                OWNERSHIP_CALLBACK_LIMIT,
                (callback, failure) -> reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
                        IsolatedCallbackKind.OWNERSHIP,
                        callback,
                        failure));
private boolean windowAttached;
private boolean holderSurfaceAvailable;
private boolean disposeStarted;
private boolean resumedForDispose;
private PageSurfaceDisposalResult disposedResult;
private PageSurfaceOwnershipSnapshot disposedOwnershipSnapshot;
private long disposingActiveGenerationId = NO_GENERATION_ID;
private long disposingPendingGenerationId = NO_GENERATION_ID;

public void dispose() {
    requireMainThread();
    startDisposeIfNeeded();
}

public void disposeForLifecycleOwner(
        PageSurfaceDisposalResult.Callback callback) {
    requireMainThread();
    if (callback == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback must not be null");
    }
    requiredDisposeCallback.register(callback::onComplete);
    startDisposeIfNeeded();
}

public DisposalCallbackRegistration dispose(
        PageSurfaceDisposalResult.Callback callback) {
    requireMainThread();
    if (callback == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("callback must not be null");
    }
    PageSurfaceTerminalCallbacks.AddResult registration =
            disposeCallbacks.add(callback::onComplete);
    startDisposeIfNeeded();
    switch (registration) {
        case ACCEPTED:
            return DisposalCallbackRegistration.ACCEPTED;
        case DELIVERED_TERMINAL:
            return DisposalCallbackRegistration.DELIVERED_TERMINAL;
        case CALLBACK_CAPACITY:
            return DisposalCallbackRegistration.CALLBACK_CAPACITY;
        default:
            throw new AssertionError("Unhandled callback registration");
    }
}

public int getPendingCallbackCount() {
    requireMainThread();
    return requiredDisposeCallback.pendingCount()
            + disposeCallbacks.pendingCount()
            + pendingOwnershipCallbacks.pendingCount()
            + pendingMainTerminalActions.get();
}

public int getPendingCallbackLimit() {
    return REQUIRED_DISPOSAL_CALLBACK_LIMIT
            + AUXILIARY_DISPOSAL_CALLBACK_LIMIT
            + OWNERSHIP_CALLBACK_LIMIT
            + MAIN_TERMINAL_ACTION_LIMIT;
}

private void startDisposeIfNeeded() {
    requireMainThread();
    if (disposedResult != null || disposeStarted) {
        return;
    }
    disposeStarted = true;
    disposed = true;
    try {
        submissionGate.close();
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }
    if (mainTerminalExecutor == null) {
        recordSetupFailure(
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "Required main terminal executor is not registered"));
        finishDetachedDisposal();
        return;
    }

    SettlementContext cancelledSettlement = null;
    try {
        cancelledSettlement = cancelSettlementAnimator();
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }
    try {
        recycleVelocityTracker();
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }
    try {
        preparedGenerations.clear();
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }
    try {
        disposingActiveGenerationId = generationIdOf(
                deckCoordinator.getActiveDeck());
        disposingPendingGenerationId = generationIdOf(
                deckCoordinator.getPendingDeck());
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }
    try {
        for (PageDeckCoordinator.Release<Bitmap> release :
                deckCoordinator.dispose()) {
            try {
                leaseRegistry.markReleaseRequested(
                        release.getDeck().getGenerationId(),
                        DeckReleaseReason.DISPOSED);
            } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
                recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
            }
        }
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }
    notifySettlementCancelledForDispose(cancelledSettlement);
    try {
        setPreserveEGLContextOnPause(false);
    } catch (Throwable setupFailure) {
        recordSetupFailure(setupFailure);
    }

    terminalDisposalGate.start(
            new PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate.Host() {
                @Override public boolean isWindowAttached() {
                    return windowAttached;
                }
                @Override public boolean isHolderSurfaceAvailable() {
                    return holderSurfaceAvailable;
                }
                @Override public boolean isLogicallyAttached() {
                    return attached;
                }
                @Override public void resumeForTerminalWork() {
                    resumedForDispose = true;
                    onResume();
                }
                @Override public void queueTerminalWork(Runnable action) {
                    queueEvent(action);
                }
            },
            this::disposeOnGlThread,
            this::finishTerminalFallback);
}

private void recordSetupFailure(Throwable failure) {
    disposalFailure.record(
            PageSurfaceDisposalStage.PRE_GL_SETUP,
            failure);
}

private void finishTerminalFallback(
        PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate.FailureKind kind,
        Throwable failure) {
    requireMainThread();
    PageSurfaceDisposalStage stage =
            kind == PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate.FailureKind.RESUME
                    ? PageSurfaceDisposalStage.SURFACE_RESUME
                    : PageSurfaceDisposalStage.GL_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE;
    disposalFailure.record(stage, failure);
    finishDetachedDisposal();
}

private void disposeOnGlThread() {
    try {
        renderer.dispose();
    } catch (Throwable rendererFailure) {
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.GL_RENDERER_DISPOSE,
                rendererFailure);
    } finally {
        int textures = renderer.textureCount();
        int textureLimit = renderer.textureLimit();
        if (!terminalDisposalGate.completeGlExecution()) {
            disposalFailure.record(
                    PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                    new IllegalStateException(
                            "GL disposal ownership was not active at completion"));
        }
        enqueueOrRetainMainTerminal(() -> finishDisposeAfterGl(
                textures,
                textureLimit,
                disposalFailure,
                false));
    }
}

public void registerMainTerminalExecutor(MainTerminalExecutor executor) {
    requireMainThread();
    Objects.requireNonNull(executor, "executor");
    if (mainTerminalExecutorRegistered) {
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Main terminal executor is already registered");
    }
    mainTerminalExecutorRegistered = true;
    mainTerminalExecutor = executor;
}

public int getMainTerminalActionLimit() {
    return MAIN_TERMINAL_ACTION_LIMIT;
}

public int getPendingMainTerminalActionCount() {
    return pendingMainTerminalActions.get();
}

private boolean enqueueMainTerminal(Runnable action) {
    MainTerminalExecutor executor = mainTerminalExecutor;
    if (executor == null) {
        return false;
    }
    int pending = pendingMainTerminalActions.incrementAndGet();
    if (pending > MAIN_TERMINAL_ACTION_LIMIT) {
        pendingMainTerminalActions.decrementAndGet();
        return false;
    }
    AtomicBoolean ownershipClaimed = new AtomicBoolean();
    Runnable counted = () -> {
        if (!ownershipClaimed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
        }
        releaseMainTerminalActionCount();
        try {
            action.run();
        } catch (Throwable actionFailure) {
            disposalFailure.record(
                    PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                    actionFailure);
            if (disposeStarted && disposedResult == null) {
                finishDetachedDisposal();
            } else if (!disposeStarted) {
                failLiveOwnershipRequests();
            }
        }
    };
    final boolean accepted;
    try {
        accepted = executor.execute(counted);
    } catch (Throwable executionFailure) {
        if (ownershipClaimed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            releaseMainTerminalActionCount();
            disposalFailure.record(
                    PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                    executionFailure);
            return false;
        }
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                executionFailure);
        return true;
    }
    if (!accepted && ownershipClaimed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
        releaseMainTerminalActionCount();
        return false;
    }
    if (!accepted) {
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "Main terminal executor ran an action before rejecting it"));
    }
    return true;
}

private void releaseMainTerminalActionCount() {
    int remaining = pendingMainTerminalActions.decrementAndGet();
    if (remaining < 0) {
        pendingMainTerminalActions.set(0);
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "Main terminal action ownership underflow"));
    }
}

private void enqueueOrRetainMainTerminal(Runnable action) {
    if (enqueueMainTerminal(action)) {
        return;
    }
    if (!retainedMainTerminalAction.compareAndSet(null, action)) {
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "A main-thread terminal action is already retained"));
        return;
    }
    disposalFailure.record(
            PageSurfaceDisposalStage.MAIN_TERMINAL_EXECUTOR,
            new IllegalStateException(
                    "Required main terminal executor rejected completion"));
}

private void drainRetainedMainTerminal() {
    requireMainThread();
    Runnable action = retainedMainTerminalAction.getAndSet(null);
    if (action != null) {
        action.run();
    }
}
```

Window attachment and actual `SurfaceHolder` availability are independent authorities. Import `android.view.SurfaceHolder`, `java.util.Objects`, `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean`, `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger`, and `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference` (`Looper` is already imported); a window-attached view whose holder surface is destroyed must not queue terminal GL work and wait forever. Production registers one bounded main-thread executor backed by the controller's already-running Main coroutine before any GL work. The fixed action bound is the four ownership completions plus one required disposal completion. A rejected executor action is retained only as a last-resort lifecycle fallback; the production executor's matching channel bound and executable saturation tests make rejection unreachable while the lifecycle owner is active:

```java
public void attach() {
    requireMainThread();
    drainRetainedMainTerminal();
    if (disposed || attached) {
        return;
    }
    attached = true;
    onResume();
    requestRender();
}

@Override
protected void onAttachedToWindow() {
    super.onAttachedToWindow();
    windowAttached = true;
    drainRetainedMainTerminal();
}

@Override
public void surfaceCreated(SurfaceHolder holder) {
    super.surfaceCreated(holder);
    holderSurfaceAvailable = true;
    drainRetainedMainTerminal();
}

@Override
public void surfaceDestroyed(SurfaceHolder holder) {
    super.surfaceDestroyed(holder);
    holderSurfaceAvailable = false;
    drainRetainedMainTerminal();
    if (disposeStarted && disposedResult == null) {
        terminalDisposalGate.onSurfaceUnavailable(
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "GL holder surface was destroyed before terminal disposal"),
                this::finishTerminalFallback);
    }
}

@Override
protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
    detach();
    super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    windowAttached = false;
    drainRetainedMainTerminal();
    if (disposeStarted && disposedResult == null) {
        terminalDisposalGate.onSurfaceUnavailable(
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "GL window detached before terminal disposal"),
                this::finishTerminalFallback);
    }
}
```

Both fallback notifications occur only after the corresponding superclass callback has stopped or detached the GL surface. The production `PageSurfaceTerminalDisposalGate` provides one atomic execution claim: if surface loss wins before the queued runnable enters, fallback owns disposal and the retained late runnable becomes a no-op; if the GL runnable wins, surface-loss fallback becomes a no-op and can never call `renderer.abandonClientState`. A logically paused view resumes solely when both window and holder surface are live, then pauses again during completion. An `onResume` or `queueEvent` exception maps to a typed failure and still completes every waiter.

`PageRenderer.dispose()` must be best-effort rather than fail-fast. Import `java.util.ArrayList` and `java.util.List`, snapshot the two retained generation IDs, sever every client reference before invoking fallible GL calls, attempt every texture/mesh/program cleanup independently, and notify every renderer release event before rethrowing the accumulated failure:

```java
void dispose() {
    if (disposed) {
        return;
    }
    Set<Long> releasedGenerations = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    if (activeDeck != null) {
        releasedGenerations.add(activeDeck.getGenerationId());
    }
    if (replacementDeck != null) {
        releasedGenerations.add(replacementDeck.getGenerationId());
    }

    disposed = true;
    activeDeck = null;
    replacementDeck = null;
    clearActiveDeck();
    glReady = false;

    DisposalFailure failure = new DisposalFailure();
    List<GpuTexture> textures =
            new ArrayList<>(textureCache.values());
    textureCache.clear();
    for (GpuTexture texture : textures) {
        failure.capture(texture::deleteGl);
    }

    failure.capture(leftMesh::dispose);
    failure.capture(frontMesh::dispose);
    failure.capture(mirroredLeftMesh::dispose);
    failure.capture(mirroredFrontMesh::dispose);
    failure.capture(rightMesh::dispose);
    failure.capture(mirroredRightMesh::dispose);

    int retainedProgram = program;
    program = 0;
    if (retainedProgram != 0) {
        failure.capture(() -> GLES20.glDeleteProgram(retainedProgram));
    }
    int retainedShadowProgram = shadowProgram;
    shadowProgram = 0;
    if (retainedShadowProgram != 0) {
        failure.capture(
                () -> GLES20.glDeleteProgram(retainedShadowProgram));
    }

    for (long generationId : releasedGenerations) {
        failure.capture(() -> events.onDeckReleased(
                generationId,
                DeckReleaseReason.DISPOSED));
    }
    failure.throwIfPresent();
}

private static final class DisposalFailure {
    private Throwable first;

    void capture(Runnable action) {
        try {
            action.run();
        } catch (Throwable next) {
            if (first == null) {
                first = next;
            } else if (next != first) {
                first.addSuppressed(next);
            }
        }
    }

    void throwIfPresent() {
        if (first == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (first instanceof RuntimeException) {
            throw (RuntimeException) first;
        }
        if (first instanceof Error) {
            throw (Error) first;
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unexpected checked renderer disposal failure",
                first);
    }
}
```

Clearing the texture map and program fields before deletion preserves authoritative zero client ownership even if the driver call throws; `GL_RENDERER_DISPOSE` still records that GPU cleanup failed. The GL `finally` above therefore posts a completion for every Java/OpenGL exception path. The Android process/driver terminating while a GL call is executing is outside in-process lifecycle recovery; before the runnable enters and after every Java return/throw path, the design always acknowledges completion.

Complete disposal with actual pre-recovery evidence and safe post-GL client release:

```java
private void finishDetachedDisposal() {
    requireMainThread();
    if (disposedResult != null || terminalDisposalGate.glOwnsExecution()) {
        return;
    }
    int textures = renderer.textureCount();
    int textureLimit = renderer.textureLimit();
    try {
        renderer.abandonClientState();
    } catch (Throwable abandonFailure) {
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.GL_RENDERER_DISPOSE,
                abandonFailure);
    }
    finishDisposeAfterGl(
            textures,
            textureLimit,
            disposalFailure,
            true);
}

private void finishDisposeAfterGl(
        int textures,
        int textureLimit,
        FailureAccumulator failure,
        boolean detachedFallback) {
    requireMainThread();
    if (disposedResult != null) {
        return;
    }
    int activeDeckLeases = leaseCount(disposingActiveGenerationId);
    int pendingDeckLeases =
            disposingPendingGenerationId == disposingActiveGenerationId
                    ? 0
                    : leaseCount(disposingPendingGenerationId);
    int releaseInFlightDeckLeases =
            leaseRegistry.releaseInFlightCount(
                    disposingActiveGenerationId,
                    disposingPendingGenerationId);
    int orphanDeckLeases = leaseRegistry.size()
            - activeDeckLeases
            - pendingDeckLeases
            - releaseInFlightDeckLeases;
    PageSurfaceOwnershipSnapshot snapshot =
            new PageSurfaceOwnershipSnapshot(
                    activeDeckLeases,
                    1,
                    pendingDeckLeases,
                    1,
                    releaseInFlightDeckLeases,
                    leaseRegistry.capacity(),
                    orphanDeckLeases,
                    0,
                    textures,
                    textureLimit);
    if (activeDeckLeases != 0
            || pendingDeckLeases != 0
            || releaseInFlightDeckLeases != 0
            || orphanDeckLeases != 0
            || textures != 0) {
        failure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.OWNERSHIP_RETAINED,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "Renderer disposal retained ownership"));
    }

    for (DeckLeaseRegistry.Lease lease :
            leaseRegistry.releaseAll(DeckReleaseReason.DISPOSED)) {
        notifyDeckReleased(
                lease.getListener(),
                lease.getGenerationId(),
                lease.getReleaseReason());
    }
    if (attached || resumedForDispose) {
        attached = false;
        resumedForDispose = false;
        try {
            onPause();
        } catch (Throwable pauseFailure) {
            failure.record(
                    PageSurfaceDisposalStage.SURFACE_PAUSE,
                    pauseFailure);
        }
    }

    disposedOwnershipSnapshot = snapshot;
    disposingActiveGenerationId = NO_GENERATION_ID;
    disposingPendingGenerationId = NO_GENERATION_ID;
    PageSurfaceDisposalResult result = new PageSurfaceDisposalResult(
            snapshot,
            failure.stage(),
            failure.failure(),
            failure.suppressedFailureCount(),
            detachedFallback);
    disposedResult = result;

    pendingOwnershipCallbacks.complete(snapshot);
    requiredDisposeCallback.complete(result);
    disposeCallbacks.complete(result);
    mainTerminalExecutor = null;
}

private int leaseCount(long generationId) {
    return generationId == NO_GENERATION_ID
            || !leaseRegistry.contains(generationId) ? 0 : 1;
}

private void notifySettlementCancelledForDispose(
        SettlementContext context) {
    if (context == null) {
        return;
    }
    PageSurfaceListener listener = null;
    try {
        listener = listenerFor(context.generationId);
        listener.onSettlementCancelled(
                context.gestureId,
                context.generationId,
                context.sourceLogicalPageId);
    } catch (Throwable callbackFailure) {
        disposalFailure.record(
                PageSurfaceDisposalStage.SETTLEMENT_CANCEL_CALLBACK,
                callbackFailure);
        reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
                IsolatedCallbackKind.SETTLEMENT_CANCEL,
                listener,
                callbackFailure);
    }
}

private void notifyDeckReleased(
        PageSurfaceListener listener,
        long generationId,
        DeckReleaseReason reason) {
    try {
        listener.onDeckReleased(generationId, reason);
    } catch (Throwable callbackFailure) {
        if (disposeStarted && disposedResult == null) {
            disposalFailure.record(
                    PageSurfaceDisposalStage.DECK_RELEASE_CALLBACK,
                    callbackFailure);
        }
        reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
                IsolatedCallbackKind.DECK_RELEASE,
                listener,
                callbackFailure);
    }
}

private static void reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
        IsolatedCallbackKind kind,
        Object callback,
        Throwable failure) {
    try {
        Log.e(
                TAG,
                "callback-failed kind=" + kind
                        + " callbackClass="
                        + (callback == null
                                ? "unresolved"
                                : callback.getClass().getName())
                        + " failureClass="
                        + failure.getClass().getName());
    } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        // Callback isolation must not depend on diagnostics.
    }
}

private enum IsolatedCallbackKind {
    SETTLEMENT_CANCEL,
    DECK_RELEASE,
    DECK_SUBMISSION_CAPACITY,
    OWNERSHIP,
    DISPOSAL
}

private static final class FailureAccumulator {
    private PageSurfaceDisposalStage stage =
            PageSurfaceDisposalStage.NONE;
    private Throwable failure;

    synchronized void record(
            PageSurfaceDisposalStage nextStage,
            Throwable nextFailure) {
        if (failure == null) {
            stage = nextStage;
            failure = nextFailure;
        } else if (nextFailure != failure) {
            failure.addSuppressed(nextFailure);
        }
    }

    synchronized PageSurfaceDisposalStage stage() { return stage; }
    synchronized Throwable failure() { return failure; }
    synchronized int suppressedFailureCount() {
        return failure == null ? 0 : failure.getSuppressed().length;
    }
}
```

`finishDisposeAfterGl` runs on the main thread after all earlier renderer `onDeckReleased` posts. It samples active, pending, release-in-flight, orphan, and texture ownership before recovery. Outstanding ownership is a protocol failure, but after successful GL disposal—or detached fallback that abandoned only client state before a GL runnable entered—the main thread can safely release client bitmap leases so later adapter and bundle owners still close. The retained snapshot remains non-zero and the typed result remains failed; recovery never replaces evidence with synthetic zeros. Set `disposedOwnershipSnapshot` and `disposedResult` before invoking arbitrary callbacks.

Import `android.util.Log`, add `private static final String TAG = "PageSurfaceView"`, and route the normal renderer acknowledgement through the same isolated release helper:

```java
private void handleDeckReleased(
        long generationId,
        DeckReleaseReason reason) {
    preparedGenerations.remove(generationId);
    deckCoordinator.release(generationId);
    DeckLeaseRegistry.Lease lease =
            leaseRegistry.release(generationId);
    if (lease == null) {
        return;
    }
    boolean capacityAvailable =
            submissionGate.takeCapacityAvailableSignal();
    DeckReleaseReason effectiveReason =
            lease.getReleaseReason() == null
                    ? reason
                    : lease.getReleaseReason();
    notifyDeckReleased(
            lease.getListener(),
            generationId,
            effectiveReason);
    if (capacityAvailable) {
        notifyDeckSubmissionCapacityAvailable(pageSurfaceListener);
    }
}

private void notifyDeckSubmissionCapacityAvailable(
        PageSurfaceListener listener) {
    try {
        listener.onDeckSubmissionCapacityAvailable();
    } catch (Throwable callbackFailure) {
        reportIsolatedCallbackFailure(
                IsolatedCallbackKind.DECK_SUBMISSION_CAPACITY,
                listener,
                callbackFailure);
    }
}
```

This matters during disposal: renderer release posts precede the GL completion post, so a hostile deck-release listener is recorded as `DECK_RELEASE_CALLBACK` before the typed result is constructed and cannot prevent later renderer acknowledgements. `PageSurfaceTerminalCallbacks.complete` catches `Throwable` per ownership/disposal waiter and continues, so one hostile waiter cannot suppress another or replace the first terminal result. Its failure handler routes to the privacy-safe Android log, which contains only the closed callback kind plus callback and exception class names; it must never pass the throwable to `Log`, read `getMessage()`, or print a stack trace. `notifySettlementCancelledForDispose` applies the same isolation and records `SETTLEMENT_CANCEL_CALLBACK` through the disposal accumulator rather than throwing out of `dispose`.

Delete the old immediate `releaseAllOutstandingLeases()` method. Do not call `renderer.abandonClientState()` on the normal GL-backed branch. Production still calls `dispose` before final view removal, but a prior logical pause is resumed for terminal disposal and a physically detached/stopped GL queue receives an explicit failed fallback result instead of an unresolved deferred.

Make the renderer owner export its structural slot bound from `TextureBudget`:

```java
private static final int MAX_RETAINED_DECKS = 2;
private static final int MAX_PAGE_IMAGES_PER_DECK = 6;
private static final int MAX_TEXTURES_PER_PAGE = 2;
static final int MAX_IDENTITY_DISTINCT_TEXTURE_SLOTS =
        MAX_RETAINED_DECKS
                * MAX_PAGE_IMAGES_PER_DECK
                * MAX_TEXTURES_PER_PAGE;

static int maximumTextureSlots() {
    return MAX_IDENTITY_DISTINCT_TEXTURE_SLOTS;
}

static int identityDistinctTextureCount(
        PageDeck<?> activeDeck,
        PageDeck<?> pendingDeck) {
    Map<String, PageImage<?>> uniqueTextures = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    collect(activeDeck, uniqueTextures);
    collect(pendingDeck, uniqueTextures);
    return uniqueTextures.size();
}

private static void collect(
        PageDeck<?> deck,
        Map<String, PageImage<?>> uniqueTextures) {
    if (deck == null) {
        return;
    }
    for (PageImage<?> page : deck.getPages()) {
        if (page.isFiller()) {
            continue;
        }
        uniqueTextures.putIfAbsent(page.identityKey(), page);
        if (page.hasOverlay()) {
            uniqueTextures.putIfAbsent(page.overlayIdentityKey(), page);
        }
    }
}
```

`PageDeckCoordinator` and `PageRenderer` enforce at most one active and one replacement deck; deck validation accepts at most the six-image landscape model; and each non-filler page image has at most one base and one overlay identity. A filler contributes neither a base nor an overlay texture slot because the shader renders its explicit color without upload or sampling. Add public `getDeckLeaseLimit()` on `PageSurfaceView` returning the registry's enforcing capacity, package-private `textureCount()` returning `textureCache.size()`, and `textureLimit()` returning `TextureBudget.maximumTextureSlots()`. `TextureBudgetTest` constructs maximally identity-distinct active and pending six-image landscape decks with distinct base and overlay identities, proves their count reaches the exported 24-slot limit, then replaces selected leaves with fillers and proves each filler removes its base and overlay bytes/slots. It also proves every accepted portrait/landscape pair remains at or below the limit. Ensure best-effort `PageRenderer.dispose()` also attempts `mirroredRightMesh.dispose()`. The source test also scans every `src/main/java/karacken/curl` production source for forbidden `List.of(` and `List.copyOf(` and verifies `surfaceDestroyed`/`onDetachedFromWindow` notify the production terminal gate only after their superclass callbacks. Create `ReaderMainTerminalActionExecutor.android.kt` as the production Main-delivery seam rather than testing a raw channel. The channel is unlimited only as a transport detail; `pendingCount` is the enforcing bound, and that bound is exactly the renderer-exported action limit. A registered executor remains open until the renderer terminal result has run, so every legally admitted live ownership completion is accepted without waiting for disposal. `false` means either caller capacity misuse or that Main has already terminalized/drained the renderer during shutdown; it is not a live-request recovery policy:

```kotlin
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

internal class ReaderMainTerminalActionExecutor(
    val actionLimit: Int,
    scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val onActionFailure: (Throwable) -> Unit
) {
    private val pendingCount = AtomicInteger()
    private val closed = AtomicBoolean()
    private val actions = Channel<Runnable>(Channel.UNLIMITED)

    val drainJob: Job = scope.launch(start = CoroutineStart.UNDISPATCHED) {
        for (action in actions) {
            try {
                action.run()
            } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                try {
                    onActionFailure(failure)
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    // Failure reporting cannot terminate the sole drain owner.
                }
            } finally {
                check(pendingCount.decrementAndGet() >= 0) {
                    "Main-terminal action ownership underflow"
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun execute(action: Runnable): Boolean {
        if (closed.get()) return false
        val pending = pendingCount.incrementAndGet()
        if (pending > actionLimit) {
            pendingCount.decrementAndGet()
            return false
        }
        if (closed.get()) {
            pendingCount.decrementAndGet()
            return false
        }
        val sent = actions.trySend(action).isSuccess
        if (!sent) pendingCount.decrementAndGet()
        return sent
    }

    fun pendingActionCount(): Int = pendingCount.get()

    suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
        if (closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) actions.close()
        drainJob.join()
        check(pendingCount.get() == 0) {
            "Main-terminal actions did not drain"
        }
    }
}
```

`ReaderMainTerminalActionExecutorTest` uses a `StandardTestDispatcher` and the real production class. It fills all exported slots without running the dispatcher, proves one additional action is rejected without changing the count, advances the dispatcher, and verifies FIFO plus zero ownership. A second test queues a throwing action followed by a successful action, verifies `onActionFailure` receives exactly the first throwable, proves the second action runs, closes, and joins. A third test closes after accepted work, proves accepted work drains before join, then proves post-close submission returns false without ownership growth. These tests establish that an exception cannot kill the sole consumer and that production cannot reject any action admitted within the renderer's fixed legal bound.

Add a behavior-testable destroy fence. `ReaderPageControllerDestroyFence.android.kt` declares every coroutine symbol it uses:

```kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Deferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
```

```kotlin
internal class ReaderPageControllerDestroyFence(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val fenceAdmission: () -> Unit,
    private val advanceGenerations: () -> Unit,
    private val cancelActiveGesture: () -> Unit,
    private val cancelRecovery: () -> Unit,
    private val closeVisualHandoff: () -> Unit,
    private val cancelRelocations: () -> ReaderPageRelocationDrain,
    private val verifyRelocationsDrained: (ReaderPageRelocationDrain) -> Unit,
    private val markPageSetsObsolete: () -> Unit,
    private val hideSurface: () -> Unit,
    private val disposeRendererAndOwners: suspend () -> Unit
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private var destroyTask: Deferred<Unit>? = null

    fun start(): Deferred<Unit> = synchronized(lock) {
        destroyTask ?: scope.async(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            fenceAdmission()
            advanceGenerations()
            cancelActiveGesture()
            cancelRecovery()
            closeVisualHandoff()
            val drained = cancelRelocations()
            verifyRelocationsDrained(drained)
            markPageSetsObsolete()
            hideSurface()
            disposeRendererAndOwners()
        }.also { created ->
            destroyTask = created
            created.start()
        }
    }
}
```

Because the lazy deferred is assigned under `lock` before `start()`, synchronous reentrant or concurrent `destroy()` calls return the same object. Add these behavioral tests to `ReaderPageControllerDestroyFenceTest`:

```kotlin
@Test
fun destroyFenceStopsAdmissionAndCancelsEveryOwnerBeforeRendererDisposal() =
    runTest {
        val queue = ReaderPageRelocationQueue(capacity = 3)
        val firstReservation = assertIs<
            ReaderPageRelocationReservationResult.Reserved
        >(queue.reserve(11L)).reservation
        val firstRequest = assertIs<
            ReaderPageRelocationTransferResult.Enqueued
        >(
            queue.enqueueReserved(
                reservation = firstReservation,
                rasterGeneration = 7L,
                textureGeneration = 9L,
                sourceOrdinal = 4,
                destinationOrdinal = 5,
                logicalDirection = ReaderPageTurnDirection.Next,
                foliateSessionId = "session"
            )
        ).request
        assertSame(firstRequest, queue.commandToDispatch())
        assertTrue(
            queue.acknowledge(
                token = firstRequest.token.value,
                pageIndex = 5,
                foliateSessionId = "session",
                rasterGeneration = 7L,
                textureGeneration = 9L
            )
        )
        val secondReservation = assertIs<
            ReaderPageRelocationReservationResult.Reserved
        >(queue.reserve(12L)).reservation
        val thirdReservation = assertIs<
            ReaderPageRelocationReservationResult.Reserved
        >(queue.reserve(13L)).reservation
        val events = mutableListOf<String>()
        val fence = ReaderPageControllerDestroyFence(
            scope = this,
            fenceAdmission = { events += "fence" },
            advanceGenerations = { events += "advance" },
            cancelActiveGesture = { events += "gesture" },
            cancelRecovery = { events += "recovery" },
            closeVisualHandoff = { events += "handoff" },
            cancelRelocations = {
                events += "cancel-relocations"

            verifyRelocationsDrained = { drain ->

                )
                assertEquals(0, queue.occupiedCount())
            },
            markPageSetsObsolete = { events += "obsolete" },
            hideSurface = { events += "hide" },

        )

        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "fence",
                "advance",
                "gesture",
                "recovery",
                "handoff",
                "cancel-relocations",
                "verify-relocations",
                "obsolete",
                "hide",
                "dispose"
            ),
            events
        )
    }

@Test
fun destroyFenceIsIdempotentUnderReentrantStart() = runTest {
    val invocations = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
    fun invoked(name: String) {
        invocations[name] = invocations.getOrDefault(name, 0) + 1
    }
    lateinit var fence: ReaderPageControllerDestroyFence
    var reentrant: Deferred<Unit>? = null
    fence = ReaderPageControllerDestroyFence(
        scope = this,
        fenceAdmission = { invoked("fence") },
        advanceGenerations = { invoked("advance") },
        cancelActiveGesture = {
            invoked("gesture")
            reentrant = fence.start()
        },
        cancelRecovery = { invoked("recovery") },
        closeVisualHandoff = { invoked("handoff") },
        cancelRelocations = {
            invoked("relocations")
            ReaderPageRelocationDrain(emptyList(), emptyList())
        },
        verifyRelocationsDrained = { invoked("verify") },
        markPageSetsObsolete = { invoked("obsolete") },
        hideSurface = { invoked("hide") },
        disposeRendererAndOwners = { invoked("dispose") }
    )

    val first = fence.start()
    first.await()
    val later = fence.start()

    assertSame(first, reentrant)
    assertSame(first, later)
    assertEquals(
        setOf(
            "fence",
            "advance",
            "gesture",
            "recovery",
            "handoff",
            "relocations",
            "verify",
            "obsolete",
            "hide",
            "dispose"
        ),
        invocations.keys
    )
    assertTrue(invocations.values.all { count -> count == 1 })
}
```

These tests establish that renderer disposal is last and that relocation cancellation drains an acknowledged head and reserved tail in FIFO insertion order.

In `ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateController`, give the raster scope an owned `SupervisorJob`, retain every current or retired adapter in `rasterAdapterOwners`, and never discard an adapter reference until `closeAndJoin()` has completed. Enforce `MAX_RASTER_ADAPTER_OWNERS = 2`: one current profile and at most one retiring profile whose active/pending renderer deck or materializer is still draining. Profile replacement calls `oldAdapter.close()`, starts one raster child that awaits `oldAdapter.closeAndJoin()`, removes it on `Dispatchers.Main.immediate`, and retries only the latest `requestedProfile`. When the set is already full, do not construct a third adapter; keep readiness in `BlockingProfileRegeneration`, log the closed `adapter-owner-capacity` reason, and let the retirement completion event call `refreshPreparedDeck()`. Repeated settings/profile invalidations therefore coalesce to the latest profile while decoded ownership remains within the fixed two-adapter aggregate bound. Replace `destroy()` with the fence's idempotent asynchronous close while keeping its current call syntax:

```kotlin
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import karacken.curl.PageSurfaceDisposalResult
import karacken.curl.PageSurfaceDisposalStage
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Deferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import paige.navic.reader.ReaderPageMaximumRasterImagesPerDeck

private companion object {
    const val MAX_RASTER_ADAPTER_OWNERS = 2
}

private val rasterJob = SupervisorJob()
private val rasterScope = CoroutineScope(rasterJob + Dispatchers.Default)
private val teardownJob = SupervisorJob()
private val teardownScope = CoroutineScope(
    teardownJob + Dispatchers.Main.immediate
)
private val mainTerminalExecutor = ReaderMainTerminalActionExecutor(
    actionLimit = surfaceView.mainTerminalActionLimit,
    scope = teardownScope,
    onActionFailure = {
        if (!destroyed) {
            updateReadiness(
                interaction = ReaderPageInteractionState.Failed,
                reason = "main-terminal-action-failed"
            )
        }
    }
)
private val rasterAdapterOwners =
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlAdapterOwnerPool<
        ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterAdapter<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterImage>
    >(ownerLimit = MAX_RASTER_ADAPTER_OWNERS)
private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
private var disposedRasterResidencyMetrics:
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyMetrics? = null
private val rasterCapacityRefreshPosted = AtomicBoolean(false)

init {
    surfaceView.registerMainTerminalExecutor(mainTerminalExecutor::execute)
}

private fun signalRasterCapacityAvailable(): Boolean {
    if (destroyed) return true
    if (!rasterCapacityRefreshPosted.compareAndSet(false, true)) return true
    val accepted = mainHandler.post {
        rasterCapacityRefreshPosted.set(false)
        if (!destroyed) refreshPreparedDeck()
    }
    if (!accepted) {
        rasterCapacityRefreshPosted.set(false)
        updateReadiness(
            interaction = ReaderPageInteractionState.Failed,
            reason = "capacity-dispatch-rejected"
        )
    }
    return accepted
}

private var rasterRetirementFailure: Throwable? = null

private fun ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyMetrics.isDrained(): Boolean =
    residentEntries == 0 &&
        uniqueDecodedBitmaps == 0 &&
        pinnedEntries == 0 &&
        activePreparationWorkers == 0 &&
        activeMaterializationWorkers == 0 &&
        pendingValueReleases == 0

private fun recordRasterRetirementFailure(failure: Throwable) {
    val first = rasterRetirementFailure
    if (first == null) rasterRetirementFailure = failure
    else if (failure !== first) first.addSuppressed(failure)
}

private fun retireRasterAdapter(
    adapter: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterAdapter<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterImage>
) {
    adapter.close()
    rasterScope.launch {
        val joinResult = runCatching { adapter.closeAndJoin() }
        val metricsResult = runCatching { adapter.metrics() }
        withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) {
            val metrics = metricsResult.getOrNull()
            val drained = metrics?.isDrained() == true
            if (drained) {
                check(rasterAdapterOwners.remove(adapter))
                if (!destroyed) refreshPreparedDeck()
            }

            val failure = joinResult.exceptionOrNull()
                ?: metricsResult.exceptionOrNull()
                ?: if (!drained) {
                    IllegalStateException(
                        "Retiring raster adapter retained ownership"
                    )
                } else {
                    null
                }
            if (failure != null) {
                recordRasterRetirementFailure(failure)
                logActivationState(
                    "adapter-retirement-failed",
                    if (drained) "owner-released" else "owner-retained"
                )
                updateReadiness(
                    interaction = ReaderPageInteractionState.Failed,
                    reason = "adapter-retirement-failed"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

An exceptional `closeAndJoin()` is not evidence that the adapter still owns capacity: release callbacks may throw after all counters reach zero. Authoritative metrics decide owner-pool removal; the exception remains in `rasterRetirementFailure`, immediately fails readiness, and is folded into `disposeRendererAndOwners` through `captureTeardownFailure`. If metrics are not drained, retain the owner slot and synthesize a typed invariant failure. Add a controller behavior test whose retiring adapter drains all six ownership counters but throws its retained release failure from `closeAndJoin`; assert the owner-pool size drops, a replacement adapter can be admitted, readiness records failure, and final teardown rethrows the recorded failure. Add the inverse case proving a nonzero metric retains the owner slot.

```kotlin
private fun createRasterAdapter(
    profile: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProfile
): ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterAdapter<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterImage> =
    ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterAdapter(
        scope = rasterScope,
        loader = ReaderPlayLikeCurlFoliateRasterLoader(
            bundleSource = bundleSource,
            profile = profile,
            onMissingRaster = { sourcePageIndex ->
                requestRasterRepair(sourcePageIndex, profile)
            }
        ),
        rendererDeckLeaseLimit = surfaceView.deckLeaseLimit,
        onCapacityAvailable = ::signalRasterCapacityAvailable,
        release = { image -> image.bitmap.recycle() }
    )

private fun createRasterAdapterOrDefer(
    profile: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterProfile
): ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterAdapter<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterImage>? {
    if (rasterAdapterOwners.size == rasterAdapterOwners.ownerLimit) {
        logActivationState("refresh-gated", "adapter-owner-capacity")
        return null
    }
    val adapter = createRasterAdapter(profile)
    check(rasterAdapterOwners.tryAdd(adapter)) {
        "Raster adapter owner capacity changed during main-thread admission"
    }
    rasterAdapter = adapter
    return adapter
}

private val destroyFence = ReaderPageControllerDestroyFence(
    scope = teardownScope,
    fenceAdmission = {
        destroyed = true
        enabled = false
    },
    advanceGenerations = {
        requestGeneration += 1L
        decodedRefillGeneration += 1L
    },
    cancelActiveGesture = {
        cancelActiveGesture(
            ReaderPageLifecycleCancellationReason.HostDestroyed
        )
    },
    cancelRecovery = deckRecoveryCoordinator::cancelAll,
    closeVisualHandoff = visualHandoff::close,
    cancelRelocations = relocationGestureCoordinator::cancelAll,
    verifyRelocationsDrained = { cancelled ->
        check(relocationGestureCoordinator.reservationCount() == 0)
        check(relocationQueue.reservedCount() == 0)
        check(relocationQueue.queuedCount() == 0)
        logActivationState(
            "teardown-relocations-cancelled",
            "queued=${cancelled.queued.size} " +
                "reserved=${cancelled.reservations.size}"
        )
    },
    markPageSetsObsolete = {
        preparedPageSets.forEach { pages -> pages.obsolete = true }
    },
    hideSurface = ::hideSurface,
    disposeRendererAndOwners = ::disposeRendererAndOwners
)

fun destroy(): Deferred<Unit> = destroyFence.start()

private suspend fun disposeRendererAndOwners() {
    val rendererDisposed = CompletableDeferred<PageSurfaceDisposalResult>()
    surfaceView.disposeForLifecycleOwner { result ->
        check(rendererDisposed.complete(result))
    }
    try {
        withContext(NonCancellable) {
            val rendererResult = rendererDisposed.await()
            mainTerminalExecutor.closeAndJoin()
            check(mainTerminalExecutor.pendingActionCount() == 0) {
                "Controller main-terminal action ownership did not drain"
            }
            check(surfaceView.pendingMainTerminalActionCount == 0) {
                "Renderer main-terminal action ownership did not drain"
            }
            val rendererSnapshot = rendererResult.ownership
            var failure: Throwable? = null
            failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                failure,
                ReaderPageTeardownStage.RendererDisposal,
                rendererResult.failureStage
            ) {
                if (!rendererResult.isSuccessful) {
                    throw rendererResult.failure
                        ?: IllegalStateException(
                            "Renderer disposal failed without a cause"
                        )
                }
            }
            failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                failure,
                ReaderPageTeardownStage.RendererOwnership
            ) {
                check(
                    rendererSnapshot.activeDeckLeases == 0 &&
                        rendererSnapshot.pendingDeckLeases == 0 &&
                        rendererSnapshot.releaseInFlightDeckLeases == 0 &&
                        rendererSnapshot.orphanDeckLeases == 0 &&
                        rendererSnapshot.textures == 0
                ) { "Renderer disposal retained authoritative ownership" }
            }

            val strandedGenerations = generationOwners.keys.toList()
            failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                failure,
                ReaderPageTeardownStage.DeckGeneration
            ) {
                check(strandedGenerations.isEmpty()) {
                    "Renderer disposal left deck generations owned"
                }
            }
            strandedGenerations.forEach { generationId ->
                failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.DeckGeneration
                ) {
                    releaseGeneration(generationId)
                }
            }
            preparedPageSets.toList().forEach { pages ->
                failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterDeck
                ) {
                    closeIfUnused(pages)
                }
            }
            failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                failure,
                ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterDeck
            ) {
                check(preparedPageSets.isEmpty()) {
                    "Renderer disposal left raster decks pinned"
                }
            }

            val adaptersToClose = rasterAdapterOwners.snapshot()
            adaptersToClose.forEach { adapter ->
                failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterAdapter
                ) {
                    adapter.close()
                }
            }
            failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                failure,
                ReaderPageTeardownStage.ControllerWorker
            ) {
                rasterJob.cancelAndJoin()
            }
            adaptersToClose.forEach { adapter ->
                failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterAdapter
                ) {
                    adapter.closeAndJoin()
                }
            }
            val finalResidency = aggregateRasterResidencyMetrics(
                adaptersToClose.map { adapter -> adapter.metrics() },
                rasterResidencyBudget.metrics()
            )
            disposedRasterResidencyMetrics = finalResidency
            failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                failure,
                ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterAdapter
            ) {
                check(
                    finalResidency.residentEntries == 0 &&
                        finalResidency.uniqueDecodedBitmaps == 0 &&
                        finalResidency.pinnedEntries == 0 &&
                        finalResidency.activePreparationWorkers == 0 &&
                        finalResidency.activeMaterializationWorkers == 0 &&
                        finalResidency.pendingValueReleases == 0
                ) { "Raster adapter ownership did not drain" }
            }
            rasterAdapter = null
            adaptersToClose.filter { adapter ->
                adapter.metrics().isDrained()
            }.forEach(rasterAdapterOwners::remove)
            activePages = null
            requestedProfile = null
            rasterRetirementFailure?.let { retirementFailure ->
                failure = captureTeardownFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterAdapter
                ) {
                    throw retirementFailure
                }
            }
            failure?.let { throw it }
        }
    } finally {
        teardownJob.complete()
    }
}

suspend fun destroyAndJoin() {
    destroy().await()
}

fun rasterResidencyMetrics(): ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyMetrics =
    disposedRasterResidencyMetrics
        ?: aggregateRasterResidencyMetrics(
            rasterAdapterOwners.snapshot().map { adapter ->
                adapter.metrics()
            },
            rasterResidencyBudget.metrics()
        )

private fun aggregateRasterResidencyMetrics(
    metrics: List<ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyMetrics>,
    budget: ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyBudgetMetrics
): ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyMetrics {
    check(metrics.sumOf { it.residentEntries } == budget.residentEntries) {
        "Adapter entries differ from shared residency ownership"
    }
    return ReaderPlayLikeCurlRasterResidencyMetrics(
        residentEntries = budget.residentEntries,
        uniqueDecodedBitmaps = metrics.sumOf { it.uniqueDecodedBitmaps },
        residentEntryLimit = budget.residentEntryLimit,
        uniqueDecodedBitmapLimit =
            metrics.sumOf { it.uniqueDecodedBitmapLimit },
        peakResidentEntries = budget.peakResidentEntries,
        peakUniqueDecodedBitmaps =
            metrics.sumOf { it.peakUniqueDecodedBitmaps },
        pinnedEntries = metrics.sumOf { it.pinnedEntries },
        activePreparationWorkers =
            metrics.sumOf { it.activePreparationWorkers },
        activeMaterializationWorkers =
            metrics.sumOf { it.activeMaterializationWorkers },
        pendingValueReleases =
            metrics.sumOf { it.pendingValueReleases },
        evictedEntries = metrics.sumOf { it.evictedEntries },
        releasedEntries = metrics.sumOf { it.releasedEntries }
    )
}

private suspend fun captureTeardownFailure(
    current: Throwable?,
    stage: ReaderPageTeardownStage,
    rendererStage: PageSurfaceDisposalStage? = null,
    action: suspend () -> Unit
): Throwable? = try {
    readerPageTeardownStage(stage, rendererStage, action)
    current
} catch (next: Throwable) {
    if (current == null) next
    else current.apply {
        if (next !== current) addSuppressed(next)
    }
}
```

Use `retireRasterAdapter` instead of dropping the current adapter in `invalidate`; the latest profile request remains the only retry target. Import `android.os.Handler`, `android.os.Looper`, and `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean`. `signalRasterCapacityAvailable` coalesces background capacity edges into one main-thread `refreshPreparedDeck()` without losing a durable available state. Make adapter preparation progress logging background-safe and immutable—log the captured request/profile/page counts directly from `onProgress` and remove its `host.post`. Replace both final `rasterScope.launch { preparation.await(); host.post { ... } }` wrappers with one raster child that awaits preparation and then uses `withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { ... }`. After renderer/deck ownership has drained, synchronously call `close()` on every adapter to fence publication, then call `rasterJob.cancelAndJoin()` before awaiting any `adapter.closeAndJoin()`. Adapter materializers already finalize cancellation by completing waiters and releasing any adopted or late value; cancelling the shared parent therefore makes indefinitely suspended persistent hydration and materialization exit cooperatively instead of deadlocking teardown. The adapter joins and final metrics then prove every cancellation cleanup and controller callback owner drained.

Before setting `destroyed`, retain the existing synchronous gesture terminal/lifecycle cancellation invoked by Task 4; after setting it, every adapter/deck continuation must check `destroyed` or the request generation before mutating state. Do not call the old `invalidate("destroyed")`, because it closes the adapter before GL deck leases are acknowledged. `onDeckReleased` remains the only normal path that removes `generationOwners`; the post-GL protocol-failure recovery path may invoke that same listener callback for a lease the renderer failed to publish. All pages are marked obsolete before disposal so the last generation release closes each deck. Add every newly created adapter to `rasterAdapterOwners` immediately.

Create the reader-level sequential coordinator. Both new teardown coordinator files import `kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope`, `CoroutineStart`, `Deferred`, `NonCancellable`, `async`, and `withContext`; `ReaderPageTurnBundleSource.android.kt` and `ReaderPageRasterPreparationController.android.kt` each import `kotlinx.coroutines.Deferred` for their public close result. Do not rely on same-package or wildcard imports for these coroutine types:

```kotlin
internal class ReaderPageReaderTeardown(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val fenceCallbacks: () -> Unit = {},
    private val fenceBundleOwners: () -> Unit,
    private val closeRendererAndAdapter: suspend () -> Unit,
    private val closeBundleOwners: suspend () -> Unit,
    private val onFinished: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private var closeTask: Deferred<Unit>? = null

    fun start(): Deferred<Unit> = synchronized(lock) {
        closeTask ?: scope.async(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                var failure: Throwable? = null
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.CallbackFence
                ) {
                    fenceCallbacks()
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterInvalidation
                ) {
                    fenceBundleOwners()
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RendererDisposal,
                    closeRendererAndAdapter
                )
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.BundleOwners,
                    closeBundleOwners
                )
                failure?.let { throw it }
            }
        }.also { task ->
            closeTask = task
            task.invokeOnCompletion { onFinished() }
            task.start()
        }
    }

    suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
        start().await()
    }

    private suspend fun captureFailure(
        current: Throwable?,
        stage: ReaderPageTeardownStage,
        action: suspend () -> Unit
    ): Throwable? = try {
        readerPageTeardownStage(stage, action = action)
        current
    } catch (next: Throwable) {
        if (current == null) next
        else current.apply { addSuppressed(next) }
    }
}
```

Implement the bundle coordinator completely and assign a closed stage to every owner:

```kotlin
internal class ReaderPageTurnBundleTeardown(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val preCloseFailure: () -> Throwable? = { null },
    private val closePublicationWorkers: suspend () -> Unit,
    private val publicationEntryCount: () -> Int,
    private val publicationDispatchFailure: () -> Throwable? = { null },
    private val closeRasterGenerationWorkers: suspend () -> Unit,
    private val closeRasterHydrationWorkers: suspend () -> Unit,
    private val closePersistentStore: () -> Unit,
    private val closeRasterCache: () -> Unit,
    private val clearReferences: () -> Unit,
    private val onFinished: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private var closeTask: Deferred<Unit>? = null

    fun start(): Deferred<Unit> = synchronized(lock) {
        closeTask ?: scope.async(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                var failure: Throwable? = null
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterInvalidation
                ) {
                    preCloseFailure()?.let { throw it }
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.PublicationWorker,
                    closePublicationWorkers
                )
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.PublicationLedger
                ) {
                    check(publicationEntryCount() == 0) {
                        "Publication ledger retained entries after worker join"
                    }
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.PublicationDispatch
                ) {
                    publicationDispatchFailure()?.let { throw it }
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterGenerationWorker,
                    closeRasterGenerationWorkers
                )
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.RasterHydrationWorker,
                    closeRasterHydrationWorkers
                )
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.PersistentStore
                ) {
                    closePersistentStore()
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.DecodedCache
                ) {
                    closeRasterCache()
                }
                failure = captureFailure(
                    failure,
                    ReaderPageTeardownStage.ReferenceClear
                ) {
                    clearReferences()
                }
                failure?.let { throw it }
            }
        }.also { task ->
            closeTask = task
            task.invokeOnCompletion { onFinished() }
            task.start()
        }
    }

    suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
        start().await()
    }

    private suspend fun captureFailure(
        current: Throwable?,
        stage: ReaderPageTeardownStage,
        action: suspend () -> Unit
    ): Throwable? = try {
        readerPageTeardownStage(stage, action = action)
        current
    } catch (next: Throwable) {
        if (current == null) next
        else current.apply { addSuppressed(next) }
    }
}
```

Even when an earlier action fails, every later owner still closes and the first typed failure receives the rest as suppressed exceptions.

Use the Task 5 `ReaderPageRasterCacheStore` as the concrete persistent file-plus-manifest access owner instead of referencing an undefined `persistentStore`. Its idempotent access fence remains independent of decoded-value closure:

```kotlin
import java.io.File

internal class ReaderPageRasterCacheStore<T : Any>(
    private val cache: ReaderPageRasterCache<T>
) : ReaderPageRasterStore<T>, AutoCloseable {
    private val lock = Any()
    private var activeOperations = 0
    private var closed = false

    private inline fun <R> withOpen(
        closedResult: R,
        action: () -> R
    ): R {
        val admitted = synchronized(lock) {
            if (closed) false
            else {
                activeOperations += 1
                true
            }
        }
        if (!admitted) return closedResult
        return try {
            action()
        } finally {
            synchronized(lock) {
                check(activeOperations > 0)
                activeOperations -= 1
            }
        }
    }

    override fun contains(key: ReaderPageRasterKey): Boolean =
        withOpen(false) { cache.contains(key) }

    override fun <R : Any> readCopy(
        key: ReaderPageRasterKey,
        copy: (T) -> R?
    ): ReaderPageRaster<R>? =
        withOpen<ReaderPageRaster<R>?>(null) {
            cache.readCopy(key, copy)
        }

    override fun write(
        key: ReaderPageRasterKey,
        metadata: ReaderPageRasterMetadata,
        value: T
    ): ReaderPageRasterWriteResult = withOpen(
        ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(
            persisted = false,
            ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
        )
    ) {
        cache.write(
            key,
            metadata,
            value,
            ReaderPageRasterWriteMode.AdoptDecoded
        )
    }

    fun writePublication(
        key: ReaderPageRasterKey,
        metadata: ReaderPageRasterMetadata,
        value: T,
        commitFence: ReaderPageRasterCommitFence
    ): ReaderPageRasterWriteResult = withOpen(
        ReaderPageRasterWriteResult(
            persisted = false,
            ownership = ReaderPageRasterValueOwnership.Caller
        )
    ) {
        cache.write(
            key = key,
            metadata = metadata,
            value = value,
            mode = ReaderPageRasterWriteMode.PersistOnly,
            commitFence = commitFence
        )
    }

    override fun rollbackPublication(
        receipt: ReaderPageRasterWriteReceipt
    ): Boolean = withOpen(false) {
        cache.rollbackPublication(receipt)
    }

    override fun remove(key: ReaderPageRasterKey): Boolean =
        withOpen(false) { cache.remove(key) }

    override fun retainProfile(profile: ReaderPageRasterProfile): Int =
        withOpen(0) { cache.retainProfile(profile) }

    override fun protectChapter(chapter: ReaderPageRasterChapterKey?) {
        withOpen(Unit) { cache.protectChapter(chapter) }
    }

    override fun encodedBytes(key: ReaderPageRasterKey): Long =
        withOpen(0L) {
            cache.pathFor(key).takeIf(File::isFile)?.length() ?: 0L
        }

    override fun close() {
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (closed) return
            check(activeOperations == 0) {
                "Persistent raster store closed with active operations"
            }
            closed = true
        }
    }
}
```

The wrapper lock guards only admission and the active-operation count; cache work and arbitrary codec callbacks run outside it. Task 5 stores the one wrapper instance in `ReaderPageTurnBundleSource.persistentStore`, passes that same instance to `ReaderPageRasterScheduler`, and uses it for publication writes. Task 6 routes every persistent hydration through the same wrapper's `readCopy` and owns those reads in `ReaderPageRasterHydrationScheduler`. Task 12 closes the wrapper only after publication, raster-generation, and hydration workers all join. `close` first proves `activeOperations == 0` and only then sets `closed = true`, so an early out-of-order close throws without poisoning the wrapper and the later correctly ordered close still succeeds. It then fences future admission before `ReaderPageRasterCache.close()` verifies zero encode pins and drains decoded identities. `ReaderPageRasterSchedulerTest` uses a temporary cache to prove calls after wrapper close return their closed result without changing disk/manifest metrics, while decoded cache metrics remain readable until the later cache close.

In `ReaderPageTurnBundleSource`, use a teardown scope independent of `rasterJob` and wire all owners:

```kotlin
private val teardownJob = SupervisorJob()
private val teardownScope = CoroutineScope(
    teardownJob + Dispatchers.Default
)
private var persistentStore: ReaderPageRasterCacheStore<Bitmap>? = null
private val closeFenceLock = Any()
private val hydrationScheduler = ReaderPageRasterHydrationScheduler(
    scope = rasterScope,
    maxConcurrentWorkers = 2
)
private var closeInvalidationFailure: Throwable? = null
private var disposedRasterCacheMetrics: ReaderPageRasterCacheMetrics? = null
private val teardown = ReaderPageTurnBundleTeardown(
    scope = teardownScope,
    preCloseFailure = { closeInvalidationFailure },
    closePublicationWorkers = {
        publicationScheduler.closeAndJoin()
    },
    publicationEntryCount = publicationLedger::entryCount,
    publicationDispatchFailure = publicationLedger::dispatchFailure,
    closeRasterGenerationWorkers = {
        rasterScheduler?.closeAndJoin()
    },
    closeRasterHydrationWorkers = {
        hydrationScheduler.closeAndJoin()
    },
    closePersistentStore = {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            persistentStore?.close()
        }
    },
    closeRasterCache = {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            rasterCache?.let { cache ->
                try {
                    cache.close()
                } finally {
                    disposedRasterCacheMetrics = cache.metrics()
                }
            }
        }
    },
    clearReferences = {
        persistentStore = null
        rasterCache = null
        activeWebView.clear()
    },
    onFinished = {
        rasterJob.cancel()
        teardownJob.complete()
    }
)

fun fenceForClose() {
    synchronized(closeFenceLock) {
        if (closed) return
        closed = true
        try {
            invalidate("close")
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            closeInvalidationFailure = failure
        }
    }
}

fun close(): Deferred<Unit> {
    fenceForClose()
    return teardown.start()
}

suspend fun closeAndJoin() {
    close().await()
}
```

When `rasterScheduler(webView)` creates a cache, create exactly one `val store = ReaderPageRasterCacheStore(cache)`, assign `persistentStore = store`, and pass `store` to `ReaderPageRasterScheduler`; Task 5's publication scheduler also resolves this same field before it acquires ledger ownership. Never construct a second wrapper around the same cache.

`fenceForClose()` is the synchronous, idempotent, non-joining raster fence and remains on the controller/Main owner. It is invoked by `ReaderPageReaderTeardown` before renderer disposal and is also safe to call directly or reentrantly; under `closeFenceLock` it closes admission, advances the epoch through `invalidate("close")`, tombstones and drains every pending JavaScript descriptor recipient, and retains any invalidation failure exactly once. The bundle teardown itself runs on `Dispatchers.Default`, while persistent-store and decoded-cache close actions explicitly use `Dispatchers.IO`; publication, generation, hydration, manifest, codec, snapshot-release, and cache-release callbacks therefore never execute on Android Main. Only renderer/GL and host-view disposal stays in the Main-owned controller teardown. `closeBundleOwners = bundleSource::closeAndJoin` merely awaits the independently running bundle teardown and does not move that work back to Main. Add a `ReaderPageTurnBundleTeardownTest` with named single-thread Main, Default, and IO test dispatchers: make the cache-release callback record its thread/dispatcher, call reader teardown from Main, and assert renderer events occur on Main while publication/generation/hydration joins occur off Main and store/cache release occurs on IO. A synchronous invalidation failure becomes the first typed `RasterInvalidation` failure, then renderer disposal, publication workers, the zero-ledger assertion, retained ledger/rollback failure, raster generation, raster hydration, persistent access, decoded ownership, and reference clearing are all attempted. An active persistence worker owns its staged value until `publicationScheduler.closeAndJoin()` reaches its `finally` and `publicationLedger.complete`. A hydration worker owns its persistent-store operation and all detached recipients until `hydrationScheduler.closeAndJoin()` has canceled and joined it.

Add a `closeRendererAndAdapter: suspend () -> Unit = {}` constructor dependency to `ReaderPageRasterPreparationController`. Its `destroy()` still synchronously cancels background prefetch, repair callbacks, batch work, preparation shields, and component callbacks, but returns one shared reader teardown deferred:

```kotlin
private val teardownJob = SupervisorJob()
private val teardownScope = CoroutineScope(
    teardownJob + Dispatchers.Main.immediate
)
private val teardown = ReaderPageReaderTeardown(
    scope = teardownScope,
    fenceBundleOwners = bundleSource::fenceForClose,
    closeRendererAndAdapter = closeRendererAndAdapter,
    closeBundleOwners = bundleSource::closeAndJoin,
    onFinished = { teardownJob.complete() }
)

fun destroy(): Deferred<Unit> {
    if (!destroyed) {
        destroyed = true
        bundleSource.fenceForClose()
        cancelBackgroundPrefetch("destroy")
        cancelRasterRepairs("destroy")
        cancelPrewarm(reason = "destroy")
        currentVisualPageIndex = null
        applicationContext.unregisterComponentCallbacks(memoryCallbacks)
    }
    return teardown.start()
}

suspend fun destroyAndJoin() {
    destroy().await()
}
```
