function Invoke-GitLinesChecked {
  param(
    [string[]] $Arguments,
    [string] $Description
  )

  $output = @(& git @Arguments)
  $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
    throw "$Description (exit=$exitCode)"
  }
  return $output
}

function Assert-ReleaseSourceIdentity {
  param([string] $ExpectedNavicCommit)

  $navicTop = (@(Invoke-GitLinesChecked `
    @('rev-parse', '--show-toplevel') 'Unable to resolve Navic root') |
    Out-String).Trim()
  $navicBranch = (@(Invoke-GitLinesChecked `
    @('branch', '--show-current') 'Unable to resolve Navic branch') |
    Out-String).Trim()
  $navicHead = (@(Invoke-GitLinesChecked `
    @('rev-parse', 'HEAD') 'Unable to resolve Navic HEAD') | Out-String).Trim()
  $forkFetch = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked `
    @('remote', 'get-url', '--all', 'fork') 'Unable to resolve Navic fetch URLs')
  $forkPush = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked `
    @('remote', 'get-url', '--push', '--all', 'fork') `
    'Unable to resolve Navic push URLs')
  $navicRemote = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked @(
      'ls-remote', '--refs', 'fork',
      'refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation'
    ) 'Unable to resolve Navic release branch')
  $navicStatus = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked `
    @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') `
    'Unable to inspect Navic status')
  $unexpectedNavic = @($navicStatus | Where-Object {
    $_ -notmatch '^\?\? \.codex-validation/'
  })
  if ((Resolve-Path $navicTop).Path -ne (Resolve-Path '.').Path -or
      $navicBranch -ne 'reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation' -or
      $navicHead -ne $ExpectedNavicCommit -or
      $forkFetch.Count -ne 1 -or
      $forkFetch[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/Navic(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $forkPush.Count -ne 1 -or
      $forkPush[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/Navic(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $navicRemote.Count -ne 1 -or
      ($navicRemote[0] -split '\s+')[0] -ne $ExpectedNavicCommit -or
      $unexpectedNavic.Count -ne 0) {
    throw 'Navic identity or clean-tree state changed during release staging'
  }
  if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $candidatePath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
      $candidateSha256) {
    throw 'Candidate-source bytes changed during release staging'
  }

  $canonicalPrefix = @('-C', $canonicalRoot)
  $canonicalTop = (@(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical root') | Out-String).Trim()
  $canonicalBranch = (@(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'branch', '--show-current'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical branch') | Out-String).Trim()
  $canonicalHead = (@(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'rev-parse', 'HEAD'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical HEAD') | Out-String).Trim()
  $canonicalFetch = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'remote', 'get-url', '--all', 'origin'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical fetch URLs')
  $canonicalPush = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'remote', 'get-url', '--push', '--all', 'origin'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical push URLs')
  $canonicalRemote = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'ls-remote', '--refs', 'origin',
      'refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical release branch')
  $canonicalStatus = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'
    )) 'Unable to inspect canonical status')
  if ((Resolve-Path $canonicalTop).Path -ne (Resolve-Path $canonicalRoot).Path -or
      $canonicalBranch -ne 'reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation' -or
      $canonicalHead -ne $releaseCommit -or
      $canonicalFetch.Count -ne 1 -or
      $canonicalFetch[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $canonicalPush.Count -ne 1 -or
      $canonicalPush[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $canonicalRemote.Count -ne 1 -or
      ($canonicalRemote[0] -split '\s+')[0] -ne $releaseCommit -or
      $canonicalStatus.Count -ne 0) {
    throw 'Canonical release-source identity or clean-tree state changed'
  }
}

}

$releaseView = $releaseViewText | ConvertFrom-Json
$assetText = gh api "repos/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl/releases/assets/$assetId"
$assetExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$asset = $assetText | ConvertFrom-Json
$remoteTagLines = @(Invoke-GitLinesChecked ($canonicalPrefix + @(
    'ls-remote', '--tags', 'origin', 'refs/tags/1.2.0',
    'refs/tags/1.2.0^{}'
  )) 'Unable to revalidate canonical remote tag')
if ($releaseViewExit -ne 0 -or $assetExit -ne 0 -or
    -not $releaseView.draft -or
    $releaseView.tag_name -cne '1.2.0' -or
    $releaseView.name -cne $expectedName -or
    $releaseView.target_commitish -cne $releaseCommit -or
    $releaseView.body -cne $expectedBody -or
    $asset.name -ne $artifactName -or [long]$asset.size -ne $aarBytes -or
    $asset.digest -ne $expectedServerDigest -or
    @($remoteTagLines | Where-Object {
      $_ -match '\srefs/tags/1\.2\.0$' -and
      ($_ -split '\s+')[0] -eq $tagObjectOid
    }).Count -ne 1 -or
    @($remoteTagLines | Where-Object {
      $_ -match '\srefs/tags/1\.2\.0\^\{\}$' -and
      ($_ -split '\s+')[0] -eq $releaseCommit
    }).Count -ne 1) {
  throw 'Draft transaction identity changed before Navic re-import'
}
$draftReceiptPath = '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-release-candidate.json'
$draftReceipt = [ordered]@{
  SchemaVersion = 1
  State = 'DraftVerified'
  Repository = 'https://github.com/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl'
  Tag = '1.2.0'
  ApiVersion = 2
  Commit = $releaseCommit
  SourceManifestSha256 = $candidateSource.sourceManifestSha256
  LicenseBlob = $candidateSource.licenseBlob
  TagObjectOid = $tagObjectOid
  TagPeeledCommit = $releaseCommit
  ReleaseId = $releaseId
  ReleaseTransactionNonce = $transactionNonce
  AssetId = $assetId
  Asset = $artifactName
  AssetServerDigest = $expectedServerDigest
  ArtifactSha256 = $aarSha256
  ArtifactBytes = $aarBytes
  GateCommit = $gateCommit
  GateReceiptSha256 = $gateReceiptSha256
}
$draftJson = $draftReceipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $draftReceiptPath -PathType Leaf) {
  $existingDraftJson = (
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $draftReceiptPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  ) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
  if ($existingDraftJson -cne $draftJson) {
    throw 'Existing draft receipt differs from the verified transaction'
  }
} else {
  $draftTemporary =
    "$draftReceiptPath.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
  $draftJson | Set-Content -LiteralPath $draftTemporary
  Move-Item -LiteralPath $draftTemporary -Destination $draftReceiptPath
}
```

Update every live Navic pin from `1.1.4`/API 1 to the digest-verified `1.2.0`/API 2 draft candidate, run the guarded importer against the authenticated draft asset identity, and verify the prospective immutable snapshot. The release remains a draft throughout this block:

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
$release = Get-Content `
  .codex-validation\playlikecurl-release-candidate.json -Raw |
  ConvertFrom-Json
if ($release.State -ne 'DraftVerified') {
  throw 'Verified draft release evidence is missing before Navic re-import'
}

$oldDigest = '9e31005cdf1768a89f7356f8519caefa80fd05fc84ca98e8b070fad009078ca8'
function Set-ExactLiteralCount(
  [string] $Path,
  [string] $Old,
  [string] $New,
  [int] $ExpectedCount
) {
  if ($ExpectedCount -lt 1) { throw 'Expected pin count must be positive' }
  $resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).Path
  $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolved)
  $oldCount = [regex]::Matches(
    $text,
    [regex]::Escape($Old)
  ).Count
  $newCount = [regex]::Matches(
    $text,
    [regex]::Escape($New)
  ).Count
  if ($oldCount -eq $ExpectedCount -and $newCount -eq 0) {
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText(
      $resolved,
      $text.Replace($Old, $New),
      [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )
  } elseif ($oldCount -ne 0) {
    throw "Pin count mismatch in ${Path}: old=$oldCount new=$newCount expectedOld=$ExpectedCount"
  }
  $updated = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolved)
  if ([regex]::Matches($updated, [regex]::Escape($Old)).Count -ne 0) {
    throw "Old pin remains in $Path"
  }
}
function Set-ExactRegexReplacement(
  [string] $Path,
  [string] $OldPattern,
  [string] $NewText,
  [string] $AppliedPattern
) {
  $resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).Path
  $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolved)
  $oldCount = [regex]::Matches($text, $OldPattern).Count
  $appliedCount = [regex]::Matches($text, $AppliedPattern).Count
  if ($oldCount -eq 1 -and $appliedCount -eq 0) {
    $replacement = [Text.RegularExpressions.MatchEvaluator]{
      param($match)
      $NewText
    }
    $text = [regex]::Replace($text, $OldPattern, $replacement)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText(
      $resolved,
      $text,
      [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )
  } elseif ($oldCount -ne 0 -or $appliedCount -ne 1) {
    throw "Regex transform state mismatch in $Path old=$oldCount applied=$appliedCount"
  }
  $updated = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolved)
  if ([regex]::Matches($updated, $OldPattern).Count -ne 0 -or
      [regex]::Matches($updated, $AppliedPattern).Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Regex transform postcondition failed in $Path"
  }
}

$transactionText = @'
  Assert-PlayLikeCurlRemovalTarget `
    -RepositoryRoot $repositoryRootPath `
    -TargetPath $targetRoot
  $targetParent = Split-Path -Parent $targetRoot
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $targetParent -Force | Out-Null
  $swapJournalPath = Join-Path $repositoryRootPath ".codex-validation/playlikecurl-import-swap.json"
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $swapJournalPath -PathType Leaf) {
    $journal = Get-Content -LiteralPath $swapJournalPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $expectedTarget = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($targetRoot)
    $recordedTarget = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$journal.Target)
    $recordedPrepared = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$journal.Prepared)
    $recordedBackup = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$journal.Backup)
    $expectedParent = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($targetParent) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
    if ($journal.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or $recordedTarget -ne $expectedTarget -or
        -not $recordedPrepared.StartsWith($expectedParent, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
        -not $recordedBackup.StartsWith($expectedParent, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
        [IO.Path]::GetFileName($recordedPrepared) -notmatch '^\.playlikecurl-prepared-[0-9a-f]{32}$' -or
        [IO.Path]::GetFileName($recordedBackup) -notmatch '^\.playlikecurl-backup-[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
      throw "PlayLikeCurl swap journal contains an unsafe path."
    }
    $targetExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $recordedTarget
    $preparedExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $recordedPrepared
    $backupExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $recordedBackup
    if (-not $targetExists -and $backupExists) {
      Move-Item -LiteralPath $recordedBackup -Destination $recordedTarget
      if ($preparedExists) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $recordedPrepared -Recurse -Force
      }
    } elseif ($targetExists -and $backupExists -and -not $preparedExists) {
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $recordedBackup -Recurse -Force
    } elseif ($targetExists -and -not $backupExists) {
      if ($preparedExists) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $recordedPrepared -Recurse -Force
      }
    } else {
      throw "PlayLikeCurl swap journal state is ambiguous; preserve it for review."
    }
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $swapJournalPath -Force
  }
  $swapId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")
  $preparedTarget = Join-Path $targetParent ".playlikecurl-prepared-$swapId"
  $backupTarget = Join-Path $targetParent ".playlikecurl-backup-$swapId"
  foreach ($path in @($preparedTarget, $backupTarget)) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) {
      throw "PlayLikeCurl swap path unexpectedly exists: $path"
    }
  }
  $journalTemporary = "$swapJournalPath.tmp"
  [ordered]@{
    SchemaVersion = 1
    Target = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($targetRoot)
    Prepared = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($preparedTarget)
    Backup = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($backupTarget)
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $journalTemporary
  Move-Item -LiteralPath $journalTemporary -Destination $swapJournalPath -Force
  try {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $stagingRoot -Destination $preparedTarget -Recurse
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $targetRoot) {
      Move-Item -LiteralPath $targetRoot -Destination $backupTarget
    }
    Move-Item -LiteralPath $preparedTarget -Destination $targetRoot
    $verifierPath = Join-Path $repositoryRootPath (
      "scripts/verify-playlikecurl-snapshot.ps1"
    )
    & pwsh -NoProfile -File $verifierPath -RepositoryRoot $repositoryRootPath
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      throw "Imported PlayLikeCurl snapshot failed verification."
    }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backupTarget) {
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $backupTarget -Recurse -Force
    }
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $swapJournalPath -Force
  } catch {
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $targetRoot) -and
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backupTarget)) {
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $targetRoot -Recurse -Force
      Move-Item -LiteralPath $backupTarget -Destination $targetRoot
    } elseif (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $targetRoot) -and
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backupTarget)) {
      Move-Item -LiteralPath $backupTarget -Destination $targetRoot
    }
    throw
  } finally {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $preparedTarget) {
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $preparedTarget -Recurse -Force
    }
  }
'@

}
foreach ($group in @($finalFailures | Group-Object)) {
  if (-not $baselineFailureGroups.ContainsKey($group.Name) -or

  }
}

- [ ] **Step 6: If a gate exposes a defect, commit the fix before recording new evidence**

If the reproduced defect belongs to canonical PlayLikeCurl, do not use the Navic-only gate-fix block below. On the initial pre-publication pass, confirm tag/release `1.2.0` is still absent, repair from the external canonical release-source branch, create and push a new exact ownership/release-source commit as applicable, regenerate `playlikecurl-release-source-commit.txt`, its full source manifest/license evidence, and Navic's tracked `candidate-source.json`, synchronize every changed canonical blob into Navic, and commit/push that candidate under the applicable earlier-task allowlist. Delete stale Task 14 output/markers and restart at Step 1. On the post-publication pass, the tag/release is immutable: a canonical defect requires a new versioned release plan rather than moving or replacing `1.2.0`. The block below is only for Navic-owned defects already named by Tasks 2–13.

}
$trackedChanged = @($trackedStatus | ForEach-Object {

})
$untrackedRaw = @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to enumerate untracked gate-fix paths' }
$untrackedChanged = @(

)
$candidates = @($trackedChanged + $untrackedChanged | Sort-Object -Unique)
if ($candidates.Count -eq 0) {
  throw "No gate-fix files changed; skip this commit step"
}
$candidates | Set-Content .codex-validation\gate-fix-candidates.txt

Only Step 1 records `automated-gate-commit.txt`, and Step 4 rewrites `final-host-failures.txt`, after the committed tree is clean and all gates run again. - [ ] **Step 7: Commit the verified draft import, publish canonical 1.2.0, and restart the frozen gates**

Proceed only after Steps 1–5 have produced a `PrePublicationCandidate` gate receipt and Step 6 found no defect. On the first pass, execute Task 13 Step 6's **Deferred draft staging, verified re-import, and immutable publication** block, then its exact live-pin/import block. The draft block is idempotent and records the tag object, release ID, asset ID, server digest, persisted AAR digest, and gate receipt. It never clobbers an existing asset and never publishes. The import block preserves `candidate-source.json`, generates the exact ten-path Navic delta, regenerates acknowledgements from source metadata, and passes all release-import verifiers.

The dispatcher below recognizes an exact uncommitted import, a just-created local import commit, a remotely pushed import commit with a draft, publication completed before local evidence, a completed release marker awaiting post-publication gates, and a fully completed post-publication pass. Every other state hard-stops.

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core' -or
    $PSVersionTable.PSVersion -lt [Version]'7.3') {
  throw 'Release publication requires PowerShell Core 7.3 or newer'
}
$releasePaths = @(
  'THIRD_PARTY.md'
  'composeApp/aboutlibraries/libraries/playlikecurl.json'
  'composeApp/aboutlibraries/licenses/playlikecurl-mit.json'
  'composeApp/src/androidHostTest/kotlin/paige/navic/reader/ThirdPartyAttributionSourceTest.kt'
  'composeApp/src/commonMain/composeResources/files/acknowledgements.json'
  'scripts/test-playlikecurl-snapshot-verifier.ps1'
  'scripts/verify-playlikecurl-snapshot.ps1'
  'scripts/verify-third-party-attributions.ps1'
  'third_party/playlikecurl/provenance.json'
  'tools/update-playlikecurl.ps1'
) | Sort-Object -Unique
if ($releasePaths.Count -ne 10) {
  throw 'Release-import path inventory is incomplete or duplicated'
}
$draftPath = '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-release-candidate.json'
$finalPath = '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-release.json'
$markerPath = '.codex-validation\release-import-commit.txt'
$gateCommitPath = '.codex-validation\automated-gate-commit.txt'
$preGateReceiptPath =
  '.codex-validation\automated-gate-receipt.pre-publication.json'
$postGateReceiptPointerPath =
  '.codex-validation\automated-gate-receipt.post-publication.current.txt'
$postGateCommitMarkerPath =
  '.codex-validation\task14-post-publication-commit.txt'
$candidatePath = 'third_party\playlikecurl\candidate-source.json'
$candidateShaPath = '.codex-validation\automated-gate-candidate-source-sha256.txt'
$canonicalRoot = (
  Get-Content .codex-validation\playlikecurl-canonical-root.txt -Raw
).Trim()
foreach ($required in @(
    $draftPath,
    $gateCommitPath,
    $preGateReceiptPath,
    $candidatePath,
    $candidateShaPath,
    '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-release-build\karackencurllib-release.aar'
  )) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $required -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "Release dispatcher input is missing: $required"
  }
}
$draft = Get-Content -LiteralPath $draftPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$gateCommit = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $gateCommitPath -Raw).Trim()
$preGateReceipt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $preGateReceiptPath -Raw |
  ConvertFrom-Json
$candidateSource = Get-Content -LiteralPath $candidatePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$candidateSha256 = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $candidateShaPath -Raw).Trim()
$draftFields = @(
  'ApiVersion', 'Artifact', 'ArtifactBytes', 'ArtifactSha256',
  'AssetId', 'AssetServerDigest', 'Commit', 'GateCommit',
  'GateReceiptSha256', 'LicenseBlob', 'ReleaseId',
  'ReleaseTransactionNonce', 'Repository', 'SchemaVersion',
  'SourceManifestSha256', 'State', 'Tag', 'TagObjectOid',
  'TagPeeledCommit'
) | Sort-Object
$gateReceiptFields = @(
  'CandidateSourceSha256', 'CanonicalClassesSha256',
  'CanonicalSourceCommit', 'CanonicalXmlManifestSha256',
  'FinalReleaseSha256', 'FocusedClassesSha256',
  'FocusedXmlManifestSha256', 'FullHostAcceptance',
  'FullHostFailureKind', 'FullHostFailuresSha256',
  'FullHostInventorySha256', 'FullHostOutcomeSha256',
  'NavicCommit', 'Phase', 'ReaderDevApkBytes',
  'ReaderDevApkSha256', 'SchemaVersion'
) | Sort-Object
$actualDraftFields = @($draft.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object)
if ([string]$draft.ReleaseTransactionNonce -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
  throw 'Verified draft transaction nonce is malformed'
}
$expectedReleaseName = 'PlayLikeCurl 1.2.0'
$expectedReleaseBody =
  "Navic release transaction: $($draft.ReleaseTransactionNonce)`n`n" +
  'Production API 2 adds logical direction and boundary contracts, bounded deck admission, ' +
  'deterministic terminal/disposal ownership, and asynchronous ownership snapshots.'
$preGateReceiptSha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 `
  $preGateReceiptPath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$candidateAarPath =
  '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-release-build\karackencurllib-release.aar'
if (@(Compare-Object $draftFields $actualDraftFields).Count -ne 0 -or
    $draft.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or $draft.State -ne 'DraftVerified' -or
    $draft.Repository -ne 'https://github.com/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl' -or
    $draft.Tag -ne '1.2.0' -or $draft.ApiVersion -ne 2 -or
    $draft.Commit -ne $candidateSource.commit -or
    $draft.Commit -ne $draft.TagPeeledCommit -or
    $draft.SourceManifestSha256 -ne $candidateSource.sourceManifestSha256 -or
    $draft.LicenseBlob -ne $candidateSource.licenseBlob -or
    $draft.GateCommit -ne $preGateReceipt.NavicCommit -or
    $draft.GateReceiptSha256 -ne $preGateReceiptSha256 -or
    $draft.Asset -ne 'karackencurllib-release.aar' -or
    $draft.AssetServerDigest -ne "sha256:$($draft.ArtifactSha256)" -or
    (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $candidateAarPath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
      $draft.ArtifactSha256 -or
    (Get-Item -LiteralPath $candidateAarPath).Length -ne
      [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes -or
    (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $candidatePath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
      $candidateSha256) {
  throw 'Verified draft receipt or candidate identity is invalid'
}
if (@(Compare-Object $gateReceiptFields @(
      $preGateReceipt.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object
    )).Count -ne 0 -or
    $preGateReceipt.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or
    $preGateReceipt.Phase -ne 'PrePublicationCandidate' -or
    $preGateReceipt.NavicCommit -ne $draft.GateCommit -or
    $preGateReceipt.CanonicalSourceCommit -ne $draft.Commit -or
    $preGateReceipt.CandidateSourceSha256 -ne $candidateSha256 -or
    $preGateReceipt.FinalReleaseSha256 -ne 'none' -or
    $preGateReceipt.FullHostAcceptance -ne 'Passed') {
  throw 'Immutable pre-publication gate receipt is invalid'
}

function Get-GateEvidenceTreeManifest {
  param([string] $Root)

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Root -PathType Container)) {
    throw "Gate evidence tree is absent: $Root"
  }
  $resolvedRoot = (Resolve-Path $Root).Path
  return @(
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Recurse -File |
      ForEach-Object {
        $relative = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath(
          $resolvedRoot,
          $_.FullName
        ).Replace('\', '/')
        "$relative`t$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $_.FullName).Hash.ToLowerInvariant())"
      } | Sort-Object
  )
}

function Assert-GateReceiptEvidence {
  param(
    [psobject] $Receipt,
    [string] $PhaseSlug,
    [switch] $ValidateTransientEvidence
  )

  $phaseRoot = ".codex-validation\automated-gate-evidence.$PhaseSlug"
  foreach ($kind in @('focused', 'canonical')) {
    $xmlRoot = Join-Path $phaseRoot "$kind-xml"
    $manifestPath = Join-Path $phaseRoot "$kind-xml-sha256.txt"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath -PathType Leaf)) {
      throw "Frozen $kind XML manifest is absent"
    }
    $recorded = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath)
    $actual = @(Get-GateEvidenceTreeManifest $xmlRoot)
    if ($actual.Count -eq 0 -or
        @(Compare-Object $recorded $actual).Count -ne 0) {
      throw "Frozen $kind XML tree differs from its recursive manifest"
    }
    $receiptField = if ($kind -eq 'focused') {
      'FocusedXmlManifestSha256'
    } else {
      'CanonicalXmlManifestSha256'
    }
    if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $manifestPath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
        [string]$Receipt.($receiptField)) {
      throw "Frozen $kind XML manifest differs from its gate receipt"
    }
  }
  $sealedInputs = [ordered]@{
    FocusedClassesSha256 = Join-Path $phaseRoot `
      'focused-reader-executed-classes.txt'
    CanonicalClassesSha256 = Join-Path $phaseRoot `
      'canonical-release-executed-classes.txt'
    FullHostInventorySha256 = Join-Path $phaseRoot 'final-host-inventory.txt'
    FullHostFailuresSha256 = Join-Path $phaseRoot 'final-host-failures.txt'
    FullHostOutcomeSha256 = Join-Path $phaseRoot 'final-host-task-outcome.json'
  }
  foreach ($entry in $sealedInputs.GetEnumerator()) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $entry.Value -PathType Leaf) -or
        (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $entry.Value).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
          [string]$Receipt.($entry.Key)) {
      throw "Sealed gate evidence differs from its receipt: $($entry.Value)"
    }
  }
  $sealedReaderDevApk = Join-Path $phaseRoot 'readerdev.apk'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sealedReaderDevApk -PathType Leaf) -or
      (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $sealedReaderDevApk).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
        $Receipt.ReaderDevApkSha256 -or
      (Get-Item -LiteralPath $sealedReaderDevApk).Length -ne
        [long]$Receipt.ReaderDevApkBytes) {
    throw 'Sealed ReaderDev APK differs from its gate receipt'
  }
  if ($Receipt.Phase -eq 'PostPublicationImport') {
    $sealedFinalRelease = Join-Path $phaseRoot 'playlikecurl-release.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sealedFinalRelease -PathType Leaf) -or
        (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $sealedFinalRelease).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
          $Receipt.FinalReleaseSha256) {
      throw 'Sealed final release evidence differs from its gate receipt'
    }
  }
  if ($ValidateTransientEvidence) {
    $readerDevApk = '.\androidApp\build\outputs\apk\readerDev\Navic.apk'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $readerDevApk -PathType Leaf) -or
        (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $readerDevApk).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
          $Receipt.ReaderDevApkSha256 -or
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $readerDevApk).Length -ne
          [long]$Receipt.ReaderDevApkBytes) {
      throw 'Current ReaderDev APK differs from its frozen gate receipt'
    }
  }
}

$preTransientEvidence = -not (
  Test-Path -LiteralPath $markerPath -PathType Leaf
)
Assert-GateReceiptEvidence $preGateReceipt 'pre-publication' `
  -ValidateTransientEvidence:$preTransientEvidence

function Invoke-DispatcherGitLines {
  param(
    [string[]] $Arguments,
    [string] $Description
  )

  $output = @(& git @Arguments)
  $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
    throw "$Description (exit=$exitCode)"
  }
  return $output
}

function Get-NavicRemoteOid {
  $lines = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
      'ls-remote', '--refs', 'fork',
      'refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation'
    ) 'Unable to resolve the Navic implementation remote')
  if ($lines.Count -ne 1) {
    throw 'Navic implementation remote is missing or ambiguous'
  }
  return ($lines[0] -split '\s+')[0]
}

function Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity {
  param(
    [string] $ExpectedHead,
    [string[]] $AllowedRemoteOids,
    [switch] $AllowReleaseDelta
  )

  $top = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines `
    @('rev-parse', '--show-toplevel') 'Unable to resolve Navic root') |
    Out-String).Trim()
  $branch = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines `
    @('branch', '--show-current') 'Unable to resolve Navic branch') |
    Out-String).Trim()
  $head = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines `
    @('rev-parse', 'HEAD') 'Unable to resolve Navic HEAD') | Out-String).Trim()
  $forkFetch = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines `
    @('remote', 'get-url', '--all', 'fork') 'Unable to resolve Navic fetch URLs')
  $forkPush = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines `
    @('remote', 'get-url', '--push', '--all', 'fork') `
    'Unable to resolve Navic push URLs')
  $remoteOid = Get-NavicRemoteOid
  if ((Resolve-Path $top).Path -ne (Resolve-Path '.').Path -or
      $branch -ne 'reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation' -or
      $head -ne $ExpectedHead -or
      $forkFetch.Count -ne 1 -or
      $forkFetch[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/Navic(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $forkPush.Count -ne 1 -or
      $forkPush[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/Navic(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $remoteOid -notin $AllowedRemoteOids) {
    throw 'Navic repository, branch, commit, or remote identity is invalid'
  }
  $status = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines `
    @('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all') `
    'Unable to inspect Navic worktree')
  $unexpected = @($status | Where-Object {
    if ($_ -match '^\?\? \.codex-validation/') {
      $false
    } elseif ($AllowReleaseDelta) {
      $_.Length -lt 4 -or
        $_.Substring(3).Replace('\', '/') -notin $releasePaths
    } else {
      $true
    }
  })
  if ($unexpected.Count -ne 0) {
    throw "Navic worktree state is invalid:`n$($unexpected -join "`n")"
  }
}

function Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity {
  $canonicalPrefix = @('-C', $canonicalRoot)
  $top = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical root') | Out-String).Trim()
  $branch = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'branch', '--show-current'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical branch') | Out-String).Trim()
  $head = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'rev-parse', 'HEAD'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical HEAD') | Out-String).Trim()
  $originFetch = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'remote', 'get-url', '--all', 'origin'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical fetch URLs')
  $originPush = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'remote', 'get-url', '--push', '--all', 'origin'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical push URLs')
  $status = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'
    )) 'Unable to inspect canonical worktree')
  $branchLines = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'ls-remote', '--refs', 'origin',
      'refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical branch remote')
  $tagLines = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines ($canonicalPrefix + @(
      'ls-remote', '--tags', 'origin', 'refs/tags/1.2.0',
      'refs/tags/1.2.0^{}'
    )) 'Unable to resolve canonical release tag')
  $tagObject = @($tagLines | Where-Object {
    $_ -match '\srefs/tags/1\.2\.0$'
  })
  $tagPeeled = @($tagLines | Where-Object {
    $_ -match '\srefs/tags/1\.2\.0\^\{\}$'
  })
  if ((Resolve-Path $top).Path -ne (Resolve-Path $canonicalRoot).Path -or
      $branch -ne 'reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation' -or
      $head -ne $draft.Commit -or
      $originFetch.Count -ne 1 -or
      $originFetch[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $originPush.Count -ne 1 -or
      $originPush[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $status.Count -ne 0 -or
      $branchLines.Count -ne 1 -or
      ($branchLines[0] -split '\s+')[0] -ne $draft.Commit -or
      $tagObject.Count -ne 1 -or
      ($tagObject[0] -split '\s+')[0] -ne $draft.TagObjectOid -or
      $tagPeeled.Count -ne 1 -or
      ($tagPeeled[0] -split '\s+')[0] -ne $draft.Commit) {
    throw 'Canonical source, branch, tag object, or remote identity is invalid'
  }
}

function Get-ExactReleaseState {
  $releaseStateText = gh api `
    "repos/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl/releases/$($draft.ReleaseId)"
  $releaseStateExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $releaseState = $releaseStateText | ConvertFrom-Json
  $assetStateText = gh api `
    "repos/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl/releases/assets/$($draft.AssetId)"
  $assetStateExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $assetState = $assetStateText | ConvertFrom-Json
  if ($releaseStateExit -ne 0 -or $assetStateExit -ne 0 -or
      [long]$releaseState.id -ne [long]$draft.ReleaseId -or
      $releaseState.tag_name -cne '1.2.0' -or
      $releaseState.name -cne $expectedReleaseName -or
      $releaseState.body -cne $expectedReleaseBody -or
      $releaseState.target_commitish -cne $draft.Commit -or
      $releaseState.prerelease -or
      [long]$assetState.id -ne [long]$draft.AssetId -or
      $assetState.name -ne $draft.Asset -or
      [long]$assetState.size -ne [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes -or
      $assetState.digest -ne $draft.AssetServerDigest) {
    throw 'GitHub release or asset identity differs from the draft receipt'
  }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    Release = $releaseState
    Asset = $assetState
  }
}

function Assert-ImportCommitShape {
  param([string] $ImportCommit)

  $subject = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
      'log', '-1', '--format=%s', $ImportCommit
    ) 'Unable to resolve release-import subject') | Out-String).Trim()
  $parent = (@(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
      'rev-parse', "$ImportCommit^"
    ) 'Unable to resolve release-import parent') | Out-String).Trim()
  $paths = @(
    Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
      'diff-tree', '--no-commit-id', '--name-only', '-r', $ImportCommit
    ) 'Unable to resolve release-import paths' |
      ForEach-Object { $_.Replace('\', '/') } | Sort-Object -Unique
  )
  if ($subject -ne 'chore(reader): import PlayLikeCurl 1.2.0 API 2' -or
      $parent -ne $draft.GateCommit -or
      @(Compare-Object $releasePaths $paths).Count -ne 0) {
    throw 'Release-import commit subject, parent, or path inventory is invalid'
  }
}

function Assert-FinalReleaseEvidence {
  param([string] $ImportCommit)

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $finalPath -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Final release evidence is absent'
  }
  $final = Get-Content -LiteralPath $finalPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  $finalFields = @(
    'ApiVersion', 'Artifact', 'ArtifactBytes', 'ArtifactSha256',
    'AssetId', 'AssetServerDigest', 'Commit', 'GateCommit',
    'Immutable', 'LicenseBlob', 'NavicImportCommit',
    'PublicDownloadBytes', 'PublicDownloadSha256', 'PublishedAt',
    'ReleaseId', 'Repository', 'SchemaVersion',
    'SourceManifestSha256', 'State', 'Tag', 'TagObjectOid',
    'TagPeeledCommit'
  ) | Sort-Object
  if (@(Compare-Object $finalFields `
        @($final.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object)).Count -ne 0 -or
      $final.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or
      $final.State -ne 'PublishedImmutableVerified' -or
      -not $final.Immutable -or
      $final.Repository -ne $draft.Repository -or
      $final.Tag -ne $draft.Tag -or $final.ApiVersion -ne 2 -or
      $final.Commit -ne $draft.Commit -or
      $final.SourceManifestSha256 -ne $draft.SourceManifestSha256 -or
      $final.LicenseBlob -ne $draft.LicenseBlob -or
      $final.TagObjectOid -ne $draft.TagObjectOid -or
      $final.TagPeeledCommit -ne $draft.Commit -or
      [long]$final.ReleaseId -ne [long]$draft.ReleaseId -or
      [long]$final.AssetId -ne [long]$draft.AssetId -or
      $final.Artifact -ne $draft.Asset -or
      $final.AssetServerDigest -ne $draft.AssetServerDigest -or
      $final.ArtifactSha256 -ne $draft.ArtifactSha256 -or
      [long]$final.ArtifactBytes -ne [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes -or
      $final.PublicDownloadSha256 -ne $draft.ArtifactSha256 -or
      [long]$final.PublicDownloadBytes -ne [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes -or
      $final.GateCommit -ne $draft.GateCommit -or
      $final.NavicImportCommit -ne $ImportCommit) {
    throw 'Final immutable release evidence is malformed or identity-mismatched'
  }
  $remoteState = Get-ExactReleaseState
  if ($remoteState.Release.draft -or -not $remoteState.Release.immutable -or
      $remoteState.Release.published_at -ne $final.PublishedAt) {
    throw 'Published immutable release state differs from final evidence'
  }
  Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
}

function Assert-ReleaseImportSemantics {
  pwsh -NoProfile -File .\scripts\verify-playlikecurl-snapshot.ps1
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Imported snapshot verification failed' }
  pwsh -NoProfile -File .\scripts\test-playlikecurl-snapshot-verifier.ps1
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Snapshot verifier semantic tests failed' }
  pwsh -NoProfile -File .\scripts\verify-third-party-attributions.ps1
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Third-party attribution verification failed' }
  .\gradlew.bat :third_party:playlikecurl:karackencurllib:test
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Re-imported PlayLikeCurl suite failed' }
  .\gradlew.bat :composeApp:testAndroidHostTest `
    --tests 'paige.navic.reader.ThirdPartyAttributionSourceTest'
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Re-imported attribution host test failed' }
}

function Assert-PostPublicationGateReceipt {
  param([string] $ExpectedHead)

  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $postGateReceiptPointerPath -PathType Leaf) -or
      -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $postGateCommitMarkerPath -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Post-publication gate receipt pointer or commit marker is absent'
  }
  $postGateCommit = (
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $postGateCommitMarkerPath -Raw
  ).Trim()
  $postGateReceiptPath = (
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $postGateReceiptPointerPath -Raw
  ).Trim()
  $expectedPostReceiptPath =
    ".codex-validation\automated-gate-receipt.post-publication.$ExpectedHead.json"
  if ($postGateCommit -cne $ExpectedHead -or
      $postGateReceiptPath -cne $expectedPostReceiptPath -or
      -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $postGateReceiptPath -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Post-publication gate receipt pointer is malformed or stale'
  }
  $postReceipt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $postGateReceiptPath -Raw |
    ConvertFrom-Json
  $finalSha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 `
    $finalPath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  if (@(Compare-Object $gateReceiptFields @(
        $postReceipt.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object
      )).Count -ne 0 -or
      $postReceipt.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or
      $postReceipt.Phase -ne 'PostPublicationImport' -or
      $postReceipt.NavicCommit -ne $ExpectedHead -or
      $postReceipt.NavicCommit -ne $gateCommit -or
      $postReceipt.CanonicalSourceCommit -ne $draft.Commit -or
      $postReceipt.CandidateSourceSha256 -ne $candidateSha256 -or
      $postReceipt.FinalReleaseSha256 -ne $finalSha256 -or
      $postReceipt.FullHostAcceptance -ne 'Passed') {
    throw 'Post-publication gate receipt is malformed or identity-mismatched'
  }
  Assert-GateReceiptEvidence $postReceipt `
    "post-publication.$ExpectedHead" -ValidateTransientEvidence
  return $postReceipt
}

$currentCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$currentCommitExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($currentCommitExit -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to resolve current Navic HEAD' }
$markerExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $markerPath -PathType Leaf
$finalExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $finalPath -PathType Leaf
$postPublicationComplete = $false
if ($markerExists) {
  $importCommit = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $markerPath -Raw).Trim()
  git merge-base --is-ancestor $importCommit $currentCommit
  $ancestorExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($ancestorExit -ne 0) {
    throw 'Release-import marker is not an ancestor of current Navic HEAD'
  }
  Assert-ImportCommitShape $importCommit
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $currentCommit @($currentCommit)
  Assert-FinalReleaseEvidence $importCommit
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $postGateReceiptPointerPath -PathType Leaf) {
    $null = Assert-PostPublicationGateReceipt $currentCommit
    $postPublicationComplete = $true
  }
} elseif ($finalExists) {
  $recoveredFinal = Get-Content -LiteralPath $finalPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  $importCommit = [string]$recoveredFinal.NavicImportCommit
  git merge-base --is-ancestor $importCommit $currentCommit
  $ancestorExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($ancestorExit -ne 0) {
    throw 'Final release import anchor is not an ancestor of current Navic HEAD'
  }
  Assert-ImportCommitShape $importCommit
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $currentCommit @($currentCommit)
  Assert-ReleaseImportSemantics
  Assert-FinalReleaseEvidence $importCommit
  $markerTemporary = "$markerPath.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
  $importCommit | Set-Content -LiteralPath $markerTemporary
  Move-Item -LiteralPath $markerTemporary -Destination $markerPath
  $markerExists = $true
}

if (-not $markerExists) {
  if ($currentCommit -eq $draft.GateCommit) {
    Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $draft.GateCommit @($draft.GateCommit) `
      -AllowReleaseDelta
    $combinedStatus = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
        'diff', 'HEAD', '--name-status', '--no-renames'
      ) 'Unable to inspect release-import delta')
    if (@($combinedStatus | Where-Object {
        ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[0] -notin @('A', 'M')
      }).Count -ne 0) {
      throw 'Release-import delta contains an unsupported status'
    }
    $combinedPaths = @($combinedStatus | ForEach-Object {
      ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[1].Replace('\', '/')
    } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    $generatedAcknowledgements =
      'composeApp/src/commonMain/composeResources/files/acknowledgements.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $generatedAcknowledgements -PathType Leaf)) {
      throw 'Generated acknowledgements are absent from the release import'
    }
    git check-ignore --quiet -- $generatedAcknowledgements
    $generatedIgnoreExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($generatedIgnoreExit -eq 0) {
      $combinedPaths = @(
        @($combinedPaths) + $generatedAcknowledgements | Sort-Object -Unique
      )
    } elseif ($generatedIgnoreExit -ne 1) {
      throw 'Unable to inspect generated acknowledgements ignore state'
    }
    $untracked = @(
      Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
        'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'
      ) 'Unable to inspect release-import untracked paths' |
        Where-Object { -not $_.StartsWith('.codex-validation/') }
    )
    if ($untracked.Count -ne 0 -or
        @(Compare-Object $releasePaths $combinedPaths).Count -ne 0) {
      throw 'Release-import candidate is not the exact ten-path delta'
    }
    if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $candidatePath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
        $candidateSha256) {
      throw 'Candidate-source identity changed during release import'
    }
    Assert-ReleaseImportSemantics
    git add -f -- $releasePaths
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release-import staging failed' }
    $stagedStatus = @(Invoke-DispatcherGitLines @(
        'diff', '--cached', '--name-status', '--no-renames'
      ) 'Unable to inspect staged release-import paths')
    $staged = @($stagedStatus | ForEach-Object {
      ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[1].Replace('\', '/')
    } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if (@($stagedStatus | Where-Object {
        ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[0] -notin @('A', 'M')
      }).Count -ne 0 -or
        @(Compare-Object $releasePaths $staged).Count -ne 0) {
      throw 'Staged release-import path set is not exact'
    }
    git diff --cached --check
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release-import whitespace check failed' }
    git diff --cached
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to inspect release-import patch' }
    Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
    $draftState = Get-ExactReleaseState
    if (-not $draftState.Release.draft) {
      throw 'Canonical release was published before the Navic import commit'
    }
    Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $draft.GateCommit @($draft.GateCommit) `
      -AllowReleaseDelta
    git diff --quiet
    $unstagedExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($unstagedExit -ne 0) {
      throw 'Unstaged changes appeared immediately before the import commit'
    }
    $boundaryStatus = @(git diff --cached --name-status --no-renames)
    $boundaryStatusExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    $boundaryPaths = @($boundaryStatus | ForEach-Object {
      ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[1].Replace('\', '/')
    } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($boundaryStatusExit -ne 0 -or
        @($boundaryStatus | Where-Object {
          ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[0] -notin @('A', 'M')
        }).Count -ne 0 -or
        @(Compare-Object $releasePaths $boundaryPaths).Count -ne 0 -or
        (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $candidatePath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
          $candidateSha256) {
      throw 'Release-import delta changed immediately before commit'
    }
    Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
    $draftState = Get-ExactReleaseState
    if (-not $draftState.Release.draft) {
      throw 'Canonical release changed immediately before the import commit'
    }
    git commit -m 'chore(reader): import PlayLikeCurl 1.2.0 API 2' `
      -m 'Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>'
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release-import commit failed' }
    $currentCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
    $currentCommitExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($currentCommitExit -ne 0) {
      throw 'Unable to resolve the release-import commit'
    }
  }
  $importCommit = $currentCommit
  Assert-ImportCommitShape $importCommit
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $importCommit @($draft.GateCommit, $importCommit)
  Assert-ReleaseImportSemantics
  $remoteOid = Get-NavicRemoteOid
  if ($remoteOid -eq $draft.GateCommit) {
    Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
    $draftState = Get-ExactReleaseState
    if (-not $draftState.Release.draft) {
      throw 'Canonical release was published before Navic remote verification'
    }
    Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $importCommit @($draft.GateCommit, $importCommit)
    git push fork HEAD:reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release-import push failed' }
    $remoteOid = Get-NavicRemoteOid
  }
  if ($remoteOid -ne $importCommit) {
    throw 'Navic release-import remote does not equal the exact import commit'
  }
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $importCommit @($importCommit)
  Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
  $remoteState = Get-ExactReleaseState
  if ($remoteState.Release.draft) {
    $immutabilityText = gh api repos/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl/immutable-releases
    $immutabilityExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    $immutability = $immutabilityText | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($immutabilityExit -ne 0 -or -not $immutability.enabled) {
      throw 'Immutable releases are not enabled immediately before publication'
    }
    $publishBodyPath = '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-publish-request.json'
    [ordered]@{ draft = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress |
      Set-Content -LiteralPath $publishBodyPath
    Assert-ReleaseImportSemantics
    Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $importCommit @($importCommit)
    Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
    $draftState = Get-ExactReleaseState
    if (-not $draftState.Release.draft) {
      throw 'Canonical release changed before the guarded publication request'
    }
    $publishedText = gh api --method PATCH `
      "repos/Darkaxt/PlayLikeCurl/releases/$($draft.ReleaseId)" `
      --input $publishBodyPath
    $publishedExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    $published = $publishedText | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($publishedExit -ne 0 -or
        [long]$published.id -ne [long]$draft.ReleaseId -or
        $published.draft) {
      throw 'Canonical release publication failed'
    }
  }
  $publishedState = $null
  for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 60; $attempt++) {
    $publishedState = Get-ExactReleaseState
    if (-not $publishedState.Release.draft -and
        $publishedState.Release.immutable) {
      break
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
  }
  if ($null -eq $publishedState -or $publishedState.Release.draft -or
      -not $publishedState.Release.immutable -or
      -not $publishedState.Release.published_at) {
    throw 'Canonical release did not become published and immutable'
  }
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $importCommit @($importCommit)
  Assert-CanonicalTagIdentity
  $publicAarPath = '.codex-validation\playlikecurl-public-release.aar'
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $publishedState.Asset.browser_download_url `
    -OutFile $publicAarPath
  if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $publicAarPath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne
        $draft.ArtifactSha256 -or
      (Get-Item -LiteralPath $publicAarPath).Length -ne
        [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes) {
    throw 'Unauthenticated public AAR differs from the draft-imported artifact'
  }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $finalPath -PathType Leaf)) {
    $final = [ordered]@{
      SchemaVersion = 1
      State = 'PublishedImmutableVerified'
      Repository = $draft.Repository
      Tag = $draft.Tag
      ApiVersion = 2
      Commit = $draft.Commit
      SourceManifestSha256 = $draft.SourceManifestSha256
      LicenseBlob = $draft.LicenseBlob
      TagObjectOid = $draft.TagObjectOid
      TagPeeledCommit = $draft.Commit
      ReleaseId = [long]$draft.ReleaseId
      AssetId = [long]$draft.AssetId
      Asset = $draft.Asset
      AssetServerDigest = $draft.AssetServerDigest
      ArtifactSha256 = $draft.ArtifactSha256
      ArtifactBytes = [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes
      GateCommit = $draft.GateCommit
      NavicImportCommit = $importCommit
      PublishedAt = [string]$publishedState.Release.published_at
      Immutable = $true
      PublicDownloadSha256 = $draft.ArtifactSha256
      PublicDownloadBytes = [long]$draft.ArtifactBytes
    }
    $finalTemporary = "$finalPath.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
    $final | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $finalTemporary
    Move-Item -LiteralPath $finalTemporary -Destination $finalPath
  }
  Assert-FinalReleaseEvidence $importCommit
  $markerTemporary = "$markerPath.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
  $importCommit | Set-Content -LiteralPath $markerTemporary
  Move-Item -LiteralPath $markerTemporary -Destination $markerPath
  $markerExists = $true
}

if (-not $postPublicationComplete) {
  $importCommit = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $markerPath -Raw).Trim()
  Assert-ImportCommitShape $importCommit
  git merge-base --is-ancestor $importCommit $currentCommit
  $ancestorExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($ancestorExit -ne 0) {
    throw 'Current Navic HEAD does not descend from the release-import anchor'
  }
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $currentCommit @($currentCommit)
  Assert-FinalReleaseEvidence $importCommit
  $staleEvidence = @(
    '.codex-validation\assert-reader-gate-identity.ps1'
    '.codex-validation\automated-gate-candidate.txt'
    '.codex-validation\automated-gate-source-commit.txt'
    '.codex-validation\automated-gate-candidate-source-sha256.txt'
    '.codex-validation\automated-gate-commit.txt'
    '.codex-validation\task14-post-publication-commit.txt'
    '.codex-validation\automated-gate-receipt.post-publication.current.txt'
    '.codex-validation\automated-gate-evidence'
    '.codex-validation\focused-reader-executed-classes.txt'
    '.codex-validation\canonical-release-executed-classes.txt'
    '.codex-validation\final-host-inventory.txt'
    '.codex-validation\final-host-failures.txt'
    '.codex-validation\final-host-task-outcome.json'
    '.\composeApp\build\test-results\testAndroidHostTest'
    '.\third_party\playlikecurl\karackencurllib\build\test-results\test'
    '.\androidApp\build\outputs\apk\readerDev\Navic.apk'
  )
  foreach ($path in $staleEvidence) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) {
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    }
  }
  Write-Host 'Immutable release and Navic import verified. Restart Task 14 at Step 1; Steps 1-5 must produce the post-publication receipt before Task 15.'
} else {
  $importCommit = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $markerPath -Raw).Trim()
  Assert-ImportCommitShape $importCommit
  Assert-NavicRepositoryIdentity $currentCommit @($currentCommit)
  $null = Assert-PostPublicationGateReceipt $currentCommit
  Assert-FinalReleaseEvidence $importCommit
  Write-Host 'Post-publication frozen gates and immutable release identity verified.'
}
```

The first pass ends after publication, final evidence sealing, marker creation, and deletion of only the listed stale gate artifacts. Restart Task 14 at Step 1 on the release-import commit. Steps 1–5 must produce a `PostPublicationImport` gate receipt bound to the final release JSON. Run Step 7 once more; it must take only the completed no-op branch. If post-publication gates expose a canonical defect, do not mutate `1.2.0`; stop release readiness and prepare a separately versioned canonical repair release.

- [ ] **Step 1: Add ReaderDev-only deterministic fault controls**

Create a queue consumed only at explicit fault seams:

```kotlin
package paige.navic.ui.screens.reader

import android.util.Log
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

enum class ReaderPageQaFault {
    FailNextPersistence,
    PauseNextPublication,
    MissNextRasterLoad,
    ForceRepairWithoutPreparedDeck,
    DeferContentNotReady,
    DeferLayoutUnstable,
    DeferPaginationNotReady,
    DeferWebViewDetached,
    DeferReaderPaused,
    DelayNextVisualStateCallback,
    DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement
}

enum class ReaderPageQaFaultState {
    Enqueued,
    Consumed,
    Applied,
    Released,
    Cleared
}

data class ReaderPageQaFaultTicket(
    val requestId: String,
    val fault: ReaderPageQaFault
)

data class ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext(
    val publicationEpoch: Long? = null,
    val persistenceAttemptId: Long? = null,
    val rasterRequestEpoch: Long? = null,
    val repairAttemptId: Long? = null,
    val preparationAttemptId: Long? = null,
    val relocationToken: String? = null,
    val handoffAttemptId: Long? = null
) {
    init {
        listOfNotNull(
            publicationEpoch,
            persistenceAttemptId,
            rasterRequestEpoch,
            repairAttemptId,
            preparationAttemptId,
            handoffAttemptId
        ).forEach { require(it >= 0L) }
        relocationToken?.let { require(it.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}"))) }
    }
}

data class ReaderPageQaAppliedFault(
    val ticket: ReaderPageQaFaultTicket,
    val context: ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext
) {
    fun correlation(
        relation: ReaderPageQaFaultRelation =
            ReaderPageQaFaultRelation.AppliedOperation
    ): ReaderPageQaFaultCorrelation = ReaderPageQaFaultCorrelation(
        requestId = ticket.requestId,
        appliedOperation = context,
        relation = relation
    )
}

enum class ReaderPageQaFaultRelation {
    AppliedOperation,
    Retry,
    Recovery
}

data class ReaderPageQaFaultCorrelation(
    val requestId: String,
    val appliedOperation: ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext,
    val relation: ReaderPageQaFaultRelation
) {
    init {
        require(requestId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")))
    }
}

data class ReaderPageQaFaultEvent(
    val ticket: ReaderPageQaFaultTicket,
    val seam: String,
    val state: ReaderPageQaFaultState,
    val operation: ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext? = null,
    val releaseRequestId: String? = null,
    val result: String
)

fun interface ReaderPageQaFaultEventSink {
    fun emit(event: ReaderPageQaFaultEvent)
}

class ReaderPageQaFaultRegistry(
    private val eventSink: ReaderPageQaFaultEventSink =
        ReaderPageQaFaultEventSink { },
    private val onOwnershipMutated: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    private companion object {
        const val CALLBACK_SLOT_LIMIT = 3
        const val QUEUED_FAULT_LIMIT = 16
    }

    private val queued = ArrayDeque<ReaderPageQaFaultTicket>()
    private var pausedPublication: CompletableDeferred<Unit>? = null
    private var pausedPublicationFault: ReaderPageQaAppliedFault? = null
    private var pausedRelocationAck:
        ((ReaderPageQaAppliedFault) -> Unit)? = null
    private var pausedRelocationFault: ReaderPageQaAppliedFault? = null

    private data class DelayedVisualState(
        val applied: ReaderPageQaAppliedFault,
        val registration: ReaderWebViewVisualDeliveryCell,
        val postPhysical: (ReaderWebViewVisualDeliveryCell) -> Unit
    )

    private var delayedVisualState: DelayedVisualState? = null
    private var closed = false

    val pendingCallbackLimit: Int
        get() = CALLBACK_SLOT_LIMIT

    val queuedFaultLimit: Int
        get() = QUEUED_FAULT_LIMIT

    @Synchronized
    fun queuedFaultCount(): Int = queued.size

    @Synchronized
    fun enqueue(requestId: String, fault: ReaderPageQaFault): Boolean {
        if (closed || queued.size == QUEUED_FAULT_LIMIT) return false
        val ticket = ReaderPageQaFaultTicket(requestId, fault)
        queued.addLast(ticket)
        emit(ticket, "queue", ReaderPageQaFaultState.Enqueued, "accepted")
        return true
    }

    fun enqueue(fault: ReaderPageQaFault): Boolean =
        enqueue("test-${fault.name}-${queuedFaultCount()}", fault)

    @Synchronized
    internal fun consumeAndApply(
        fault: ReaderPageQaFault,
        context: ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext
    ): ReaderPageQaAppliedFault? {
        if (closed) return null
        check(contextMatches(fault, context)) {
            "Fault operation context does not match $fault"
        }
        val index = queued.indexOfFirst { it.fault == fault }
        if (index < 0) return null
        val ticket = queued.removeAt(index)
        val seam = seamFor(fault)
        emit(ticket, seam, ReaderPageQaFaultState.Consumed, "matched")
        val applied = ReaderPageQaAppliedFault(ticket, context)
        emit(
            ticket = ticket,
            seam = seam,
            state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Applied,
            result = "fault-applied",
            operation = context
        )
        return applied
    }

    private fun contextMatches(
        fault: ReaderPageQaFault,
        context: ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext
    ): Boolean {
        val present = buildSet {
            if (context.publicationEpoch != null) add("publicationEpoch")
            if (context.persistenceAttemptId != null) add("persistenceAttemptId")
            if (context.rasterRequestEpoch != null) add("rasterRequestEpoch")
            if (context.repairAttemptId != null) add("repairAttemptId")
            if (context.preparationAttemptId != null) add("preparationAttemptId")
            if (context.relocationToken != null) add("relocationToken")
            if (context.handoffAttemptId != null) add("handoffAttemptId")
        }
        val expected = when (fault) {
            ReaderPageQaFault.FailNextPersistence ->
                setOf("publicationEpoch", "persistenceAttemptId")
            ReaderPageQaFault.PauseNextPublication ->
                setOf("publicationEpoch")
            ReaderPageQaFault.MissNextRasterLoad ->
                setOf("rasterRequestEpoch")
            ReaderPageQaFault.ForceRepairWithoutPreparedDeck ->
                setOf("repairAttemptId")
            ReaderPageQaFault.DeferContentNotReady,
            ReaderPageQaFault.DeferLayoutUnstable,
            ReaderPageQaFault.DeferPaginationNotReady,
            ReaderPageQaFault.DeferWebViewDetached,
            ReaderPageQaFault.DeferReaderPaused ->
                setOf("preparationAttemptId")
            ReaderPageQaFault.DelayNextVisualStateCallback ->
                setOf("relocationToken", "handoffAttemptId")
            ReaderPageQaFault.DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement ->
                setOf("relocationToken")
        }
        return present == expected
    }

    private fun seamFor(fault: ReaderPageQaFault): String = when (fault) {
        ReaderPageQaFault.FailNextPersistence -> "persistence"
        ReaderPageQaFault.PauseNextPublication -> "publication-worker"
        ReaderPageQaFault.MissNextRasterLoad -> "raster-resolver"
        ReaderPageQaFault.ForceRepairWithoutPreparedDeck -> "repair-role"
        ReaderPageQaFault.DeferContentNotReady,
        ReaderPageQaFault.DeferLayoutUnstable,
        ReaderPageQaFault.DeferPaginationNotReady,
        ReaderPageQaFault.DeferWebViewDetached,
        ReaderPageQaFault.DeferReaderPaused -> "deferred-retry"
        ReaderPageQaFault.DelayNextVisualStateCallback -> "visual-state"
        ReaderPageQaFault.DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement -> "relocation-ack"
    }

    private fun emit(
        ticket: ReaderPageQaFaultTicket,
        seam: String,
        state: ReaderPageQaFaultState,
        result: String,
        operation: ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext? = null,
        releaseRequestId: String? = null
    ) {
        eventSink.emit(
            ReaderPageQaFaultEvent(
                ticket = ticket,
                seam = seam,
                state = state,
                operation = operation,
                releaseRequestId = releaseRequestId,
                result = result
            )
        )
    }

    suspend fun pausePublicationWithinWorker(
        publicationEpoch: Long
    ): ReaderPageQaAppliedFault? {
        val owner = synchronized(this) {
            if (closed || pausedPublication != null) {
                null
            } else {
                val applied = consumeAndApply(
                    ReaderPageQaFault.PauseNextPublication,
                    ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext(
                        publicationEpoch = publicationEpoch
                    )
                )
                if (applied == null) {
                    null
                } else {
                    val created = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
                    pausedPublication = created
                    pausedPublicationFault = applied
                    applied to created
                }
            }
        } ?: return null
        onOwnershipMutated()
        val (applied, gate) = owner
        try {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                gate.await()
            }
        } finally {
            val detached = synchronized(this) {
                if (pausedPublication === gate) {
                    pausedPublication = null
                    pausedPublicationFault = null
                    true
                } else {
                    false
                }
            }
            if (detached) {
                onOwnershipMutated()
                gate.complete(Unit)
            }
        }
        return applied
    }

    fun releasePublication(releaseRequestId: String): Boolean {
        val released = synchronized(this) {
            val gate = pausedPublication ?: return@synchronized null
            val applied = checkNotNull(pausedPublicationFault)
            pausedPublication = null
            pausedPublicationFault = null
            applied to gate
        } ?: return false
        onOwnershipMutated()
        emit(
            ticket = released.first.ticket,
            seam = "publication-worker",
            state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Released,
            result = "command-release",
            operation = released.first.context,
            releaseRequestId = releaseRequestId
        )
        released.second.complete(Unit)
        return true
    }

    fun pauseRelocationAck(
        relocationToken: String,
        completion: (ReaderPageQaAppliedFault) -> Unit
    ): Boolean {
        val admitted = synchronized(this) {
            if (pausedRelocationAck != null) return@synchronized false
            val applied = consumeAndApply(
                ReaderPageQaFault.DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement,
                ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext(
                    relocationToken = relocationToken
                )
            ) ?: return@synchronized false
            pausedRelocationAck = completion
            pausedRelocationFault = applied
            true
        }
        if (admitted) onOwnershipMutated()
        return admitted
    }

    fun releaseRelocationAck(releaseRequestId: String): Boolean {
        val released = synchronized(this) {
            val callback = pausedRelocationAck ?: return@synchronized null
            val applied = checkNotNull(pausedRelocationFault)
            pausedRelocationAck = null
            pausedRelocationFault = null
            applied to callback
        } ?: return false
        onOwnershipMutated()
        emit(
            ticket = released.first.ticket,
            seam = "relocation-ack",
            state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Released,
            result = "command-release",
            operation = released.first.context,
            releaseRequestId = releaseRequestId
        )
        invokeOwnedCallback { released.second(released.first) }
        return true
    }

    internal fun delayVisualState(
        relocationToken: String,
        handoffAttemptId: Long,
        registration: ReaderWebViewVisualDeliveryCell,
        postPhysical: (ReaderWebViewVisualDeliveryCell) -> Unit
    ): ReaderPageQaAppliedFault? {
        val applied = synchronized(this) {
            if (closed || delayedVisualState != null) {
                return@synchronized null
            }
            val owner = consumeAndApply(
                ReaderPageQaFault.DelayNextVisualStateCallback,
                ReaderPageQaFaultOperationContext(
                    relocationToken = relocationToken,
                    handoffAttemptId = handoffAttemptId
                )
            ) ?: return@synchronized null
            check(registration.transferToQa()) {
                "Visual-state callback was not transferable"
            }
            delayedVisualState = DelayedVisualState(
                applied = owner,
                registration = registration,
                postPhysical = postPhysical
            )
            owner
        } ?: return null
        onOwnershipMutated()
        return applied
    }

    fun releaseVisualState(releaseRequestId: String): Boolean {
        val released = synchronized(this) {
            val owner = delayedVisualState ?: return@synchronized null
            check(owner.registration.returnFromQaToPhysical()) {
                "QA visual-state owner could not return to physical delivery"
            }
            delayedVisualState = null
            owner
        } ?: return false
        onOwnershipMutated()
        emit(
            ticket = released.applied.ticket,
            seam = "visual-state",
            state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Released,
            result = "command-release",
            operation = released.applied.context,
            releaseRequestId = releaseRequestId
        )
        try {
            released.postPhysical(released.registration)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            released.registration.abandonPhysicalOwnership()
            logIsolatedCallbackFailure()
        }
        return true
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun pendingCallbackCount(): Int =
        listOfNotNull(
            pausedPublication,
            pausedRelocationAck,
            delayedVisualState
        ).size

    private data class DrainedFaultOwners(
        val queued: List<ReaderPageQaFaultTicket>,
        val publication:
            Pair<ReaderPageQaAppliedFault, CompletableDeferred<Unit>>?,
        val callbacks: List<Pair<
            ReaderPageQaAppliedFault,
            (ReaderPageQaAppliedFault) -> Unit
        >>,
        val visualStates: List<DelayedVisualState>
    ) {
        val ownershipChanged: Boolean
            get() = publication != null ||
                callbacks.isNotEmpty() || visualStates.isNotEmpty()
    }

    fun clear(commandRequestId: String) {
        val owners = drainOwners(close = false)
        if (owners.ownershipChanged) onOwnershipMutated()
        releaseDrainedOwners(
            owners = owners,
            commandRequestId = commandRequestId,
            result = "command-clear",
            invokeRelocationCallbacks = true
        )
    }

    fun closeAndDrain() {
        val owners = drainOwners(close = true)
        if (owners.ownershipChanged) onOwnershipMutated()
        releaseDrainedOwners(
            owners = owners,
            commandRequestId = null,
            result = "host-closed-discarded",
            invokeRelocationCallbacks = false
        )
    }

    private fun drainOwners(close: Boolean): DrainedFaultOwners =
        synchronized(this) {
            if (close) closed = true
            DrainedFaultOwners(
                queued = queued.toList(),
                publication = pausedPublication?.let { gate ->
                    checkNotNull(pausedPublicationFault) to gate
                },
                callbacks = pausedRelocationAck?.let { callback ->
                    listOf(checkNotNull(pausedRelocationFault) to callback)
                }.orEmpty(),
                visualStates = listOfNotNull(delayedVisualState)
            ).also {
                queued.clear()
                pausedPublication = null
                pausedPublicationFault = null
                pausedRelocationAck = null
                pausedRelocationFault = null
                delayedVisualState = null
            }
        }

    private fun releaseDrainedOwners(
        owners: DrainedFaultOwners,
        commandRequestId: String?,
        result: String,
        invokeRelocationCallbacks: Boolean
    ) {
        owners.queued.forEach { ticket ->
            emit(
                ticket = ticket,
                seam = "queue",
                state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Cleared,
                result = result,
                releaseRequestId = commandRequestId
            )
        }
        owners.publication?.let { (applied, gate) ->
            emit(
                ticket = applied.ticket,
                seam = "publication-worker",
                state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Cleared,
                result = result,
                operation = applied.context,
                releaseRequestId = commandRequestId
            )
            gate.complete(Unit)
        }
        owners.callbacks.forEach { (applied, callback) ->
            emit(
                ticket = applied.ticket,
                seam = "relocation-ack",
                state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Cleared,
                result = result,
                operation = applied.context,
                releaseRequestId = commandRequestId
            )
            if (invokeRelocationCallbacks) {
                invokeOwnedCallback { callback(applied) }
            }
        }
        owners.visualStates.forEach { owner ->
            emit(
                ticket = owner.applied.ticket,
                seam = "visual-state",
                state = ReaderPageQaFaultState.Cleared,
                result = result,
                operation = owner.applied.context,
                releaseRequestId = commandRequestId
            )
            owner.registration.abandonPhysicalOwnership()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun isClosed(): Boolean = closed

    private fun invokeOwnedCallback(callback: () -> Unit) {
        try {
            callback()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            logIsolatedCallbackFailure()
        }
    }

    private fun logIsolatedCallbackFailure() {
        try {
            Log.e(
                "ReaderPageQaFault",
                "isolatedCallbackFailure=true"
            )
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            // Host tests and shutdown must not depend on android.util.Log.
        }
    }
}

object ReaderPageQaFaultControl {
    class Registration internal constructor(
        internal val id: Long,
        internal val registry: ReaderPageQaFaultRegistry
    )

    private var nextRegistrationId = 1L
    private var active: Registration? = null

    @Synchronized
    fun attach(
        registry: ReaderPageQaFaultRegistry
    ): Registration {
        check(!registry.isClosed()) { "Cannot attach a closed fault registry" }
        return Registration(nextRegistrationId++, registry).also { created ->
            active = created
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun detach(registration: Registration) {
        if (active === registration) active = null
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun activeRegistry(): ReaderPageQaFaultRegistry? =
        active?.registry

    fun enqueue(requestId: String, fault: ReaderPageQaFault): Boolean =
        activeRegistry()?.enqueue(requestId, fault) == true

    fun releasePublication(requestId: String): Boolean =
        activeRegistry()?.releasePublication(requestId) == true

    fun releaseRelocationAck(requestId: String): Boolean =
        activeRegistry()?.releaseRelocationAck(requestId) == true

    fun releaseVisualState(requestId: String): Boolean =
        activeRegistry()?.releaseVisualState(requestId) == true

    fun clear(requestId: String): Boolean {
        val registry = activeRegistry() ?: return false
        registry.clear(requestId)
        return true
    }
}
```

Decode the exported broadcast through a platform-free, privacy-safe command value before touching global control state:

```kotlin
sealed interface ReaderPageQaFaultCommand {
    val requestId: String

    data class Enqueue(
        override val requestId: String,
        val fault: ReaderPageQaFault
    ) : ReaderPageQaFaultCommand

    data class ReleasePublication(override val requestId: String) :
        ReaderPageQaFaultCommand
    data class ReleaseRelocation(override val requestId: String) :
        ReaderPageQaFaultCommand
    data class ReleaseVisualState(override val requestId: String) :
        ReaderPageQaFaultCommand
    data class Clear(override val requestId: String) : ReaderPageQaFaultCommand
    data class Rejected(
        override val requestId: String,
        val reason: Rejection
    ) : ReaderPageQaFaultCommand

    enum class Rejection {
        InvalidAction,
        InvalidRequestId,
        InvalidCommand,
        InvalidFault
    }
}

object ReaderPageQaFaultCommandDecoder {
    const val Action = "darkaxt.navic.readerdev.READER_QA_FAULT"

    private val safeRequestId = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")

    fun acceptsAction(action: String?): Boolean = action == Action

    fun decode(
        requestId: String?,
        command: String?,
        faultName: String?
    ): ReaderPageQaFaultCommand {
        val safeId = requestId?.takeIf(safeRequestId::matches)
            ?: return ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejected(
                "invalid",
                ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejection.InvalidRequestId
            )
        return when (command) {
            "enqueue" -> ReaderPageQaFault.values()
                .firstOrNull { it.name == faultName }
                ?.let { ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Enqueue(safeId, it) }
                ?: ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejected(
                    safeId,
                    ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejection.InvalidFault
                )
            "release-publication" ->
                ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.ReleasePublication(safeId)
            "release-relocation" ->
                ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.ReleaseRelocation(safeId)
            "release-visual-state" ->
                ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.ReleaseVisualState(safeId)
            "clear" -> ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Clear(safeId)
            else -> ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejected(
                safeId,
                ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejection.InvalidCommand
            )
        }
    }
}
```

`ReaderPageQaFaultCommandTest` exhaustively covers every valid command, missing/unsafe request IDs, missing/unknown commands, and missing/unknown faults. It asserts rejected values contain only the closed reason enum and safe/`invalid` request ID, never the raw command/fault sentinel. The registry test fills all 16 queue slots and proves the seventeenth known enqueue returns `false` without mutation.

The `readerDev`-only exported receiver accepts explicit ADB commands `enqueue`, `release-publication`, `release-relocation`, `release-visual-state`, and `clear`. It rejects a wrong or missing intent action before reading extras, and `android.permission.DUMP` restricts explicit delivery to adb shell/system-signature holders rather than ordinary installed applications:

```kotlin
package paige.navic.androidApp

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.util.Log
import paige.navic.ui.screens.reader.ReaderPageQaFaultCommand
import paige.navic.ui.screens.reader.ReaderPageQaFaultCommandDecoder
import paige.navic.ui.screens.reader.ReaderPageQaFaultControl

class ReaderPageQaFaultReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    private companion object {
        const val Tag = "ReaderPageQaFault"
    }

    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        if (!ReaderPageQaFaultCommandDecoder.acceptsAction(intent.action)) {
            Log.i(
                Tag,
                "requestId=invalid accepted=false reason=" +
                    ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejection.InvalidAction.name
            )
            return
        }
        when (val decoded = ReaderPageQaFaultCommandDecoder.decode(
            requestId = intent.getStringExtra("requestId"),
            command = intent.getStringExtra("command"),
            faultName = intent.getStringExtra("fault")
        )) {
            is ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Enqueue -> {
                val accepted = ReaderPageQaFaultControl.enqueue(
                    decoded.requestId,
                    decoded.fault
                )
                Log.i(
                    Tag,
                    "requestId=${decoded.requestId} fault=${decoded.fault} " +
                        "accepted=$accepted"
                )
            }
            is ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.ReleasePublication -> Log.i(
                Tag,
                "requestId=${decoded.requestId} releasePublication=" +
                    ReaderPageQaFaultControl.releasePublication(decoded.requestId)
            )
            is ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.ReleaseRelocation -> Log.i(
                Tag,
                "requestId=${decoded.requestId} releaseRelocation=" +
                    ReaderPageQaFaultControl.releaseRelocationAck(decoded.requestId)
            )
            is ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.ReleaseVisualState -> Log.i(
                Tag,
                "requestId=${decoded.requestId} releaseVisualState=" +
                    ReaderPageQaFaultControl.releaseVisualState(decoded.requestId)
            )
            is ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Clear -> Log.i(
                Tag,
                "requestId=${decoded.requestId} cleared=" +
                    ReaderPageQaFaultControl.clear(decoded.requestId)
            )
            is ReaderPageQaFaultCommand.Rejected -> Log.i(
                Tag,
                "requestId=${decoded.requestId} accepted=false reason=" +
                    decoded.reason.name
            )
        }
    }
}
```

Create a neutral Gradle init task for manifest-only validation:

```groovy
gradle.beforeProject { project ->
    if (project == project.rootProject) {
        project.tasks.register("readerQaProcessVariantManifests") {
            dependsOn(
                ":androidApp:processReaderDevMainManifest",
                ":androidApp:processDebugMainManifest",
                ":androidApp:processReleaseMainManifest"
            )
        }
