### Task 16: Execute ReaderDev emulator and physical-device acceptance matrix

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/reader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1`
- Modify (prerequisite runner contract in Task 15): `scripts/adb-reader-playlikecurl-qa.ps1`
- Create: `docs/superpowers/reports/2026-07-18-reader-playlikecurl-qa-remediation-validation.md`
- Verify locally: `.codex-validation/task15-automated-gate-receipt.current.txt`
- Consume locally: one commit-keyed `.codex-validation/task15-automated-gate-evidence.<commit>/` bundle
- Create locally: `.codex-validation/reader-acceptance-root.txt`
- Capture locally: one resumable `.codex-validation/reader-acceptance-<acceptance-id>/` evidence tree

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the resumable acceptance-state helper, consume the Task 15 bundle, and preflight both device classes**

Create `scripts/reader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1` exactly as follows. It is both a dot-sourced library and the externally invocable invalidation command. Every entry point refuses Windows PowerShell and PowerShell Core older than 7.3.

```powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Library', 'Invalidate')]
    [string] $Operation = 'Library',
    [string] $Reason = ''
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

function Assert-ReaderPwshCore {
    if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core' -or
        $PSVersionTable.PSVersion -lt [version]'7.3') {
        throw 'Reader acceptance requires PowerShell Core 7.3 or newer; invoke it with pwsh.'
    }
}
Assert-ReaderPwshCore

$script:ReaderValidationRoot = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.codex-validation'
$script:ReaderAcceptancePointer = Join-Path `
    $script:ReaderValidationRoot 'reader-acceptance-root.txt'
$script:ReaderAcceptanceLockPath = Join-Path `
    $script:ReaderValidationRoot 'reader-acceptance.lock'
$script:ReaderTask15Pointer = Join-Path `
    $script:ReaderValidationRoot 'task15-automated-gate-receipt.current.txt'
$script:ReaderPackage = 'darkaxt.navic.readerdev'
$script:ReaderPhases = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Index = 1; Name = 'install'
        ArtifactPrefixes = @('installed-package-')
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Index = 2; Name = 'automated-matrix'
        ArtifactPrefixes = @(
            'smoke-', 'komikku-', 'automated-matrix-manifest.json'
        )
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Index = 3; Name = 'viewport'
        ArtifactPrefixes = @('viewport-')
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Index = 4; Name = 'manual'
        ArtifactPrefixes = @(
            'manual-', 'fault-command-manifest.json',
            'fault-evidence-manifest.json'
        )
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Index = 5; Name = 'stress'
        ArtifactPrefixes = @('stress-')
    }
)

function Enter-ReaderAcceptanceLock {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:ReaderValidationRoot -Force |
        Out-Null
    try {
        return [IO.File]::Open(
            $script:ReaderAcceptanceLockPath,
            [IO.FileMode]::OpenOrCreate,
            [IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,
            [IO.FileShare]::None
        )
    } catch {
        throw 'Another acceptance state transition or final seal owns the exclusive lock.'
    }
}

function Write-ReaderAtomicText {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][AllowEmptyString()][string] $Text,
        [switch] $NoReplace
    )
    $fullPath = $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.
        GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($Path)
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $fullPath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container)) {
        throw "Atomic-write parent is absent: $parent"
    }
    $temporary = Join-Path $parent (
        ".$([IO.Path]::GetFileName($fullPath)).$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
    )
    try {
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText(
            $temporary,
            $Text,
            [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
        )
        if ($NoReplace) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fullPath) {
                throw "Immutable publication already exists: $fullPath"
            }
            [IO.File]::Move($temporary, $fullPath)
        } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fullPath -PathType Leaf) {
            $backup = "$fullPath.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).backup"
            [IO.File]::Replace($temporary, $fullPath, $backup, $true)
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $backup -Force
        } else {
            [IO.File]::Move($temporary, $fullPath)
        }
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

function Write-ReaderAtomicJson {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Value,
        [int] $Depth = 10,
        [switch] $NoReplace
    )
    $json = $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth $Depth
    Write-ReaderAtomicText -Path $Path -Text ($json + [Environment]::NewLine) `
        -NoReplace:$NoReplace
}

function Get-ReaderHash {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Required evidence file is absent: $Path"
    }
    return (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $Path).Hash
}

function Assert-ReaderPathUnderValidation {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Path)
    $validation = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $script:ReaderValidationRoot).Path.
        TrimEnd('\')
    $resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).Path.TrimEnd('\')
    if (-not $resolved.StartsWith(
        "$validation\",
        [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
    )) {
        throw "Acceptance path escapes .codex-validation: $resolved"
    }
    return $resolved
}

function Assert-ReaderXmlBundle {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $EvidenceRoot,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Label,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $ExpectedManifestSha256
    )
    $xmlRoot = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot "$Label-xml"
    $manifestPath = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot "$Label-xml-sha256.txt"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $xmlRoot -PathType Container)) {
        throw "Task 15 $Label XML tree is absent"
    }
    $resolvedRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $xmlRoot).Path
    $actual = @(
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $xmlRoot -Recurse -File |
            ForEach-Object {
                $relative = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath(
                    $resolvedRoot,
                    $_.FullName
                ).Replace('\', '/')
                "$relative`t$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash.ToLowerInvariant())"
            } | Sort-Object
    )
    $recorded = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath)
    if ($actual.Count -eq 0 -or
        @(Compare-Object $recorded $actual).Count -ne 0 -or
        (Get-ReaderHash $manifestPath) -cne $ExpectedManifestSha256) {
        throw "Task 15 $Label XML tree differs from its sealed manifest"
    }
}

function Get-ReaderTask15Bundle {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:ReaderTask15Pointer -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw 'Task 15 schema-2 current receipt pointer is absent.'
    }
    $gateCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $gateCommit -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') {
        throw 'Unable to resolve the Task 16 implementation commit.'
    }
    $receiptText = (
        Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:ReaderTask15Pointer -Raw
    ).Trim()
    $expectedReceiptText =
        ".codex-validation\task15-automated-gate-evidence.$gateCommit\receipt.json"
    if ($receiptText -cne $expectedReceiptText) {
        throw 'Task 15 current pointer is stale, malformed, or not commit-keyed to HEAD.'
    }
    $receiptPath = Join-Path (Get-Location) $receiptText
    $evidenceRoot = Split-Path -Parent $receiptPath
    [void](Assert-ReaderPathUnderValidation $receiptPath)
    $receipt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $receiptPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $receiptFields = @(
        'Acceptance', 'ApkBytes', 'ApkEvidenceSha256', 'ApkSha256',
        'CanonicalClassesSha256', 'CanonicalXmlManifestSha256',
        'EvidenceRoot', 'FinalReleaseSha256', 'FocusedClassesSha256',
        'FocusedXmlManifestSha256', 'FullHostFailureKind',
        'FullHostFailuresSha256', 'FullHostInventorySha256',
        'FullHostOutcomeSha256', 'FullHostXmlManifestSha256',
        'NavicCommit', 'OutputMetadataSha256', 'Phase', 'SchemaVersion',
        'Task14PostPublicationCommit', 'Task14PostPublicationReceiptPath',
        'Task14PostPublicationReceiptSha256'
    ) | Sort-Object
    if (@(Compare-Object $receiptFields @(
            $receipt.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object
        )).Count -ne 0 -or
        $receipt.SchemaVersion -ne 2 -or
        $receipt.Phase -cne 'Task15ScriptBearing' -or
        $receipt.Acceptance -cne 'Passed' -or
        $receipt.NavicCommit -cne $gateCommit -or
        $receipt.EvidenceRoot -cne (
            ".codex-validation\task15-automated-gate-evidence.$gateCommit"
        )) {
        throw 'Task 15 schema-2 commit-keyed receipt is malformed.'
    }
    $hashInputs = [ordered]@{
        FocusedXmlManifestSha256 = 'focused-xml-sha256.txt'
        FocusedClassesSha256 = 'script-bearing-focused-reader-executed-classes.txt'
        CanonicalXmlManifestSha256 = 'canonical-xml-sha256.txt'
        CanonicalClassesSha256 = 'canonical-release-executed-classes.txt'
        FullHostXmlManifestSha256 = 'full-host-xml-sha256.txt'
        FullHostInventorySha256 = 'final-host-inventory.txt'
        FullHostFailuresSha256 = 'final-host-failures.txt'
        FullHostOutcomeSha256 = 'final-host-task-outcome.json'
        ApkEvidenceSha256 = 'readerdev-apk.json'
        OutputMetadataSha256 = 'readerdev-output-metadata.json'
    }
    foreach ($entry in $hashInputs.GetEnumerator()) {
        $path = Join-Path $evidenceRoot $entry.Value
        if ((Get-ReaderHash $path) -cne [string]$receipt.($entry.Key)) {
            throw "Task 15 bundle member differs from its receipt: $($entry.Value)"
        }
    }
    Assert-ReaderXmlBundle $evidenceRoot 'focused' `
        ([string]$receipt.FocusedXmlManifestSha256)
    Assert-ReaderXmlBundle $evidenceRoot 'canonical' `
        ([string]$receipt.CanonicalXmlManifestSha256)
    Assert-ReaderXmlBundle $evidenceRoot 'full-host' `
        ([string]$receipt.FullHostXmlManifestSha256)

    $apkEvidencePath = Join-Path $evidenceRoot 'readerdev-apk.json'
    $apkPath = Join-Path $evidenceRoot 'readerdev.apk'
    $outputMetadataPath = Join-Path $evidenceRoot 'readerdev-output-metadata.json'
    $apkEvidence = Get-Content -LiteralPath $apkEvidencePath -Raw |
        ConvertFrom-Json
    $apkEvidenceFields = @(
        'ApkBytes', 'ApkRelativePath', 'ApkSha256', 'ApplicationId',
        'BuildCompletedUtc', 'BuildStartedUtc', 'BuildTask',
        'CanonicalClassesSha256', 'CanonicalXmlManifestSha256',
        'FinalReleaseSha256', 'FocusedClassesSha256',
        'FocusedXmlManifestSha256', 'FullHostFailuresSha256',
        'FullHostInventorySha256', 'FullHostOutcomeSha256',
        'FullHostXmlManifestSha256', 'GitCommit', 'OutputMetadataSha256',
        'SchemaVersion', 'Task14PostPublicationCommit',
        'Task14PostPublicationReceiptPath',
        'Task14PostPublicationReceiptSha256', 'Variant', 'VersionCode',
        'VersionName'
    ) | Sort-Object
    if (@(Compare-Object $apkEvidenceFields @(
            $apkEvidence.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object
        )).Count -ne 0 -or
        $apkEvidence.SchemaVersion -ne 2 -or
        $apkEvidence.GitCommit -cne $gateCommit -or
        $apkEvidence.BuildTask -cne ':androidApp:assembleReaderDev' -or
        $apkEvidence.Variant -cne 'readerDev' -or
        $apkEvidence.ApplicationId -cne $script:ReaderPackage -or
        $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -cne $receipt.ApkSha256 -or
        [long]$apkEvidence.ApkBytes -ne [long]$receipt.ApkBytes -or
        $apkEvidence.OutputMetadataSha256 -cne $receipt.OutputMetadataSha256 -or
        (Get-ReaderHash $apkPath) -cne $receipt.ApkSha256 -or
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $apkPath).Length -ne [long]$receipt.ApkBytes -or
        (Get-ReaderHash $outputMetadataPath) -cne
            $receipt.OutputMetadataSha256) {
        throw 'Task 15 sealed ReaderDev APK identity or metadata is invalid.'
    }
    foreach ($name in @(
        'Task14PostPublicationCommit',
        'Task14PostPublicationReceiptPath',
        'Task14PostPublicationReceiptSha256', 'FinalReleaseSha256',
        'FocusedXmlManifestSha256', 'FocusedClassesSha256',
        'CanonicalXmlManifestSha256', 'CanonicalClassesSha256',
        'FullHostXmlManifestSha256', 'FullHostInventorySha256',
        'FullHostFailuresSha256', 'FullHostOutcomeSha256'
    )) {
        if ([string]$apkEvidence.($name) -cne [string]$receipt.($name)) {
            throw "Task 15 APK evidence differs from receipt field $name"
        }
    }

    $task14ReceiptPath = Join-Path (Get-Location) `
        ([string]$receipt.Task14PostPublicationReceiptPath)
    $finalReleasePath = Join-Path $script:ReaderValidationRoot `
        'playlikecurl-release.json'
    if ((Get-ReaderHash $task14ReceiptPath) -cne
            [string]$receipt.Task14PostPublicationReceiptSha256 -or
        (Get-ReaderHash $finalReleasePath) -cne
            [string]$receipt.FinalReleaseSha256) {
        throw 'Task 15 upstream authorization differs from its sealed receipt.'
    }
    $task14Receipt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $task14ReceiptPath -Raw |
        ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($task14Receipt.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or
        $task14Receipt.Phase -cne 'PostPublicationImport' -or
        $task14Receipt.FullHostAcceptance -cne 'Passed' -or
        $task14Receipt.NavicCommit -cne
            [string]$receipt.Task14PostPublicationCommit) {
        throw 'Task 14 post-publication authorization is malformed.'
    }
    git merge-base --is-ancestor $task14Receipt.NavicCommit $gateCommit
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw 'Task 15 commit does not descend from its Task 14 authorization.'
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        GateCommit = $gateCommit
        Receipt = $receipt
        ReceiptPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $receiptPath).Path
        ReceiptRelativePath = $receiptText.Replace('\', '/')
        ReceiptSha256 = Get-ReaderHash $receiptPath
        EvidenceRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $evidenceRoot).Path
        ApkEvidence = $apkEvidence
        ApkEvidencePath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $apkEvidencePath).Path
        ApkEvidenceSha256 = Get-ReaderHash $apkEvidencePath
        ApkPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $apkPath).Path
        OutputMetadataPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $outputMetadataPath).Path
    }
}

function Assert-ReaderSealedApk {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Context)
    if ((Get-ReaderHash $Context.ApkPath) -cne
            [string]$Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $Context.ApkPath).Length -ne
            [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.ApkBytes) {
        throw 'The commit-keyed Task 15 sealed APK changed.'
    }
}

function Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput {
    param(
        [AllowEmptyString()][string] $Serial,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]] $Arguments,
        [switch] $AllowFailure
    )
    $adbArguments = @()
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Serial)) {
        $adbArguments += @('-s', $Serial)
    }
    $adbArguments += $Arguments
    $oldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference
    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $output = @(& adb @adbArguments 2>&1)
        $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $oldPreference
    }
    if ($exitCode -ne 0 -and -not $AllowFailure) {
        throw "adb $($adbArguments -join ' ') failed (exit=$exitCode)"
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $exitCode
        Lines = @($output | ForEach-Object { "$_" })
    }
}

function Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets {
    $devices = Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput -Serial '' -Arguments @('devices')
    $serials = @(
        $devices.Lines | Where-Object {
            $_ -match '^(?<Serial>\S+)\s+device$'
        } | ForEach-Object { $Matches['Serial'] } | Sort-Object -Unique
    )
    if ($serials.Count -eq 0) {
        throw 'No online Android device is attached.'
    }
    $targets = @(
        foreach ($serial in $serials) {
            $property = @{}
            foreach ($name in @(
                'ro.kernel.qemu', 'ro.product.manufacturer',
                'ro.product.model', 'ro.build.version.sdk'
            )) {
                $value = Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput $serial @(
                    'shell', 'getprop', $name
                )
                $property[$name] = ($value.Lines | Out-String).Trim()
            }
            [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
                Serial = $serial
                SafeSerial = ($serial -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_')
                Class = if ($property['ro.kernel.qemu'] -eq '1') {
                    'emulator'
                } else {
                    'physical'
                }
                Manufacturer = $property['ro.product.manufacturer']
                Model = $property['ro.product.model']
                Api = $property['ro.build.version.sdk']
            }
        }
    )
    if (@($targets | Group-Object SafeSerial | Where-Object Count -ne 1).Count) {
        throw 'Sanitized device serials are not unique.'
    }
    if (-not ($targets | Where-Object Class -eq 'emulator')) {
        throw 'Acceptance preflight requires an online emulator.'
    }
    if (-not ($targets | Where-Object Class -eq 'physical')) {
        throw 'Acceptance preflight requires an online physical device.'
    }
    return @($targets)
}

function Get-ReaderInstalledPackageIdentity {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Context,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Device,
        [switch] $AllowAbsent,
        [switch] $RequireExact
    )
    Assert-ReaderSealedApk $Context
    $pathResult = Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput $Device.Serial @(
        'shell', 'pm', 'path', $script:ReaderPackage
    ) -AllowFailure
    $packagePaths = @(
        $pathResult.Lines | Where-Object {
            $_ -match '^package:(?<Path>.+)$'
        } | ForEach-Object { $Matches['Path'].Trim() }
    )
    if ($pathResult.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $packagePaths.Count -eq 0) {
        if (-not $AllowAbsent) {
            throw "ReaderDev is not installed on $($Device.Serial)."
        }
        return [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
            DeviceSerial = $Device.Serial; DeviceClass = $Device.Class
            Present = $false; RemoteBaseApk = $null; ApkSha256 = $null
            ApkBytes = $null; VersionCode = $null; VersionName = $null
            CapturedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
        }
    }
    if ($packagePaths.Count -ne 1) {
        throw "Expected one installed ReaderDev base APK on $($Device.Serial)."
    }
    $temporary = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) (
        "navic-readerdev-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).apk"
    )
    try {
        $pull = Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput $Device.Serial @(
            'pull', $packagePaths[0], $temporary
        )
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporary -PathType Leaf)) {
            throw "Installed APK pull emitted no file on $($Device.Serial)."
        }
        $sha256 = Get-ReaderHash $temporary
        $bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temporary).Length
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    $dump = Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput $Device.Serial @(
        'shell', 'dumpsys', 'package', $script:ReaderPackage
    )
    $dumpText = $dump.Lines | Out-String
    $code = [regex]::Match($dumpText, 'versionCode=(?<Value>\d+)')
    $name = [regex]::Match(
        $dumpText,
        '(?m)^\s*versionName=(?<Value>[^\r\n]*)$'
    )
    if (-not $code.Success -or -not $name.Success) {
        throw "Installed package version is unparseable on $($Device.Serial)."
    }
    $identity = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
        DeviceSerial = $Device.Serial
        DeviceClass = $Device.Class
        Present = $true
        RemoteBaseApk = $packagePaths[0]
        ApkSha256 = $sha256
        ApkBytes = [long]$bytes
        VersionCode = [long]$code.Groups['Value'].Value
        VersionName = $name.Groups['Value'].Value.Trim()
        CapturedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    }
    if ($RequireExact -and
        ($identity.ApkSha256 -cne $Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
         $identity.ApkBytes -ne [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.ApkBytes -or
         $identity.VersionCode -ne [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.VersionCode -or
         $identity.VersionName -cne [string]$Context.ApkEvidence.VersionName)) {
        throw "Installed ReaderDev hash, bytes, or version differs on $($Device.Serial)."
    }
    return $identity
}

function Get-ReaderInstalledPackageSet {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Context,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $Targets,
        [switch] $AllowAbsent,
        [switch] $RequireExact
    )
    return @(
        foreach ($device in $Targets) {
            Get-ReaderInstalledPackageIdentity $Context $device `
                -AllowAbsent:$AllowAbsent -RequireExact:$RequireExact
        }
    )
}

function Assert-ReaderRecordedPackageSet {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Context,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $Targets,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $Records,
        [switch] $AllowAbsent,
        [switch] $RequireExact
    )
    if ($Records.Count -ne $Targets.Count -or
        @($Records | Group-Object DeviceSerial |
            Where-Object Count -ne 1).Count -ne 0) {
        throw 'Recorded installed-package set is incomplete or duplicated.'
    }
    foreach ($device in $Targets) {
        $record = @($Records | Where-Object DeviceSerial -ceq $device.Serial)
        if ($record.Count -ne 1 -or $record[0].DeviceClass -cne $device.Class) {
            throw "Recorded installed-package target is invalid: $($device.Serial)"
        }
        if (-not [bool]$record[0].Present) {
            if (-not $AllowAbsent) {
                throw "Recorded installed package is absent: $($device.Serial)"
            }
            continue
        }
        if ($record[0].ApkSha256 -notmatch '^[0-9A-F]{64}$' -or
            [long]$record[0].ApkBytes -le 0 -or
            [long]$record[0].VersionCode -le 0 -or
            $null -eq $record[0].VersionName) {
            throw "Recorded installed package lacks hash/bytes/version: $($device.Serial)"
        }
        if ($RequireExact -and
            ($record[0].ApkSha256 -cne $Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
             [long]$record[0].ApkBytes -ne [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.ApkBytes -or
             [long]$record[0].VersionCode -ne [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.VersionCode -or
             $record[0].VersionName -cne [string]$Context.ApkEvidence.VersionName)) {
            throw "Recorded installed package differs from the sealed APK: $($device.Serial)"
        }
    }
}

function Get-ReaderPhaseDefinition {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Name)
    $match = @($script:ReaderPhases | Where-Object Name -eq $Name)
    if ($match.Count -ne 1) { throw "Unknown acceptance phase: $Name" }
    return $match[0]
}

function Test-ReaderPhaseOwnsPath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Phase,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $RelativePath
    )
    foreach ($prefix in @($Phase.ArtifactPrefixes)) {
        if ($RelativePath.StartsWith(
            [string]$prefix,
            [StringComparison]::Ordinal
        )) { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

function Get-ReaderRootInventory {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Root,
        [string[]] $Exclude = @()
    )
    $resolvedRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Root).Path.TrimEnd('\')
    return @(
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $resolvedRoot -Recurse -File |
            ForEach-Object {
                $relative = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath(
                    $resolvedRoot,
                    $_.FullName
                ).Replace('\', '/')
                if ($relative -notin $Exclude) {
                    [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
                        Path = $relative
                        Sha256 = Get-ReaderHash $_.FullName
                        Bytes = [long]$_.Length
                    }
                }
            } | Sort-Object Path
    )
}

function Get-ReaderPhaseInventory {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Root,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Phase
    )
    return @(
        Get-ReaderRootInventory $Root | Where-Object {
            Test-ReaderPhaseOwnsPath $Phase $_.Path
        }
    )
}

function Get-ReaderPhaseEntryCount {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Root,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Phase
    )
    return @(
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Force | Where-Object {
            Test-ReaderPhaseOwnsPath $Phase $_.Name
        }
    ).Count
}

function Assert-ReaderRootPathOwnership {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Root)
    $baseNames = @(
        'run-start.json', 'device-targets.json', 'phase-plan.json',
        'run-complete.json', 'run-complete.sha256.txt', '.phase-state'
    )
    foreach ($item in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Force) {
        if ($item.Name -in $baseNames) { continue }
        $owners = @($script:ReaderPhases | Where-Object {
            Test-ReaderPhaseOwnsPath $_ $item.Name
        })
        if ($owners.Count -ne 1) {
            throw "Acceptance root path has no unique phase owner: $($item.Name)"
        }
    }
    $stateRoot = Join-Path $Root '.phase-state'
    $allowedStateNames = @(
        foreach ($phase in $script:ReaderPhases) {
            $paths = Get-ReaderPhasePaths $Root $phase
            Split-Path -Leaf $paths.Start
            Split-Path -Leaf $paths.Complete
        }
    )
    $unexpectedState = @(
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $stateRoot -Force | Where-Object {
            $_.PSIsContainer -or $_.Name -notin $allowedStateNames
        }
    )
    if ($unexpectedState.Count -ne 0) {
        throw "Acceptance phase-state path is not declared: $($unexpectedState[0].Name)"
    }
}

function Assert-ReaderInventoryEqual {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $Expected,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $Actual,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Context
    )
    if (@($Expected | Group-Object Path | Where-Object Count -ne 1).Count -ne 0 -or
        $Expected.Count -ne $Actual.Count) {
        throw "$Context artifact inventory count or uniqueness changed."
    }
    foreach ($actualFile in $Actual) {
        $expectedFile = @($Expected | Where-Object Path -ceq $actualFile.Path)
        if ($expectedFile.Count -ne 1 -or
            $expectedFile[0].Sha256 -cne $actualFile.Sha256 -or
            [long]$expectedFile[0].Bytes -ne [long]$actualFile.Bytes) {
            throw "$Context artifact changed: $($actualFile.Path)"
        }
    }
}

function Get-ReaderPhasePaths {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Root,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Phase
    )
    $stateRoot = Join-Path $Root '.phase-state'
    $stem = '{0:D2}-{1}' -f [int]$Phase.Index, [string]$Phase.Name
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Start = Join-Path $stateRoot "$stem-start.json"
        Complete = Join-Path $stateRoot "$stem-complete.json"
    }
}

function Assert-ReaderPhaseManifest {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Session,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Phase
    )
    $paths = Get-ReaderPhasePaths $Session.Root $Phase
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Start -PathType Leaf) -or
        -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Complete -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Completed phase lacks start/completion state: $($Phase.Name)"
    }
    $start = Get-Content -LiteralPath $paths.Start -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $complete = Get-Content -LiteralPath $paths.Complete -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($start.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or $start.Status -cne 'started' -or
        $start.AcceptanceId -cne $Session.RunStart.AcceptanceId -or
        $start.GitCommit -cne $Session.Context.GateCommit -or
        $start.ApkSha256 -cne $Session.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
        $start.PhaseIndex -ne $Phase.Index -or
        $start.PhaseName -cne $Phase.Name -or
        $complete.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or
        $complete.Status -cne 'complete' -or
        $complete.AcceptanceId -cne $Session.RunStart.AcceptanceId -or
        $complete.GitCommit -cne $Session.Context.GateCommit -or
        $complete.ApkSha256 -cne $Session.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
        $complete.PhaseIndex -ne $Phase.Index -or
        $complete.PhaseName -cne $Phase.Name -or
        $complete.StartManifestSha256 -cne (Get-ReaderHash $paths.Start)) {
        throw "Acceptance phase binding is invalid: $($Phase.Name)"
    }
    Assert-ReaderRecordedPackageSet `
        $Session.Context $Session.Targets @($start.InstalledPackagesBefore) `
        -AllowAbsent:($Phase.Name -eq 'install') `
        -RequireExact:($Phase.Name -ne 'install')
    Assert-ReaderRecordedPackageSet `
        $Session.Context $Session.Targets @($complete.InstalledPackagesAfter) `
        -RequireExact
    $actual = @(Get-ReaderPhaseInventory $Session.Root $Phase)
    if ($actual.Count -eq 0) {
        throw "Completed acceptance phase has no artifacts: $($Phase.Name)"
    }
    Assert-ReaderInventoryEqual @($complete.Artifacts) $actual `
        "acceptance phase $($Phase.Name)"
}

function Get-ReaderPhaseState {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Session)
    Assert-ReaderRootPathOwnership $Session.Root
    $firstPending = $null
    foreach ($phase in $script:ReaderPhases) {
        $paths = Get-ReaderPhasePaths $Session.Root $phase
        $hasStart = Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Start -PathType Leaf
        $hasComplete = Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Complete -PathType Leaf
        $ownedEntryCount = Get-ReaderPhaseEntryCount $Session.Root $phase
        if ($null -eq $firstPending -and $hasStart -and $hasComplete) {
            Assert-ReaderPhaseManifest $Session $phase
            continue
        }
        if ($null -eq $firstPending) { $firstPending = $phase }
        if ($hasStart -or $hasComplete -or $ownedEntryCount -ne 0) {
            throw "Acceptance evidence is not an exact completed-phase prefix at $($phase.Name). Preserve the root and invoke external invalidation."
        }
    }
    return $firstPending
}

function Assert-ReaderAcceptanceRoot {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Context,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Root,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $PreflightTargets
    )
    $resolvedRoot = Assert-ReaderPathUnderValidation $Root
    $startPath = Join-Path $resolvedRoot 'run-start.json'
    $targetPath = Join-Path $resolvedRoot 'device-targets.json'
    $planPath = Join-Path $resolvedRoot 'phase-plan.json'
    foreach ($path in @($startPath, $targetPath, $planPath)) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) {
            throw "Acceptance root state is absent: $path"
        }
    }
    $runStart = Get-Content -LiteralPath $startPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $targets = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $targetPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    $plan = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $planPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    if ($runStart.SchemaVersion -ne 2 -or $runStart.Status -cne 'started' -or
        $runStart.AcceptanceId -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' -or
        $runStart.GitCommit -cne $Context.GateCommit -or
        $runStart.ApkSha256 -cne $Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
        [long]$runStart.ApkBytes -ne [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.ApkBytes -or
        $runStart.Task15ReceiptRelativePath -cne
            $Context.ReceiptRelativePath -or
        $runStart.Task15ReceiptSha256 -cne $Context.ReceiptSha256 -or
        $runStart.Task15ApkEvidenceSha256 -cne
            $Context.ApkEvidenceSha256 -or
        $runStart.DeviceTargetsSha256 -cne (Get-ReaderHash $targetPath) -or
        $runStart.PhasePlanSha256 -cne (Get-ReaderHash $planPath)) {
        throw 'Acceptance run start is not bound to the current Task 15 bundle.'
    }
    if (($targets | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress) -cne
        ($PreflightTargets | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress)) {
        throw 'Online preflight targets differ from the active acceptance target set.'
    }
    if ($plan.Count -ne $script:ReaderPhases.Count) {
        throw 'Acceptance phase plan count changed.'
    }
    for ($index = 0; $index -lt $script:ReaderPhases.Count; $index += 1) {
        if (($plan[$index] | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress) -cne
            ($script:ReaderPhases[$index] | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress)) {
            throw "Acceptance phase plan changed at index $index."
        }
    }
    $session = [pscustomobject]@{
        Context = $Context
        Root = $resolvedRoot
        RunStart = $runStart
        Targets = $targets
        PhasePlan = $plan
    }
    $session | Add-Member -NotePropertyName NextPhase -NotePropertyValue (
        Get-ReaderPhaseState $session
    )
    return $session
}

function Assert-ReaderAcceptanceCompletion {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Session)
    if ($null -ne $Session.NextPhase) {
        throw "Acceptance cannot seal before phase $($Session.NextPhase.Name)."
    }
    $completionPath = Join-Path $Session.Root 'run-complete.json'
    $digestPath = Join-Path $Session.Root 'run-complete.sha256.txt'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $completionPath -PathType Leaf) -or
        -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $digestPath -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw 'Acceptance completion manifest or digest is absent.'
    }
    $completion = Get-Content -LiteralPath $completionPath -Raw |
        ConvertFrom-Json
    $recordedDigest = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $digestPath -Raw).Trim()
    if ((Get-ReaderHash $completionPath) -cne $recordedDigest -or
        $completion.SchemaVersion -ne 2 -or
        $completion.Status -cne 'complete' -or
        $completion.AcceptanceId -cne $Session.RunStart.AcceptanceId -or
        $completion.GitCommit -cne $Session.Context.GateCommit -or
        $completion.ApkSha256 -cne
            $Session.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
        $completion.Task15ReceiptSha256 -cne
            $Session.Context.ReceiptSha256) {
        throw 'Acceptance completion binding or digest is invalid.'
    }
    foreach ($propertyName in @(
        'InstalledPackagesBeforeSeal', 'InstalledPackagesAfterSeal'
    )) {
        $records = @($completion.($propertyName))
        if ($records.Count -ne $Session.Targets.Count) {
            throw "Completion $propertyName count is invalid."
        }
        foreach ($device in $Session.Targets) {
            $record = @($records | Where-Object DeviceSerial -ceq $device.Serial)
            if ($record.Count -ne 1 -or -not [bool]$record[0].Present -or
                $record[0].DeviceClass -cne $device.Class -or
                $record[0].ApkSha256 -cne
                    $Session.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
                [long]$record[0].ApkBytes -ne
                    [long]$Session.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkBytes -or
                [long]$record[0].VersionCode -ne
                    [long]$Session.Context.ApkEvidence.VersionCode -or
                $record[0].VersionName -cne
                    [string]$Session.Context.ApkEvidence.VersionName) {
                throw "Completion $propertyName identity is invalid on $($device.Serial)."
            }
        }
    }
    $actual = @(Get-ReaderRootInventory $Session.Root -Exclude @(
        'run-complete.json', 'run-complete.sha256.txt'
    ))
    Assert-ReaderInventoryEqual @($completion.Artifacts) $actual `
        'post-completion acceptance re-inventory'
    return $completion
}

function Open-ReaderAcceptance {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Context,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]] $PreflightTargets
    )
    if (-not ($PreflightTargets | Where-Object Class -eq 'emulator') -or
        -not ($PreflightTargets | Where-Object Class -eq 'physical')) {
        throw 'Both device classes must be preflighted before state publication.'
    }
    $lock = Enter-ReaderAcceptanceLock
    try {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer -PathType Leaf) {
            $rootText = (
                Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer -Raw
            ).Trim()
            $session = Assert-ReaderAcceptanceRoot `
                $Context $rootText $PreflightTargets
            $completionPath = Join-Path $session.Root 'run-complete.json'
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $completionPath -PathType Leaf) {
                [void](Assert-ReaderAcceptanceCompletion $session)
            }
            return $session
        }

        $acceptanceId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
        $relativeRoot = ".codex-validation\reader-acceptance-$acceptanceId"
        $finalRoot = Join-Path (Get-Location) $relativeRoot
        $temporaryRoot = "$finalRoot.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $finalRoot) -or
            (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot)) {
            throw 'Generated acceptance root already exists.'
        }
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot | Out-Null
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (
            Join-Path $temporaryRoot '.phase-state'
        ) | Out-Null
        $targetPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'device-targets.json'
        $planPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'phase-plan.json'
        Write-ReaderAtomicJson $targetPath @($PreflightTargets) -NoReplace
        Write-ReaderAtomicJson $planPath @($script:ReaderPhases) -NoReplace
        $runStart = [ordered]@{
            SchemaVersion = 2
            Status = 'started'
            AcceptanceId = $acceptanceId
            GitCommit = $Context.GateCommit
            ApkSha256 = $Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256
            ApkBytes = [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.ApkBytes
            VersionCode = [long]$Context.ApkEvidence.VersionCode
            VersionName = [string]$Context.ApkEvidence.VersionName
            Task15ReceiptRelativePath = $Context.ReceiptRelativePath
            Task15ReceiptSha256 = $Context.ReceiptSha256
            Task15ApkEvidenceSha256 = $Context.ApkEvidenceSha256
            DeviceTargetsSha256 = Get-ReaderHash $targetPath
            PhasePlanSha256 = Get-ReaderHash $planPath
            PreflightCompletedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
            StartedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
            RequiredDeviceClasses = @('emulator', 'physical')
        }
        Write-ReaderAtomicJson (
            Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'run-start.json'
        ) $runStart -NoReplace
        [IO.Directory]::Move($temporaryRoot, $finalRoot)
        Write-ReaderAtomicText $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer `
            ($relativeRoot + [Environment]::NewLine) -NoReplace
        return Assert-ReaderAcceptanceRoot `
            $Context $relativeRoot $PreflightTargets
    } finally {
        $lock.Dispose()
    }
}

function Start-ReaderAcceptancePhase {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Session,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Name
    )
    $lock = Enter-ReaderAcceptanceLock
    try {
        $current = Assert-ReaderAcceptanceRoot `
            $Session.Context $Session.Root $Session.Targets
        $phase = Get-ReaderPhaseDefinition $Name
        if ($null -eq $current.NextPhase -or
            $phase.Index -lt $current.NextPhase.Index) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ AlreadyComplete = $true; Session = $current }
        }
        if ($current.NextPhase.Name -cne $Name) {
            throw "Exact phase resume requires $($current.NextPhase.Name), not $Name."
        }
        $paths = Get-ReaderPhasePaths $current.Root $phase
        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Start) -or
            (Get-ReaderPhaseEntryCount $current.Root $phase) -ne 0) {
            throw "Phase $Name is partial; preserve the root and externally invalidate it."
        }
        $before = Get-ReaderInstalledPackageSet `
            $current.Context $current.Targets `
            -AllowAbsent:($Name -eq 'install') `
            -RequireExact:($Name -ne 'install')
        $start = [ordered]@{
            SchemaVersion = 1; Status = 'started'
            AcceptanceId = $current.RunStart.AcceptanceId
            GitCommit = $current.Context.GateCommit
            ApkSha256 = $current.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256
            PhaseIndex = $phase.Index; PhaseName = $phase.Name
            StartedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
            InstalledPackagesBefore = $before
        }
        Write-ReaderAtomicJson $paths.Start $start -NoReplace
        return [pscustomobject]@{ AlreadyComplete = $false; Session = $current }
    } finally {
        $lock.Dispose()
    }
}

function Assert-ReaderAcceptancePhaseActive {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Session,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Name
    )
    $phase = Get-ReaderPhaseDefinition $Name
    $paths = Get-ReaderPhasePaths $Session.Root $phase
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Start -PathType Leaf) -or
        (Test-Path -LiteralPath $paths.Complete)) {
        throw "Acceptance phase is not the active incomplete phase: $Name"
    }
}

function Complete-ReaderAcceptancePhase {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] $Session,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Name
    )
    $lock = Enter-ReaderAcceptanceLock
    try {
        $phase = Get-ReaderPhaseDefinition $Name
        $paths = Get-ReaderPhasePaths $Session.Root $phase
        Assert-ReaderAcceptancePhaseActive $Session $Name
        $after = Get-ReaderInstalledPackageSet `
            $Session.Context $Session.Targets -RequireExact
        $artifacts = @(Get-ReaderPhaseInventory $Session.Root $phase)
        if ($artifacts.Count -eq 0) {
            throw "Phase $Name cannot complete without phase-owned artifacts."
        }
        $complete = [ordered]@{
            SchemaVersion = 1; Status = 'complete'
            AcceptanceId = $Session.RunStart.AcceptanceId
            GitCommit = $Session.Context.GateCommit
            ApkSha256 = $Session.Context.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256
            PhaseIndex = $phase.Index; PhaseName = $phase.Name
            StartManifestSha256 = Get-ReaderHash $paths.Start
            CompletedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
            InstalledPackagesAfter = $after
            Artifacts = $artifacts
        }
        Write-ReaderAtomicJson $paths.Complete $complete -NoReplace
        $current = Assert-ReaderAcceptanceRoot `
            $Session.Context $Session.Root $Session.Targets
        if ($null -ne $current.NextPhase -and
            $current.NextPhase.Index -le $phase.Index) {
            throw "Phase $Name did not advance the exact completed prefix."
        }
        return $current
    } finally {
        $lock.Dispose()
    }
}

function Invoke-ReaderAcceptanceInvalidation {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $InvalidationReason)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($InvalidationReason) -or
        $InvalidationReason.Length -gt 1000) {
        throw 'Invalidation requires a non-empty reason of at most 1000 characters.'
    }
    $lock = Enter-ReaderAcceptanceLock
    try {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer -PathType Leaf)) {
            throw 'There is no active acceptance pointer to invalidate.'
        }
        $rootText = (
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer -Raw
        ).Trim()
        $root = Assert-ReaderPathUnderValidation $rootText
        $startPath = Join-Path $root 'run-start.json'
        $start = Get-Content -LiteralPath $startPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        if ($start.AcceptanceId -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
            throw 'Active acceptance start manifest is malformed.'
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'run-complete.json')) {
            throw 'A completed acceptance root cannot be invalidated.'
        }
        $recordPath = Join-Path $script:ReaderValidationRoot (
            "reader-acceptance-invalidated-$($start.AcceptanceId).json"
        )
        $archivePointer = Join-Path $script:ReaderValidationRoot (
            "reader-acceptance-root-$($start.AcceptanceId)-invalidated.txt"
        )
        $record = [ordered]@{
            SchemaVersion = 1; Status = 'invalidated'
            AcceptanceId = $start.AcceptanceId
            Root = $rootText.Replace('\', '/')
            GitCommit = $start.GitCommit
            ApkSha256 = $start.ApkSha256
            InvalidatedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
            Reason = $InvalidationReason
            PreservedRootInventory = @(Get-ReaderRootInventory $root)
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $recordPath -PathType Leaf) {
            $existing = Get-Content -LiteralPath $recordPath -Raw |
                ConvertFrom-Json
            if ($existing.AcceptanceId -cne $start.AcceptanceId -or
                $existing.Root -cne $record.Root -or
                $existing.Reason -cne $InvalidationReason) {
                throw 'Existing external invalidation record does not match this request.'
            }
        } else {
            Write-ReaderAtomicJson $recordPath $record -NoReplace
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $archivePointer) {
            throw 'Invalidated acceptance archive pointer already exists.'
        }
        [IO.File]::Move($script:ReaderAcceptancePointer, $archivePointer)
        Write-Host "Invalidated acceptance $($start.AcceptanceId); root preserved at $rootText"
    } finally {
        $lock.Dispose()
    }
}

if ($MyInvocation.InvocationName -ne '.') {
    if ($Operation -ne 'Invalidate') {
        throw 'Invoke this file directly only with -Operation Invalidate; otherwise dot-source it.'
    }
    Invoke-ReaderAcceptanceInvalidation -InvalidationReason $Reason
}
```

Use the external command below to abandon an incomplete phase. It atomically publishes a reasoned invalidation record and archives the active pointer while holding the exclusive state lock; it never writes into, deletes, or renames the evidence root.

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
  .\scripts\reader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1 `
  -Operation Invalidate `
  -Reason 'operator-supplied reason for abandoning the incomplete phase'
```

Only after the helper exists, run this preflight. The Task 15 current pointer and all APK inputs come from the commit-keyed schema-2 bundle. Target enumeration proves that both an emulator and a physical device are online before `Open-ReaderAcceptance` is allowed to create or publish any root, state manifest, or pointer.

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts\reader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
Assert-ReaderSealedApk $task15
$targets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)

$statusLines = @(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to inspect the Task 16 worktree.' }
$unexpected = @($statusLines | Where-Object {
    $_ -notmatch '^\?\? \.codex-validation/'
})
if ($unexpected.Count -ne 0) {
    throw "Unexpected worktree paths before acceptance:`n$($unexpected -join "`n")"
}
```
