```powershell
  docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-18-reader-playlikecurl-qa-remediation.md `
  docs/superpowers/baselines/2026-07-18-reader-playlikecurl-host-baseline.json
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw 'Approved documents or baseline metadata are absent from HEAD.'
}
$remote = @(git ls-remote --refs fork `
  refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $remote.Count -ne 1 -or
    ($remote[0] -split '\s+')[0] -cne $task15.GateCommit) {
    throw 'Remote implementation branch does not equal the Task 15 bundle commit.'
}
$acceptance = Open-ReaderAcceptance `
  -Context $task15 `
  -PreflightTargets $targets
$acceptance | Format-List Root, NextPhase
```

Expected: the schema-2 current pointer resolves exactly to `.codex-validation/task15-automated-gate-evidence.<HEAD>/receipt.json`; every sealed bundle member, recursive XML tree, APK hash/bytes/version metadata, Task 14 authorization, and immutable release binding validates. Both required device classes are online before any acceptance publication. A resumed run validates one exact completed-phase prefix and names only its first absent phase; any partial phase, later-phase artifact, changed package identity, or changed target set blocks resumption and requires the external non-mutating invalidation command.

- [ ] **Step 2: Install and launch the exact sealed ReaderDev APK on each target**

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts\reader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$targets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)
$acceptance = Open-ReaderAcceptance $task15 $targets
$phase = Start-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'install'
if ($phase.AlreadyComplete) {
  Write-Host 'Install phase already sealed; exact-prefix resume skips it.'
  return
}
$acceptance = $phase.Session
$envFile = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath .\bindery-debug.env).Path

foreach ($device in $acceptance.Targets) {
  Assert-ReaderSealedApk $task15
  $install = Invoke-ReaderAdbOutput $device.Serial @(
    'install', '-r', '-t', $task15.ApkPath
  )
  if (-not ($install.Lines | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -eq 'Success' })) {
    throw "Exact sealed APK install did not report Success on $($device.Serial)."
  }
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\install-reader-dev.ps1 `
    -DeviceSerial $device.Serial `
    -EnvFile $envFile `
    -NoBuild `
    -NoInstall `
    -RequireReaderLaunch `
    -SkipNativeShellCover
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "ReaderDev launch failed on $($device.Serial)."
  }
  $installed = Get-ReaderInstalledPackageIdentity `
    $task15 $device -RequireExact
  $manifest = [ordered]@{
    SchemaVersion = 2
    Status = 'complete'
    AcceptanceId = $acceptance.RunStart.AcceptanceId
    CapturedUtc = $installed.CapturedUtc
    DeviceSerial = $device.Serial
    DeviceClass = $device.Class
    GitCommit = $task15.GateCommit
    ApplicationId = $task15.ApkEvidence.ApplicationId
    SealedApkPath = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath(
      (Get-Location).Path,
      $task15.ApkPath
    ).Replace('\', '/')
    ApkSha256 = $installed.ApkSha256
    ApkBytes = [long]$installed.ApkBytes
    VersionCode = [long]$installed.VersionCode
    VersionName = [string]$installed.VersionName
    RemoteBaseApk = $installed.RemoteBaseApk
  }
  Write-ReaderAtomicJson -Path (
    Join-Path $acceptance.Root "installed-package-$($device.SafeSerial).json"
  ) -Value $manifest -NoReplace
}
$acceptance = Complete-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'install'
```

Expected: the install phase records installed-package identity before and after the phase for every target. The post-phase APK SHA-256, byte count, version code, and version name match the commit-keyed Task 15 sealed APK exactly, and the reader—not only the app shell—is foreground. A completed install phase is revalidated and skipped; an interrupted install phase is preserved and must be externally invalidated rather than overwritten.

- [ ] **Step 3: Run existing smoke and Komikku matrix scripts**

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts
eader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$targets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)
$acceptance = Open-ReaderAcceptance $task15 $targets
$phase = Start-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'automated-matrix'
if ($phase.AlreadyComplete) {
  Write-Host 'Automated matrix phase already sealed; exact-prefix resume skips it.'
  return
}
$acceptance = $phase.Session
$acceptanceRoot = $acceptance.Root
$runStart = $acceptance.RunStart
$apkEvidence = $task15.ApkEvidence
$targets = $acceptance.Targets
$envFile = (Resolve-Path .indery-debug.env).Path
$matrixManifestPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'automated-matrix-manifest.json'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $matrixManifestPath) {
  throw 'Automated matrix phase owns an unexpected pre-existing manifest.'
}
$matrixManifest = @()
function Seal-MatrixArtifactRoot(
  [string] $Kind,
  [object] $Device,
  [string] $Root,
  [string] $RequiredArtifact,
  [string] $StartedUtc
) {
  $requiredPath = Join-Path $Root $RequiredArtifact
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $requiredPath -PathType Leaf) -or
      (Get-Item -LiteralPath $requiredPath).Length -eq 0) {
    throw "$Kind produced no required artifact on $($Device.Serial): $RequiredArtifact"
  }
  $resolvedRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Root).Path.TrimEnd('\')
  $files = @(
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $resolvedRoot -Recurse -File | Sort-Object FullName
  )
  if ($files.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "$Kind produced no artifacts on $($Device.Serial)"
  }
  $artifacts = @(
    $files | ForEach-Object {
      [ordered]@{
        Path = $_.FullName.Substring($resolvedRoot.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
        Sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash
        Bytes = $_.Length
      }
    }
  )
  $completionPath = Join-Path $resolvedRoot 'run-complete.json'
  [ordered]@{
    Status = 'complete'
    AcceptanceId = $runStart.AcceptanceId
    GitCommit = $apkEvidence.GitCommit
    ApkSha256 = $apkEvidence.ApkSha256
    DeviceSerial = $Device.Serial
    DeviceClass = $Device.Class
    Kind = $Kind
    StartedUtc = $StartedUtc
    CompletedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    RequiredArtifact = $RequiredArtifact
    Artifacts = $artifacts
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $completionPath
  $script:matrixManifest += [pscustomobject]@{
    AcceptanceId = $runStart.AcceptanceId
    GitCommit = $apkEvidence.GitCommit
    ApkSha256 = $apkEvidence.ApkSha256
    DeviceSerial = $Device.Serial
    DeviceClass = $Device.Class
    Kind = $Kind
    Root = $resolvedRoot.Substring(
      (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $acceptanceRoot).Path.TrimEnd('\').Length + 1
    ).Replace('\', '/')
    CompletionManifest = 'run-complete.json'
    CompletionManifestSha256 = (
      Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $completionPath
    ).Hash
    CompletionManifestBytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $completionPath).Length
  }
  @($script:matrixManifest) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7 |
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $matrixManifestPath
}
foreach ($device in @($targets)) {
  Assert-ReaderSealedApk $task15
  $smokeRoot = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot "smoke-$($device.SafeSerial)"
  $komikkuRoot = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot "komikku-$($device.SafeSerial)"
  foreach ($phasePath in @($smokeRoot, $komikkuRoot)) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $phasePath) {
      throw "Matrix phase owns an unexpected pre-existing path: $phasePath"
    }
  }
  $smokeStartedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\adb-reader-smoke.ps1 `
    -Package darkaxt.navic.readerdev `
    -DeviceSerial $device.Serial `
    -ArtifactDir $smokeRoot `
    -SwipeFraction '0.82,0.50,0.18,0.50,240,800' `
    -LongPressFraction '0.50,0.50,900,500' `
    -RequireNativeLongTap `
    -RequireNoReaderConsoleErrors `
    -CaptureReaderDiagnostics `
    -PrivacySafeEvidence
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Reader smoke script failed on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  Seal-MatrixArtifactRoot `
    -Kind 'smoke' `
    -Device $device `
    -Root $smokeRoot `
    -RequiredArtifact 'privacy-safe-smoke.json' `
    -StartedUtc $smokeStartedUtc
  $komikkuStartedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\adb-reader-komikku-matrix.ps1 `
    -Package darkaxt.navic.readerdev `
    -DeviceSerial $device.Serial `
    -EnvFile $envFile `
    -PrepareReaderLaunch `
    -PrivacySafeEvidence `
    -ArtifactRoot $komikkuRoot
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Reader Komikku matrix failed on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  Seal-MatrixArtifactRoot `
    -Kind 'komikku' `
    -Device $device `
    -Root $komikkuRoot `
    -RequiredArtifact 'reader-matrix-summary.csv' `
    -StartedUtc $komikkuStartedUtc
}
$acceptance = Complete-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'automated-matrix'
```

Expected: PASS with no reader console errors. Privacy-safe smoke and Komikku evidence exists for every emulator and physical target, and the phase manifest seals installed package APK hash/bytes/version before and after the matrix.

- [ ] **Step 4: Validate portrait and landscape viewport profiles**

Run both orientations on the emulator:

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts
eader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$targets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)
$acceptance = Open-ReaderAcceptance $task15 $targets
$phase = Start-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'viewport'
if ($phase.AlreadyComplete) {
  Write-Host 'Viewport phase already sealed; exact-prefix resume skips it.'
  return
}
$acceptance = $phase.Session
$acceptanceRoot = $acceptance.Root
$apkEvidence = $task15.ApkEvidence
$envFile = (Resolve-Path .indery-debug.env).Path
$emulator = @($acceptance.Targets | Where-Object Class -eq 'emulator')[0]
if ($null -eq $emulator) { throw 'Acceptance emulator is unavailable.' }
$serial = $emulator.Serial
function Invoke-ViewportReaderQa([string] $Profile, [string] $Name) {
  Assert-ReaderSealedApk $task15
  $artifactRoot = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot "viewport-$Name"
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactRoot) {
    throw "Viewport phase owns an unexpected pre-existing root: $artifactRoot"
  }
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\set-reader-dev-viewport.ps1 `
    -DeviceSerial $serial `
    -Profile $Profile
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Viewport setup failed: $Name" }
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\adb-reader-playlikecurl-qa.ps1 `
    -DeviceSerial $serial `
    -EnvFile $envFile `
    -SealedApkPath $task15.ApkPath `
    -ExpectedApkSha256 $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 `
    -ExpectedApkBytes $apkEvidence.ApkBytes `
    -ExpectedVersionCode $apkEvidence.VersionCode `
    -ExpectedVersionName $apkEvidence.VersionName `
    -NoInstall `
    -ArtifactRoot $artifactRoot `
    -StressTurns 100 `
    -OpenCloseCycles 10
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Viewport ReaderDev QA failed: $Name" }
  $run = Get-Content (Join-Path $artifactRoot 'run-complete.json') -Raw |
    ConvertFrom-Json
  if ($run.GitCommit -ne $apkEvidence.GitCommit -or
      $run.EvidenceMode -ne 'FrozenCommit' -or
      $null -ne $run.CandidateTreeSha256 -or
      $run.ApkSha256 -ne $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
      $run.ApkBytes -ne $apkEvidence.ApkBytes -or
      $run.VersionCode -ne $apkEvidence.VersionCode -or
      $run.VersionName -cne $apkEvidence.VersionName -or
      -not [bool]$run.NoInstall) {
    throw "Viewport run is not bound to the frozen APK: $Name"
  }
  $geometryEvidence = Get-Content -LiteralPath (
    Join-Path $artifactRoot 'post-stress\privacy-safe-smoke.json'
  ) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  $wmSize = (adb -s $serial shell wm size | Out-String).Trim()
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Unable to read applied viewport: $Name" }
  $applied = [regex]::Matches($wmSize, '(?<Width>\d+)x(?<Height>\d+)') |
    Select-Object -Last 1
  if ($null -eq $applied) { throw "Applied viewport is unparseable: $Name" }
  $appliedWidth = [int]$applied.Groups['Width'].Value
  $appliedHeight = [int]$applied.Groups['Height'].Value
  if ([int]$geometryEvidence.Geometry.ViewportWidthPx -ne $appliedWidth -or
      [int]$geometryEvidence.Geometry.ViewportHeightPx -ne $appliedHeight) {
    throw "Geometry evidence does not match the applied viewport: $Name"
  }
  if ($Name -eq 'zfold7-portrait') {
    if ($appliedWidth -ge $appliedHeight) {
      throw 'Portrait viewport evidence is not portrait'
    }
  } elseif ($appliedWidth -le $appliedHeight -or
      $geometryEvidence.Geometry.Mode -ne 'spread' -or
      [int]$geometryEvidence.Geometry.GutterPx -le 0 -or
      -not [bool]$geometryEvidence.Assertions.SpreadGeometryValid -or
      -not [bool]$geometryEvidence.Assertions.PositiveGutter) {
    throw 'Landscape viewport lacks a coherent spread and positive stable gutter'
  }
}
try {
  Invoke-ViewportReaderQa 'zfold7-inner' 'zfold7-portrait'
  Invoke-ViewportReaderQa 'zfold7-inner-landscape' 'zfold7-landscape'
} finally {
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\set-reader-dev-viewport.ps1 `
    -DeviceSerial $serial `
    -Profile reset
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Viewport reset failed' }
}
$acceptance = Complete-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'viewport'
```

Expected: no fatal/ownership errors; landscape keeps a coherent two-page spread and fixed gutter.

- [ ] **Step 5: Record a manual interaction video and execute the complete UX checklist**

Record five bounded segments per device. Each segment has a 180-second safety limit and an explicit checklist mapping; do not attempt to fit the complete matrix into one recording:

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts
eader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$targets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)
$acceptance = Open-ReaderAcceptance $task15 $targets
$phase = Start-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'manual'
if ($phase.AlreadyComplete) {
  Write-Host 'Manual phase already sealed; exact-prefix resume skips it.'
  return
}
$acceptance = $phase.Session
$acceptanceRoot = $acceptance.Root
$runStart = $acceptance.RunStart
$targets = $acceptance.Targets
$apkEvidence = $task15.ApkEvidence
$envFile = (Resolve-Path .indery-debug.env).Path
. .\scripts
eader-playlikecurl-qa-parser.ps1
$segments = @(
  [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'core-ltr'; Items = @(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 12) },
  [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'rtl-lifecycle-rollback'; Items = @(6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 20) },
  [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'publication-repair'; Items = @(13, 14, 16) },
  [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'typed-deferrals'; Items = @(15) },
  [pscustomobject]@{ Name = 'relocation-handoff-clear'; Items = @(17, 18, 19) }
)
$videoManifest = @()
$checklistResults = @()
$diagnosticManifest = @()
foreach ($device in @($targets)) {
  Assert-ReaderSealedApk $task15
  adb -s $device.Serial logcat -c
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to clear checklist log on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $clearResult = (adb -s $device.Serial shell pm clear darkaxt.navic.readerdev |
    Out-String).Trim()
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $clearResult -ne 'Success') {
    throw "Unable to establish cold ReaderDev state on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\install-reader-dev.ps1 `
    -DeviceSerial $device.Serial `
    -EnvFile $envFile `
    -NoBuild `
    -NoInstall `
    -RequireReaderLaunch `
    -SkipNativeShellCover
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to launch the cold ReaderDev checklist on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $pid = (adb -s $device.Serial shell pidof darkaxt.navic.readerdev |
    Out-String).Trim()
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $pid -notmatch '^\d+$') {
    throw "ReaderDev PID is unavailable on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $intervalStartedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  foreach ($segment in $segments) {
    $remote = "/sdcard/navic-playlikecurl-$($segment.Name).mp4"
    $artifactName =
      "manual-$($device.Class)-$($device.SafeSerial)-$($segment.Name).mp4"
    $local = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot $artifactName
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $local) {
      throw "Manual phase owns an unexpected pre-existing video: $local"
    }
    adb -s $device.Serial shell rm -f $remote
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      throw "Remote recording cleanup failed on $($device.Serial): $($segment.Name)"
    }
    $startedAt = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    Write-Host (
      "Record $($segment.Name) on $($device.Class) $($device.Serial); " +
      "perform checklist items $($segment.Items -join ',')"
    )
    adb -s $device.Serial shell screenrecord --time-limit 180 $remote
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      throw "screenrecord failed on $($device.Serial): $($segment.Name)"
    }
    adb -s $device.Serial pull $remote $local
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
        -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $local -PathType Leaf) -or
        (Get-Item -LiteralPath $local).Length -eq 0) {
      throw "Recording pull failed on $($device.Serial): $($segment.Name)"
    }
    $video = [pscustomobject]@{
      AcceptanceId = $runStart.AcceptanceId
      GitCommit = $apkEvidence.GitCommit
      ApkSha256 = $apkEvidence.ApkSha256
      DeviceSerial = $device.Serial
      DeviceClass = $device.Class
      Segment = $segment.Name
      ChecklistItems = $segment.Items
      StartedAtUtc = $startedAt
      FinishedAtUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
      Artifact = $artifactName
      Sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $local).Hash
      Bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $local).Length
    }
    $videoManifest += $video
    $videoManifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 |
      Set-Content (Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'manual-video-manifest.json')

    foreach ($item in $segment.Items) {
      do {
        $verdict = (Read-Host (
          "Review $artifactName for checklist item $item; enter PASS or FAIL"
        )).Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
      } while ($verdict -notin @('PASS', 'FAIL'))
      $checklistResults += [pscustomobject]@{
        AcceptanceId = $runStart.AcceptanceId
        GitCommit = $apkEvidence.GitCommit
        ApkSha256 = $apkEvidence.ApkSha256
        DeviceSerial = $device.Serial
        DeviceClass = $device.Class
        ChecklistItem = $item
        Segment = $segment.Name
        VideoArtifact = $artifactName
        VideoSha256 = $video.Sha256
        Verdict = $verdict
        ReviewedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
      }
      $checklistResults | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 |
        Set-Content (Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'manual-checklist-results.json')
      if ($verdict -eq 'FAIL') {
        throw "Manual checklist item $item failed on $($device.Serial)"
      }
    }
  }

  $pidAfter = (adb -s $device.Serial shell pidof darkaxt.navic.readerdev |
    Out-String).Trim()
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $pidAfter -ne $pid) {
    throw "ReaderDev PID changed during checklist on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $rawLogLines = @(adb -s $device.Serial logcat -d --pid=$pid -v threadtime)
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to capture checklist interval on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $rawLog = $rawLogLines | Out-String
  Assert-ReaderRuntimeLogSafe $rawLog "manual checklist $($device.Serial)"
  $hasher = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
  try {
    $rawIntervalSha256 = [BitConverter]::ToString(
      $hasher.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($rawLog))
    ).Replace('-', '')
  } finally {
    $hasher.Dispose()
  }

  $publications = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderPublicationLog $rawLog)
  $acquisitions = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderRasterAcquisitionLog $rawLog)
  $preparations = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderPreparationLog $rawLog)
  $repairs = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderRepairLog $rawLog)
  $qaFaultEvents = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderQaFaultLog $rawLog)
  $appliedFaults = @(
    $qaFaultEvents | Where-Object State -eq 'Applied'
  )
  $appliedFaultRequestIds = @(
    $appliedFaults | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RequestId -Unique |
      Sort-Object
  )
  if ($appliedFaults.Count -ne 11 -or $appliedFaultRequestIds.Count -ne 11) {
    throw "Manual checklist did not apply exactly eleven unique faults on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $faultManifestPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'fault-command-manifest.json'
  $deviceFaultCommands = @(
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $faultManifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json |
      Where-Object DeviceSerial -eq $device.Serial
  )
  if ($deviceFaultCommands.Count -ne 16) {
    throw "Manual checklist fault command manifest is incomplete on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $releaseCommandByFault = @{
    PauseNextPublication = 'release-publication'
    DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement = 'release-relocation'
    DelayNextVisualStateCallback = 'release-visual-state'
  }
  $releaseLinks = @()
  foreach ($applied in $appliedFaults) {
    $requestId = $applied.RequestId
    $fault = $applied.Fault
    $seam = $applied.Seam
    $chain = @(
      $qaFaultEvents | Where-Object {
        $_.RequestId -eq $requestId -and $_.Fault -eq $fault
      }
    )
    $enqueued = @($chain | Where-Object State -eq 'Enqueued')
    $consumed = @($chain | Where-Object State -eq 'Consumed')
    $appliedAgain = @($chain | Where-Object State -eq 'Applied')
    $released = @($chain | Where-Object State -eq 'Released')
    if ($enqueued.Count -ne 1 -or $consumed.Count -ne 1 -or
        $appliedAgain.Count -ne 1 -or
        $enqueued[0].Index -ge $consumed[0].Index -or
        $consumed[0].Index -ge $appliedAgain[0].Index -or
        $enqueued[0].Seam -ne 'queue' -or
        $consumed[0].Seam -ne $seam -or
        $appliedAgain[0].Seam -ne $seam -or
        $enqueued[0].ReleaseRequestId -ne 'none' -or
        $consumed[0].ReleaseRequestId -ne 'none' -or
        $appliedAgain[0].ReleaseRequestId -ne 'none' -or
        -not (Test-ReaderQaFaultOperationAbsent $enqueued[0]) -or
        -not (Test-ReaderQaFaultOperationAbsent $consumed[0])) {
      throw "Fault request did not order Enqueued < Consumed < Applied exactly once on $($device.Serial): $requestId"
    }
    Assert-ReaderQaFaultAppliedContext $appliedAgain[0] (
      "manual fault $requestId on $($device.Serial)"
    )
    if ($releaseCommandByFault.ContainsKey($fault)) {
      $releaseCommand = $releaseCommandByFault[$fault]
      $commandEntry = @(
        $deviceFaultCommands | Where-Object Command -eq $releaseCommand
      )
      if ($commandEntry.Count -ne 1 -or $released.Count -ne 1 -or
          $chain.Count -ne 4 -or
          $appliedAgain[0].Index -ge $released[0].Index -or
          $released[0].Seam -ne $seam -or
          $released[0].Result -ne 'command-release' -or
          $released[0].ReleaseRequestId -ne $commandEntry[0].RequestId -or
          -not (Test-ReaderQaFaultOperationEqual $appliedAgain[0] $released[0])) {
        throw "Delayed fault lacks one operation- and request-correlated release on $($device.Serial): $requestId"
      }
      $releaseLinks += [pscustomobject]@{
        Fault = $fault
        FaultRequestId = $requestId
        Command = $releaseCommand
        ReleaseRequestId = $commandEntry[0].RequestId
      }
    } elseif ($released.Count -ne 0 -or $chain.Count -ne 3) {
      throw "Non-delayed fault emitted an unexpected terminal event on $($device.Serial): $requestId"
    }
  }
  if ($releaseLinks.Count -ne 3) {
    throw "Manual checklist did not prove all three delayed-fault releases on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $clearQueuedCommand = @(
    $deviceFaultCommands | Where-Object {
      $_.Command -eq 'enqueue' -and $_.Fault -eq 'FailNextPersistence' -and
      $_.Segment -eq 'relocation-handoff-clear'
    }
  )
  $clearCommand = @(
    $deviceFaultCommands | Where-Object Command -eq 'clear'
  )
  $clearedChain = @(
    if ($clearQueuedCommand.Count -eq 1) {
      $qaFaultEvents | Where-Object {
        $_.RequestId -eq $clearQueuedCommand[0].RequestId
      }
    }
  )
  if ($clearQueuedCommand.Count -ne 1 -or $clearCommand.Count -ne 1 -or
      $clearedChain.Count -ne 2 -or
      $clearedChain[0].State -ne 'Enqueued' -or
      $clearedChain[1].State -ne 'Cleared' -or
      $clearedChain[1].Result -ne 'command-clear' -or
      $clearedChain[0].Index -ge $clearedChain[1].Index -or
      -not (Test-ReaderQaFaultOperationAbsent $clearedChain[0]) -or
      -not (Test-ReaderQaFaultOperationAbsent $clearedChain[1]) -or
      $clearedChain[1].ReleaseRequestId -ne $clearCommand[0].RequestId) {
    throw "Clear did not drain its exact queued fault on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $warmSessions = @(
    $acquisitions | Where-Object Trigger -eq 'WarmReopen' |
      Select-Object -ExpandProperty Session -Unique
  )
  if ($warmSessions.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Manual checklist emitted no warm-reopen diagnostics on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  foreach ($session in $warmSessions) {
    Assert-WarmReopenUsesPersistentHydration `
      -Log $rawLog `
      -ReaderSession $session `
      -Context "manual warm reopen $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $requiredDeferrals = @(
    'ContentNotReady', 'LayoutUnstable', 'PaginationNotReady',
    'WebViewDetached', 'ReaderPaused'
  )
  $typedGroups = @(
    $preparations | Where-Object {
      $_.State -eq 'Deferred' -and $_.Reason -in $requiredDeferrals
    } | Group-Object Session | Where-Object {
      @($_.Group.Reason | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -eq
        $requiredDeferrals.Count
    }
  )
  if ($typedGroups.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Manual checklist did not exercise all typed deferrals on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  foreach ($group in $typedGroups) {
    Assert-TypedDeferralsResumeOnNewerEvent `
      -Log $rawLog `
      -ReaderSession ([long]$group.Name) `
      -Context "manual typed deferrals $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $repairSessions = @(
    $repairs | Where-Object State -eq 'Started' |
      Select-Object -ExpandProperty Session -Unique
  )
  if ($repairSessions.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Manual checklist emitted no repair attempt on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  foreach ($session in $repairSessions) {
    Assert-RepairAttemptReachesSubmission `
      -Log $rawLog `
      -ReaderSession $session `
      -Context "manual active repair $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $deckEvents = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderDeckLog $rawLog)
  if ($deckEvents.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Manual checklist emitted no deck ownership events on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  foreach ($ready in @($repairs | Where-Object State -eq 'Ready')) {
    $repairRoot = @(
      $appliedFaults | Where-Object {
        $_.RequestId -eq $ready.QaFaultRequestId
      }
    )
    $requiresActive = $ready.QaFaultRequestId -ne 'none'
    if ($requiresActive -and
        ($repairRoot.Count -ne 1 -or
         $repairRoot[0].Fault -ne 'ForceRepairWithoutPreparedDeck' -or
         $repairRoot[0].RepairAttemptId -ne $ready.Attempt)) {
      throw "Repair fault correlation does not identify this repair attempt on $($device.Serial)"
    }
    $submission = @(
      $deckEvents | Where-Object {
        $roleOwnsGeneration = (
          ($_.Role -eq 'Active' -and $_.Active -eq $_.Generation) -or
          ($_.Role -eq 'Pending' -and $_.Pending -eq $_.Generation)
        )
        $_.Index -gt $ready.Index -and
        $_.Session -eq $ready.Session -and
        $_.RepairAttempt -eq $ready.Attempt -and
        $_.Prepared -and
        $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $ready.QaFaultRequestId -and
        $roleOwnsGeneration -and
        (-not $requiresActive -or $_.Role -eq 'Active')
      }
    )
    if ($submission.Count -ne 1) {
      $expectedRole = if ($requiresActive) { 'Active' } else { 'Active-or-Pending' }
      throw "Repair did not reach one correlated prepared $expectedRole submission on $($device.Serial)"
    }
    if ($submission[0].Role -eq 'Pending') {
      if ($null -eq $submission[0].Active) {
        throw "Pending repair lacks an authoritative active generation on $($device.Serial)"
      }
      $activeProof = @(
        $deckEvents | Where-Object {
          $_.Index -lt $submission[0].Index -and
          $_.Session -eq $submission[0].Session -and
          $_.Generation -eq $submission[0].Active -and
          $_.Role -eq 'Active' -and
          $_.Prepared -and
          $_.Active -eq $_.Generation
        } | Select-Object -Last 1
      )
      if ($activeProof.Count -ne 1) {
        throw "Pending repair has no prepared usable active-deck proof on $($device.Serial)"
      }
    }
  }
  $handoffEvents = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderHandoffLog $rawLog)
  $visualFault = @(
    $appliedFaults | Where-Object Fault -eq 'DelayNextVisualStateCallback'
  )
  if ($visualFault.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Delayed visual-state fault has no unique Applied root on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $visualFault = $visualFault[0]
  $timeouts = @(
    $handoffEvents | Where-Object {
      $_.Result -eq 'TimedOut' -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $visualFault.RequestId -and
      $_.QaFaultRelation -eq 'AppliedOperation' -and
      $_.Token -eq $visualFault.RelocationToken -and
      $_.HandoffAttemptId -eq $visualFault.HandoffAttemptId
    }
  )
  if ($timeouts.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Delayed visual-state fault emitted no unique correlated timeout on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $timeout = $timeouts[0]
  $stale = @(
    $handoffEvents | Where-Object {
      $_.Index -gt $timeout.Index -and
      $_.Session -eq $timeout.Session -and
      $_.Token -eq $timeout.Token -and
      $_.HandoffAttemptId -eq $timeout.HandoffAttemptId -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $visualFault.RequestId -and
      $_.Result -eq 'StalePhysicalCallbackReleased'
    }
  )
  if ($stale.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Timed-out handoff lacks one inert stale physical release on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $ready = @(
    $handoffEvents | Where-Object {
      $_.Index -gt $stale[0].Index -and
      $_.Session -eq $timeout.Session -and
      $_.Token -eq $timeout.Token -and
      $_.Target -eq $timeout.Target -and
      $_.HandoffAttemptId -gt $timeout.HandoffAttemptId -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $visualFault.RequestId -and
      $_.QaFaultRelation -eq 'Recovery' -and
      $_.QaFaultHandoffAttemptId -eq $timeout.HandoffAttemptId -and
      $_.Result -eq 'Ready'
    }
  )
  if ($ready.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Timed-out handoff did not recover on one fresh correlated attempt on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $oldAttemptReady = @(
    $handoffEvents | Where-Object {
      $_.Token -eq $timeout.Token -and
      $_.HandoffAttemptId -eq $timeout.HandoffAttemptId -and
      $_.Result -eq 'Ready'
    }
  )
  if ($oldAttemptReady.Count -ne 0) {
    throw "Timed-out handoff attempt later became Ready on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $relocationEvents = @(ConvertFrom-ReaderRelocationLog $rawLog)
  $queued = @(
    $relocationEvents | Where-Object State -eq 'Queued'
  )
  if ($queued.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "Manual checklist emitted no queued relocation on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $expectedRelocationStates = @(
    'Queued',
    'Dispatched',
    'Acknowledged',
    'AwaitingVisualHandoff',
    'Completed'
  )
  foreach ($entry in $queued) {
    $tokenEvents = @(
      $relocationEvents | Where-Object {
        $_.Index -ge $entry.Index -and
        $_.Session -eq $entry.Session -and
        $_.Token -eq $entry.Token -and
        $_.GestureId -eq $entry.GestureId -and
        $_.Source -eq $entry.Source -and
        $_.Target -eq $entry.Target -and
        $_.Direction -eq $entry.Direction -and
        $_.RasterGeneration -eq $entry.RasterGeneration -and
        $_.TextureGeneration -eq $entry.TextureGeneration
      }
    )
    $actualStates = @(
      $tokenEvents | Select-Object -ExpandProperty State
    )
    if ($actualStates.Count -ne $expectedRelocationStates.Count) {
      throw "Relocation token had duplicate, missing, or extra stages on $($device.Serial)"
    }
    for ($stateIndex = 0;
         $stateIndex -lt $expectedRelocationStates.Count;
         $stateIndex += 1) {
      if ($actualStates[$stateIndex] -ne $expectedRelocationStates[$stateIndex]) {
        throw "Relocation token violated Queued < Dispatched < Acknowledged < AwaitingVisualHandoff < Completed on $($device.Serial)"
      }
      if ($stateIndex -gt 0 -and
          $tokenEvents[$stateIndex - 1].Index -ge $tokenEvents[$stateIndex].Index) {
        throw "Relocation token did not have strictly increasing event indices on $($device.Serial)"
      }
    }
  }
  $completed = @(
    $relocationEvents | Where-Object State -eq 'Completed'
  )
  $queuedTokens = @($queued | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Token)
  $completedTokens = @($completed | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Token)
  if ($queuedTokens.Count -ne $completedTokens.Count) {
    throw "Relocation completion count was not FIFO on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  for ($tokenIndex = 0; $tokenIndex -lt $queuedTokens.Count; $tokenIndex += 1) {
    if ($queuedTokens[$tokenIndex] -ne $completedTokens[$tokenIndex]) {
      throw "Relocation completion order was not FIFO on $($device.Serial)"
    }
  }

  $downstreamEvents = @(
    $publications
    $acquisitions
    $preparations
    $repairs
    $deckEvents
    $relocationEvents
    $handoffEvents
  )
  Assert-ReaderQaFaultCorrelation `
    -FaultEvents $qaFaultEvents `
    -DownstreamEvents $downstreamEvents `
    -Context "manual fault causality $($device.Serial)"

  $persistenceFault = @(
    $appliedFaults | Where-Object Fault -eq 'FailNextPersistence'
  )
  $publicationPauseFault = @(
    $appliedFaults | Where-Object Fault -eq 'PauseNextPublication'
  )
  if ($persistenceFault.Count -ne 1 -or $publicationPauseFault.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Publication faults lack unique Applied roots on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $failedPersistence = @(
    $publications | Where-Object {
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $persistenceFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.QaFaultRelation -eq 'AppliedOperation' -and
      $_.RasterEpoch -eq $persistenceFault[0].PublicationEpoch -and
      $_.PersistenceAttemptId -eq $persistenceFault[0].PersistenceAttemptId -and
      $_.Result -eq 'Failed'
    }
  )
  if ($failedPersistence.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Persistence fault did not fail its exact applied attempt on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $persistenceRetry = @(
    $publications | Where-Object {
      $_.Index -gt $failedPersistence[0].Index -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $persistenceFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.QaFaultRelation -eq 'Retry' -and
      $_.PersistenceAttemptId -gt $persistenceFault[0].PersistenceAttemptId -and
      $_.Result -eq 'Durable'
    }
  )
  if ($persistenceRetry.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Persistence fault did not cause one failed attempt then one durable retry on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $stalePublication = @(
    $publications | Where-Object {
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $publicationPauseFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.QaFaultRelation -eq 'AppliedOperation' -and
      $_.RasterEpoch -eq $publicationPauseFault[0].PublicationEpoch -and
      $_.Result -eq 'Stale'
    }
  )
  if ($stalePublication.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Paused old publication epoch did not reject exactly once as stale on $($device.Serial)"
  }

  $rasterMissFault = @(
    $appliedFaults | Where-Object Fault -eq 'MissNextRasterLoad'
  )
  $rasterMiss = @(
    $acquisitions | Where-Object {
      $rasterMissFault.Count -eq 1 -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $rasterMissFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.Attempt -eq $rasterMissFault[0].RasterRequestEpoch -and
      $_.Result -eq 'Miss'
    }
  )
  if ($rasterMissFault.Count -ne 1 -or $rasterMiss.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Raster miss fault did not affect its exact request epoch on $($device.Serial)"
  }

  $deferralFaultNames = @{
    DeferContentNotReady = 'ContentNotReady'
    DeferLayoutUnstable = 'LayoutUnstable'
    DeferPaginationNotReady = 'PaginationNotReady'
    DeferWebViewDetached = 'WebViewDetached'
    DeferReaderPaused = 'ReaderPaused'
  }
  foreach ($entry in $deferralFaultNames.GetEnumerator()) {
    $root = @($appliedFaults | Where-Object Fault -eq $entry.Key)
    $deferred = @(
      $preparations | Where-Object {
        $root.Count -eq 1 -and
        $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $root[0].RequestId -and
        $_.Attempt -eq $root[0].PreparationAttemptId -and
        $_.State -eq 'Deferred' -and $_.Reason -eq $entry.Value
      }
    )
    $resumed = @(
      $preparations | Where-Object {
        $deferred.Count -eq 1 -and $_.Index -gt $deferred[0].Index -and
        $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $root[0].RequestId -and
        $_.Attempt -eq $root[0].PreparationAttemptId -and
        $_.QaFaultRelation -eq 'Retry' -and $_.State -eq 'Resumed' -and
        $_.Reason -eq $entry.Value -and
        $_.EventVersion -gt $deferred[0].EventVersion
      }
    )
    if ($root.Count -ne 1 -or $deferred.Count -ne 1 -or $resumed.Count -ne 1) {
      throw "Typed deferral fault lacks one exact deferred/resumed chain for $($entry.Key) on $($device.Serial)"
    }
  }

  $forcedRepairFault = @(
    $appliedFaults | Where-Object Fault -eq 'ForceRepairWithoutPreparedDeck'
  )
  $forcedActiveSubmission = @(
    $deckEvents | Where-Object {
      $forcedRepairFault.Count -eq 1 -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $forcedRepairFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.RepairAttempt -eq $forcedRepairFault[0].RepairAttemptId -and
      $_.Role -eq 'Active' -and $_.Prepared -and
      $_.Active -eq $_.Generation
    }
  )
  if ($forcedRepairFault.Count -ne 1 -or $forcedActiveSubmission.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Forced repair did not submit one prepared Active deck for its exact attempt on $($device.Serial)"
  }

  $relocationFault = @(
    $appliedFaults |
      Where-Object Fault -eq 'DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement'
  )
  $delayedAcknowledged = @(
    $relocationEvents | Where-Object {
      $relocationFault.Count -eq 1 -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $relocationFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.Token -eq $relocationFault[0].RelocationToken -and
      $_.State -eq 'Acknowledged'
    }
  )
  $delayedCompleted = @(
    $relocationEvents | Where-Object {
      $relocationFault.Count -eq 1 -and
      $_.QaFaultRequestId -eq $relocationFault[0].RequestId -and
      $_.Token -eq $relocationFault[0].RelocationToken -and
      $_.State -eq 'Completed'
    }
  )
  if ($relocationFault.Count -ne 1 -or
      $delayedAcknowledged.Count -ne 1 -or $delayedCompleted.Count -ne 1 -or
      $delayedAcknowledged[0].Index -ge $delayedCompleted[0].Index) {
    throw "Delayed relocation did not acknowledge and complete its exact FIFO token on $($device.Serial)"
  }

  $diagnosticName = "manual-diagnostics-$($device.SafeSerial).txt"
  $diagnosticPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot $diagnosticName
  $diagnosticRecords = @(
    @($downstreamEvents + $qaFaultEvents) |
      Sort-Object Index |
      Select-Object -ExpandProperty LogLine
  )
  Assert-ReaderDiagnosticRecordSet `
    -Records $diagnosticRecords `
    -Context "manual diagnostics before write $($device.Serial)"
  $diagnosticRecords | Set-Content -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath
  Assert-ReaderDiagnosticRecordSet `
    -Records @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath) `
    -Context "manual diagnostics after write $($device.Serial)"
  $diagnosticManifest += [pscustomobject]@{
    AcceptanceId = $runStart.AcceptanceId
    GitCommit = $apkEvidence.GitCommit
    ApkSha256 = $apkEvidence.ApkSha256
    DeviceSerial = $device.Serial
    DeviceClass = $device.Class
    Pid = [int]$pid
    IntervalStartedUtc = $intervalStartedUtc
    IntervalFinishedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    RawPidIntervalSha256 = $rawIntervalSha256
    ParsedArtifact = $diagnosticName
    ParsedArtifactSha256 = (
      Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath
    ).Hash
    ParsedArtifactBytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath).Length
    WarmSessions = $warmSessions
    TypedDeferralSessions = @($typedGroups.Name)
    RepairSessions = $repairSessions
    AppliedFaultRequestIds = $appliedFaultRequestIds
    ReleaseLinks = $releaseLinks
    ClearLink = [pscustomobject]@{
      FaultRequestId = $clearQueuedCommand[0].RequestId
      ClearRequestId = $clearCommand[0].RequestId
    }
    VisualTimeoutCount = $timeouts.Count
    RelocationCount = $queued.Count
  }
  $diagnosticManifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 |
    Set-Content (Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'manual-diagnostic-manifest.json')
}
$faultCommands = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'fault-command-manifest.json'
) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
$diagnosticRecords = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'manual-diagnostic-manifest.json'
) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
$faultEvidence = @(
  foreach ($fault in $faultCommands) {
    $diagnostic = @($diagnosticRecords | Where-Object {
      $_.DeviceSerial -ceq $fault.DeviceSerial
    })
    if ($diagnostic.Count -ne 1) {
      throw "Fault evidence lacks one device diagnostic: $($fault.DeviceSerial)"
    }
    [ordered]@{
      AcceptanceId = $fault.AcceptanceId
      GitCommit = $fault.GitCommit
      ApkSha256 = $fault.ApkSha256
      DeviceSerial = $fault.DeviceSerial
      DeviceClass = $fault.DeviceClass
      RequestId = $fault.RequestId
      Command = $fault.Command
      Fault = $fault.Fault
      Segment = $fault.Segment
      ChecklistItems = $fault.ChecklistItems
      SentUtc = $fault.SentUtc
      AcknowledgedUtc = $fault.AcknowledgedUtc
      Acknowledgement = $fault.Acknowledgement
      DiagnosticArtifact = $diagnostic[0].ParsedArtifact
      DiagnosticSha256 = $diagnostic[0].ParsedArtifactSha256
      RawPidIntervalSha256 = $diagnostic[0].RawPidIntervalSha256
    }
  }
)
Write-ReaderAtomicJson -Path (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'fault-evidence-manifest.json'
) -Value $faultEvidence -Depth 8 -NoReplace
$acceptance = Complete-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'manual'
```

Use each segment only for its mapped items and let the command pull it immediately after recording. A missing segment or missing checklist mapping blocks the device result.

Use a second PowerShell window for deterministic faults while recording:

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts
eader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$acceptanceRootText = (
  Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer -Raw
).Trim()
$acceptanceRoot = Assert-ReaderPathUnderValidation $acceptanceRootText
$runStart = Get-Content -LiteralPath (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'run-start.json'
) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$targets = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'device-targets.json'
) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
if ($runStart.GitCommit -cne $task15.GateCommit -or
    $runStart.ApkSha256 -cne $task15.ApkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
    $runStart.Task15ReceiptSha256 -cne $task15.ReceiptSha256) {
  throw 'Active manual phase is not bound to the current Task 15 bundle.'
}
$acceptance = [pscustomobject]@{
  Context = $task15; Root = $acceptanceRoot
  RunStart = $runStart; Targets = $targets
}
Assert-ReaderAcceptancePhaseActive $acceptance 'manual'
$apkEvidence = $task15.ApkEvidence
$apkPath = $task15.ApkPath
$receiver = 'darkaxt.navic.readerdev/paige.navic.androidApp.ReaderPageQaFaultReceiver'
$action = 'darkaxt.navic.readerdev.READER_QA_FAULT'
$faultManifestPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'fault-command-manifest.json'
$faultEntries = @(
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $faultManifestPath -PathType Leaf) {
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $faultManifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  }
)
function Save-FaultManifest {
  $temporary =
    "$faultManifestPath.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
  @($script:faultEntries) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 |
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $temporary
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $faultManifestPath -PathType Leaf) {
    $backup = "$faultManifestPath.backup"
    [IO.File]::Replace(
      (Resolve-Path $temporary).Path,
      (Resolve-Path $faultManifestPath).Path,
      [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($backup)
    )
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $backup -Force
  } else {
    Move-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Destination $faultManifestPath
  }
}
function Get-FaultTarget([string] $DeviceSerial) {
  $matches = @($targets | Where-Object Serial -eq $DeviceSerial)
  if ($matches.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Fault target is absent or ambiguous: $DeviceSerial"
  }
  return $matches[0]
}
function Assert-FaultApkFrozen {
  if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $apkPath).Hash -ne
        $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
      (Get-Item -LiteralPath $apkPath).Length -ne $apkEvidence.ApkBytes) {
    throw 'Frozen APK changed during fault matrix'
  }
}
function Wait-ReaderFaultAck(
  [string] $DeviceSerial,
  [string] $ExpectedPattern,
  [string] $RejectedPattern = ''
) {
  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(10)
  do {
    $pid = (adb -s $DeviceSerial shell pidof darkaxt.navic.readerdev |
      Out-String).Trim()
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $pid -notmatch '^\d+$') {
      throw "ReaderDev PID is unavailable for fault acknowledgement on $DeviceSerial"
    }
    $logLines = @(adb -s $DeviceSerial logcat -d --pid=$pid -v brief `
      -s ReaderPageQaFault:I '*:S')
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
      throw "Fault acknowledgement logcat failed on $DeviceSerial"
    }
    $log = $logLines | Out-String
    if ($RejectedPattern) {
      $rejected = [regex]::Match($log, $RejectedPattern)
      if ($rejected.Success) {
        throw "Fault receiver rejected command on ${DeviceSerial}: $($rejected.Value)"
      }
    }
    $accepted = [regex]::Match($log, $ExpectedPattern)
    if ($accepted.Success) { return $accepted.Value }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
  } while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline)
  throw "Fault receiver acknowledgement missing on ${DeviceSerial}: $ExpectedPattern"
}
function Add-FaultEvidence(
  [object] $Target,
  [string] $RequestId,
  [string] $Command,
  [string] $Fault,
  [string] $Segment,
  [int[]] $ChecklistItems,
  [string] $SentUtc,
  [string] $Acknowledgement
) {
  $script:faultEntries += [pscustomobject]@{
    AcceptanceId = $runStart.AcceptanceId
    GitCommit = $apkEvidence.GitCommit
    ApkSha256 = $apkEvidence.ApkSha256
    DeviceSerial = $Target.Serial
    DeviceClass = $Target.Class
    RequestId = $RequestId
    Command = $Command
    Fault = $Fault
    Segment = $Segment
    ChecklistItems = $ChecklistItems
    SentUtc = $SentUtc
    AcknowledgedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    Acknowledgement = $Acknowledgement
  }
  Save-FaultManifest
}
function Add-ReaderFault(
  [string] $DeviceSerial,
  [string] $Fault,
  [string] $Segment,
  [int[]] $ChecklistItems
) {
  Assert-FaultApkFrozen
  $target = Get-FaultTarget $DeviceSerial
  $requestId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
  $sentUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  adb -s $DeviceSerial shell am broadcast -n $receiver -a $action `
    --es requestId $requestId --es command enqueue --es fault $Fault
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Fault enqueue failed on ${DeviceSerial}: $Fault"
  }
  $faultPattern = [regex]::Escape($Fault)
  $ack = Wait-ReaderFaultAck `
    -DeviceSerial $DeviceSerial `
    -ExpectedPattern "requestId=$requestId fault=$faultPattern accepted=true" `
    -RejectedPattern "requestId=$requestId fault=$faultPattern accepted=false"
  Add-FaultEvidence `
    -Target $target `
    -RequestId $requestId `
    -Command 'enqueue' `
    -Fault $Fault `
    -Segment $Segment `
    -ChecklistItems $ChecklistItems `
    -SentUtc $sentUtc `
    -Acknowledgement $ack
}
function Invoke-ReaderFaultCommand(
  [string] $DeviceSerial,
  [string] $Command,
  [string] $Segment,
  [int[]] $ChecklistItems
) {
  Assert-FaultApkFrozen
  $target = Get-FaultTarget $DeviceSerial
  $requestId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
  $sentUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  adb -s $DeviceSerial shell am broadcast -n $receiver -a $action `
    --es requestId $requestId --es command $Command
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Fault command failed on ${DeviceSerial}: $Command"
  }
  $result = switch ($Command) {
    'release-publication' {
      @{ Accepted = 'releasePublication=true'; Rejected = 'releasePublication=false' }
    }
    'release-relocation' {
      @{ Accepted = 'releaseRelocation=true'; Rejected = 'releaseRelocation=false' }
    }
    'release-visual-state' {
      @{ Accepted = 'releaseVisualState=true'; Rejected = 'releaseVisualState=false' }
    }
    'clear' { @{ Accepted = 'cleared=true'; Rejected = 'cleared=false' } }
    default { throw "Unknown fault command: $Command" }
  }
  $ack = Wait-ReaderFaultAck `
    -DeviceSerial $DeviceSerial `
    -ExpectedPattern "requestId=$requestId $($result.Accepted)" `
    -RejectedPattern "requestId=$requestId $($result.Rejected)"
  Add-FaultEvidence `
    -Target $target `
    -RequestId $requestId `
    -Command $Command `
    -Fault '' `
    -Segment $Segment `
    -ChecklistItems $ChecklistItems `
    -SentUtc $sentUtc `
    -Acknowledgement $ack
}
```

Before starting each target's checklist, set `$serial = $device.Serial` for the device whose recording is active. Every fault helper requires that serial plus the exact segment/checklist mapping, verifies the frozen APK, waits for a request-correlated acknowledgement from the same device, and atomically rewrites the acceptance root's structured `fault-command-manifest.json`. Do not proceed to the next checklist action if the same-device acknowledgement is absent.

While recording, perform in this order on each target:

1. Cold open: use the fresh app-data state and ReaderDev launch established by the checklist script before PID capture; immediately begin the `core-ltr` recording, open the prepared chapter if the setup path has not already done so, and verify the cover remains until the required chapter rasters are durable and the active deck is prepared. Do not clear app data again inside the PID-stable checklist interval.
2. Warm reopen: close and reopen the same chapter; verify diagnostics report persistent hydration and zero preview recaptures for valid protected pages.
3. LTR portrait: slow forward drag, slow backward drag, forward fling, backward fling, release below commit threshold for snap-back, and two rapid consecutive committed turns.
4. LTR landscape: repeat direct drag, fling, snap-back, and consecutive turns; verify one leaf turns at a time and the center gutter remains stable.
5. First and last boundaries: attempt to drag and fling beyond each boundary; verify `RejectedBoundary`, no Foliate relocation, and no duplicate page identity becomes navigable.
6. RTL portrait and landscape: change the reader direction to RTL through reader settings; verify physical drag/fling maps to the same logical previous/next commands as taps.
7. Arbitration: vertical drag scroll/movement remains with content, a long press still selects/opens the long-press action, and movement below touch slop does not start curl.
8. Rotation and resize: rotate during ready state, during a partial drag, and while a relocation awaits handoff; verify explicit lifecycle cancellation where required and successful re-preparation.
9. Background/resume: background during ready, partial drag, and settlement; resume without stale frame or invisible blocked state.
10. GL recreation: background long enough to recreate GL or use the emulator's activity recreation control; verify a matching generation is prepared before input resumes.
11. Repeated open/close spot-check: manually close and reopen once and verify there is no visible stale state. The mandatory ten-cycle ownership proof is scripted in Step 6; review all ten zero-valued `ownership-after-close-*.txt` artifacts rather than relying on manual counting.
12. Visual handoff: on every ordinary turn, verify there is no preparation cover, blank flash, stale WebView frame, or visible content replacement between GL settlement and Foliate.
13. Persistence failure: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault FailNextPersistence -Segment publication-repair -ChecklistItems @(13)`, trigger preparation, verify visible retryable failure, then retry and verify already durable pages are not recaptured.
14. Publication epoch: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault PauseNextPublication -Segment publication-repair -ChecklistItems @(14)`, trigger preparation, rotate or change the raster profile to invalidate it, then call `Invoke-ReaderFaultCommand -DeviceSerial $serial -Command release-publication -Segment publication-repair -ChecklistItems @(14)`; verify the old completion is rejected and the new epoch alone becomes ready.
15. Typed deferrals: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault DeferContentNotReady -Segment typed-deferrals -ChecklistItems @(15)`, trigger preparation and its content-ready event, then repeat with `DeferLayoutUnstable`, `DeferPaginationNotReady`, `DeferWebViewDetached`, and `DeferReaderPaused`, always passing the same segment/checklist mapping and triggering only the matching lifecycle event. Verify no case becomes invisible and input-blocked.
16. Active repair recovery: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault MissNextRasterLoad -Segment publication-repair -ChecklistItems @(16)` and `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault ForceRepairWithoutPreparedDeck -Segment publication-repair -ChecklistItems @(16)`, turn into the missing far edge, verify diagnostics show `Active` recovery, input remains blocked before the matching prepared generation, and input resumes afterward.
17. Delayed relocation: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement -Segment relocation-handoff-clear -ChecklistItems @(17)`, commit one turn, commit a second turn against the promoted prepared deck, then call `Invoke-ReaderFaultCommand -DeviceSerial $serial -Command release-relocation -Segment relocation-handoff-clear -ChecklistItems @(17)`; verify FIFO token order and final ordinal.
18. Missing visual callback: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault DelayNextVisualStateCallback -Segment relocation-handoff-clear -ChecklistItems @(18)`, commit a turn, wait for the handoff timeout, and verify the GL shield remains visible while retryable recovery is reported. Send `Invoke-ReaderFaultCommand -DeviceSerial $serial -Command release-visual-state -Segment relocation-handoff-clear -ChecklistItems @(18)` and require `releaseVisualState=true`; then trigger attach/resume or matching re-preparation, verify the durable capacity edge admits the retry, and verify recovery completes without a stale flash. Preserve both the enqueue/release acknowledgements and the timeout diagnostic in the fault-command evidence.
19. Clear faults: call `Add-ReaderFault -DeviceSerial $serial -Fault FailNextPersistence -Segment relocation-handoff-clear -ChecklistItems @(19)` but do not trigger persistence. Immediately call `Invoke-ReaderFaultCommand -DeviceSerial $serial -Command clear -Segment relocation-handoff-clear -ChecklistItems @(19)`. Require exactly one `Cleared` event for that queued request with all operation fields absent and `releaseRequestId` equal to the clear command request; then trigger ordinary persistence and prove the cleared fault does not apply. A subsequent `release-publication` probe must return `false` and is captured as an expected rejection rather than a successful fault-manifest entry.
20. Rollback: disable the curl/page-turn-canvas setting and verify ordinary non-curl page navigation remains usable.

Before clearing each target's log, persist the complete PID-scoped checklist interval, dot-source `scripts/reader-playlikecurl-qa-parser.ps1`, resolve the process-local reader session from that interval, and run `Assert-WarmReopenUsesPersistentHydration`, `Assert-TypedDeferralsResumeOnNewerEvent`, and `Assert-RepairAttemptReachesSubmission`. The active-repair segment must also contain a `reader-deck` submission with `role=Active` after that repair's `Ready` event; compare the shared raster generation and ordering rather than storing a role in the repair result. Any missing, duplicate, stale-version, recapture, or out-of-order event fails the device checklist even if the visual recording appears correct. Save the parsed acquisition, preparation, repair, and deck lines and their SHA-256 hashes in the per-device fault-command manifest.

The loop pulls every named segment into the active resumable acceptance root and writes `manual-video-manifest.json` with commit/APK binding, device, checklist-item, timestamp, artifact, SHA-256, and byte-count mappings. It then requires an explicit `PASS` or `FAIL` review for every mapped checklist item and persists `manual-checklist-results.json`; any `FAIL` stops the gate. Execute the matching fault commands from the second PowerShell window during the segment that names those items. Do not proceed to the next target until all five artifacts exist and every checklist item applicable to the current device is represented by a `PASS` result.

Expected: interaction matches the modest Google Play Books behavioral target on both device classes; no pixel-perfect comparison is required.

- [ ] **Step 6: Run resource stress on both emulator and physical device**

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts
eader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$targets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)
$acceptance = Open-ReaderAcceptance $task15 $targets
$phase = Start-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'stress'
if ($phase.AlreadyComplete) {
  Write-Host 'Stress phase already sealed; exact-prefix resume skips it.'
  return
}
$acceptance = $phase.Session
$acceptanceRoot = $acceptance.Root
$targets = $acceptance.Targets
$apkEvidence = $task15.ApkEvidence
$envFile = (Resolve-Path .indery-debug.env).Path
foreach ($device in @($targets)) {
  Assert-ReaderSealedApk $task15
  $artifactRoot = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot `
    "stress-$($device.Class)-$($device.SafeSerial)"
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactRoot) {
    throw "Stress phase owns an unexpected pre-existing root: $artifactRoot"
  }
  pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `
    .\scripts\adb-reader-playlikecurl-qa.ps1 `
    -DeviceSerial $device.Serial `
    -EnvFile $envFile `
    -SealedApkPath $task15.ApkPath `
    -ExpectedApkSha256 $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 `
    -ExpectedApkBytes $apkEvidence.ApkBytes `
    -ExpectedVersionCode $apkEvidence.VersionCode `
    -ExpectedVersionName $apkEvidence.VersionName `
    -NoInstall `
    -ArtifactRoot $artifactRoot `
    -StressTurns 100 `
    -OpenCloseCycles 10
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "ReaderDev resource stress failed on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $run = Get-Content (Join-Path $artifactRoot 'run-complete.json') -Raw |
    ConvertFrom-Json
  if ($run.GitCommit -ne $apkEvidence.GitCommit -or
      $run.EvidenceMode -ne 'FrozenCommit' -or
      $null -ne $run.CandidateTreeSha256 -or
      $run.ApkSha256 -ne $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
      $run.ApkBytes -ne $apkEvidence.ApkBytes -or
      $run.VersionCode -ne $apkEvidence.VersionCode -or
      $run.VersionName -cne $apkEvidence.VersionName -or
      -not [bool]$run.NoInstall -or
      $run.DeviceSerial -ne $device.Serial) {
    throw "Resource-stress evidence is not frozen/device-bound on $($device.Serial)"
  }
}
$acceptance = Complete-ReaderAcceptancePhase $acceptance 'stress'
```

Expected after warmup:

- every residency, staged-publication, lease, texture, callback, and relocation-token count is at or below the limit emitted by its enforcing owner;
- residency peak fields are also at or below the emitted resident and identity-distinct decoded-bitmap limits;
- after the first ten peak-preparation and steady-state samples, no ownership category establishes a new high-water mark;
- orphan deck leases remain zero at cold-start, peak preparation, steady state, and close;
- evictions and releases are recorded for diagnosis without being used as substitute ownership bounds;
- no double release, recycled-bitmap use, `OutOfMemoryError`, or fatal GL error;
- cold-start, all peak-preparation samples, all steady-state samples, and each of ten all-zero after-close snapshots are persisted as evidence;
- disk cache remains within its configured byte limit.

- [ ] **Step 7: Exclusively seal the completed phase prefix and write the frozen-commit validation report**

Hold the exclusive acceptance lock while validating completeness and publishing `run-complete.json`. If completion already exists, re-inventory it without mutating the evidence root and regenerate only the report:

```powershell
      throw "Fault command has no exact video segment on $($device.Serial)"
    }
    $sentTime = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$entry[0].SentUtc)
    $ackTime = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$entry[0].AcknowledgedUtc)
    $segmentStart = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
      [string]$segmentVideo[0].StartedAtUtc
    )
    $segmentEnd = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
      [string]$segmentVideo[0].FinishedAtUtc
    )
    if ($sentTime -lt $segmentStart -or $ackTime -lt $sentTime -or
        $ackTime -gt $segmentEnd) {
      throw "Fault command acknowledgement is outside its mapped video segment on $($device.Serial)"
    }
  }
  if (@($deviceFaults | Where-Object {
      $_.AcceptanceId -ne $runStart.AcceptanceId -or
      $_.GitCommit -ne $apkEvidence.GitCommit -or
      $_.ApkSha256 -ne $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
      $_.DeviceClass -ne $device.Class -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.RequestId) -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.SentUtc) -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.AcknowledgedUtc) -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.Segment) -or
      @($_.ChecklistItems).Count -eq 0 -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.Acknowledgement) -or
      -not $_.Acknowledgement.Contains("requestId=$($_.RequestId)")
    }).Count -ne 0) {
    throw "Fault command binding is incomplete on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $diagnostic = @(
    $diagnostics | Where-Object DeviceSerial -eq $device.Serial
  )
  if ($diagnostic.Count -ne 1 -or
      $diagnostic[0].AcceptanceId -ne $runStart.AcceptanceId -or
      $diagnostic[0].GitCommit -ne $apkEvidence.GitCommit -or
      $diagnostic[0].ApkSha256 -ne $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
      $diagnostic[0].DeviceClass -ne $device.Class -or
      [int]$diagnostic[0].Pid -le 0 -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($diagnostic[0].IntervalStartedUtc) -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($diagnostic[0].IntervalFinishedUtc) -or
      $diagnostic[0].RawPidIntervalSha256 -notmatch '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}$' -or
      @($diagnostic[0].WarmSessions).Count -lt 1 -or
      @($diagnostic[0].TypedDeferralSessions).Count -lt 1 -or
      @($diagnostic[0].RepairSessions).Count -lt 1 -or
      @($diagnostic[0].AppliedFaultRequestIds).Count -ne 11 -or
      @($diagnostic[0].ReleaseLinks).Count -ne 3 -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($diagnostic[0].ClearLink.FaultRequestId) -or
      [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($diagnostic[0].ClearLink.ClearRequestId) -or
      $diagnostic[0].VisualTimeoutCount -ne 1 -or
      $diagnostic[0].RelocationCount -lt 2) {
    throw "Manual diagnostic proof is incomplete on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $clearFaultEntry = @($deviceFaults | Where-Object {
    $_.Command -eq 'enqueue' -and $_.Fault -eq 'FailNextPersistence' -and
    $_.Segment -eq 'relocation-handoff-clear'
  })
  $clearEntry = @($deviceFaults | Where-Object Command -eq 'clear')
  if ($clearFaultEntry.Count -ne 1 -or $clearEntry.Count -ne 1 -or
      $diagnostic[0].ClearLink.FaultRequestId -ne
        $clearFaultEntry[0].RequestId -or
      $diagnostic[0].ClearLink.ClearRequestId -ne $clearEntry[0].RequestId) {
    throw "Clear diagnostic link is not command-correlated on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $expectedAppliedRequestIds = @(
    $deviceFaults | Where-Object {
      $_.Command -eq 'enqueue' -and
      -not ($_.Fault -eq 'FailNextPersistence' -and
        $_.Segment -eq 'relocation-handoff-clear')
    } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RequestId | Sort-Object
  )
  $actualAppliedRequestIds = @(
    $diagnostic[0].AppliedFaultRequestIds | Sort-Object
  )
  if (@(Compare-Object $expectedAppliedRequestIds $actualAppliedRequestIds).Count -ne 0) {
    throw "Applied fault diagnostics do not match enqueued request IDs on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  $expectedReleaseLinks = @(
    [pscustomobject]@{
      Fault = 'PauseNextPublication'
      Command = 'release-publication'
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
      Fault = 'DelayNextRelocationAcknowledgement'
      Command = 'release-relocation'
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
      Fault = 'DelayNextVisualStateCallback'
      Command = 'release-visual-state'
    }
  )
  foreach ($expectedLink in $expectedReleaseLinks) {
    $faultEntry = @($deviceFaults | Where-Object {
      $_.Command -eq 'enqueue' -and $_.Fault -eq $expectedLink.Fault
    })
    $releaseEntry = @($deviceFaults | Where-Object {
      $_.Command -eq $expectedLink.Command
    })
    $actualLink = @($diagnostic[0].ReleaseLinks | Where-Object {
      $_.Fault -eq $expectedLink.Fault -and
      $_.Command -eq $expectedLink.Command
    })
    if ($faultEntry.Count -ne 1 -or $releaseEntry.Count -ne 1 -or
        $actualLink.Count -ne 1 -or
        $actualLink[0].FaultRequestId -ne $faultEntry[0].RequestId -or
        $actualLink[0].ReleaseRequestId -ne $releaseEntry[0].RequestId) {
      throw "Fault release diagnostics are not command-correlated on $($device.Serial): $($expectedLink.Fault)"
    }
  }
  $diagnosticPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot `
    $diagnostic[0].ParsedArtifact
  if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath).Hash -ne
        $diagnostic[0].ParsedArtifactSha256 -or
      (Get-Item -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath).Length -ne
        $diagnostic[0].ParsedArtifactBytes) {
    throw "Manual diagnostic artifact is invalid on $($device.Serial)"
  }
  Assert-ReaderDiagnosticRecordSet `
    -Records @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $diagnosticPath) `
    -Context "frozen manual diagnostics $($device.Serial)"
}
$expectedFaultEvidence = @(

$installedAfterSeal = Get-ReaderInstalledPackageSet `

$artifactHashes = @(Get-ReaderRootInventory $acceptanceRoot)
$completion = [ordered]@{
```
