The report is generated from the already validated immutable manifests; do not hand-edit it. It must contain:

```markdown
# Reader PlayLikeCurl QA Remediation Validation

- Validated implementation commit: `NavicCommit` from the schema-2 receipt selected by `.codex-validation/task15-automated-gate-receipt.current.txt`
- Frozen APK: sealed bundle path plus source-output path, application ID, variant, version code/name, SHA-256, byte count, build start/completion timestamps, and AGP output-metadata SHA-256 from the commit-keyed Task 15 bundle
- Evidence run: acceptance ID, resumable acceptance-root path, exact completed-phase prefix, start/completion timestamps, `run-complete.json` SHA-256, and artifact count
- Evidence-commit policy: this report is committed as the only changed path in a documentation-only child of the validated implementation commit; runtime artifacts and release readiness remain tied to the immutable parent implementation commit
- Automated gates: focused host PASS; PlayLikeCurl PASS; complete full-host inventory/no-new-failure-occurrence PASS; ReaderDev manifest isolation PASS; ReaderDev assemble PASS
- Devices: manufacturer/model/API/serial class plus each `installed-package-*.json` path and SHA-256; temporary pulls prove installed APK hash/bytes/version before and after every phase without persisting duplicate APK bytes
- Functional matrix: cold, warm, drag, fling, snap-back, rapid turns, portrait, landscape, LTR, RTL, boundaries, rotation, resume, GL recreation, open/close, rollback; reference `manual-video-manifest.json` and `manual-checklist-results.json` with all 20 items PASS per device
- Fault matrix: persistence failure/retry, old-epoch publication release, all five typed deferrals, active repair without usable deck, delayed relocation acknowledgement, and missing visual callback recovery; reference `fault-evidence-manifest.json`, enumerate every request ID, and map each to its device, segment, checklist items, acknowledgement, parsed diagnostic artifact, and hashes
- Resource matrix: 100-turn before/after memory; cold-start/peak/steady ownership streams; every owner-provided bound; adapter resident/unique-decoded/peak/pinned/evicted/released; active/pending/release-in-flight/orphan leases; textures; pending callbacks; relocation reservations/queued tokens; no post-warmup high-water growth; ten zero-valued after-close snapshots; disk entries/bytes
- Visual result: no ordinary-turn preparation cover or stale WebView flash; basic Google Play Books interaction target met
- Known baseline failures: exact occurrence count, tracked baseline metadata path, baseline inventory/failure SHA-256 values, and zero new failure occurrence
- Privacy check: persisted diagnostics contain no EPUB text, raster pixels/payloads/labels, rendered bitmap bytes, credentials, Whispersync transcript, annotations, selected text, URL, href, CFI, book ID, or user identifier used as reader-session ID
- Release verdict: PASS only when every mandatory gate above passed on the named validated implementation commit and the exclusively published completion manifest passes post-completion re-inventory; the documentation-only child report commit is not a separately validated runtime candidate
```

Do not claim PASS for a device or scenario that was skipped. If no physical device is attached, the release verdict remains blocked and the task remains incomplete.

- [ ] **Step 8: Commit the report as a documentation-only child and preserve the validated parent identity**

```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
. .\scripts\reader-playlikecurl-acceptance-state.ps1
$task15 = Get-ReaderTask15Bundle
$preflightTargets = @(Get-ReaderAcceptanceTargets)
$opened = Open-ReaderAcceptance $task15 $preflightTargets
$reportSealLock = Enter-ReaderAcceptanceLock
try {
$report = 'docs/superpowers/reports/2026-07-18-reader-playlikecurl-qa-remediation-validation.md'
$validatedImplementationCommit = $task15.GateCommit
$currentCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
    $validatedImplementationCommit -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -or
    $currentCommit -ne $validatedImplementationCommit) {
  throw 'Report must be committed directly on the validated implementation commit'
}
function Assert-ReportMutationIdentity {
  param(
    [string] $ExpectedHead,
    [string] $ExpectedRemote,
    [switch] $AllowReportDelta
  )

  $top = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel | Out-String).Trim()
  $topExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $branch = (git branch --show-current).Trim()
  $branchExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  $headExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $fetch = @(git remote get-url --all fork)
  $fetchExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $push = @(git remote get-url --push --all fork)
  $pushExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $remote = @(git ls-remote --refs fork `
    refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation)
  $remoteExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $status = @(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)
  $statusExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $unexpectedStatus = @($status | Where-Object {
    if ($_ -match '^\?\? \.codex-validation/') { return $false }
    if (-not $AllowReportDelta -or $_.Length -lt 4) { return $true }
    return $_.Substring(3).Replace('\', '/') -ne $report
  })
  if ($topExit -ne 0 -or $branchExit -ne 0 -or $headExit -ne 0 -or
      $fetchExit -ne 0 -or $pushExit -ne 0 -or $remoteExit -ne 0 -or
      $statusExit -ne 0 -or
      (Resolve-Path $top).Path -ne (Resolve-Path '.').Path -or
      $branch -ne 'reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation' -or
      $head -ne $ExpectedHead -or
      $fetch.Count -ne 1 -or
      $fetch[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/Navic(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $push.Count -ne 1 -or
      $push[0] -notmatch '(?i)^(?:https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)Darkaxt/Navic(?:\.git)?/?$' -or
      $remote.Count -ne 1 -or
      ($remote[0] -split '\s+')[0] -ne $ExpectedRemote -or
      $unexpectedStatus.Count -ne 0) {
    throw 'Validation report mutation identity is invalid'
  }
}
$pointerRoot = (
  Get-Content -LiteralPath $script:ReaderAcceptancePointer -Raw
).Trim()
if ((Assert-ReaderPathUnderValidation $pointerRoot) -cne $opened.Root) {
  throw 'Acceptance pointer changed before report staging lock acquisition.'
}
$acceptance = Assert-ReaderAcceptanceRoot `
  $task15 $opened.Root $preflightTargets
$completion = Assert-ReaderAcceptanceCompletion $acceptance
$acceptanceRoot = $acceptance.Root
$completionPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'run-complete.json'
$completionShaPath = Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'run-complete.sha256.txt'
$completionSha = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $completionShaPath -Raw).Trim()
$apkEvidence = $task15.ApkEvidence
if ($completion.GitCommit -ne $validatedImplementationCommit -or
    $completion.ApkSha256 -ne $apkEvidence.ApkSha256 -or
    (Get-ReaderHash $completionPath) -cne $completionSha) {
  throw 'Acceptance completion evidence is invalid before report commit'
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $report -PathType Leaf)) {
  throw 'Validation report has not been written'
}
$reportText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw
foreach ($required in @(
    $validatedImplementationCommit,
    $apkEvidence.ApkSha256,
    $completion.AcceptanceId,
    $completionSha,
    $apkEvidence.ApkRelativePath,
    $apkEvidence.ApplicationId,
    $apkEvidence.Variant,
    [string]$apkEvidence.VersionCode,
    [string]$apkEvidence.VersionName,
    [string]$apkEvidence.ApkBytes,
    $apkEvidence.OutputMetadataSha256,
    [string]$completion.StartedUtc,
    [string]$completion.CompletedUtc,
    [string](@($completion.Artifacts).Count)
)) {
  if (-not $reportText.Contains([string]$required)) {
    throw "Validation report omits required frozen evidence value: $required"
  }
}
$requiredSections = @(
  '# Reader PlayLikeCurl QA Remediation Validation'
  '## Automated gates — PASS'
  '## Devices — PASS'
  '## Functional and visual matrix — PASS'
  '## Fault matrix — PASS'
  '## Resource matrix — PASS'
  '## Baseline and privacy — PASS'
  '## Release verdict — PASS'
)
foreach ($section in $requiredSections) {
  if ([regex]::Matches(
      $reportText,
      "(?m)^$([regex]::Escape($section))`r?$"
    ).Count -ne 1) {
    throw "Validation report section is absent or duplicated: $section"
  }
}
$forbiddenReportTokens = @(
  ('TB' + 'D')
  ('TO' + 'DO')
  'SKIPPED'
  'BLOCKED'
  'UNKNOWN'
)
$forbiddenReportPattern = '(?im)\b(' + (@(
  $forbiddenReportTokens | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
) -join '|') + ')\b'
if ($reportText -match $forbiddenReportPattern) {
  throw 'Validation report contains a placeholder or non-PASS status'
}
$targets = @(Get-Content (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'device-targets.json'
) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
foreach ($device in $targets) {
  foreach ($value in @(
      $device.Serial,
      $device.Class,
      $device.Manufacturer,
      $device.Model,
      [string]$device.Api,
      "installed-package-$($device.SafeSerial).json"
  )) {
    if (-not $reportText.Contains([string]$value)) {
      throw "Validation report omits device evidence value: $value"
    }
  }
}
$faultEvidence = @(Get-Content (
  Join-Path $acceptanceRoot 'fault-evidence-manifest.json'
) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
$expectedFaultsPerTarget = 16
if ($faultEvidence.Count -ne ($targets.Count * $expectedFaultsPerTarget)) {
  throw 'Fault evidence manifest count changed before report commit'
}
foreach ($fault in $faultEvidence) {
  foreach ($value in @(
      $fault.RequestId,
      $fault.DeviceSerial,
      $fault.Command,
      $fault.Fault,
      $fault.Segment,
      $fault.Acknowledgement,
      $fault.DiagnosticArtifact,
      $fault.DiagnosticSha256,
      $fault.RawPidIntervalSha256
  ) | Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$_) }) {
    if (-not $reportText.Contains([string]$value)) {
      throw "Validation report omits fault evidence value: $value"
    }
  }
}
foreach ($device in $targets) {
  $requiredRunnerNames = if ($device.Class -eq 'emulator') {
    @(
      'viewport-zfold7-portrait'
      'viewport-zfold7-landscape'
      "stress-$($device.Class)-$($device.SafeSerial)"
    )
  } else {
    @("stress-$($device.Class)-$($device.SafeSerial)")
  }
  foreach ($runnerName in $requiredRunnerNames) {
    if (-not $reportText.Contains($runnerName)) {
      throw "Validation report omits resource runner: $runnerName"
    }
  }
}
git diff --quiet
$trackedExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($trackedExit -gt 1) { throw "Unable to inspect tracked tree (exit=$trackedExit)" }
if ($trackedExit -eq 1) {
  throw 'Unstaged tracked changes exist before the documentation-only evidence commit'
}
git diff --cached --quiet
$indexExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($indexExit -gt 1) { throw "Unable to inspect index (exit=$indexExit)" }
if ($indexExit -eq 1) {
  throw 'Index is not empty before the documentation-only evidence commit'
}
# Re-inventory the completed root immediately before report staging while
# the exclusive seal lock is still held.
$completionBeforeStaging = Assert-ReaderAcceptanceCompletion $acceptance
if ((Get-ReaderHash $completionPath) -cne $completionSha -or
    $completionBeforeStaging.AcceptanceId -cne $completion.AcceptanceId) {
  throw 'Acceptance evidence changed immediately before report staging.'
}
git add -- $report
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Validation report staging failed' }
$stagedStatus = @(git diff --cached --name-status --no-renames)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or @($stagedStatus | Where-Object {
    ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[0] -notin @('A', 'M')
  }).Count -ne 0) {
  throw 'Staged checkpoint contains a deletion, rename, copy, or unsupported status'
}
$staged = @($stagedStatus | ForEach-Object {
  ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[1].Replace('\', '/')
} | Sort-Object -Unique)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
    $staged.Count -ne 1 -or $staged[0].Replace('\', '/') -ne $report) {
  throw 'Only the validation report may be staged for the evidence commit'
}
$untracked = @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to inspect untracked evidence paths' }
$unexpectedUntracked = @(
  $untracked | Where-Object { -not $_.StartsWith('.codex-validation/') }
)
if ($unexpectedUntracked.Count -gt 0) {
  throw "Unexpected untracked paths before evidence commit:`n$($unexpectedUntracked -join "`n")"
}
git diff --cached --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Validation report whitespace check failed' }
git diff --quiet
$unstagedBoundaryExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($unstagedBoundaryExit -ne 0) {
  throw 'Unstaged changes remain before the validation report commit'
}
$boundaryStatus = @(git diff --cached --name-status --no-renames)
$boundaryStatusExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$boundaryPaths = @($boundaryStatus | ForEach-Object {
  ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[1].Replace('\', '/')
} | Sort-Object -Unique)
if ($boundaryStatusExit -ne 0 -or
    @($boundaryStatus | Where-Object {
      ($_ -split '\s+', 2)[0] -notin @('A', 'M')
    }).Count -ne 0 -or
    $boundaryPaths.Count -ne 1 -or $boundaryPaths[0] -ne $report) {
  throw 'Validation report delta changed before commit'
}
Assert-ReportMutationIdentity `
  $validatedImplementationCommit $validatedImplementationCommit `
  -AllowReportDelta
git commit -m 'docs(reader): record PlayLikeCurl remediation validation' -m 'Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Validation report commit failed' }
$evidenceCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$evidenceCommitExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$evidenceSubject = (git log -1 --format=%s $evidenceCommit).Trim()
$evidenceSubjectExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($evidenceCommitExit -ne 0 -or $evidenceSubjectExit -ne 0 -or
    $evidenceCommit -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -or
    $evidenceSubject -ne 'docs(reader): record PlayLikeCurl remediation validation') {
  throw 'Validation report commit ID or subject is invalid'
}
$evidenceParent = (git rev-parse HEAD^).Trim()
$evidenceParentExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($evidenceParentExit -ne 0 -or
    $evidenceParent -ne $validatedImplementationCommit) {
  throw 'Evidence commit parent does not match the validated implementation commit'
}
$evidencePaths = @(
  git diff --name-only "$validatedImplementationCommit..$evidenceCommit"
)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
    $evidencePaths.Count -ne 1 -or
    $evidencePaths[0].Replace('\', '/') -ne $report) {
  throw 'Evidence commit contains a non-documentation change'
}
Assert-ReportMutationIdentity $evidenceCommit $validatedImplementationCommit
git push fork HEAD:reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Validation report push failed' }
$publishedLocal = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$publishedLocalExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$publishedRemoteLines = @(git ls-remote --refs fork `
  refs/heads/reader/playlikecurl-qa-remediation)
$publishedRemoteExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($publishedLocalExit -ne 0 -or $publishedRemoteExit -ne 0 -or
    $publishedRemoteLines.Count -ne 1) {
  throw 'Unable to resolve the published Navic implementation ref'
}
$publishedRemote = ($publishedRemoteLines[0] -split '\s+')[0]
if ($publishedRemote -ne $publishedLocal) {
  throw 'Published Navic implementation ref does not match HEAD'
}
$evidenceCommit | Set-Content .codex-validation\validation-report-commit.txt
} finally {
  $reportSealLock.Dispose()
}
```

Expected: the remote branch contains the immutable validated implementation commit followed by exactly one documentation-only evidence commit; `fork/master` is unchanged. Any APK or release operation must check out the recorded validated implementation parent, not infer runtime validation from the evidence commit. If any non-report path must change, abandon this step, fix and commit it, then restart Tasks 14–16 on the new implementation commit.

---

## Final release checklist

Do not represent the integration as release-ready until every runtime item is checked on one frozen implementation commit. A single documentation-only validation-report child may sit above it, but it does not change or replace the validated runtime identity:

- [ ] All QA-01 through QA-16 behavior tests pass.
- [ ] `:third_party:playlikecurl:karackencurllib:test` passes.
- [ ] Focused reader host tests pass.
- [ ] Full Android host suite has no new failing test identity versus the captured baseline.
- [ ] `ReaderDevEnvironmentContractTest` proves the QA receiver/action exist only in the readerDev merged manifest.
- [ ] `:androidApp:assembleReaderDev` passes.
- [ ] Cold preparation waits for durable current-chapter publication and prepared active deck.
- [ ] Warm reopen uses persistent hydration with zero unnecessary recapture.
- [ ] Portrait/landscape and LTR/RTL drag, fling, snap-back, boundaries, and rapid turns pass.
- [ ] Vertical movement, long press, selection, and taps survive provisional arbitration.
- [ ] Exact relocations are FIFO, tokenized, stale-safe, and not overwritten.
- [ ] GL remains visible until token-matched WebView visual state plus next frame.
- [ ] One hundred turns stay within every owner-provided bound, establish no post-warmup ownership high-water mark, retain zero orphan leases, and ten open/close cycles return all eleven counts to zero.
- [ ] Emulator and physical-device ReaderDev matrices pass.
- [ ] Diagnostics meet the privacy restrictions.
- [ ] Non-curl navigation remains a working rollback path.
- [ ] The evidence report names the validated implementation commit, and its commit changes only that report with the validated implementation commit as its direct parent.
